descripcion: Argentina - Remote Why Valtech? We’re the experience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience. The opportunity At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries. We Are Proud Of: The work we do and the innovation we drive Our values of share, care and dare A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration The role As a Data Scientist , you are passionate about experience innovation and eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible. You bring 4+ YEARS of experience, a growth mindset and a drive to make a lasting impact. Ideal candidates will have strong quantitative backgrounds and both academic/formal analytical skills and demonstrated hands-on experience in statistical modelling and information visualization. While they will have some demonstrated ability to write code, they will not have learned programming languages for the sake of building their resume, but rather as a means to express their intellectual curiosity and analytical voice. Valtech will provide a platform and training to help them reach their full potential. You Will Thrive In This Role If You Are: A curious problem solver who challenges the status quo A collaborator who values teamwork and knowledge-sharing Excited by the intersection of technology, creativity and data Experienced in Agile methodologies and consulting (a plus) Role Responsibilities Design and conduct statistical modeling and analysis based on business-level problem specifications. Lead experimentation and A/B testing to systematically evaluate business hypotheses and inform decision-making. Perform ad hoc and deep-dive analytics to answer business questions, uncover insights, and identify opportunities for impact. Analyze complex, raw datasets with strong analytical rigor and explainability. Define KPIs, reporting workflows, dashboards, and data visualizations to measure outcomes and support strategic business decisions. Translate analytical results into intuitive insights through interactive dashboards (Tableau, Power BI) or custom web applications. Communicate technical concepts, findings, and data-driven recommendations clearly to non-technical stakeholders. Partner directly with stakeholders to understand business needs and translate requirements into analyses, experiments, and actionable recommendations. Gather stakeholder requirements, conduct technical due diligence, and design pragmatic, high-impact analytical solutions. Work autonomously across the end-to-end analytics lifecycle, from problem framing and analysis design through insight delivery. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment on priorities, methodology, and deliverables. Must Have Qualifications To be considered for this role, you must meet the following essential qualifications: Advanced/Fluent English Proven industry experience developing predictive or inferential statistical models OR a Master’s/PhD in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, or similar quantitative field. 4+ years of experience in data science, data engineering, or analytical roles. Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, with the ability to interface with each component in the full pipeline from data ingestion to insight. Hands-on experience with Data Analysis Practical experience with Experimentation / A/B Testing Experience with Data Visualization tools Ability to work with strong autonomy, managing analyses end-to-end Strong communication skills, able to engage directly with stakeholders and translate business needs into analytical work Nice To Have Qualifications Experience with Generative AI Experience with LangChain / LangGraph Experience with AI-powered dashboarding Experience with Metabase Experience with Power BI, Tableau or similar If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn. Commitment to reaching all kinds of people We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all. The Benefits This is a full-time position based in Buenos Aires, Argentina. Beyond a Competitive Compensation Package, We Offer: Flexibility, with remote and hybrid work options (country-dependent) Career advancement, with international mobility and professional development programs Learning and development, with access to cutting-edge tools, training and industry experts Our benefits are tailored to each location. Your Talent Partner will provide full details during the hiring process. Your application process Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. If your skills and experience align with the role, we’ll reach out for next steps. Your CV should cover key information on relevant experiences and expertise. We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential. ⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud: Only engage with official Valtech email addresses. We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know. Tignish, PE C0B 2B0 Looking For CPA Employment Type Full Time Date Posted August 25, 2026 Salary Starting at $90K-$110K Submission Deadline unspecified Location Tignish JOB SUMMARY Reporting to the General Manager, the Corporate Controller will be accountable for the integrity of financial reporting, budgeting and forecasting, cash flow management, the day-to-day leadership of the finance team to support the organization’s long-term business planning. This position requires a strong understanding of accounting principles, financial regulations, and business operations, with a demonstrated commitment to maintaining the financial and ethical integrity of the organization. The Corporate Controller will ensure financial reporting is prepared in accordance with Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) and will maintain compliance with all applicable regulatory requirements and Canadian laws. Our Controller should be a strategic thinker who can translate financial data into actionable insights, drive operational efficiency, and strengthen internal controls and financial processes. OUR TEAM Within our team, we maintain a strong focus on performance, acknowledging and rewarding valuable contributions and recognizing talent. We value individuals that have a genuine passion for learning, a relentless drive for growth, and the vibrant energy needed to propel their career forward – all while being part of a dynamic team. JOB ACCOUNTABILITIES Job Accountabilities outline the responsibilities that an individual has for tasks, projects, and initiatives that they are assigned or involved in. In general, it focuses on being accountable for one’s actions, decisions, and performance, both in terms of achieving objectives and adhering to agreed-upon standards, guidelines, and expectations. General - Providing day to day support and guidance to the finance team - Managing financial operations, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, and payroll, ensuring and preparing accurate and timely financial reporting. - Oversee cash and banking activity, including daily bank monitoring, cheque signing, etc. - Collaborating with the executive team to develop and manage budgets, forecasts, and operational KPIs; analyze financial performance and implement cost-saving measures. - Providing year-end financial information to external accountants, to manage year end costs and achieve deliverables. - Maintain and strengthen internal controls and ensure finance processes are documented and consistently applied. - Oversee accounts receivable and collections, ensuring accurate reporting and timely follow-up, identifying and then implementing improvements to financial processes and systems to enhance operational efficiency and accuracy. - Provide payroll oversight, including processing and reviewing management and staff payrolls. - Support governance requirements, including attending board meetings and maintaining board minutes. - Ensuring compliance with all federal and provincial tax laws and regulations while working with external accountants on any complex tax issues. - Foster positive employee relations within the team through annual performance reviews and handling staff concerns appropriately and effectively. - Provide oversight for company IT (hardware/software/service vendors), ensuring continuity and appropriate access governance. Employee Relations/Team Engagement - Provide leadership to the Finance Team by offering training, coaching/mentoring, guidance, to support their personal development. - Identify challenges/problems and make quick decisions to resolve issues - resulting in errors identified prior to final financial reports being generated. - Develop and foster relationships with other departments encouraging continuous improvement through effective teamwork. - Effectively communicate expectations to employees with an emphasis on developing a high-performance finance team. - In conjunction with Human Resources assist in staff recruitment of new team members, including ensuring an effective and engaging onboarding process. - Foster an environment of open communications/interactions with all team members and other departments. - Performance Management: Identify team development opportunities, set realistic development plans, and provide opportunities for growth. Learning & Development - Actively participate in training provided to support personal development. - Identify personal professional training needs and opportunities for skill enhancement. - Foster a continuous improvement culture with a commitment to excellence - teamwork, finance practices, etc. – with an overall focus on accurate, timely reporting. - Provide guidance and support to employees in setting and achieving their own professional goals. - Stay informed about industry trends and best practices and share relevant information with team for teams’ overall development. QUALIFICATIONS Job Qualifications refer to the required experience, skills, and attributes a position requires. This section outlines the minimum Qualifications the company desires for this role, from leadership skills to education and training requirements. Leadership Skills - Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, including written and verbal. - Act and speak in a professional manner by representing the company values and mission. - A strong ability to build collaborative relationships and effectively communicate financial insights across all levels of the organization. - Collaborator with strong listening, facilitation, and persuasion skills - Possesses strong analytical, problem-solving, interpersonal, and communication skills to foster positive employee relations. - Ability to prioritize work and motivate employees to achieve production results. - Understand people and operation lines, KPIs, budgets and cost of goods. - Demonstrated success in teamwork, change management and continuous improvement. - Dedicated to the goals and values of the company. - Adapts quickly to change in the work environment. - Demonstrated ability to develop and execute clear objectives. - Previous leadership and supervisory experience. - Ability to work with minimal supervision, taking initiative to achieve results. - Proactive, reliable, self-motivated, and committed to being a team player. - Capable of understanding and working with limited supervision; willingness to train other team members. - High tolerance for flexibility, change, and ambiguity. Education & Training - Bachelor’s Business Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related field. - Chartered Professional Accountant (CPA) designation. 5+ years post CPA designation experience preferred although equivalencies will be considered. - 3–7 years of experience managing people and processes within a team environment. - Strong computer skills with proficiency in MS Office: Excel, Word, and Outlook. - Advanced Excel skills preferred Other Requirements - Ability to provide a satisfactory Security Clearance Certificate (criminal record check) - Demonstrated knowledge of financial regulations, GAAP, and tax laws in Canada. - Commitment to being organized, with strong logistical and planning skills. - Experience in strategic planning and execution in a dynamic environment. KEY COMPETENCIES Key Competencies are skills and abilities that people need to perform the function of the job well (thinking, relating to others, communication, self-awareness, etc.). This section outlines the minimum Key Competencies the company desires for this role. Innovative Thinking - Thinking outside the box by creating new and better ways for the company to be successful. - Trust: Gains the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity, and authenticity. Team Builder - Collaborates: Builds partnerships and works collaboratively with others to meet company objectives. - Interpersonal Skills: Relates openly and comfortably with diverse groups of people. - Communication: Effectively conveys a clear understanding of the needs of the team/company. - Persuades: Uses effective techniques to gain the support and commitment of others. Performance Leader - Team Accountability: Holding self and others accountable to meet commitments. - Drives Results: Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances. - Takes Initiative: Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm. - Resourceful: Managing resources effectively and efficiently (product, people, etc.). - Self-Develop: Actively seeking ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development opportunities. Managing the Work - Quality decisions: Making good and timely decisions that positively impact the company. - Optimize Processes: Knowing the most effective and efficient way to get things done with a focus on continuous improvement. LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES Leadership Competencies refer to a combination of knowledge, skills, and abilities a leader possesses, the expected leadership behavior of the company. These competencies include creating vision and strategy, mobilizing people, upholding integrity and respect, achieving results, promoting innovation, guiding change, and collaborating with partners and stakeholders. Innovative Thinking - Forward thinking mindset: Seeing future possibilities and translating them into workable strategies for the company. - Courageous: Comfortable stepping up to address difficult issues, saying what needs to be said while maintaining an engaged workforce. Performance Leader - Shares Vision/Purpose: Painting a clear picture for the team on what is to be accomplished. Managing the Work - Providing Direction: Delegating properly and removing obstacles to get work done by the team. - Planning: Prioritizing work to meet company plans and established timelines. descripcion: Most companies are running AI pilots. We are rebuilding how our companies actually operate. Ionic Partners is a holding company with a portfolio of operating businesses. We are not adding AI features to products or rolling assistants out to employees. We are rebuilding the operating systems of entire business functions — engineering, support, finance, marketing, revenue operations — as agentic systems that do the work, in production, every day. We are looking for Principal AI-Native Engineers to build them. This is not a plan we are pitching. Agents already write and review code inside our engineering pipeline. Our own orchestration framework is what those systems run on, and it is on its second generation because the first one taught us what breaks. The knowledge our agents work from is maintained as structured, machine-readable artifacts rather than scraped from wikis, because we learned early that context quality sets the ceiling on everything else. Every hard-won lesson in that sentence cost us something. You will inherit all of it, and the next set of lessons is yours to learn. This is a central team, deliberately flat, that builds agentic systems for every company in the portfolio. There are no internal layers, no leads, and no junior tier. Everyone on it is a principal-level builder reporting directly to the executive who owns the mandate. Scope is concentrated rather than distributed: each engineer carries an unusually large share of the outcome and an unusually direct line to the decisions that matter. You will not be starting from scratch. We already run a production agentic platform in-house — our own orchestration framework, machine-readable context artifacts that give agents grounded knowledge of our products and customers, and automated development and QA agents working inside our engineering pipeline. Your first job is to ramp into a live system that real businesses depend on. Your ongoing job is to extend it, harden it, and use it to make each new function agentic faster than the last. The team is domain-agnostic by design. Subject-matter experts inside each business define what their function needs. You design and build the systems that deliver it. You do not need to be an expert in finance, support, or revenue operations. You need to be exceptional at turning a well-specified problem into a reliable agentic system that runs without you standing over it. And you own what you build. Not a prototype handed to another team. Not a proof of concept that dies in a demo. You ship it, you run it, you watch its evals, you carry its cost line, you improve it. If it breaks, it is yours. If it transforms how a company works, that is yours too. This is not an applied research role, and it is not an AI enablement or transformation role. Your work product is not a strategy, a recommendation, or a rollout plan — it is a working system in production, operating a real business function, measured on whether that function got materially better. The distance between an impressive agentic prototype and a system a business will actually depend on is where this entire job lives: the eval harnesses, the failure modes nobody anticipated, the guardrails, the traces, the fallback paths, the cost per run at volume, the second year of maintenance. It is also not a management role, and it does not become one. There is no reporting line beneath you and no expectation that you build one. Influence here comes from what you ship and the standard you set for the engineers and operators around you. We built the team flat specifically so we would never have to ask an elite builder to stop building to advance. The bar is high, and we intend to keep it there. Each hire is a large fraction of this team, and we would rather stay understaffed than lower it. If you want to build agentic systems that run real businesses — and stay technical while doing it — we would like to hear from you. descripcion: About CookUnity Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul. Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world. If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting. The Role CookUnity is looking for a Senior Data Analyst, B2B to own and scale analytics across our growing B2B business. Our B2B organization serves customers through multiple business models—including Corporate, Smart Fridge, and Healthcare—each with distinct go-to-market motions, customer journeys, and economics. You will build the analytics foundation that helps us understand how these businesses are performing, where our biggest growth opportunities are, and how we can scale them efficiently. You’ll partner closely with Sales, Partnerships, Sales Enablement, Marketing, Finance, and B2B leadership to connect the dots from pipeline generation and conversion through customer performance, retention, revenue, and profitability. This role is the connective tissue between the B2B business and CookUnity’s core Data team. Today, B2B analytics are spread across multiple tools—Salesforce, Tableau, Hex, and standalone dashboards—with no single owner consolidating them into a coherent, executive-ready view. You will be that owner. You’ll translate what B2B leadership needs to see into what the Data Engineering team needs to build, and ensure that every metric the business runs on is accurate, consistent, and available without manual effort. This is a highly visible role for someone who enjoys bringing structure to ambiguous business problems, building reliable metrics and reporting from the ground up, and translating data into recommendations that directly influence commercial decisions. What You’ll Do Own the analytics strategy for CookUnity’s B2B business, developing the reporting infrastructure, executive-ready dashboards, and analytical frameworks needed to understand and accelerate growth across Corporate, Smart Fridge, Healthcare, and emerging B2B opportunities (e.g., Airbnb, partnerships). Build an authoritative, single-source-of-truth view of B2B business health—clean data, executive-level visibility, one place leadership goes for the numbers. Partner with B2B leadership to translate business objectives into measurable KPIs and data models that connect the full commercial funnel—from lead generation and pipeline through conversion, activation, revenue, retention, and expansion. Partner with Sales, Partnerships, Sales Enablement, and Marketing to analyze pipeline health, conversion rates, sales velocity, win/loss patterns, deal velocity by stage, and other drivers of commercial productivity. Identify opportunities to improve how we acquire, prioritize, and grow B2B customers. Build the attribution layer that connects marketing spend to SQLs, pipeline created, and ARR won—by channel and by vertical. Partner with Finance and B2B leadership on forecasting and planning, translating pipeline and customer trends into forward-looking views of revenue and business performance, and helping explain gaps between plan and actuals. Own the data inputs for the Board-ready standard metric pack—including ARR bridge (opening → new → expansion → contraction → churn → closing), profitability trend, retention cohorts, stage-weighted pipeline, and efficiency metrics—per pod and consolidated. Develop a deep understanding of B2B business economics, including revenue, retention, expansion, order behavior, margins, and unit economics. Surface the segments, channels, ICPs (Ideal Customer Profiles), and customer profiles that create the greatest long-term value. Build LTV and CAC analysis at the B2B level to start, with increasing granularity by pod and ICP over time. Build the analytical frameworks needed to compare performance across B2B pods and business models, recognizing that success may look different across Corporate, Smart Fridge, and Healthcare while creating a common language and standard scorecard for leadership. Define what green/yellow/red looks like for each pod’s key metrics. Develop and maintain automated dashboards and reporting that give commercial teams and leadership timely visibility into pipeline, revenue, customer health, and key business drivers—reducing manual reporting and increasing confidence in the numbers. Consolidate today’s scattered reporting (Salesforce, Tableau, Hex, standalone tools) into a unified, reliable analytics layer. Go beyond reporting to diagnose what is driving performance. Proactively identify trends, risks, and opportunities and translate them into clear recommendations for Sales, Partnerships, Marketing, Finance, and B2B leadership. Own analyses like: retention by cohort with largest-account exclusion, pipeline movement waterfalls (added/advanced/slipped/lost), Healthcare funnel conversion (applications submitted → approved → contracting), and ICP-level performance tracking. Serve as the connective tissue between the B2B business and CookUnity’s core Data and Analytics Engineering teams. Translate B2B business requirements into data modeling and infrastructure needs. Partner with Analytics Engineering and Data Engineering to improve B2B data foundations—ensuring critical commercial and operational data (Salesforce ingestion, ad platform integrations, pricing logic, coupon attribution) is modeled consistently, accurately, and at the right level of granularity. Drive the B2B data alignment roadmap and ensure the Data team’s build priorities reflect the business’s most pressing analytical needs. Turn complex analyses into clear, compelling business stories. Present insights and recommendations to senior stakeholders—including Board-level presentations—in a way that makes the “so what” obvious and helps teams make faster, better decisions. Qualifications 5+ years of experience in analytics, ideally supporting B2B, enterprise sales, revenue operations, commercial strategy, or a similar go-to-market organization. Advanced proficiency in SQL, with the ability to independently explore, transform, validate, and analyze large and sometimes imperfect datasets. Strong understanding of B2B and commercial metrics, such as pipeline, funnel conversion, sales velocity, win rates, revenue, retention, expansion, account performance, and unit economics. Experience building dashboards, recurring business reporting, and executive-ready metric packs that become reliable sources of truth for commercial teams and leadership. Strong analytical problem-solving skills and the ability to take an ambiguous business question, structure it, identify the right data, and turn the analysis into a recommendation. Experience partnering with Sales, Finance, Marketing, Partnerships, Revenue Operations, or other commercial stakeholders, with an understanding of how analytics can influence both strategic and day-to-day decisions. Experience with business intelligence platforms such as Tableau, Looker, or equivalent. Strong communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex analyses into concise insights for both technical and non-technical audiences, including Board-level presentations. Excellent English, both written and spoken, given our U.S. presence and cross-functional collaboration. Comfortable operating with high autonomy in a fast-paced environment, balancing recurring reporting needs with deeper strategic analyses and proactively identifying where analytics can create value. Preferred Experience working with CRM and sales data, particularly Salesforce or similar platforms. Experience with revenue forecasting, sales capacity/productivity analysis, customer segmentation, or account-level economics. Experience analyzing businesses with multiple B2B go-to-market motions or customer segments (e.g., enterprise sales, self-serve/kiosk, marketplace, healthcare payer relationships). Familiarity with ETL, data warehousing, and data modeling concepts; experience with tools such as dbt and Snowflake is a plus. Experience working in a high-growth startup, marketplace, food-tech, or operationally complex business. Familiarity with connecting commercial data to financial and operational outcomes, rather than analyzing the sales funnel in isolation. Experience consolidating analytics across multiple disconnected tools and data sources into a unified reporting layer. Exposure to healthcare or regulated-industry sales cycles (RFPs, credentialing, payer contracting) is a plus. Benefits 💸 Get paid in USD. 🗺 Work remotely: design the life that you want. ⛱ Enjoy 15 days of vacation each year from the start date. 🎄 16 fully paid Argentinean holidays. 🩺 Healthcare Benefit: Monthly stipend to use in your preferred healthcare provider. 🗓️ 5- year Sabbatical: After 5 years with CookUnity, you get a 4-week paid sabbatical. 🐣 Paid family leave. 🕯 Compassionate Leave: 3-5 days each time the need arises. 🧘🏽‍♀️ Flexible benefits, your way: a prepaid card you can use on wellness, learning, food, and more. 🤖 AI-forward workplace: enterprise access to ChatGPT and Claude to help you work smarter and grow faster. 🧑‍🏫 Personalized English coach. If you’re interested in this role, please submit your application, and if we think you might be a fit, we'll get in touch with you. Thank you for your time! That means emails ending in @cookunity.com and interviews held through official company platforms (Google Meet or Zoom) — never WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. We’ll never ask for payment or personal financial details. If anyone does, please don’t share any information and let us know right away. If something ever feels off or you’re unsure about a message, we’d much rather you double-check with us. You can always contact us directly through any of our social media channels. We appreciate your interest in joining CookUnity — and we care about keeping your experience (and safety) as genuine as possible. Show more Show less

descripcion: Sourceability® is a global digital distributor of electronic components transforming how modern businesses bring products to market. With innovation, quality and logistics as the backbone of the company, Sourceability's cutting-edge products and services expedite the procurement process across a wide range of industries, including communications/cellular, consumer electronics, and auto manufacturing. Sourceability is building a new Global Engineering Organization (GEO) to strengthen internal software delivery, improve production ownership, and build long-term engineering capability inside the company. We are looking for a Principal Computer Vision Scientist to lead advanced Computer Vision and AI / ML work inside GEO. This role will be responsible for research direction, model architecture, experimentation, model quality, production readiness, and practical implementation of computer vision solutions used in company products. This is a senior technical leadership role for a highly experienced specialist who can work across research, engineering, product, and production systems. The right candidate should be able to evaluate new approaches, design model architectures, run experiments, improve model quality, and help engineering teams bring AI / ML capabilities into real production workflows. This role requires PhD-level education and strong hands-on experience in applied Computer Vision, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning. The person in this role should be comfortable working with business-critical systems, practical production constraints, imperfect datasets, and evolving product requirements. Assigned Product Group This role will be primarily aligned with the Computer Vision product group inside GEO. The role may also support other internal product groups or AI / ML initiatives where computer vision, image processing, visual search, object detection, segmentation, classification, or model evaluation expertise is needed. Product Group Focus Areas Depending on business priorities, the role may focus on one or more of the following areas: Mobile App / Computer Vision: Image capture workflows, mobile application integration, computer vision model development, model inference, warehouse / field usability, user feedback loops, production model quality, and UAT support. AI / ML Product Features: Applied machine learning features, model evaluation workflows, proof-of-concepts, model-assisted automation, AI-assisted business tools, and integration of AI / ML capabilities into existing business workflows. Data and Annotation Workflows: Image datasets, data quality, annotation requirements, labeling guidelines, model training datasets, validation datasets, failure case analysis, and continuous improvement of model performance. Production ML Systems: Model deployment, model versioning, inference performance, monitoring, reproducibility, scalability, reliability, and MLOps practices. Insight on Your Impact In this role, you will: Lead research, design, development, and implementation of Computer Vision and AI / ML solutions. Define model architecture, technical approach, experiment strategy, validation methodology, and production readiness criteria. Train, fine-tune, evaluate, optimize, and deploy models for object detection, semantic segmentation, image classification, feature matching, OCR, visual search, and image understanding. Own the full model lifecycle, including data analysis, dataset quality, annotation requirements, model training, experiment tracking, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Build prototypes, proof-of-concepts, demos, and technical experiments to validate new ideas before full product implementation. Analyze model performance, identify failure cases, and recommend practical improvements based on data, user behavior, and business needs. Review and improve existing Computer Vision pipelines, model quality, inference performance, scalability, and production reliability. Work with software engineers to integrate ML models into production applications and services. Define standards for model evaluation, model versioning, dataset management, reproducibility, and MLOps practices. Evaluate research papers, open-source models, AI platforms, and new technologies for potential use in company products. Provide technical guidance and mentoring to engineers working on AI / ML and computer vision features. Support planning and estimation for AI / ML work by clarifying technical complexity, risks, dependencies, and realistic delivery assumptions. Create technical documentation, model evaluation reports, architecture notes, and recommendations for engineering and product teams. Partner with Product / Delivery Managers to translate business needs into practical AI / ML implementation plans. Partner with Engineering Managers, Team Leads / Architects, QA, DevOps, Data, and business stakeholders to make sure AI / ML work can be delivered and supported in production. Your Qualifications, Your Influence To be successful in this role, you should have: PhD in Computer Science, Computer Vision, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or closely related technical field. 7+ years of hands-on experience in Machine Learning / Deep Learning, with strong focus on Computer Vision. Strong practical experience with PyTorch and / or TensorFlow. Strong Python development skills. Experience with OpenCV, NumPy, Pandas, scikit-learn, and modern Python ML ecosystem. Deep understanding of classical Computer Vision algorithms and modern deep learning approaches. Strong experience with object detection, semantic segmentation, image classification, feature matching, image retrieval, and model evaluation. Experience with modern Computer Vision architectures and techniques, including CNNs, Transformers, Vision Transformers, YOLO, Mask R-CNN, CLIP-like models, SAM-like models, or similar. Experience bringing ML models into production environments. Experience with model optimization for inference speed, latency, memory usage, scalability, and reliability. Experience with REST APIs, Docker, CI / CD, model versioning, experiment tracking, and MLOps practices. Strong understanding of datasets, data quality, annotation processes, labeling requirements, and model error analysis. Ability to read, understand, and evaluate technical documentation and research papers in English. Ability to explain complex technical topics to engineering, product, and business stakeholders. Experience working in Agile software development environment. Strong ownership mindset, good judgment, and ability to make practical technical decisions under uncertainty. Comfortable working in distributed teams across multiple locations and time zones. Preferred Skills and Technical Familiarity The following experience will be helpful: Post-PhD research or industry experience in applied Computer Vision. Publications, patents, or strong applied research record in Computer Vision, Machine Learning, or AI. Experience leading technical direction for AI / ML projects. Experience mentoring ML engineers, software engineers, or data annotation teams. Experience with edge or mobile inference technologies, including ONNX, TensorRT, OpenVINO, TFLite, CoreML, or similar. Experience with large-scale image processing pipelines. Experience with synthetic data generation, active learning, weak supervision, or dataset quality improvement. Experience with multimodal models, vision-language models, prompt engineering, OpenAI, or similar AI platforms. Experience with cloud ML platforms and production monitoring of ML models. Familiarity with mobile applications, warehouse workflows, field operations systems, or image capture workflows. Familiarity with Azure DevOps, Git, CI / CD tooling, documentation systems, and practical software delivery processes. Experience in electronic components, technology distribution, supply chain, logistics, manufacturing, e-commerce, or similar B2B environments. Success in the First 90 Days Within the first 90 days, the Principal Computer Vision Scientist should be able to: Understand the relevant product areas, users, business workflows, image capture workflows, datasets, model use cases, and current technical risks. Establish working relationships with Engineering Managers, Team Leads / Architects, Product / Delivery Managers, engineers, QA, DevOps, Data, and business stakeholders. Review current Computer Vision and AI / ML work, including models, datasets, evaluation methods, annotation process, production integration, and known quality issues. Identify the most important model quality risks, data quality gaps, technical debt items, production risks, and maintainability concerns. Define or improve model evaluation criteria, validation process, dataset requirements, and model readiness expectations. Help improve technical clarity of the active AI / ML backlog by adding design notes, technical breakdown, dependencies, estimates, and risks. Lead at least one meaningful model improvement, prototype, evaluation effort, or production risk-reduction activity. Improve documentation around model architecture, data flows, evaluation results, known limitations, and production behavior. Create an initial technical roadmap or remediation plan for Computer Vision work aligned with product priorities and engineering capacity. Help onboard or mentor engineers working on Computer Vision, AI / ML, or related product features. What This Role Does Not Own This role does not own formal people management for engineers. Engineering Managers remain responsible for hiring, performance management, compensation input, team structure, and capacity planning. This role does not own business prioritization or user acceptance. Product / Delivery Managers and business stakeholders remain responsible for intake, priority alignment, backlog readiness, UAT coordination, and business acceptance. This role does not independently commit delivery dates without alignment with Engineering Managers and Product / Delivery Managers. This role does not own all AI / ML work across the company unless specifically assigned by GEO leadership. The primary responsibility is Computer Vision technical leadership and production-quality AI / ML implementation for assigned product areas. This role does not replace Software Architects, DevOps, Data, QA, or Infrastructure ownership. The role will work closely with those teams to make sure Computer Vision solutions are technically sound, production-ready, and supportable. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER. descripcion: Requirements Description & Requirements Resumen de trabajo El rol de líder clave es una parte esencial del equipo de liderazgo de la tienda, y afecta a los miembros del equipo de la planta de ventas y a la experiencia de los huéspedes (es decir, los clientes) todos los días. Los líderes clave son responsables de predicar con el ejemplo y brindar apoyo a los educadores, facilitar una excelente experiencia para los huéspedes en la tienda y supervisar todas las operaciones del piso minorista. Los líderes clave aprovechan los indicadores y métricas clave de desempeño para priorizar las responsabilidades mientras se adaptan a los ajustes y desafíos comerciales diarios. Responsabilidades clave del trabajo Liderazgo y Gestión de Personas Apoyar el aprendizaje y el desarrollo continuo de los miembros del equipo proporcionando retroalimentación directa, entrenamiento, tutoría y orientación profesional, y abordando inquietudes de desempeño. Proporcionar reconocimiento a los miembros del equipo, evaluación de brechas y documentación de desempeño general para respaldar y reforzar el crecimiento personal y profesional. Desarrollar, mantener y difundir el producto y el conocimiento general de la empresa a través de canales de comunicación adecuados. Experiencia del huésped (es decir, del cliente) Proporcionar liderazgo en el piso de ventas a los miembros del equipo, incluida la planificación de la cobertura del piso de ventas y la toma de decisiones para mantener la eficiencia y eficacia de las operaciones del piso de ventas. Apoyar a los miembros del equipo (p. ej., liderando con el ejemplo o brindando capacitación) para garantizar una excelente experiencia para los huéspedes que valore su tiempo, incluida la evaluación de las necesidades de los huéspedes, brindando educación técnica sobre productos y respaldando transacciones en la tienda y programas omnicanal (p. ej., compra en línea/ opciones de recogida en tienda, venta telefónica y envío desde tienda). Interactuar y evaluar las necesidades únicas de los huéspedes para brindarles soporte y soluciones de compra y devolución efectivas y personalizadas. Proporcionar educación técnica sobre el producto articulando el valor y beneficio del producto. Resolver los comentarios de los huéspedes y abordar sus inquietudes o derivaciones para que sean “correctos” para los huéspedes. Muévase dinámicamente en la sala para evaluar y satisfacer las necesidades del negocio, el equipo y los invitados. Trabajando con otros Contribuir a un ambiente de equipo respetuoso e inclusivo dando la bienvenida y celebrando las diferencias para garantizar una experiencia de apoyo y participación para todos los miembros del equipo e invitados. Establecer relaciones productivas y de apoyo con todos los miembros del equipo. Colaborar con los miembros del equipo para garantizar una experiencia óptima para los huéspedes y respaldar las operaciones de la tienda. Operaciones Revisar datos y métricas comerciales para evaluar el progreso hacia las metas y determinar si se justifican ajustes. Abrir y cerrar la tienda de acuerdo con las listas de verificación de apertura y cierre. Gestionar las tareas de presentación de productos (por ejemplo, volver a colocar los artículos en su lugar, reponer o agregar artículos agotados al piso desde el inventario, eliminar existencias o reubicar artículos) de acuerdo con los estándares de la empresa. Asigne a los educadores tareas de limpieza según sea necesario durante el turno para mantener el ambiente de lujo de la tienda. Garantizar que el equipo utilice la tecnología de la tienda para respaldar las operaciones de la tienda y brindar experiencias positivas a los huéspedes. Comprender y cumplir las políticas y procedimientos de seguridad de las personas para mantener un ambiente de trabajo seguro. Realizar el trabajo de acuerdo con las políticas, procedimientos y leyes o regulaciones aplicables. Responsabilidad presupuestaria No aplica Gestión de Personas Rol de líder del equipo, responsable indirectamente del subconjunto de empleados de la tienda en el piso o según lo delegado por el gerente de la tienda. Habilidades clave y valores fundamentales que aporta Inclusión y diversidad: crea/apoya un entorno inclusivo que valora/celebra las diferencias Integridad/Honestidad: Se comporta de manera honesta, justa y ética. Experiencia del huésped: disfruta trabajando y conectando, comprendiendo y ayudando a los huéspedes. Colaboración y trabajo en equipo: trabaja productivamente y apoya a otros para lograr sus objetivos; busca asociaciones y perspectivas diversas Liderazgo: es capaz y desea liderar, influir e inspirar a otros; Motiva, empodera, desarrolla y dirige a las personas mientras trabajan. Comunicación sincera: está dispuesto a compartir inquietudes de manera abierta y constructiva (es decir, hablar con franqueza) Toma de decisiones: utiliza la lógica y el razonamiento para evaluar alternativas y tomar decisiones efectivas y oportunas. Requisitos de trabajo Elegibilidad Debe estar legalmente autorizado para trabajar en el país en el que se encuentra la tienda. Debe tener 18 años de edad o más. Debe tener prueba del Derecho al Trabajo y evidencia relacionada con los requisitos legislativos locales asociados (solo EMEA) Debe tener la capacidad de viajar a la tienda asignada con métodos de transporte propios. Disponibilidad Dispuesto a trabajar en un horario flexible que incluya tardes, fines de semana y días festivos. Otros requisitos de voluntad Dispuesto a trabajar como parte de un equipo y también completar el trabajo de forma independiente. Estar dispuesto a moverse por una tienda durante la mayor parte del turno para ayudar a los huéspedes y realizar el trabajo. Dispuesto a mover cajas que pesen hasta 30 libras (13,6 kg) Dispuesto a trabajar en un ambiente con luces brillantes y música alta. Experiencia Experiencia laboral Activos laborales (es decir, es bueno tenerlos; no es obligatorio) Educación: diploma de escuela secundaria, GED o equivalente Educación: Licenciatura o equivalente Experiencia: 1 año de experiencia en liderazgo de ventas/venta minorista (no es necesario supervisor o gestión de personas) Job Summary The Key Leader role is an essential part of the store leadership team, impacting salesfloor team members and guest (i.e., customer) experience every day. Key Leaders are responsible for leading by example and providing support to Educators, facilitating an outstanding guest experience in the store, and overseeing all operations of the retail floor. Key Leaders leverage key performance indicators and metrics to prioritize responsibilities while adapting to day-to-day business adjustments and challenges. Key Responsibilities Of The Job Leadership and People Management Support ongoing learning and development of team members by providing direct feedback, coaching, mentoring, and career path guidance, and addressing performance concerns. Provide team members recognition, gap assessment, and overall performance documentation to support and reinforce career and personal growth. Develop, maintain, and disseminate product and general company knowledge through appropriate communication channels. Guest (i.e., Customer) Experience Provide salesfloor leadership to team members, including planning salesfloor coverage and making decisions to maintain efficiency and effectiveness of salesfloor operations. Support team members (e.g., leading by example or coaching) with ensuring a great guest experience that values guests’ time, including assessing guest needs, providing technical product educations, and supporting in-store transactions and omnichannel programs (e.g., buy online/pickup in store, phone sales, and ship from store options). Interact with and assess guests’ unique needs to provide customized, effective purchase and return solutions and support. Provide technical product education by articulating the value and benefit of the product. Resolve guest feedback and address guest concerns or escalations to make it “right” for guests. Move dynamically on the floor to assess and fulfill the needs of the business, team, and guests. Working With Others Contribute to a respectful and inclusive team environment by welcoming and celebrating differences to ensure a supportive and engaging experience for all team members and guests. Establish supportive and productive relationships with all team members. Collaborate with team members to ensure optimal guest experience and support store operations. Operations Review business data and metrics to evaluate progress toward goals and determine if adjustments are warranted. Open and close the store in accordance with the opening and closing checklists. Manage product presentation tasks (e.g., put items back in place, restock or add depleted items to the floor from inventory, destock or relocate items) according to company standards. Assign Educators cleaning tasks as needed throughout the shift to maintain the luxury environment of the store. Ensure team uses in-store technology to support store operations and provide positive guest experiences. Understand and adhere to people safety policies and procedures to maintain a safe work environment. Perform work in accordance with applicable policies, procedures, and laws or regulations. Budget Responsibility Not Applicable People Management Team lead role indirectly responsible for subset of store employees on the floor or as delegated by Store Manager Key Skills & Core Values You Bring Inclusion & Diversity: Creates/supports an inclusive environment that values/celebrates differences Integrity/Honesty: Behaves in an honest, fair, and ethical manner Guest Experience: Enjoys working and connecting with, understanding, and helping guests Collaboration and Teamwork: Works productively with and supports others to achieve goals; seeks partnerships and diverse perspectives Leadership: Is able and desires to lead, influence, and inspire others; motivates, empowers, develops, and directs people as they work Candid Communication: Is willing to openly/constructively share concerns (i.e., straight talk) Decision Making: Uses logic and reasoning to evaluate alternatives and make effective, timely decisions Job Requirements Eligibility Must be legally authorized to work in the country in which the store is located Must be 18 years of age or older Must have proof of the Right to Work and evidence relating to associated local legislative requirements (EMEA only) Must have the ability to travel to assigned store with own transportation methods Availability Willing to work a flexible schedule including evenings, weekends, and holidays Other Willingness Requirements Willing to work as part of a team and also complete work independently Willing to move through a store for most of a shift to help guests and accomplish work Willing to move boxes weighing up to 30 lbs (13.6 kg) Willing to work in an environment with bright lights and loud music Experience Work experience Job Assets (i.e., nice to have; not required) Education: High school diploma, GED, or equivalent Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent Experience: 1 year of retail/sales leadership experience (supervisor or people management not necessary) Show more Show less

descripcion: Postúlate en Kit Empleo: kitempleo.com.ar/empleo/vy5q5 : The Role The Process and System Specialist will own the ongoing analysis, improvement, documentation, and implementation of the company's operational systems and processes. This role sits at the intersection of people, processes, systems, technology, and organizational change. You will investigate how work is actually being done, compare execution against documented processes, identify root causes, design practical improvements, document the new standard, implement changes, and measure whether they are working. The goal is not to create documentation for its own sake. The goal is to build an operating environment where processes are clear, systems support execution, responsibilities are understood, changes are adopted, and critical knowledge is not dependent on individual employees. This is an analysis-heavy role (approximately 70% analysis / 30% communication and persuasion) for someone who enjoys turning operational complexity into clear, scalable systems. What You'll Own 1. Process Analysis & Operational Diagnostics - Audit existing processes, workflows, and SOPs against actual day-to-day execution. - Map how work moves across teams, systems, and functions. - Identify gaps between how work is supposed to happen, how it actually happens, and what the systems support. - Shadow and interview team members to understand real-world workflows and operational friction. - Identify bottlenecks, duplication, unnecessary steps, handoff failures, and recurring issues. - Determine whether problems are caused by process design, systems, documentation, capability, accountability, or unclear ownership. - Use data and evidence to validate problems rather than relying solely on anecdotal feedback. - Translate findings into clear recommendations and prioritized improvement opportunities. 2. Process Design & Improvement - Design clear, practical, and scalable processes that improve consistency, efficiency, accuracy, and accountability. - Break complex problems into smaller, manageable, and testable improvements. - Prioritize initiatives based on business impact, revenue impact, urgency, feasibility, and potential for quick wins. - Redesign workflows where existing processes are inefficient, unclear, or overly dependent on individual knowledge. - Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, or eliminate unnecessary work. - Test proposed changes before broader implementation. - Measure outcomes and continuously refine processes based on presente performance. 3. Systems & Workflow Optimization - Evaluate whether existing systems and tools effectively support the company's workflows. - Identify gaps between business processes and system capabilities. - Improve the way teams use core platforms, including: - Notion — knowledge management and SOPs - ClickUp — task and workflow management - Slack — internal communication - Cubby — property management - Google Workspace — documents, files, and collaboration - Identify opportunities for better workflows, automations, integrations, reporting, and information flow. - Reduce unnecessary manual work, duplicate data entry, and fragmented information. - Help establish clear ownership for critical systems, workflows, and information. - Ensure systems remain aligned with evolving business processes. 4. Documentation & Knowledge Management - Build, restructure, and maintain a scalable SOP and process documentation framework. - Maintain Notion as a practical and reliable source of truth for operational knowledge. - Convert validated processes into clear, usable documentation. - Create process maps, workflows, checklists, decision trees, and other documentation where appropriate. - Ensure documentation clearly communicates what to do, how to do it, who owns it, and what outcome is expected. - Establish documentation standards, ownership, review cycles, and version control. - Identify and eliminate outdated, duplicative, or conflicting documentation. - Build systems that reduce reliance on tribal knowledge and individual employees. 5. Organizational Change & Implementation - Own the implementation of approved process and systems changes from planning through adoption. - Develop practical rollout plans, communication strategies, training materials, and implementation timelines. - Work closely with department leaders and team members to introduce new ways of working. - Communicate the why behind changes and connect new processes to business outcomes. - Identify resistance, confusion, capability gaps, or other barriers to adoption. - Provide training and support during implementation. - Monitor adoption after rollout and address gaps when teams revert to old habits. - Ensure process improvements become part of normal operations rather than remaining theoretical recommendations. 6. Performance Measurement & Continuous Improvement - Develop practical ways to measure whether processes are working. - Build and maintain trackers, dashboards, and reporting mechanisms where needed. - Establish meaningful KPIs and measurable outcomes for key processes. - Use operational data to identify recurring problems, trends, and systemic weaknesses. - Distinguish between activity and results — completing a process does not necessarily mean the process is effective. - Create feedback loops that allow processes to be continuously evaluated and improved. - Use a no-blame, evidence-based approach to identifying and solving operational problems. 7. AI & Modern Productivity - Use AI tools to improve the speed and quality of research, analysis, documentation, process design, and operational work. - Demonstrate practical familiarity with Claude and other leading AI tools. - Identify opportunities to incorporate AI into documentation, knowledge management, workflow analysis, reporting, and repetitive operational tasks. - Use AI as a productivity and problem-solving tool while maintaining appropriate judgment, accuracy, confidentiality, and human oversight. - Help the organization identify practical AI applications that improve efficiency without introducing unnecessary complexity. Requirements Required - 3+ years of experience in process improvement, business systems, business operations, business analysis, organizational effectiveness, or a related field. - Proven experience analyzing, designing, documenting, and improving business processes. - Strong experience creating and maintaining SOPs, workflows, process maps, and operational documentation. - Demonstrated ability to take a process improvement from diagnosis through implementation and adoption. - Strong understanding of organizational change and change implementation. - Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven approach. - Ability to identify root causes rather than simply addressing symptoms. - Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail. - Strong ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, stakeholders, and moving parts simultaneously. - High ownership mentality and strong follow-through. - Excellent written and verbal English communication. - Experience working with remote or distributed teams. - Proficiency with modern productivity and workflow tools such as Notion, ClickUp, Slack, and Google Workspace. - Legitimate hands-on familiarity with AI tools, particularly Claude, and the ability to demonstrate how you have used AI to improve your work. - Ability to prioritize initiatives based on business impact, urgency, feasibility, and expected outcomes. - Comfortable working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. - Ability to work full-time during Oklahoma business hours (9am–5pm CT). Strong Plus - Experience in self-storage, real estate, property management, hospitality, or another operationally intensive environment. - Experience with property management software, including Cubby, AppFolio, or similar platforms. - Experience supporting multiple properties, locations, departments, or teams simultaneously. - Experience with operational reporting, KPI tracking, dashboards, or performance measurement. - Experience implementing organizational change across multiple departments or teams. - Experience designing scalable knowledge management systems. - Experience with workflow automation, integrations, or no-code/low-code tools. - Experience working remotely with US-based companies or distributed international teams. You Are Not a Fit If - You require constant direction to identify problems or prioritize your work. - You prefer maintaining existing processes rather than analyzing and improving them. - You are primarily an administrator or documentation writer rather than a process owner and implementer. - You create SOPs but do not care whether people actually follow them or whether they produce results. - You struggle to manage multiple projects, stakeholders, and moving parts simultaneously. - You are reactive rather than proactive and investigative. - You jump to solutions without first understanding the root cause. - You avoid difficult conversations or operational follow-up. - You rely on assumptions instead of data, evidence, and measurable outcomes. - You struggle to get people aligned around process or system changes. - You are uncomfortable challenging inefficient or outdated ways of working. - You view AI as a buzzword rather than a practical tool for improving how work gets done. - You prefer purely administrative work over systems ownership, process improvement, and organizational change. Benefits - Client Relationship: You will be directly working with the client. This means that you will communicate with the client, provide services, and address any client-related matters independently. - Payments: All payments for your services will be handled by the client. Elevate and Delegate is not involved in processing your payroll. Your salary will directly go to you. - Vacation Leaves and Holidays: While we may have recommendations or guidelines regarding vacation leaves and holidays, the decision is entirely at the discretion of the client. You are expected to align your schedule with the client’s business needs and any specific policies or preferences they may have in this regard. --- Application Process: - As part of your application, you’ll be asked to record your responses to the initial interview questions through a Loom video (questions & instructions are in the application page). - Our team will carefully review your submission, and if shortlisted, we’ll share your responses with the client for their review and next steps. - Please treat this recording as you would a real interview: - Come prepared and make sure you’re clearly visible on camera. - Record your answers in a quiet, well-lit, and clutter-free space with a stable internet connection. - We’re excited to get to know you better! Show us your personality and strengths. We encourage you to answer authentically and in your own words, without reading from a script or using AI tools. descripcion: Postúlate en Kit Empleo: kitempleo.com.ar/empleo/vs8w2 The Role The Process and System Specialist will own the ongoing analysis, improvement, documentation, and implementation of the company's operational systems and processes. This role sits at the intersection of people, processes, systems, technology, and organizational change. You will investigate how work is actually being done, compare execution against documented processes, identify root causes, design practical improvements, document the new standard, implement changes, and measure whether they are working. The goal is not to create documentation for its own sake. The goal is to build an operating environment where processes are clear, systems support execution, responsibilities are understood, changes are adopted, and critical knowledge is not dependent on individual employees. This is an analysis-heavy role (approximately 70% analysis / 30% communication and persuasion) for someone who enjoys turning operational complexity into clear, scalable systems. What You'll Own - Process Analysis & Operational Diagnostics - Audit existing processes, workflows, and SOPs against presente day-to-day execution. - Map how work moves across teams, systems, and functions. - Identify gaps between how work is supposed to happen, how it actually happens, and what the systems support. - Shadow and interview team members to understand real-world workflows and operational friction. - Identify bottlenecks, duplication, unnecessary steps, handoff failures, and recurring issues. - Determine whether problems are caused by process design, systems, documentation, capability, accountability, or unclear ownership. - Use data and evidence to validate problems rather than relying solely on anecdotal feedback. - Translate findings into clear recommendations and prioritized improvement opportunities. 2. Process Design & Improvement - Design clear, practical, and scalable processes that improve consistency, efficiency, accuracy, and accountability. - Break complex problems into smaller, manageable, and testable improvements. - Prioritize initiatives based on business impact, revenue impact, urgency, feasibility, and potential for quick wins. - Redesign workflows where existing processes are inefficient, unclear, or overly dependent on individual knowledge. - Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, or eliminate unnecessary work. - Test proposed changes before broader implementation. - Measure outcomes and continuously refine processes based on actual performance. 3. Systems & Workflow Optimization - Evaluate whether existing systems and tools effectively support the company's workflows. - Identify gaps between business processes and system capabilities. - Improve the way teams use core platforms, including: - Notion — knowledge management and SOPs - ClickUp — task and workflow management - Slack — internal communication - Cubby — property management - Google Workspace — documents, files, and collaboration - Identify opportunities for better workflows, automations, integrations, reporting, and information flow. - Reduce unnecessary manual work, duplicate data entry, and fragmented information. - Help establish clear ownership for critical systems, workflows, and information. - Ensure systems remain aligned with evolving business processes. 4. Documentation & Knowledge Management - Build, restructure, and maintain a scalable SOP and process documentation framework. - Maintain Notion as a practical and reliable source of truth for operational knowledge. - Convert validated processes into clear, usable documentation. - Create process maps, workflows, checklists, decision trees, and other documentation where appropriate. - Ensure documentation clearly communicates what to do, how to do it, who owns it, and what outcome is expected. - Establish documentation standards, ownership, review cycles, and version control. - Identify and eliminate outdated, duplicative, or conflicting documentation. - Build systems that reduce reliance on tribal knowledge and individual employees. 5. Organizational Change & Implementation - Own the implementation of approved process and systems changes from planning through adoption. - Develop practical rollout plans, communication strategies, training materials, and implementation timelines. - Work closely with department leaders and team members to introduce new ways of working. - Communicate the why behind changes and connect new processes to business outcomes. - Identify resistance, confusion, capability gaps, or other barriers to adoption. - Provide training and support during implementation. - Monitor adoption after rollout and address gaps when teams revert to old habits. - Ensure process improvements become part of normal operations rather than remaining theoretical recommendations. 6. Performance Measurement & Continuous Improvement - Develop practical ways to measure whether processes are working. - Build and maintain trackers, dashboards, and reporting mechanisms where needed. - Establish meaningful KPIs and measurable outcomes for key processes. - Use operational data to identify recurring problems, trends, and systemic weaknesses. - Distinguish between activity and results — completing a process does not necessarily mean the process is effective. - Create feedback loops that allow processes to be continuously evaluated and improved. - Use a no-blame, evidence-based approach to identifying and solving operational problems. 7. AI & Modern Productivity - Use AI tools to improve the speed and quality of research, analysis, documentation, process design, and operational work. - Demonstrate practical familiarity with Claude and other leading AI tools. - Identify opportunities to incorporate AI into documentation, knowledge management, workflow analysis, reporting, and repetitive operational tasks. - Use AI as a productivity and problem-solving tool while maintaining appropriate judgment, accuracy, confidentiality, and human oversight. - Help the organization identify practical AI applications that improve efficiency without introducing unnecessary complexity. Required - 3+ years of experience in process improvement, business systems, business operations, business analysis, organizational effectiveness, or a related field. - Proven experience analyzing, designing, documenting, and improving business processes. - Strong experience creating and maintaining SOPs, workflows, process maps, and operational documentation. - Demonstrated ability to take a process improvement from diagnosis through implementation and adoption. - Strong understanding of organizational change and change implementation. - Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven approach. - Ability to identify root causes rather than simply addressing symptoms. - Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail. - Strong ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, stakeholders, and moving parts simultaneously. - High ownership mentality and strong follow-through. - Excellent written and verbal English communication. - Experience working with remote or distributed teams. - Proficiency with modern productivity and workflow tools such as Notion, ClickUp, Slack, and Google Workspace. - Legitimate hands-on familiarity with AI tools, particularly Claude, and the ability to demonstrate how you have used AI to improve your work. - Ability to prioritize initiatives based on business impact, urgency, feasibility, and expected outcomes. - Comfortable working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. - Ability to work full-time during Oklahoma business hours (9am–5pm CT). Strong Plus - Experience in self-storage, real estate, property management, hospitality, or another operationally intensive environment. - Experience with property management software, including Cubby, AppFolio, or similar platforms. - Experience supporting multiple properties, locations, departments, or teams simultaneously. - Experience with operational reporting, KPI tracking, dashboards, or performance measurement. - Experience implementing organizational change across multiple departments or teams. - Experience designing scalable knowledge management systems. - Experience with workflow automation, integrations, or no-code/low-code tools. - Experience working remotely with US-based companies or distributed international teams. You Are Not a Fit If - You require constant direction to identify problems or prioritize your work. - You prefer maintaining existing processes rather than analyzing and improving them. - You are primarily an administrator or documentation writer rather than a process owner and implementer. - You create SOPs but do not care whether people actually follow them or whether they produce results. - You struggle to manage multiple projects, stakeholders, and moving parts simultaneously. - You are reactive rather than proactive and investigative. - You jump to solutions without first understanding the root cause. - You avoid difficult conversations or operational follow-up. - You rely on assumptions instead of data, evidence, and measurable outcomes. - You struggle to get people aligned around process or system changes. - You are uncomfortable challenging inefficient or outdated ways of working. - You view AI as a buzzword rather than a practical tool for improving how work gets done. - You prefer purely administrative work over systems ownership, process improvement, and organizational change. - Client Relationship: You will be directly working with the client. This means that you will communicate with the client, provide services, and address any client-related matters independently. - Payments: All payments for your services will be handled by the client. Elevate and Delegate is not involved in processing your payroll. Your salary will directly go to you. - Vacation Leaves and Holidays: While we may have recommendations or guidelines regarding vacation leaves and holidays, the decision is entirely at the discretion of the client. You are expected to align your schedule with the client’s business needs and any specific policies or preferences they may have in this regard. --- Application Process: - As part of your application, you’ll be asked to record your responses to the initial interview questions through a Loom video (questions & instructions are in the application page). - Our team will carefully review your submission, and if shortlisted, we’ll share your responses with the client for their review and next steps. - Please treat this recording as you would a real interview: - Come prepared and make sure you’re clearly visible on camera. - Record your answers in a quiet, well-lit, and clutter-free space with a stable internet connection. - We’re excited to get to know you better! Show us your personality and strengths. We encourage you to answer authentically and in your own words, without reading from a script or using AI tools. descripcion: Summary And Description Thomson Reuters Special Services (TRSS) is looking for a Data Scientist to support our Federal Law Enforcement customers. TRSS Data Scientists serve several Federal Law Enforcement agencies by collecting, integrating, resolving, analyzing, modeling, and explaining large data in support of complex investigations. Success in this role requires strong technical depth, the initiative to operate with minimal direction, creativity to develop novel solutions, and a mission-focused mindset. TRSS Data Scientists support the full range of Federal Law Enforcement missions including, but not limited to: Emerging Threat Detection, Money Laundering, Fraud, Force Protection, Human Rights Crimes, Transnational Crime, and more. Outside of contract work, TRSS Data Scientists contribute to internal innovation by participating in research and development (R&D), developing and maintaining shared capabilities, strengthening technical skills, and supporting business development efforts such as proof-of-concept projects and capabilities briefings. This opportunity is specifically for positions located on US Government customer sites in the Washington, DC area. This is not a telework position. We recruit from a broad range of disciplines and experience. If you are passionate about the chance to put your Data Science skills to practice in support of Federal Law Enforcement, then we are looking for you! About The Role TRSS Data Scientist candidates must possess the following minimum qualifications. Please ensure your resume and application clearly demonstrate that you have: United States Citizenship (essential to comply with government contract requirements). Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance or agency work suitability determination, as required by assignment. Willingness to work full time, on-site, embedded at US Government offices in the Washington, DC area. (Specific office assignments are subject to change). Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in a technical field (e.g., data science, statistics, computer science, mathematics, physical/biological sciences, or geographic information systems (GIS), etc.). At least 3 years of relevant experience. Relevant experience can include some combination of: Large Data Management: querying, extracting, cleaning, verifying, resolving, and maintaining data. Large Data Analysis: statistical methods, graph networks, anomaly detection, spatial analysis, pattern-of-life, sentiment analysis. Large Data Modeling: risk modeling, community detection, classification, computer vision, and general application of machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI) models. Large Data Storytelling: explaining insights and methodology to a non-technical audience, dashboards, plots & visualizations, direct experience with customers. Programming: Candidates must have practical experience writing, editing, customizing, and executing code written in Python. SQL proficiency: Candidates must have experience using SQL for data extraction, pipelining, or exploration. Master’s Degree in a related field can substitute two (2) years of experience. PhD (or equivalent) in a related field can substitute four (4) years of experience. Ability to handle sensitive, confidential, or regulated data in accordance with applicable policies and requirements. Ability to interface directly with customers at all levels and be a representative of TRSS. Ability to work both independently and as a member of a team. Teams may include other Data Scientists or be cross-disciplinary and include Subject Matter Expert Analysts and/or Data Engineers. Ability to interpret customer requests and/or problem statements into clear project plans, develop project goals and methods, and to deliver actionable results within required timeframes.
