descripcion: Role Overview Ignyte is seeking a highly experienced Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer to design, build, integrate, deploy, and maintain software across a diverse technology environment. This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who can take a business objective or loosely defined requirement and turn it into a working production solution with minimal supervision. The engineer will work under the architectural direction of a highly experienced senior technical leader while maintaining substantial ownership over implementation, delivery, and production support. The role spans customer-facing applications, internal tools, integrations, cloud infrastructure, structured data, workflow automation, and AI-enabled software. Key Responsibilities * Build and enhance full-stack web applications * Develop modern frontend applications using React * Build backend services, APIs, integrations, and automation using Python * Design and maintain PostgreSQL databases * Develop and manage applications and infrastructure in Google Cloud Platform * Build integrations using REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, OAuth, and third-party services * Develop solutions using Google Workspace APIs, including Calendar, Gmail, Drive, Sheets, and related services * Build and maintain headless CMS and modern web architectures * Extend, troubleshoot, and modernize existing applications and codebases * Build internal business applications and operational tools * Translate business workflows into scalable software and automated processes * Develop AI-enabled applications, workflows, and automation * Implement structured data processing and validation * Generate documents and other outputs from structured and unstructured data * Implement CI/CD, automated testing, deployments, logging, and monitoring * Troubleshoot production issues across frontend, backend, database, cloud, and integration layers * Maintain secure, scalable, documented, and maintainable code * Participate in architecture and technical design discussions * Propose solutions and communicate technical tradeoffs clearly Nature of the Engineering Work Our engineering environment spans multiple products, technology stacks, and business systems. Engineers are expected to be comfortable moving between new development and existing applications rather than working within one narrow technology or product. Typical work may include: * Customer-facing web applications * Existing enterprise software * New product development * Internal business applications * API development * Systems integration * Workflow automation * Cloud infrastructure * Structured data processing * Document generation * AI-assisted applications * Business process automation * Production troubleshooting and modernization The successful candidate must be comfortable switching between frontend, backend, database, infrastructure, integration, and AI-related work depending on business priorities. Required Experience * 10+ years of professional software development experience * Significant professional engineering experience predating modern generative-AI coding tools * Strong full-stack software development background * Advanced Python experience * Strong React frontend development experience * Strong JavaScript and/or TypeScript experience * Strong PostgreSQL and SQL experience * Production experience with Google Cloud Platform * Strong experience with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, OAuth, and third-party integrations * Experience with Google Workspace APIs * Experience with headless CMS or similar modern web architectures * Experience working with unfamiliar or inherited codebases * Experience with Git, branching, code review, and CI/CD * Practical DevOps and production deployment experience * Strong debugging and troubleshooting capability * Strong understanding of software architecture, scalability, security, and performance Multi-Stack Engineering This role requires flexibility across technologies. The ideal candidate is comfortable learning and working within existing systems even when the technology differs from their primary stack. Candidates should be capable of: * Understanding unfamiliar applications quickly * Navigating inherited codebases * Extending existing systems safely * Identifying technical debt * Modernizing systems incrementally * Selecting appropriate technologies based on the problem rather than personal preference AI Engineering AI is expected to be a normal part of the software development process. Candidates should have practical experience with some combination of: * OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or similar APIs * AI-assisted coding tools * Agentic development workflows * LLM integrations * Structured outputs * JSON schemas * Function and tool calling * Retrieval-augmented generation * Prompt and context engineering * AI workflow automation * Human-in-the-loop workflows Candidates must understand software engineering fundamentals independently of AI-generated code and be capable of reviewing, debugging, testing, and improving AI-assisted implementations. We are looking for someone who uses AI to increase engineering productivity, not someone who depends on AI to understand the software they are building. Systems Integration A significant portion of the role involves connecting applications and business systems. Candidates should be comfortable designing workflows involving: * REST APIs * JSON * Webhooks * Authentication and OAuth * Event-driven processing * Data synchronization * Business rules * Scheduled processes * Error handling * Retry logic * Logging and monitoring Experience integrating platforms such as Google Workspace, CRM systems, accounting systems, cloud platforms, databases, and third-party SaaS applications is highly desirable. Structured Data & Automation The engineer should be comfortable building systems that transform information between multiple formats and systems. This may include: * Converting structured and unstructured information into validated JSON * Mapping data between systems * Data validation * Schema-driven processing * Automated document generation * Workflow orchestration * AI-assisted data extraction and transformation * Human review and approval workflows DevOps & Production Ownership Engineers are expected to own work beyond code completion. Responsibilities include: * Testing * Deployment * CI/CD * Cloud configuration * Logging * Monitoring * Troubleshooting * Documentation * Performance optimization * Production support The engineer should be capable of taking work from development through stable production deployment. Security Candidates should understand secure software development practices, including: * Authentication * Authorization * Role-based access * Secrets management * API security * Sensitive data handling * Audit logging * Secure cloud configuration * Dependency management * Least-privilege access Prior cybersecurity or compliance experience is useful but not required. Working Style This role requires significant independence. The engineer may receive a business requirement such as: “We need these systems connected and this workflow automated.” They should be able to: * Understand the business objective * Investigate the existing environment * Identify technical requirements * Design an implementation approach * Identify APIs and dependencies * Develop the solution * Test it * Deploy it * Document it * Support it in production The engineer will receive architectural guidance from senior technical leadership but should not require detailed technical tickets or step-by-step development instructions. We expect engineers to bring proposed solutions, identify risks early, and ask focused questions when necessary. Communication * Excellent written and spoken English is required * Must communicate technical decisions clearly * Must be comfortable working directly with business leadership * Must explain technical tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders * Must proactively communicate blockers, risks, and dependencies * Must document systems and important technical decisions Technical Assessment Final candidates will complete a practical technical assessment. The assessment may evaluate: * Python development * React development * PostgreSQL * API integration * JSON and structured data * Debugging * Application architecture * Cloud deployment * AI-assisted development * Code quality * Ability to interpret incomplete business requirements The assessment will focus on realistic engineering work rather than algorithm puzzles. Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is a senior engineer who has spent years building production software before AI coding assistants became common and now uses modern AI tools aggressively to improve productivity. They are: * Technically strong * Highly independent * Pragmatic * Comfortable across multiple technology stacks * Strong at debugging * Capable of understanding existing systems quickly * Comfortable moving between product development and automation * Able to turn ambiguous business requirements into working software * Comfortable taking technical direction while independently owning execution This is not a narrowly defined frontend, backend, or DevOps position. We are looking for a broad senior engineer capable of owning complex software problems across the stack. Show more Show less

descripcion: Summary The Business Intelligence Analyst I is responsible for developing, maintaining, and supporting business intelligence, reporting, and data visualization solutions across Loyal Source Government Services' analytics platforms. This role partners with business stakeholders, senior analysts, data engineers, and technology teams to transform data into actionable insights that support strategic, operational, and executive decision-making. The ideal candidate possesses foundational to intermediate Power BI development skills, SQL knowledge, strong analytical capabilities, and a passion for data-driven problem solving. This position supports both Commercial and GCC reporting initiatives while gaining experience with enterprise reporting platforms, Microsoft Fabric technologies, and business intelligence best practices. Pay: Starting at $55,000 *Salary Exempt* Duties and Functions Power BI Development Develop, maintain, and enhance Power BI reports, dashboards, and scorecards that support operational, financial, and strategic decision-making across the organization. Create DAX measures, calculated columns, KPIs, and visualizations that transform complex data into meaningful and actionable business insights. Participate in report design, testing, deployment, and ongoing enhancement activities while following established reporting standards and best practices. Troubleshoot report, dashboard, and data issues by performing root cause analysis and partnering with senior analysts, data engineers, and business stakeholders to resolve problems. Maintain report documentation, data definitions, and business logic to ensure reporting consistency, accuracy, and knowledge sharing across teams. Data Analysis & Reporting Analyze data from multiple sources to identify trends, performance indicators, operational risks, and opportunities for business improvement. Support recurring and ad hoc reporting requests by delivering accurate, timely, and relevant information to business stakeholders. Gather, document, and validate business requirements to ensure reporting solutions align with organizational goals and user expectations. Validate report results against source systems and investigate discrepancies to ensure data integrity and reporting accuracy. Present analytical findings and recommendations in a clear and concise manner to both technical and non-technical audiences. SQL & Data Support Develop and maintain SQL queries used to support reporting, dashboard development, data validation, and analytical initiatives. Perform data reconciliation and source-to-target validation activities to ensure consistency across systems and reporting platforms. Collaborate with Data Engineering and technology teams to understand data structures, business rules, and reporting requirements. Job Summary: The Supply Chain Manager role will be responsible for establishing and leading the end-to-end supply chain function for a newly established Buenos Aires Corporate Office. This role is highly strategic and externally focused, requiring strong supplier engagement, market intelligence, and network development to build a competitive and resilient local supply base. The Supply Chain Manager will lead the establishment and execution of the supply chain function for mining operations and projects in Argentina. You will participate with the project management team in defining and developing the scope of work, and in preparing and coordinating supply chain plans, procedures, schedules, estimates, forecasts, and budgets. You will ensure supply chain operations comply with corporate, business unit and project requirements. Lead and develop the Supply Chain team and implement the procurement and sub/contract plans while leveraging value and efficiencies and ensuring the monitoring of safety, quality, cost, and performance. This role sets the standard for technical excellence across the analytics team, defining metrics frameworks, data modeling practices, and governance standards while serving as a trusted advisor to senior business stakeholders and a key contributor to Jamf's AI-enabled analytics strategy. What you can expect to do in this role: Drive strategic impact by leading analytical roadmaps and initiatives that align with Jamf's long-term goals. Identify high-impact opportunities, cut through ambiguity on critical initiatives, and represent the data function in leadership forums. Take end-to-end ownership of complex, cross-functional analytical projects, from scoping and stakeholder alignment through to delivery. Partner with senior leadership and functional analysts as a trusted analytical advisor across Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Operations, translating business questions into scalable data products and delivering insights that shape decisions. Set the standard for metrics definition, data modeling, data storytelling, and analytical best practice across the team. Lead the design of scalable data infrastructure and workflows using tools such as dbt, and maintain a high bar for code quality and system design. Lead cross-departmental initiatives that grow data literacy across Jamf, including developing enablement resources, running training sessions, and embedding data-driven thinking into how teams operate. Contribute to roadmap and vision planning alongside Business Intelligence leadership. Mentor analysts at all levels, accelerating their technical and business growth, and foster a culture of autonomy, constructive feedback, and continuous learning. Own data quality and governance by driving the health, integrity, and discoverability of Jamf's data assets, leading stewardship practices, maintaining the data catalog, and ensuring data is trusted across the organization. (Required) Expert-level SQL and 4+ years building data models within a modern data stack (dbt, Snowflake, or equivalent), including layered modeling, testing, performance optimization, and cost management. (Required) Strong analytics engineering and data system design across databases, schemas, marts, aggregates, and views, including 4+ years extending and maintaining a data model system to serve multiple business use cases, with the ability to architect scalable, future-proofed solutions and set technical direction for a team. (Required) Demonstrated ownership of large, complex, cross-functional analytics projects from scoping through delivery. (Required) Experience with data access and security practices both within and outside of a data warehouse. (Required) Preferred Experience building multi-quarter analytical roadmaps or leading organization-wide data initiatives. Experience introducing a new tool, technique, or pattern to a team, with measurable productivity or quality improvements. Familiarity with SaaS business metrics such as ARR, churn, retention, NRR, and product usage analytics. Operating globally, our 6000+ specialists provide a full spectrum of services, including business and tech advisory, enterprise solutions, CX, UX and Ul design, managed services, product development, and software development. This is the job In Argentina within the Fintech industry , we are actively seeking a professional to strengthen our team dedicated to scaling and evolving our high-availability backend platforms. In this position, during your first six months, your primary objective will be to enable and scale our existing systems to support multi-region AWS infrastructures . Following this initial high-impact phase, you will have the opportunity to rotate into and contribute your talent to another core team within the company. This is the team In your role, you'll become a vital member of a skilled, multi-technology team working alongside Product Owners, Web, and Mobile engineers under the Scrum framework. Your primary responsibility will involve technically leading the adaptation of existing systems into multi-region architectures and maintaining resilient event-driven workflows. Here you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to global technological progress while at the same time advancing your own skills and career. This is you 4 years of proven experience in Backend Software Development. Advanced proficiency in Node.js and TypeScript. Strong hands-on experience in AWS cloud development, specifically with containerization and orchestration using EKS (Elastic Kubernetes Service). Advanced knowledge of Kafka and Event-Driven Architectures (required). Solid experience working with relational databases, preferably MySQL or PostgreSQL. Practical and demonstrable application of Clean Architecture principles and design patterns. Proven experience designing or implementing multi-region cloud deployments. descripcion: Why Work at Banner? For over 50 years, Banner Engineering has been at the forefront of industrial automation. We offer products and solutions including award-winning sensors, wireless solutions, machine safety, indication and LED lighting. From Fortune 500 leaders to innovative startups, Banner's award-winning products and solutions are helping companies around the world increase efficiency, reduce costs, safeguard equipment, and protect personnel. Our commitment to innovation shows through a continuous, market-driven evolution of products and technology. With engineers employed in nearly every major department, engineering is in our DNA. Banner is a rapidly growing company that offers many personal development opportunities, an excellent benefits package, and a collaborative team of employees who are passionate about what they do. Position Summary The Senior Supply Chain Planner will play a critical role in advancing Banner’s inventory planning capability and stocking program strategy. This role will support and drive the processes, analytics, and cross-functional decision-making needed to improve in-stock levels at Banner and across distributor channels while balancing customer service, working capital, operational constraints, and product lifecycle priorities. The position will partner closely with Operations, Commercial, Product Management, Supply Chain, and regional teams to translate demand signals, stocking policies, service-level expectations, and product-family strategies into actionable inventory plans. The role will help define which products should be stocked, where inventory should be positioned, how stocking levels should be maintained, and how exceptions should be surfaced for decision-making. This position reports to Demand Planning Manager. This role requires working onsite at our Brooklyn Park, MN office five days a week. What You’ll Be Doing This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working Collaboratively and Individually, staying on top of tasks, and making a meaningful impact across teams and projects. Below are some key responsibilities of the role. Key Responsibilities Support the development and execution of Banner’s stocking program strategy, including P/S/N stocking recommendations, min/max logic, demand segmentation, and service-level targets. Analyze inventory availability, forecast inputs, demand behavior, backlog, open sales orders, lead times, and distributor requirements to identify gaps in in-stock performance. Partner with Product Management and Commercial teams to align stocking decisions with product-family strategy, lifecycle stage, customer promise, distributor expectations, and revenue priorities. Work with Operations and Supply Chain teams to translate stocking strategy into executable replenishment, production, and material plans. Develop reporting and dashboards to monitor in-stock levels, inventory health, service levels, forecast quality, slow-moving inventory, excess exposure, and stocking-policy effectiveness. Identify root causes of stockouts, inventory imbalances, past-due backlog, slow-moving inventory, and unmanaged stocking drift; recommend corrective actions and process improvements. Support monthly forecast and inventory reviews, product-family health reviews, and cross-functional stocking governance forums. Evaluate demand patterns using segmentation methods such as ABC/XYZ, runners/repeaters/strangers, lifecycle stage, customer concentration, and revenue contribution. Recommend stocking policy updates, safety stock assumptions, replenishment parameters, and exception-handling rules based on data, business priorities, and operational feasibility. Coordinate with distributor-facing and regional teams to understand channel inventory needs, availability gaps, lead-time expectations, and communication requirements. Help build standard work, planning tools, and repeatable processes that improve inventory decision quality and reduce reliance on ad hoc analysis. Escalate material stocking risks, service-level tradeoffs, or inventory exposure issues with clear options, financial impact, and recommended next steps. What You Bring To The Table To perform this job successfully, you must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily, and regular attendance is required. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required to perform this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to support individuals with disabilities. Required Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Business, Finance, Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in demand planning, inventory planning, supply planning, operations analytics, commercial operations, or a related manufacturing environment. Strong analytical capability with experience translating large datasets into business insights, recommendations, and action plans. Experience with inventory management concepts including safety stock, min/max, service levels, forecast accuracy, lifecycle planning, SKU segmentation, and excess/obsolete inventory. Working knowledge of ERP, MRP, forecasting, planning, or inventory optimization systems; experience with Oracle, GAINS, Qlik, Power BI, Excel, or similar tools preferred. Ability to work cross-functionally with Operations, Supply Chain, Product Management, Sales, Finance, Customer Care, and regional teams. Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain analytical findings, tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations to both technical and business audiences. Demonstrated ability to manage ambiguity, structure problems, drive follow-up, and influence decisions without direct authority. Preferred Qualifications Experience in industrial manufacturing, automation, electronics, or distribution-supported business models. Familiarity with make-to-stock, configure-to-order, build-to-order, and engineer-to-order fulfillment models. Experience supporting SIOP, product lifecycle management, stocking strategy, distributor inventory programs, or product-family business reviews. Advanced Excel, data visualization, SQL, Power BI, Qlik, or similar analytics skills. APICS/ASCM CPIM, CSCP, or related supply chain certification preferred. Success Measures Improved in-stock levels for priority and stocked items at Banner and key distributor locations. Improved accuracy and discipline of stocking parameters, including P/S/N status, min/max levels, and replenishment assumptions. Better visibility to inventory gaps, stockout drivers, slow-moving inventory, and service-level tradeoffs. Clearer linkage between product-family strategy, commercial demand signals, and executable supply plans. Reduction in unmanaged inventory drift, excess exposure, and recurring planning exceptions. Repeatable reporting cadence and governance process for inventory and stocking decisions. What To Expect At Work Physical Demands The physical demands described here must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to support individuals with disabilities. Sit for up to 8 hours per day. Continuous movement, walking, or standing. Exposed to a computer screen for extended periods May require repetitive motions such as utilize a computer mouse, keyboard, computer, and other standard office equipment. Communicate with others frequently. Occasionally lift and/or move objects up to 25 pounds. Working Environment The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those you may encounter while performing the essential functions of this job. The Principal NLP Scientist is a senior technical leader responsible for designing, researching, and improving advanced Natural Language Processing and Large Language Model capabilities for production business systems. This role combines applied research, hands‑on model development, technical architecture, and practical product impact. The Principal NLP Scientist will lead the design of NLP solutions for named entity recognition, text classification, text generation, semantic search, information extraction, and other language‑driven automation use cases. This is not only a research role. The focus is to take modern NLP and LLM technologies and make them reliable, measurable, maintainable, and useful inside real production workflows. Assigned Product Group - Product Group | NLP / AI Automation - Stream | Software Engineering / AI & Machine Learning - Role Type | Principal-level individual contributor / technical leader The Principal NLP Scientist will work closely with engineers, data engineers, product managers, analysts, and data annotation teams to define, build, evaluate, and continuously improve NLP models and language‑based automation systems. Product Group Focus Areas The NLP product group is responsible for building and improving systems related to: - Named entity recognition and structured data extraction - Text classification and categorization - Text generation and language‑based automation - Large Language Model evaluation, adaptation, and integration - Retrieval‑augmented generation and semantic search - Knowledge graph and GraphRAG‑based approaches for connecting structured business data, unstructured text, and entity relationships in AI assistant workflows - Data preparation, annotation strategy, and labeling quality - Model evaluation, monitoring, and production performance - Applied NLP research and prototype development - Integration of NLP models into internal business applications Insight on Your Impact In this role, you will influence how the company uses modern NLP and LLM technologies across internal platforms and operational workflows. You will define technical direction for NLP systems, evaluate new approaches, design experiments, create prototypes, and help move successful models into production. Your work will directly affect automation quality, data processing accuracy, operational efficiency, and the long‑term AI capabilities of the company. The role requires strong scientific depth, but also practical engineering judgment. The right candidate should be able to read research papers, understand model architecture, design measurable experiments, and also work with engineers to make sure the final solution can run reliably in production. Your Qualifications, Your Influence To be successful in this role, you should have: - PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Computational Linguistics, Applied Mathematics, Data Science, or a closely related technical field - 8+ years of professional experience in machine learning, artificial intelligence, or NLP - 5+ years of hands‑on experience building NLP models for production or near‑production systems - Deep understanding of modern neural network architectures, including RNN, CNN, Transformer‑based architectures, attention mechanisms, embeddings, fine‑tuning strategies, layers, modules, and loss functions - Strong practical experience with NLP tasks such as NER, classification, text generation, semantic similarity, information extraction, and document understanding - Strong experience with Large Language Models, including model evaluation, prompt design, fine‑tuning, retrieval‑augmented generation, and safe production usage - Practical understanding of RAG, GraphRAG, knowledge graphs, embeddings, and hybrid retrieval approaches for production LLM applications - Strong hands‑on experience with Python - Strong experience with PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers - Experience with ONNX or other model optimization / model serving formats - Strong understanding of data preparation, data quality, labeling workflows, annotation guidelines, and model evaluation metrics - Practical experience with main data analysis and machine learning libraries, including Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, scikit‑learn, and Matplotlib - Experience working with SQL databases and structured business data - Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or AWS - Ability to design experiments, define success metrics, compare model approaches, and explain trade‑offs clearly - Strong written and verbal English communication skills - Experience working in Agile engineering environments - Ability to provide technical leadership without requiring formal people management authority Preferred Skills and Technical Familiarity The following experience will be helpful: - Experience leading NLP or AI research initiatives in a commercial production environment - Experience with multilingual NLP systems - Experience with vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, and RAG architectures - Experience with knowledge graph concepts, including entity and relationship modeling, graph schema design, traversal queries, and LLM integration with graph databases such as Neo4j, FalkorDB, or similar technologies - Experience with model serving, monitoring, drift detection, and production ML observability - Experience with Docker and containerized ML workloads - Experience with MLOps practices and CI/CD for machine learning systems - Experience working with data annotation teams and creating annotation instructions - Experience with .NET / C#, ASP.NET Core, or integration of ML services into enterprise software platforms - Experience building prototypes, demos, and proof‑of‑concept applications for new AI capabilities - Publications, patents, or recognized technical contributions in NLP, machine learning, or applied AI are a plus Success in the First 90 Days - Understand the current NLP and AI automation landscape inside the company - Review existing models, datasets, annotation processes, and production use cases - Identify the highest‑impact opportunities for NLP and LLM improvements - Define practical evaluation metrics for current and future NLP models - Create a technical roadmap for improving NER, classification, generation, and information extraction capabilities - Propose clear standards for data labeling quality, model validation, and production readiness - descripcion: Org Marketing Statement Parker Hannifin, a Fortune 250 company, is solving the world’s greatest engineering challenges and driving the future of electronics technology. Parker Chomerics is part of a world leader in the development and manufacture of high-quality products that enable engineering breakthroughs for a cleaner and more sustainable world, including thermal interface materials, EMI shielding solutions, electrical grounding products, and conductive and non-conductive injection molded plastics. Building on 100 years in business, we strive to balance evolving our business while strengthening the communities we operate in and prioritizing our employees’ well-being. We are committed to maintaining an inclusive, caring, and friendly work environment, and we support career advancement through continued education, skill development, and regional and global advancement opportunities. If you’re looking for a fast-paced, collaborative environment where you can be at the cutting edge of engineering solutions, we can’t wait to meet you. Position Summary As an entry-level Supply Chain Analyst, this position will support forecasting and coordination of materials and production schedules to ensure efficient operations. The role involves demand forecasting, inventory management, data analysis, and collaboration with Customer Service, Supply Chain, external customers, and other departments to support smooth production processes, improve electronic communication, and contribute to the Order to Cash process in a LEAN environment. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, eager to learn, and capable of working in a fast-paced environment. This position does not have direct reports. Responsibilities Customer Forecast Management: Receive, review, and analyze customer forecasts to identify demand trends, risks, requirement changes, and forecast variability. Work directly with customers and internal teams to improve forecast accuracy, align supply plans, and communicate demand changes across the organization. S&OP Support: Participate in the Sales & Operations Planning process for assigned sites by aligning customer demand, production capacity, material availability, inventory strategies, service goals, cost objectives, and operational requirements. Production, Material & Supply Planning: Partner with production sites to support the smooth flow of materials, timely communication of demand changes, and alignment of supply plans with manufacturing schedules and customer requirements. Evaluate material availability, initiate work orders or purchase requests as needed, and coordinate material movements to support customer demand, production schedules, inventory targets, and supply continuity. Inventory & Demand Analysis: Analyze inventory usage, forecast consumption, scrap, excess, and obsolescence. Recommend actions to optimize inventory levels, improve turnover, reduce waste, and maintain customer service levels. Status Reporting & Risk Communication: Provide management with updates on demand, supply risks, material constraints, work-in-progress, potential production issues, and recommended actions to improve planning effectiveness and reduce disruptions. Problem Resolution: Work with management and cross-functional teams to resolve shortages, over shipments, forecast variability, engineering changes, order cancellations, and other customer service or supply chain disruptions. Cross-Functional Coordination: Collaborate with Customer Service, Supply Chain, IT, Manufacturing, Purchasing, Engineering, Quality, Materials Management, Shipping, Contract Administration, external customers, and other departments to ensure effective communication, material flow, and execution of customer requirements. New Product Introduction Support: Support new product introductions by coordinating material readiness, validating supply chain capacity, and assisting with ramp-up plans to ensure successful launches and uninterrupted customer support. Configuration & Data Management: Maintain accurate planning parameters, open order status, customer information, and relevant system data in accordance with division policies to support effective forecasting, scheduling, customer service, and execution. EDI & Electronic Communication Support: Support Electronic Data Interchange projects to ensure seamless and efficient electronic communication between the organization and its customers or partners, including training for the Customer Service team. MyParker/PHconnect Administration: Support MyParker and PHconnect administration and training for internal and external users to ensure effective use of customer-facing tools. Customer Service Automation & System Support: Maintain Conexiom and Salesforce robotic process automation tools and stay current on Customer Service and Supply Chain trends to identify opportunities to automate workflows, improve order processing efficiency, reduce manual effort, and support continuous improvement within the Customer Service team. Customer Service Reporting & System Maintenance: Run daily reports for the Customer Service team, including price variances, duplicate orders, special charge locations, and other key order management items. Review report findings, communicate issues as needed, and keep related systems and data updated to support accurate and efficient customer service processes. Continuous Improvement: Proactively review processes and apply continuous improvement methods to strengthen planning processes, improve forecast-to-supply alignment, enhance customer service workflows, reduce costs, improve project efficiency, and enhance overall customer service and supply chain performance. Professional Development & Team Contribution: Stay current on customer service and supply chain best practices, share knowledge across the organization, mentor team members, and contribute to cross-functional initiatives that improve planning, customer service, and operational performance. Qualifications Education: Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, or a related field required. Experience: 0-2 years of previous internship experience or coursework related to supply chain, inventory management, or production planning required. US Citizenship or US Permanent Resident status required. Technical Skills: Familiarity with Microsoft Office Suite (especially Excel) and basic knowledge of ERP systems is preferred. Preferred Qualifications Certifications: Interest in pursuing certifications such as APICS Certified in Planning and Inventory Management (CPIM) or similar is a plus. Industry Exposure: Experience in a manufacturing or logistics environment, even if through internships or projects. descripcion: Koin Limited is a fast-growing, multi-brand direct-to-consumer (D2C) e-commerce group headquartered in Poole, UK. The company operates across the UK, USA, Canada, and Australia and is working towards £100 million in annual revenue by 2030. Koin is an AI-first company. We believe that AI is not a nice-to-have but a fundamental part of how we operate, compete, and scale. We are actively incorporating AI into every element of the business — from marketing and operations to finance and customer experience — and this role sits at the centre of that transformation. Koin builds and scales digitally-led brands through strong commercial strategy, data-led decision making, and high-performance e-commerce operations. The brand portfolio includes: The Koin Club — licensed collectible coins and medallions Tilly Pig — financial literacy products for children Jonny's Sister — personalised gifts and homeware Bubba Boo — eco-conscious baby, toddler and adult clothing The Wessex Mint — precious metals savings and investment platform Pastel Sixteen — contemporary fashion and accessories The AI Product Engineer is a mid to senior level individual contributor responsible for designing, building, and shipping the internal tools, applications, dashboards, and automations that power Koin's operations. Everything you build ships to real users across the business and directly supports revenue, margin, and operational efficiency. This is a product engineering role with a difference: we build AI-natively. Claude Code is the primary development environment, and the expectation is that you orchestrate AI to produce production-grade software rather than hand-coding it line by line. Dashboard Reporting – The ability to access information from databases, forms, and other sources, and prepare reports according to requirements. Data Analysis – The process of measuring and managing organizational data, identifying methodological best practices, and conducting statistical analyses. Data Interpretations – Data interpretation involves analyzing and extracting meaningful insights from raw data, transforming it into a comprehensible and actionable format. It often requires the application of statistical methods, visualization techniques, and domain knowledge to derive informed conclusions and make data-driven decisions. Data Mining – Data mining is sorting through data to identify patterns and establish relationships. Data mining parameters include: Association - looking for patterns where one event is connected to another event Sequence or path analysis - looking for patterns where one event leads to another later event Classification - looking for new patterns [May result in a change in the way the data is organized but that's ok] Clustering - finding and visually documenting groups of facts not previously known Forecasting - discovering patterns in data that can lead to reasonable predictions about the future Data mining techniques are used in mathematics, cybernetics, and genetics. Web mining, a type of data mining used in customer relationship management [CRM], takes advantage of the huge amount of information gathered by a Web site to look for patterns in user behavior. Data Preparation – Data preparation, data wrangling, also known as data munging, refers to the process of cleaning, structuring, and transforming raw data into a suitable format for analysis or other purposes. It involves tasks such as handling missing values, standardizing formats, and merging datasets to ensure data quality and usability. Data Privacy – Ability to understand and implement practices that ensure the protection and confidential handling of personal and sensitive information. This includes knowledge of relevant laws and regulations (such as GDPR or HIPAA), the ability to design and enforce policies that safeguard data, and the skills to manage data access rights and consent protocols. Data Quality Management – Strong understanding of data quality dimensions, methodologies, and best practices to establish and maintain data quality standards and processes. Data Visualization – Skill in designing and creating compelling visualizations and data stories that effectively communicate insights and facilitate decision-making. Predictive Analytics – Augmented Analytics refers to the use of artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies to enhance data preparation, insight generation, and decision-making within analytics processes. It automates data analysis, identifies patterns, and provides natural language processing interfaces to empower non-technical users with actionable insights, making the analytics process more accessible and efficient. Structured Query Language (SQL) – SQL (Structured Query Language) is a standardized programming language designed for managing and manipulating relational databases. It enables users to interact with databases by defining, querying, updating, and managing data stored in a relational database management system (RDBMS). SQL allows users to perform various operations such as retrieving data, inserting new records, updating existing records, and deleting records, as well as creating and modifying database structures like tables, indexes, views, and stored procedures. descripcion: Husch Blackwell LLP is a full-service litigation and business law firm with multiple locations across the United States, serving clients with domestic and international operations. At Husch Blackwell we believe that diverse, equitable and inclusive teams lead to better outcomes. Husch Blackwell is committed to retaining, recruiting, developing, and promoting talented lawyers and business professionals with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We foster an engaged, diverse, and inclusive team culture of accountability and purpose that makes our Firm and our communities better. Our firm is committed to attracting and retaining professionals who value each other and the service we provide by embracing Teamwork, Collaboration, Client Service, and Innovation. If you are a motivated professional looking for a long-term fit where you can grow in a role, and will be valued and empowered, then we invite you to apply to our Enterprise Data Analyst position. This position may be filled remotely or in a hybrid capacity in any of our Central and Eastern Time locations. Strong candidates located in Mountain Time will also be considered. The Enterprise Data Analyst is a firmwide shared-services role within the Firm’s Data Science function. The analyst turns the Firm’s data, client data, and the extensive internal data the Firm maintains into clear, actionable insight, delivered primarily through Power BI dashboards and reports that teams across the Firm rely on. The role will initially support a key business unit, with scope expanding to serve additional practice groups and functions across the Firm over time. The right candidate will be skilled in the visual display of quantitative information and have a passion for high impact data storytelling. Essential functions include: Data Analysis & Insight Analyze large, complex datasets from client and internal Firm sources to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights Clean, transform, and structure data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and readiness for analysis Apply statistical and data-modeling techniques to answer business questions and support decision-making Leverage AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate routine tasks, and enhance data products Translate stakeholder questions into clearly defined analytical problems, prioritizing work by impact and urgency Dashboarding & Reporting Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards that serve as the Firm’s primary, everyday reporting tools Build automated, self-service reports and visualizations in Power BI and Tableau, tailored to different audiences across the Firm Use data storytelling to deliver client-facing data presentations and executive-level reports that communicate findings clearly to key partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders, and drive action Collaborate with the Data Science Information Design and Engineering function to deliver data visualization and information rich analyses across various media types Streamline and standardize reporting processes to ensure timely, accurate delivery of key metrics Data Management & Quality Partner with the Data Engineering team to source, integrate, and validate data from across the Firm Develop and apply data quality standards to ensure reliable, trustworthy outputs Document data sources, definitions, and methodologies to support consistency and reuse Maintain and enhance existing datasets, models, and reporting pipelines Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner with teams across the Firm; including Finance and client-facing groups to gather requirements and align on objectives Work directly with internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients to understand needs and deliver solutions Connect analytical findings to business outcomes and Firm priorities Continuous Improvement & Growth Share knowledge and best practices to elevate data and analytics capabilities across the Firm Identify opportunities to automate, improve, and scale analytics as the function grows Contribute to building out the Firm’s enterprise data and analytics capabilities over time Develop and improve reporting and business intelligence techniques to align the firm with leading edge information and business intelligence delivery Engage in research and study to continuously improve the Firm’s reporting and business intelligence Position Requirements Bachelor’s degree in statistics, economics, computer science, information design, or a related quantitative communications field; commensurate professional and educational experience shall also qualify 3+ years in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related analytical role (the role may be filled at more than one level; strong candidates earlier in their careers will also be considered) Advanced, demonstrable proficiency in Power BI is required; including building, publishing, and maintaining production dashboards Strong proficiency in Excel and SQL, with experience querying and working with large, complex datasets Proficiency with basic statistical and analytical tools including the Python statistical ecosystem Experience working with data warehouses, databases, and modern BI/data platforms Strong data storytelling skills, with a proven ability to design clear, effective data visualizations and deliver client-facing presentations to partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders Experience with statistical modeling, regression analysis, and null hypothesis significance testing Proven ability to independently scope and lead complex data analysis projects Experience analyzing financial and operational performance metrics and the drivers behind them Fluent in translating complex data into clear implications and actionable recommendations for the business Comfortable working with large, complex datasets and developing data quality standards Experience working directly with senior stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients Operates with a client-service mindset; responsive, proactive, and a trusted advisor Comfortable working at both strategic and tactical levels Thrives in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy under pressure Eager to contribute beyond assigned tasks and play a key role in the growth of a new, firmwide analytics function Understanding of data confidentiality and the sensitivity of legal and client information Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting multiple business units or functions in a shared-services or enterprise environment Experience with data pipeline or ETL processes and working alongside data engineers Experience applying AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate and enhance analytics Familiarity and comfort with executive level communication and presentations The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of essential functions, responsibilities, or requirements. descripcion: When you join the team at Unum, you become part of an organization committed to helping you thrive. Benefits Here, we work to provide the employee benefits and service solutions that enable employees at our client companies to thrive throughout life’s moments. And this starts with ensuring that every one of our team members enjoys opportunities to succeed both professionally and personally. To enable this, we provide: Award-winning culture Inclusion and diversity as a priority Performance Based Incentive Plans Competitive benefits package that includes: Health, Vision, Dental, Short & Long-Term Disability Generous PTO (including paid time to volunteer!) Up to 9.5% 401(k) employer contribution Mental health support Career advancement opportunities Student loan repayment options Tuition reimbursement Flexible work environments All the benefits listed above are subject to the terms of their individual Plans. And that’s just the beginning… With 10,000 employees helping more than 39 million people worldwide, every role at Unum is meaningful and impacts the lives of our customers. Whether you’re directly supporting a growing family, or developing online tools to help navigate a difficult loss, customers are counting on the combined talents of our entire team. Help us help others, and join Team Unum today! General Summary We are seeking a Principal Data Scientist to join the CX Analytics team within our Customer Experience Organization. In this role, you will drive applied data science work that goes beyond modeling—mining structured and unstructured data to uncover deeper drivers, patterns, and opportunities that inform how the business supports its customers. You will design and run experiments, develop analytical approaches to complex business questions, and connect findings to outcomes across BI/reporting, operations, and value stream partners. AI and LLMs are central to how our team works, both in how we write code and in how we extract signal from unstructured sources such as raw text, and you will play a key role in advancing these capabilities across the team. As a hands-on technical leader, you will guide complex analytical workstreams while mentoring other Data Scientists and helping raise the bar for how the team applies advanced analytics. You will partner closely with BI Analysts and Data Engineers to ensure work is operationalized effectively and grounded in reliable data. The ideal candidate is a strong analytical thinker and collaborator who can work across structured and unstructured data, guide technical approach, and consistently translate complex data into meaningful outputs that support better decision-making across the organization. This is a campus-based role. Current remote and field-based Unum employees may apply and will be considered in accordance with company policy. Principal Duties And Responsibilities Proactively partner with the business to provide actionable insights and identify growth opportunities; communicate analysis to obtain buy-in and drive decision making. Integrate large volume of data from different sources (including DB2, SQL Server, Web API and Teradata) to create data assets for ad-hoc analyses and larger studies. Apply validation, aggregation and reconciliation techniques to create rich modeling-ready data framework. Build and maintain best practices for team's data science strategy; as well as staying informed of best practices across industries and striving for innovation and efficiency. Prioritize and lead analytics projects Apply domain expertise to modeling process using state-of-the-art techniques to construct predictive models to explain and understand observed events, forecast expected behavior, or identify risk through scoring or clustering. Efficiently interpret results and communicate findings and potential value to business partners to influence strategic decision making. Lead the integration of solutions within existing business processes using automation techniques. Understand theory and application of current and emerging statistical methods and tools. Coaches, mentors and develops peers and/or team members. Perform other related duties as assigned. Job Specifications Bachelor’s degree in quantitative field is required, Master’s or PhD is preferred 8 years of professional experience or equivalent relevant work experience preferred Core Data Science Capabilities: Deep expertise in each of the following categories of skillsets is preferred Programming & Process automation: Experience with using file I/O, database integrations, and APIs to build automated analytics pipelines. Demonstrated experience using DevOps libraries to research and design processes including automation, data mining, web scraping, or object-oriented software is preferred. Experience engineering solutions using cloud platforms and exposure to scaling solutions in the cloud. Understands partnership with IT to deploy solutions. Demonstrated expertise at bringing analytics to scale Data Visualization: Demonstrates the ability to critically evaluate visualization suitability to specific scenarios. Statistics & Statistical Modeling: Expertise on statistical inference and regression. Expertise in machine learning, feature selection, and feature extraction. Demonstrated experience in leading multiple high-impact machine learning and analysis projects end-to-end Data Extraction, Transformation, and Loading skillsets preferred: Expertise in writing complex SQL queries that join multiple tables/databases. Demonstrated through independent research of data sources, troubleshooting complex SQL queries, and leading partnerships with external data providers. Demonstrates ability to create logical data models by combining data from multiple sources including internal and external data. Core business capabilities: Strong communication skills, expertise in financial services, strong experience leading engagements, and working with executive leadership. Strong project management skills; effectively and independently prioritizes and manages own projects simultaneously and provides direction on projects and prioritization to less experienced team members. Leadership Capabilities: Leader within their field, both internally and externally. Naturally effective coach and mentor, actively engages peers and team members, especially within areas of expertise. Viewed as a leader in change management. Maintains depth of technical understanding of third party/cloud solutions. This position may have key leadership responsibilities, including: People Management: Actively participates in determining staffing needs of the team, including hiring and development. Leads assigned team in the completion of requested activities and projects. Analytics strategic and program management for their organization: Coaches, mentors, and helps build team. Proactively identifies and researches new approaches and skills needed for performing data science and advanced analytics. Preferred characteristics: Entrepreneurial self-starter. A thorough, results-oriented problem-solver, and a lifelong learner with voracious curiosity. Deep expertise in their organization. MartinFed's Core Values That Set Us Apart Are The Following Be Driven - We are fueled by the hunger to learn more and do more. Be Curious - We engage in continuous improvement - never accepting the status quo. Be Humble - We seek honest feedback to strengthen our relationships. Pursue Excellence - We strive to achieve extraordinary results and do not settle for mediocrity. Strive for excellence and consider joining our growing team today! Job Overview The Junior Software Engineer provides hands-on development and engineering support to the Splunk Engineering and Maintenance team supporting government agencies. Working under the direction of senior Data, Platform, and Detection Engineers, this role contributes across the full breadth of the SIEM environment: onboarding and normalizing data sources, maintaining platform infrastructure and configurations, developing searches, dashboards, and content, and automating recurring engineering tasks through scripting and code. This is an entry-level, growth-oriented position for an engineer with a software development or cybersecurity foundation who is expected to build depth in Splunk and security operations over time. The Junior Software Engineer collaborates with senior engineers, security analysts, and agency stakeholders, and follows established code review, testing, and change management practices. Essential Functions Software Development and Automation. Write, test, and maintain scripts and small applications (Python, Bash, PowerShell) that automate recurring Splunk engineering, maintenance, and reporting tasks. Use version control, peer code review, and established branching and deployment practices for all code and configuration changes. Data Engineering Support. Assist with onboarding new log sources, including configuration of inputs, forwarders, parsing rules (props and transforms), source types, and index assignment. Support data quality efforts by validating field extractions, timestamps, event breaking, and Common Information Model (CIM) normalization under senior engineer guidance. Platform Engineering and Maintenance. Support routine maintenance of the Splunk environment, including indexers, search heads, forwarders, deployment servers, and app and patch deployments. Monitor platform health, license usage, ingest volume, and search performance; identify anomalies and assist senior engineers with troubleshooting and remediation. Content Development. Develop and maintain SPL searches, reports, dashboards, and alerts that support security, operational, and mission use cases. Assist Detection Engineers with building, testing, documenting, and deploying detection content through established review and release workflows. Testing, Documentation, and Quality. Test changes in development and test environments prior to production deployment and validate results against expected outcomes. Maintain technical documentation, configuration standards, runbooks, and knowledge articles for the work performed. Operational and Customer Support. Respond to assigned tickets and user requests for Splunk access, search assistance, data questions, and minor configuration changes. Provide data and platform context in support of incident response, audits, and after-action activities as directed. Collaboration and Professional Development. Participate in stand-ups, sprint planning, code reviews, and change management processes with the Splunk Engineering and Maintenance team. Work with senior engineers to translate requirements into technical tasks, and progress toward Splunk certification and technical specialization. Qualifications US Citizen with an active Top Secret Security Clearance. Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field; equivalent technical training, certifications, or demonstrable experience will be considered. 0-2 years of professional software development, IT engineering, or cybersecurity experience; internship, co-op, apprenticeship, or substantial project work is applicable. Working proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language such as Python, Bash, PowerShell, Java, Go, or JavaScript. Comfort operating in a Linux command-line environment and a foundational understanding of system administration concepts. Familiarity with version control (Git) and standard development workflows including branching, pull requests, and code review. Ability to work with structured and semi-structured data formats such as JSON, XML, CSV, YAML, and syslog, including basic use of regular expressions. Foundational understanding of networking and logging concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, authentication events) and how security-relevant events are generated across endpoint, network, and cloud. Foundational cybersecurity knowledge, including core security principles, common attack patterns, and the role of a SIEM in security operations. Willingness and demonstrated ability to learn Splunk and the Splunk Search Processing Language (SPL) quickly. Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical work for other engineers and non-technical stakeholders. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to take direction and follow established engineering processes. Ability to obtain and maintain the clearance and suitability requirements for the contract. Preferred Hands-on exposure to Splunk (SPL, dashboards, universal forwarders, apps) or another SIEM such as Elastic, Microsoft Sentinel, QRadar, or Google SecOps. As one of the nation’s top professional services firms, CohnReznick creates rewarding careers in advisory, assurance, and tax with team members who value innovation and collaboration in everything they do! We currently have an exciting career opportunity for a for a Procurement Senior Specialist – Multi-Commodity to join the Corporate Services team. CohnReznick is a hybrid firm and most of our professionals are located within a commutable distance to one of our offices. This position is considered remote which means it does not require job duties be performed within proximity of a CohnReznick office location. The Procurement Senior Specialist – Multi-Commodity will support the continued growth and maturity of the firm’s procurement function. This role will help drive strategic sourcing, supplier management, contract review, cost optimization, and procurement governance across a broad range of indirect spend categories. The Procurement Senior Specialist will partner closely with business stakeholders to understand purchasing needs, evaluate supplier options, support negotiations, and ensure procurement activity aligns with firm policies, budget expectations, risk requirements, and business priorities. Whether it’s working alongside your peers to solve a client challenge, or volunteering together at the local food bank, there are so many ways to find your “why” at the firm. We believe it’s important to balance work with everyday life – and make time for enjoyment and fun. We invest in a robust Total Rewards package that includes everything from generous PTO, a flexible work environment, expanded parental leave, extensive learning & development, and even paid time off for employees to volunteer. YOUR ROLE. Responsibilities Responsibilities include but are not limited to: Lead sourcing activities across multiple indirect spend categories, including professional services, facilities, office services, marketing, HR-related services, financial services, business operations, travel, supplies, and other business services. Partner with stakeholders to define business requirements, evaluate suppliers, compare pricing, and recommend sourcing strategies that balance cost, quality, risk, compliance, and business need. Support supplier selection, onboarding, performance management, renewal reviews, and vendor rationalization efforts. Negotiate supplier pricing, service levels, commercial terms, and contract protections in partnership with business owners, Legal, Finance, and other stakeholders. Review supplier agreements before Legal review to confirm business terms, pricing, service requirements, renewal language, approvals, and procurement documentation are complete and accurate. Identify opportunities to reduce cost, consolidate spend, standardize buying channels, improve supplier value, and strengthen procurement compliance. Maintain sourcing documentation, supplier records, approval history, savings tracking, and other procurement materials to support governance and audit readiness. Contribute to procurement process improvements, tools, templates, workflows, reporting, and automation initiatives. Your Experience. The successful candidate will have: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Finance, Operations, or a related field required. 6+ years of experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, category management, supplier management, or related business operations. Experience supporting sourcing events, supplier evaluations, pricing analysis, contract negotiations, and vendor management across multiple indirect spend categories. Strong understanding of procurement best practices, contract review, supplier governance, cost analysis, and stakeholder management. Ability to analyze spend data, supplier proposals, pricing models, total cost of ownership, and business impacts. Strong communication, negotiation, organization, and project management skills. Preferred Qualifications Procurement or supply chain certification such as CPSM, CSCP, CPM, CPP, or similar. Experience in professional services, financial services, tax, audit, advisory, or business services environments. Familiarity with procurement, ERP, contract management, or workflow tools such as SAP, Coupa, Oracle, Workday, Ariba, or similar platforms. Experience developing sourcing templates, vendor scorecards, savings trackers, procurement policies, or supplier governance models. We Dare to Amaze, Own It, Make It Simple, and Win Together challenging ourselves every day to do better than the day before. We've learned that the secret to great coffee is the people who make it, and we apply the same care in selecting and preparing our teams as we do when crafting the perfect cup. The Manufacturing Process Engineer will support Peets’ Minneapolis Manufacturing Site and report to the VP of Coffee Operations. This role will play a key part in driving operational excellence by identifying and eliminating waste, improving process efficiency, and reducing variability across manufacturing operations. The ideal candidate is a hands-on problem solver with a passion for continuous improvement. This role will leverage lean methodologies, structured problem-solving, process optimization, and change management to implement sustainable improvements and foster a culture of engagement and operational excellence in a fast-paced manufacturing environment. Salary $90,000-$115,000 Location Brooklyn Center, MN – Onsite Responsibilities Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and eliminate the eight sources of waste (e.g., downtime, defects, overproduction, motion, inventory, waiting, transportation, and underutilized talent) Identify, quantify, and prioritize opportunities to reduce manufacturing and operating costs. Analyze process performance, material usage, labor, energy, scrap, downtime, and other cost drivers. Develop and implement process improvements that reduce waste, improve productivity, and optimize resource utilization. Establish project baselines and measure financial impact to ensure savings are sustainable and accurately documented. Partner with Operations, Maintenance, Quality, Supply Chain, Finance, and other functions to implement improvements. Investigate process losses and develop data-driven corrective actions. Standardize successful improvements and develop processes to sustain gains. Lead and support structured problem-solving activities (e.g., RCCMs, A3s, DMAIC projects) and change management initiatives to drive root cause analysis and implement sustainable solutions Partner with operations, maintenance, and quality teams to implement process changes that enhance safety, quality, and throughput Facilitate and support kaizen events, problem solving workshops, and project team meetings to solve operational and financial problems Monitor and analyze process performance data to identify trends and improvement opportunities Support the development and implementation of standard work and visual management tools Provide leadership to operational functions to drive productivity with a focus on efficiencies, yield, people capability building and waste elimination opportunities. Lead Lean/Kaizen events across the roasting plant to provide recommendations and implementation of enhancements to existing workflows and processes to increase throughput, reduce costs, and improve quality of our products. Assist in training frontline teams on problem solving tools and lean daily management Foster a culture of continuous improvement throughout the plant Coordinates efforts to deliver projects to meet annual cost savings goal for the roasting plant. Develop and lead routines to drive the measurement of downtime and plans to improve up time via industrial engineering time studies, standard work, and labor standard targets for operations. Analyze existing processes and identify opportunities for improvement in throughput, quality, cost, safety, and reliability. Develop process flows, specifications, layouts, standard work, and engineering documentation. Conduct root-cause analysis and develop sustainable solutions to recurring process issues. Use data and statistical analysis to evaluate process capability and performance. Support implementation of new products, equipment, technologies, and manufacturing processes. Who You Are Shares Peet’s core values: Accountability, Curiosity, Mastery, and Inclusivity. Excellent organizational, leadership, and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across departments. High level of professionalism: reliable, punctual, detail-oriented, self-motivated, and results-driven. Ability to maintain confidentiality and ensure compliance with all company policies and procedures. Qualifications Required: Bachelor’s degree (B.S.) in Engineering or a related technical field preferred. 3–5 years of experience in a manufacturing or industrial environment. Proven experience using structured problem-solving tools and methodologies to identify root causes and implement sustainable process improvements that positively impact manufacturing operations. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate complex issues, develop solutions, and drive effective implementation. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence, collaborate with, and engage teams at all levels of the organization. Proactive and self-motivated, with a demonstrated ability to take ownership of projects and responsibilities, work independently, anticipate needs, and identify opportunities for improvement. Hands-on, results-oriented approach with a strong bias for action and a track record of driving projects through to completion. Basic knowledge or hands-on experience with mechanical and/or electrical systems is a plus. Preferred Green Belt and Black Belt certification preferred Prior experience in the Food & Beverage or CPG industry Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365), SAP, and Microsoft Office Suite, including advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint. Experience with Power BI and AutoCAD is also preferred.
