descripcion: About The Role The FP&A Finance Manager for Precor and Peloton Commercial oversees the rhythm of the business for our core finance processes, including monthly close, the annual operating plan, CapEx spending, and our long-range financial plan, leveraging each of those cycles as a decision-making moment rather than a reporting exercise. This position reports to the Senior Director of FP&A and is a storytelling role as much as a planning role; the successful candidate will turn close results and forecast movements into a clear, credible narrative that connects performance to drivers, risks, and the choices in front of leadership. This role is instrumental in leveraging the operating rhythm as an engine for growth, helping the business prioritize the investments that matter most. This is a leadership role for someone who is equally comfortable in the mechanics and the message. The successful candidate brings strong business partnering instincts, the credibility to influence senior stakeholders when the answer is unpopular, the ability to modernize processes so the team spends less time assembling numbers and more time shaping decisions, and proven experience driving tangible business results. They should be energized by ambiguity, driving standardization across functions, and building trust in a fast-moving, matrixed environment. Responsibilities Rhythm of Business, Close & Planning Owns consolidation of the CBU financials, bringing together the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow across entities and channels into a single, coherent picture of business performance. Directs the rhythm of business calendar and governance, spanning our close cycles, monthly updates, quarterly forecast, annual operating plan, and the long-range plan. Continuously evolves the FP&A operating model, applying systems thinking to end-to-end process dependencies, stakeholder needs, governance requirements, and decision flows to reduce complexity. Drives operational excellence through process redesign, standardization, and automation, improving cycle time, insight quality, and decision velocity. Partners with Accounting and systems owners to strengthen reporting capability, data integrity, and cost and performance visibility. Storytelling & Executive Reporting Owns MBR, QBR, and Board-level reporting, converting close and forecast outcomes into enterprise narratives that tie results to the themes, drivers, and risks leadership cares about. Turns complex financial and operational dynamics into clear, executive-ready storylines that give leaders the confidence to decide and act. Delivers concise, consistent, and insight-forward reporting that provokes decisions and sharpens the recommended course of action. Process Efficiency, Automation & AI Champions the adoption of advanced analytics, modern data platforms, and AI-enabled tooling to modernize how finance produces insight, supports decisions, and scales its impact, including validation and controls over automated output. Builds and maintains dashboards and reporting that give business leaders self-service visibility into performance, reducing manual reporting effort and shortening the time from result to insight. Proactively identifies and leads improvement opportunities, automating recurring workflows, improving data quality at the source, and building repeatable analytical assets the team can rely on. Capital Investment & NPI Support Partners cross-functionally on capital investment evaluation and productivity analysis, supporting resource allocation choices that drive growth and shareholder value. Helps shape R&D and product investment strategy so it connects clearly to differentiated innovation and to topline and bottom-line commitments. Supports product roadmap prioritization based on profit contribution and engineering resource constraints, working closely with Engineering and Product leaders. Models design iterations and builds the business case for new products and features based on product-market fit and expected cost reduction, supporting the stage-gate NPI process. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related discipline. 6+ years of progressive experience in Financial Planning & Analysis, Corporate Finance, or Commercial Finance. 2+ years of experience leading end-to-end corporate close and forecast processes, consolidating and reporting a multi-entity financial view, and producing the executive reporting that follows (MBR, QBR, or Board-level materials), with accountability for accuracy, timeliness, and the narrative delivered to leadership. Proven track record of delivering high-impact business results, influencing outcomes without authority. Demonstrated ability to forge strong business partnerships that shape strategy, execution, and resource decisions. Advanced financial modeling skills with expert proficiency in Microsoft Excel. Demonstrated use of AI and automation to rebuild finance workflows and deliver measurable gains in cycle time, accuracy, and analyst capacity, including hands-on experience with tools such as Power Query, Python, and AI agents, along with the controls needed to trust the output. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to synthesize large, complex data sets into meaningful business insights. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Experience with business intelligence and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms. Experience with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, or similar financial systems. Preferred Qualifications MBA, CPA, CFA, or other advanced finance credential. Experience in manufacturing, consumer products, SaaS, or commercial organizations with global operations. Experience supporting new product development as a finance partner, including business case development, product cost modeling, and stage-gate governance alongside Engineering and Product teams. Prior experience supporting capital planning, including annual budgeting, ROI analysis, and capital request approval workflows. The Global Supply Chain Process & Systems Manager is responsible for driving standardization, efficiency, and excellence across the company’s global supply chain organization. The role will oversee the design, governance, and continuous improvement of supply chain business processes, lead the effective deployment and optimization of supply chain management systems (with particular focus on SAP), and establish a robust framework for Master Data Management, Integrated Demand Planning and Contract Lifecycle Management. The role requires strong cross‑functional leadership to align Supply Chain, Operations, Asset Management & Maintenance, Finance, and IT, ensuring that supply chain processes and systems are integrated, effective, and support the organization’s strategic objectives. The Day To Day Business Process Leadership - Define, harmonize, and optimize end‑to‑end supply chain processes globally (Plan, Source, Procure, Deliver, Maintain & Sustain). - Establish global process governance and standards to ensure consistency across regions and business units (aligning with IMS and MOS standards, audit, and governance frameworks). - Identify and implement process improvements to reduce inefficiencies, duplications, and operational risks to ensure a robust and sustainable framework across all SSR operating mine sites. Systems Ownership (SAP & SCM Tools) - Serve as global process owner for SAP Supply Chain modules (MM, WM/EWM, PP, FICO, etc.) and related SCM systems (MIDAS, IDP). - Partner with IT to ensure system enhancements align with business requirements. - Drive adoption of digital solutions and advanced analytics within the supply chain function. Master Data Management (MDM) - Develop and enforce global master data standards, policies, and governance frameworks. - Oversee the integrity, accuracy, and timeliness of supply chain master data (materials, vendors, contracts, pricing, assets, etc.). - Implement tools and processes for ongoing data quality monitoring and cleansing. Change Management & Training - Lead global training initiatives to strengthen user adoption of processes and systems. - Act as a change champion to embed a culture of process discipline and data‑driven decision‑making. Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement - Partner with Operations, Maintenance, Asset Management, and Finance to ensure supply chain systems and data support business needs. - Represent Supply Chain in global system projects, upgrades, and SAP S/4HANA transformation initiatives. descripcion: Product & Retention Analytics Manager At Félix , we are building the indispensable financial companion for Latinos in the US. We combine an AI-powered, conversational-first interface with real-time financial infrastructure to make cross-border money movement as easy as sending a text. Starting with fast, affordable remittances powered by AI and crypto rails, we are expanding into credit, savings, and wallet services to support the complete immigrant financial journey. Our ambition is to deliver a white-glove financial experience with the simplicity of a conversation to a community the traditional financial system has historically overlooked. We are a hyper-growth Series C company, backed by over $300 million in funding from top-tier global investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, QED, Castle Island, Switch Ventures, HTwenty, Monashees, General Catalyst Customer Value Fund. This isn't just about the numbers; it's a testament to the trust our investors have in our vision and our team. Additionally, Félix was selected as an “Endeavour Entrepreneur” and was a recipient of the CrossTech Fintech Startups Award. Joining Félix means you will be part of a team building a legacy, a company that will outlive us all. This is a rare opportunity to apply your skills to a deeply meaningful mission—serving a community that has been underserved for too long because we are obsessed with our customers . We get things done with urgency and focus , driven by extreme ownership over our impact. We collaborate without ego , fostering radical transparency and fierce loyalty so we can grow together. Because we aim for insanely great rather than just good enough, we stay insatiably curious —always experimenting, building the future today, and delivering a product that truly makes our users' lives better. About the role We are looking for a highly analytical and business-oriented Product & Retention Analytics Manager to lead a multidisciplinary team across Chat, Retention, AI, and Operations . This role sits at the intersection of Data, Product, and Customer Experience . The ideal candidate will be able to deeply understand the business, map the key drivers and KPIs across the customer journey, identify opportunities and friction points, and translate data into actions that improve conversion, retention, and operational efficiency. Beyond managing the team, this person will be expected to raise the analytical bar of the organization —bringing structure to complex problems, moving quickly from ambiguous questions to actionable insights, and partnering closely with stakeholders to drive measurable business impact. What you'll own 💬 Chat & Conversion Lead the analytics agenda for the Chat experience, covering both upper and lower funnel and different geographies. Partner closely with Product stakeholders to understand and improve the conversion funnel. Build and evolve dashboards and analytical frameworks, primarily using Amplitude, to monitor funnel performance and identify opportunities. Identify key conversion drivers, drop-offs, and friction points across the customer journey. Turn behavioral data into clear product recommendations and experiments. 🔄 Retention Lead the analytical strategy around user retention and lifecycle behavior. Develop a deep understanding of the different friction points users experience throughout their journey. Analyze changes in user composition, behavior, and lifecycle mix to understand what is driving retention changes. Build frameworks to identify the root causes behind retention increases or declines. Partner with Product, Operations, Growth and Fintech teams to prioritize initiatives based on their expected impact. 🤖 AI & Conversational Experience Develop a data-driven understanding of how users interact with AI-powered experiences. Identify where and why conversational experiences break down and how those failures impact conversion and retention. Define and monitor key metrics across the conversational funnel. Partner with AI/Product teams to identify opportunities to improve the experience through data and experimentation. ⚙️ Operations Build a strong understanding of operator queues, workload, performance, and operational efficiency. Develop scalable analytics and tools to monitor operator performance and identify bottlenecks. Partner with Customer Experience to improve how operators handle conversations by providing them with better context and actionable information before and during interactions. Explore and experiment with operators as a lever for retention and customer experience, measuring their incremental impact through rigorous experimentation. Help transition operational analytics from reactive reporting to proactive decision-making. These are the applicable requisites, although equivalent competencies in any of the above will also be considered. What you'll do Lead and develop a team of highly analytical data professionals. Establish a clear analytical roadmap aligned with company and product priorities. Deeply understand the business and build a comprehensive map of KPIs, drivers, and relationships across the customer lifecycle. Quickly investigate ambiguous business problems and turn them into structured analytical questions. Raise the quality, speed, and impact of analytical work across the team. Ensure that insights are not just descriptive but lead to clear actions, experiments, and measurable outcomes. Build strong relationships with a broad range of stakeholders across Product, Operations, AI, and Leadership. Challenge assumptions and bring a data-driven perspective to strategic decisions. Create scalable frameworks, dashboards, and tools that enable stakeholders to answer questions independently. Identify opportunities where data, automation, or AI can significantly improve how the organization operates. What We’re Looking For Analytical & Business Skills 6+ years of experience in Data Science, Analytics, Product Analytics, or a related field. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down complex and ambiguous problems. Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets. Strong understanding of product metrics, funnels, cohorts, retention, experimentation, and behavioral analytics. Ability to move beyond reporting and understand why metrics move and what actions can influence them. Strong business acumen and curiosity—you enjoy getting deep into how the business actually works. Leadership & Stakeholder Management Experience managing and developing analytical teams. Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills. Ability to work effectively with very different audiences, from technical teams to Product, Operations, and senior leadership. Ability to influence decisions without relying solely on formal authority. Comfortable challenging stakeholders and translating complex analyses into simple, actionable narratives. Technical & Product Strong SQL and data analysis capabilities. Experience with product analytics tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, or similar. Experience with BI and visualization tools (we use Omni). Familiarity with experimentation and causal inference is a strong plus. Experience with AI/LLM products or conversational analytics is a plus. Experience in fintech, conversational products, or other high-growth environments is a plus. descripcion: At ExtraHop, we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running. Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you. Position Summary ExtraHop is at the forefront of cybersecurity innovation, delivering Network Detection and Response (NDR) solutions that help organizations detect, investigate, and respond to cyber threats in real time. Join ExtraHop as a Senior Data Scientist and help advance the machine learning and artificial intelligence capabilities that power our products. You will analyze large-scale network telemetry, develop and evaluate methods for identifying malicious behavior, and improve the accuracy and efficacy of ExtraHop’s threat detection capabilities. This is an applied data science role for someone who enjoys solving ambiguous, high-impact problems using statistical analysis, experimentation, and machine learning. You will work closely with other data scientists, threat researchers, and software engineers to translate research into reliable product capabilities, and play a key role in contributing to the improvement of the RevealX platform. Key Responsibilities Analyze large-scale network telemetry to identify behavioral patterns, anomalies, and signals associated with malicious activity. Design, develop, and refine machine learning and AI-based methods that support ExtraHop’s products. Develop evaluation methods appropriate for cybersecurity data, including highly imbalanced datasets, incomplete labels, rare events, and changing attacker and network behavior. Conduct exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, model development, and error analysis using complex, high-volume datasets. Research emerging machine learning and AI techniques, relevant cybersecurity developments, and assess their applicability to ExtraHop’s products. Establish metrics and monitoring strategies for measuring model and detector performance over time. Communicate findings, limitations, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to technical stakeholders and product leaders. Provide technical leadership and mentorship to other data scientists through code reviews, design discussions, technical strategy, and contributions to the team’s analytical and engineering standards. Document methodologies, experiments, model behavior, and evaluation results. Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested production-quality code. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, or another quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 7+ years of professional experience in data science, including developing and evaluating machine learning models for real-world use cases, defining meaningful success metrics, and conducting rigorous offline and online evaluations. Strong foundation in statistics, experimental design, machine learning, and model evaluation. Experience working with incomplete, noisy, or highly imbalanced data; performing detailed error analysis; and identifying the causes of false positives and false negatives. Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, experience with common data science and machine learning libraries, and the ability to write maintainable, tested, and reviewable code. Experience collaborating with software engineers to integrate data science methods into production systems. Strong problem-solving skills, intellectual curiosity, and a track record of independently owning complex technical work. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical findings, uncertainty, and tradeoffs to varied audiences. Preferred Qualifications Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, or another quantitative discipline. Experience applying data science or machine learning to cybersecurity, fraud detection, abuse detection, anomaly detection, or another adversarial domain. Familiarity with Network Detection and Response, network protocols, threat detection, or incident investigation. Experience with time-series analysis, anomaly detection, actuarial modeling, clustering, graph analytics, or unsupervised and semi-supervised learning. Experience evaluating models in domains where positive examples are rare, labels are incomplete, and the underlying behavior changes over time. Experience with generative AI, large language models, agentic systems, or other emerging AI techniques. Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP. The salary range for this role is $165,000 - $180,000 + bonus + benefits About Extrahop ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments. As a Sr. Enterprise Data & Business Intelligence Analyst , you'll play a key role in advancing BECU's enterprise data visualization capabilities by designing intuitive, impactful, and scalable reporting solutions that help leaders make smarter decisions. You'll partner with analytics teams, business leaders, and BI engineers across the organization to transform complex data into meaningful stories that influence strategy at every level—including executive leadership. This role is about much more than building dashboards. You'll champion best practices in data visualization, help establish enterprise reporting standards, mentor fellow analysts, and introduce innovative ideas that elevate how BECU communicates with data. If you're passionate about the art and science of data storytelling, enjoy teaching others, and are always exploring new ways to make data more accessible and actionable, this is an opportunity to make a lasting impact. Guide analysts across the organization by mentoring on dashboard design, storytelling techniques, accessibility, and visualization best practices. Evaluate emerging visualization trends, tools, and industry practices to continuously improve BECU's reporting capabilities and user experience. Conduct technical demonstrations, knowledge-sharing sessions, and presentations with stakeholders ranging from analysts to executive leadership. Collaborate with Enterprise Data Management, BI Engineering, and Analytics teams to ensure high-quality, trusted, and well-governed enterprise reporting solutions. Support data governance initiatives by promoting high-quality datasets, visualization standards, and consistent reporting practices across the organization. Perform additional duties as assigned. This isn’t just about ticking off tasks on a list. It's about making a significant, positive change in BECU’s journey, where your contributions are valued, and your growth is continually fostered. Opportunities to mentor fellow analysts and share your expertise with a collaborative, enterprise-wide analytics community. Exposure to executive stakeholders while helping communicate strategic business insights through impactful data storytelling. Hands-on experience with leading business intelligence platforms including Tableau, Power BI, and Microsoft Fabric. A collaborative environment that values innovation, continuous learning, and bringing new ideas from across the data visualization community. Experience partnering with business stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into intuitive, scalable reporting and visualization solutions. Strong communication, presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence across technical and business audiences. Experience establishing visualization standards, governance practices, or enterprise reporting best practices. descripcion: The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities. descripcion: Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team. Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder. Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, the UK, and France. As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. This helps foster meaningful conversation and allows us to create an experience that closely resembles our standard working environment. Certain interview steps may take place by phone. For remote roles, and at our discretion, candidates may be asked to participate in an on-site interview as part of the final stages of the process. We understand there may be occasional circumstances requiring accommodation and are happy to discuss them as needed. Your recruiter will be able to clarify expectations and answer any questions you have. We are looking for a Director of Operations Finance & Strategy to support our rapidly expanding businesses in the collectibles marketplace space. The Company is headquartered in Santa Ana, CA with offices in Paris, Hong Kong, Tokyo, Shanghai and New Jersey. The Finance & Strategy team contributes to Collectors mission by enabling decision making with key financial insights. The team partners with key senior business leaders to support strong operational management of the business and to facilitate strategic decision making focused on key investments, operational improvements, new business opportunities and strategic transactions. Reporting directly to our VP of Finance & Strategy, the Director of Operations Finance & Strategy will serve as the primary financial leader for our Manufacturing operations. This critical role will partner closely with our COO and his leadership team. They will be responsible for driving financial discipline, operational efficiency, and data-driven decision-making within a fast-paced consumer manufacturing environment. The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between finance and operations, partnering with cross-functional leaders to maximize margins, optimize working capital, and enhance profitability through cost management and strategic analysis. This role is based at our Santa Ana, CA headquarters, our Jersey City, NJ office, or remotely from San Fransisco with flexibility for a hybrid work schedule. What You'll Do Lead financial planning and strategy for manufacturing operations, including annual operating plans (AOP), monthly/quarterly forecasts, and long-term strategic plans. Partner with Operations leadership to help drive cost efficiency, margin improvement, and evaluate capital investment decisions through close partnership, thoughtful analysis, and rigorous reporting/tracking. Forecast and track company-wide operations performance (e.g. CPU, gross margin, capacity) and provide transparency to business leaders via reporting and live reviews Provide financial leadership on key Operations initiatives (e.g. expansions, cost savings projects) Collaborate across the broader Finance team and other multifunctional teams to support strategic decisions with financial/economic analysis and insight Effectively manage team priorities and deliverables; ensuring consistent quality, on-time delivery Lead by example and be a champion of all company policies, including safety, attendance & security Proactively identify ways to improve our core FP&A processes Who You Are At least 15 years of experience in a high-volume transaction environment with multiple lines of business At least 5 years of providing finance leadership in an operations/ supply chain capacity; preferably in a consumer product manufacturing environment A visible, collaborative and proactive leader who demonstrates a high level of ownership, process orientation, operating discipline and accountability Excellent oral and written communication skills with the ability to articulate issues at all levels of the organization with a bias towards over communication An experienced people manager with demonstrated ability to effectively manage team priorities and coaches/develops team members Demonstrated ability to effectively partner and influence in a matrixed organization Outstanding Excel and data management skills Hands on individual willing to roll up sleeves Have a strong work ethic Superior attention to detail with problem solving techniques Strong understanding of GAAP Strong understanding of financial management processes Strong understanding of financial systems and tools (e.g. Adaptive, Netsuite) Bonus Experience with consumer goods and/pr digital businesses with consumer and operational components (e.g.CPG, ecommerce) Passionate about collectibles and/or sports Salary Range: The salary range for this position is $172,640 - $243,360. descripcion: At Schaefer Plastics, we manufacture industry-leading solutions and drive responsible practices towards a sustainable future for generations to come. As a family-owned company since 1937, we are deeply committed to delivering exceptional customer care through high-quality, innovative waste and packaging solutions. Our customers and their satisfaction are paramount to our business; we strive to understand their needs and exceed their expectations at every turn. We are a global injection molding manufacturer, producing durable waste and recycling carts, and pioneering reusable packaging systems that reduce carbon footprints. Our dynamic and inclusive culture fosters personal and professional growth, making us an ideal employer for career advancement. Position Overview The Purchasing and Inventory Manager ensures the availability of materials needed to support production while improving profitability, inventory performance, and supplier reliability. This position oversees purchasing and inventory planning for raw materials, components, and packaging. The successful candidate will identify cost-saving opportunities, improve inventory turns, reduce working capital tied up in inventory, and support the company’s financial and operational goals. Key ResponsibilitiesPurchasing and Supplier Management Lead the procurement of plastic resins, recycled materials, components, packaging, and other materials required for production. Negotiate pricing, contracts, payment terms, lead times, and supply agreements to improve margins and cash flow. Monitor supplier performance related to cost, quality, delivery, and responsiveness. Build and maintain strong supplier relationships while identifying opportunities for alternative sourcing and improved terms. Research market conditions, pricing trends, supply risks, and other economic developments that may affect material availability or cost. Identify and implement cost-reduction and sourcing improvement initiatives. Address supplier performance concerns and coordinate corrective actions when necessary. Inventory Management and Planning Optimize inventory levels, safety stock, reorder points, and purchasing quantities to improve inventory turns while maintaining appropriate service levels. Monitor material requirements, inventory balances, production schedules, forecasts, and open purchase orders. Reduce excess, obsolete, and slow-moving inventory. Identify inventory discrepancies, determine root causes, and coordinate corrective action. Maintain accurate purchasing and inventory information within the company’s ERP/MRP system. Review purchasing and inventory reports to identify shortages, excess inventory, cost variances, and improvement opportunities. Support inventory audits, cycle counts, and reconciliation activities as needed. Operational and Financial Support Partner with Operations, Materials, Quality, Finance, Sales, Logistics, and other departments to ensure material availability and prevent production disruptions. Improve planning, forecasting, and supplier collaboration to reduce working capital requirements. Track procurement and inventory performance against established goals and key performance indicators. Provide regular updates regarding material availability, supplier performance, cost-saving initiatives, and inventory risks. Support budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis related to purchasing and inventory. Perform general clerical and administrative responsibilities, including data entry, maintaining purchasing and supplier records, preparing routine reports, processing documentation, and organizing procurement files. Perform other duties and support special projects as assigned. QualificationsRequired Five or more years of purchasing, inventory management, procurement, or supply chain experience within a manufacturing environment. Demonstrated experience managing suppliers, negotiating terms, and identifying cost-saving opportunities. Experience with inventory planning, demand forecasting, safety stock, and reorder-point management. Working knowledge of ERP/MRP systems and purchasing processes. Strong analytical, organizational, negotiation, and problem-solving skills. Ability to evaluate data, identify trends, and make sound business decisions. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment. High level of accuracy and attention to detail. Preferred Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Operations, Finance, or a related field. Experience purchasing plastic resins, recycled materials, packaging, or other materials used in plastics manufacturing. Experience supporting multiple manufacturing locations or business units. Professional certification in purchasing, supply chain, or inventory management. Success in This Role Success will be measured through improvements in: Inventory turns Working capital reduction Material cost savings Supplier on-time delivery Material availability Excess and obsolete inventory reduction Purchasing and inventory accuracy EBITDA improvement generated through procurement initiatives Why Join Schaefer Plastics? Schaefer Plastics is a family-owned company with a history dating back to 1937. As a global leader in injection-molded plastic products, we manufacture waste and recycling carts, reusable packaging solutions, and other products that serve customers across a wide range of industries. This newly created position offers the opportunity to directly influence purchasing strategy, inventory performance, supplier relationships, profitability, and operational success. You will work closely with leaders across the organization and play an important role in ensuring the right materials are available at the right time, at the best total cost, and with the least amount of capital invested. descripcion: Job Details Job Description: The Production Engineer is responsible for defining, developing, implementing, and continuously improving factory operational strategies, standards, business processes, and systems that enable consistent, high-velocity output in a low-volume, high-product-mix semiconductor manufacturing environment. This role drives factory operational excellence through the application of manufacturing science, factory physics, and data-driven decision-making to optimize Work-in-Process (WIP), cycle time, output, and overall manufacturing performance. As a key strategic partner to Captain of Ship (COS) and Remote Operations Center (ROC) Group Leaders, the Production Engineer helps develop and execute operational strategies that support both technology development and high-volume manufacturing objectives. This individual identifies systemic constraints, evaluates alternative operating models, and develops scalable solutions that improve factory agility, efficiency, and business performance. Key Responsibilities Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: Develop and deploy factory-wide operational strategies, standards, business processes, and systems that improve output, cycle time, WIP health, and manufacturing velocity. Serve as a key integrator across Production, Planning, Automation, Process Engineering, Integration, Industrial Engineering (IE), and other factory organizations to drive alignment and execution. Identify and address systemic manufacturing constraints through the application of factory physics, Theory of Constraints, Lean principles, and structured problem-solving methodologies. Lead complex cross-functional initiatives that improve factory performance, operational efficiency, resource utilization, and manufacturing capability. Own the strategic roadmap, governance, and continuous improvement of critical operational business systems, ensuring alignment with site and Virtual Factory (VF) objectives. Develop and implement data-driven solutions, reporting frameworks, and decision-support tools that enhance operational visibility and enable proactive factory management. Drive adoption of Best Known Methods (BKMs), operational standards, and continuous improvement initiatives across the factory and Virtual Factory network. Represent F11X Production in Virtual Factory councils, improvement teams, and strategic forums, influencing the development and implementation of network-wide operational capabilities. Influence operational priorities and business decisions through data-driven recommendations and effective stakeholder engagement. Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers and factory stakeholders, strengthening organizational capability and operational excellence. Lead complex problem-solving efforts involving multiple organizations, competing priorities, and significant business impact. Desired Skills And Behavioral Traits The ideal candidate will demonstrate: Deep expertise in manufacturing science, factory physics, operational excellence methodologies, and production flow management. Proven ability to lead through influence and drive alignment across organizations without direct reporting authority. Strong strategic thinking skills with the ability to translate business objectives into executable operational plans. Demonstrated success solving complex and ambiguous operational challenges through structured problem-solving methodologies. Strong knowledge of Quality Management Systems (QMS), Model-Based Problem Solving (MBPS), Lean Manufacturing principles, and continuous improvement practices. Advanced analytical skills with the ability to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and systemic constraints through data analysis. Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences and leadership teams. Strong stakeholder management, collaboration, negotiation, and influencing skills in a dynamic manufacturing environment. A proven track record of leading transformational improvements and delivering measurable business impact across organizations and shifts. The ability to quickly learn, integrate, and optimize complex manufacturing technologies and business systems. Experience leading factory-level operational improvement programs and large-scale business process transformations. Experience developing and implementing operational business systems, manufacturing KPIs, and decision-support tools. descripcion: Hello, Thank You For Your Interest In Career Opportunities With The University Of Mississippi Medical Center. Please Review The Following Instructions Prior To Submitting Your Job Application Provide all of your employment history, education, and licenses/certifications/registrations. You will be unable to modify your application after you have submitted it. You must meet all of the job requirements at the time of submitting the application. You can only apply one time to a job requisition. Once you start the application process you cannot save your work. Please ensure you have all required attachment(s) available to complete your application before you begin the process. Applications must be submitted prior to the close of the recruitment. Once recruitment has closed, applications will no longer be accepted. After you apply, we will review your qualifications and contact you if your application is among the most highly qualified. Due to the large volume of applications, we are unable to individually respond to all applicants. You may check the status of your application via your Candidate Profile. Thank you, Human Resources Important Applications Instructions Please complete this application in entirety by providing all of your work experience, education and certifications/ license. You will be unable to edit/add/change your application once it is submitted. Job Requisition ID R00050374 Job Category Professional and Technical Organization Office of Operational Excellence Location/s: Main Campus Jackson Job Title Process Engineer I - Office of Operational Excellence Job Summary Drive change as it relates to Operational Excellence, Quality, Safety, Efficiency, and Patient Satisfaction. Use applied knowledge of lean, six sigma, and/or change management to support process engineer II's in their assigned quality improvement team, working toward the established goal with regards to a given scope. Change agent, methodology liaison, and catalyst to move UMMC forward toward a high reliability organization. Education & Experience Education and Experience Required: Bachelor's degree in healthcare, engineering, business, or a process related field and 1-2 years involvement with improvement projects. Lean or six sigma and healthcare experience preferred. Certifications, Licenses, or Registration Required: Lean green belt within 12 months. Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities: Skilled in the use of personal computers and related software. Excellent verbal and written communication. Facilitation skills. High level of emotional intelligence. Ability to present information and respond to inquiries. Ability to take direction and execute accordingly. Team building skills. Demonstrate sound problem solving skills. Ability to research industry standards and best practices and integrate those into the team process. Formal training in one or more of the following preferred: lean, six sigma, change management, and/or project management. Responsibilities Actively perform self-evaluation to become a change agent. Develop a mind set and thought capacity to support the vision of the CMO office as it relates to the high reliability journey of UMMC. Build an understanding of the organizational structure and their role within it to exert influence wherever possible for the purpose of standardization and waste removal in healthcare processes. Constantly evolve professionally by creating a new future state for themselves. Systematically compares and objectively analyzes alternatives, and weighs costs, benefits, and risks of decisions. Rounds on project stakeholders to seek perspective, identify strengths and risks. Look for variation and waste daily. Practice advanced problem solving techniques in regards to all aspects of daily work. Actively apply pi tools as appropriate. Work with process engineer II's to create standard work where there is none. Support assigned quality improvement team through meetings by acting as the resource for process engineer ii. This responsibility will include assuring the value and efficiency of each meeting is established and delivered upon. It will also include monitoring the group dynamic and making quick adjustments throughout the meeting to create an atmosphere conducive to team work and safety. Prepare for these meetings and follow up afterwards as appropriate. Incorporate accountability into the culture of team. Keep abreast of organizational objectives and assure project activities align with such. Understand the direction of the organization to keep the project on pace to support the success of the organization. Utilize work breakdown structure methods to organize complex efforts into milestones, tasks, subtasks, and achieve clarity around specific work, including the who, how, when by whom. Foster positive professional relationships with a cross functional coalition of practitioners and colleagues. Resolve problems that arise with speed and emotional intelligence to support the movement of the project and the success of UMMC. Manages up colleagues, informs leadership of both success and barriers, and utilizes a standard template to maintain project documents and reports. Demonstrates ability to meet stakeholders where they are, by identifying information and framing it appropriately to be persuasive to others. Drive change related to quality goals through the use of standardization and the research and adoption/integration of industry best practices. Collect, track, analyze data and apply proper intervention where needed. Assist qi teams by teaching them how to collect, interpret, and use data. Regularly and completely tracks project progress against stated commitments. Accept and deliver upon special projects as assigned that support the forward movement of the pi department. (power points, error prevention, hand hygiene observations, pi tools, GEMBA training, etc.) Accountable to put in place for measured improvement of the metric associated with the scope of work assigned. Demonstrates urgency and a high capacity for making visible progress against stated goals. Develops project plans for each initiative and provides up-to-date status reports. Help Process Engineer II’s in delivering a sustainability plan at the end of projects. titulo: Principal AI Research Scientist: Designing Multi-Scale Intelligence for the Energy Transition
descripcion: Principal AI Research Scientist: Designing Multi-Scale Intelligence for the Energy Transition Remote • Full-time • Three-year grant-funded term (renewable) Link to application: https://noteforms.com/forms/principal-ai-research-scientist-application-tgtkdo Ready to help shape the next frontier of AI by designing intelligent systems that reason across nested scales—from buildings to cities to nations—to accelerate the global energy transition. Open Earth Foundation (OEF) is a non-profit research and development organization building open digital infrastructure for planetary stewardship. We develop open digital infrastructure, AI systems, and data platforms that strengthen multi-stakeholder coordination and accelerate environmental protection, climate action, and Earth-system resilience. We’re a diverse, global team working remotely and collaborating with partners worldwide to make real change possible. With strong funding and a powerhouse team of innovators, we’re ready to tackle big challenges for a resilient Earth for generations to come and we need the planet’s brightest minds to help solve them! Your mission, should you choose to accept it: As the Principal AI Research Scientist for NEST at Open Earth Foundation, you will define the AI research architecture behind a new generation of intelligent systems for multi-scale energy-transition planning. You will set the research agenda, design the nested-agent and reasoning architectures that underpin the programme, and help shape its long-term scientific vision. NEST (Nested Energy System Transitions) is a three-year research programme funded by Schmidt Sciences through the Decarbonization and Energy Virtual Institute (DEVI) initiative. The programme is developing AI-agent architectures that connect existing energy models across nested spatial, temporal, and organizational scales, from buildings and cities to national systems, and from near-term operations to multi-decadal planning. The goal is to produce coherent energy-transition pathways by advancing both the intelligent systems and agentic research processes needed for cross-scale reasoning and model coupling. This is an architectural research role, not a production engineering role. You will design and validate new approaches, working closely with consortium Principal Investigators, Active Inference Scientists, and the Full-Stack AI Engineers who translate promising directions into robust systems. Success in this role could redefine how intelligent systems reason across interacting models, disciplines, and scales—well beyond climate and energy applications. This position is fully remote and international as our organization works across different time zones. This position is fully remote and international, full-time, and grant-funded for a three-year term with the possibility of renewal. Regular overlap with Central European and U.S. Pacific working hours required. Opportunities to participate in occasional in-person team gatherings. Priority will be given to applications submitted by August 14th. The following requirements describe our ideal candidate. If you don't meet some of the requirements, you're encouraged to apply anyway. Let us know if there is something missing and how we can work together to make it up. Essential Functions and Specific Duties: Set the AI research direction: Define and drive NEST’s agenda for agentic, probabilistic, and multi-scale intelligence across coupled models. Design nested intelligence: Co-design nested agents, advanced agent architectures, and the agentic research processes that make cross-scale coupling possible. Create coherent representations: Explore hierarchical agents, latent-state representations, world models, and uncertainty-aware methods that remain consistent across spatial, temporal, and organizational scales. Prototype and validate: Turn original research ideas into working prototypes and research instruments through hands-on experimentation and rapid iteration. Bridge research and production: Hand promising designs and coupling strategies to the Lead Full-Stack AI Engineer to harden into the production platform. Align with inference science: Partner with the Active Inference Scientist so the intelligence architecture and Bayesian inference layer—including factor graphs, message passing, and convergence—fit together. Set the scientific bar: Define standards for reproducibility, validation, posterior predictive checks, and comparison with established model couplings and benchmarks. Publish and represent the work: Shape NEST’s long-term scientific vision and communicate the research through publications, presentations, and external collaborations. Other: Actively participate in team building and culture-development activities at Open Earth Foundation. Contribute to an open, collaborative research culture grounded in rigor, curiosity, and shared purpose. Qualifications: PhD advancing the AI/ML field with a track record of original contributions in architectures, reasoning frameworks, or research methodologies—not only applications of existing models. Deep expertise in probabilistic reasoning, Bayesian methods, machine learning, or related approaches for uncertainty-aware AI systems. A record of turning ambitious ideas into rigorous research and impactful outcomes. Hands-on ability to translate research into working prototypes through experimentation and rapid iteration. Deep technical understanding of modern AI systems and agentic architectures. A deep commitment to safe, beneficial AI and using AI for the good of humanity. Strong written and verbal English communication skills. Strong Preference: Interest in world models, scientific AI, structured reasoning systems, or multi-scale reasoning LLM agent architectures, nested or multi-agent design, and tool-use frameworks Familiarity with energy systems, climate science, or scientific computing Nice to Have: Multi-model simulation, co-simulation, or model-coupling frameworks Active Inference, probabilistic programming, message-passing inference, or factor graphs Contributions to open-source scientific software Geospatial data processing, including GeoJSON, H3, or PostGIS Interpersonal Skills: Ability to collaborate across AI research, engineering, energy modelling, Bayesian inference, and programme leadership Ability to explain complex research choices clearly to technical and interdisciplinary audiences Comfort working independently in a distributed, international research team Other Qualities: Dedication to fighting climate change Intellectual courage, curiosity, and scientific rigor Focus on real-world impact and open research Interest in nonprofit, mission-driven work Compensation and Benefits: This full-time position offers compensation of $80,000–$130,000/ year (USD), commensurate with experience and location and paid in USD. A defining role at the frontier of agentic and multi-scale AI, applied to global environmental challenges. Unlimited paid time off, paid holidays, and paid sick leave. Remote work in a dynamic, international, mission-driven environment. OEF is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, age, religion, national origin, or any other protected characteristic. We celebrate diversity, equity, and inclusion in our teams and believe people should align their work with their purpose. Join us if you love Earth. We look forward to hearing from you! We use AI-assisted tools to help organize and summarize application materials. All hiring decisions are reviewed and made by people. Show more Show less

descripcion: Role overview The Senior Supply Chain Manager – Long-Lead Equipment is responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing the end-to-end supply chain strategy for complex, long-lead materials and capital equipment. This role ensures continuity of supply for critical items with extended lead times by driving rigorous forecasting, supplier collaboration, risk management, and cross-functional alignment with Engineering, Project Management, Finance, and Operations. You will be the primary owner of long-lead equipment strategy, from early project scoping through delivery, installation, and commissioning. Key responsibilities Strategic planning and ownership Develop and own the long-lead equipment strategy across assigned programs, including make-vs-buy, sourcing, and inventory strategies. Partner with Project Management and Engineering to translate project timelines and specifications into material demand plans and procurement milestones. Build multi-year plans for long-lead components and equipment, aligning with business growth, capacity expansion, and cost targets. Demand planning and forecasting Create and maintain detailed forecasts for long-lead items, incorporating project schedules, engineering changes, and historical consumption. Run scenario and sensitivity analyses to understand the impact of delays, scope changes, and schedule shifts. Collaborate with Finance to align spend forecasts and cash-flow impacts for major equipment purchases. Supplier management and sourcing Identify, qualify, and manage strategic suppliers for long-lead equipment, including OEMs and key component manufacturers. descripcion: Job Description About the Role As a Data Scientist, you're building genuine hands-on data science skills across the full CRISP-DM lifecycle — business understanding, data understanding, feature engineering, and statistical modeling. Data science is the job here, not a data-analyst-plus-business-analyst-plus-QA blend. You'll work with strong SQL and Python, applying real statistical modeling and exploratory data analysis to real business problems — school or project-based ML/EDA experience is a perfectly acceptable starting point. Around that core, you'll be capable of client-facing discussions and translating requirements into modeling tasks, and your delivery proof point is data/model validation rigor — UAT test cases, model development and validation — not front-end QA. You'll work closely with our dedicated data architecture team, and with our senior Data Scientist / Product Engineer on more complex problems, growing toward that role over time. What You'll Do Work hands-on across the CRISP-DM lifecycle: business understanding, data understanding, feature engineering, and statistical modeling Apply strong SQL and Python to real data problems — exploratory data analysis, data preparation, and model building Build and evaluate statistical and machine learning models under guidance from senior technical staff Validate models and data rigorously: write UAT test cases and own data/model validation and automated validation scripts — using tools like Pytest and RTF for model/data validation automation — rather than front-end QA Participate in client-facing discussions, translating business requirements into concrete modeling tasks Collaborate with our dedicated data architecture team on data understanding and feature engineering, without owning deep pipeline architecture Apply modern AI/GenAI tools in your data workflows — coding assistants, LLM-assisted EDA, and similar — as a practical, everyday skill Document your work clearly enough for both technical and non-technical audiences to follow Who You Are After nearly 100 years, we know this business is fundamentally about making connections — between facts, technologies, and above all, people. We look for collaborative, inquisitive problem-solvers who don't accept the first thing in front of them, who are always unapologetically themselves, and who take real ownership of the rigor behind their models and data. In addition, we look for individuals with the following experience or qualities: Roughly 0-3 years of experience in data science, analytics, or a related hands-on modeling role — school or project-based ML/EDA experience is genuinely acceptable in place of professional tenure Strong, demonstrated SQL and Python skills, with real exposure to statistical modeling and exploratory data analysis Comfortable across the CRISP-DM lifecycle — business understanding through feature engineering and modeling — rather than narrowly focused on one stage A genuine quality mindset for model and data validation — attention to detail and a habit of double-checking rather than assuming Capable of client-facing discussions, translating business questions into modeling tasks Real business acumen: even in a technical role, comfortable in front of a stakeholder. Forge pods are small, and everyone contributes to the client relationship Industry-vertical background (aerospace & defense, large-scale/heavy construction, manufacturing, supply chain, or S&OP) is helpful but not required at this level — it becomes a requirement as you grow toward the senior Data Scientist role Comfortable operating in fast-paced, iterative, client-facing environments Strong written and verbal communication skills Comfortable using modern AI/GenAI tools day to day, or eager to build that fluency quickly English fluency Required Qualifications Ability to obtain, or current possession of, a U.S. Secret security clearance is required; an active or prior clearance is a strong plus Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent demonstrated experience; school or project-based ML/EDA experience is acceptable in place of professional experience Core (expected) Technical skills and tools CRISP-DM lifecycle fundamentals (business understanding, data understanding, feature engineering) Statistical modeling and exploratory data analysis Strong SQL and Python Basic data pipeline and relational data-modeling literacy Preferred / a Plus Pytest and RTF in particular for model/data validation automation Exposure to ETL tooling or a cloud data platform (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) Git-based version control familiarity Basic exposure to LLM-assisted EDA or GenAI-assisted analysis workflows Location Washington, D.C. or Arlington preferred. descripcion: Backblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customer success with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators. Together with our partners, we’re helping customers break free from the restrictive, overpriced legacy solutions that hold them back, and blaze forward with the full power of the open cloud in their hands. Founded in 2007, we scaled the business with less than $3 million in outside funding until 2021, when we did a traditional IPO on the Nasdaq stock exchange. Today, Backblaze generates over $100m in revenue and is the leading specialized storage cloud - managing over three billion gigabytes of data storage for 500K+ customers in 175+ countries, including businesses, developers, IT professionals, and individuals. But while there is a lot to celebrate in our past, there is almost as much opportunity ahead of us. We are seeking an AI Workflow Engineer ! About The Role Backblaze is running a company-wide AI transformation program, and this role is where strategy becomes something you can actually use. As AI Workflow Engineer, you will be the hands-on builder inside the AI Program Office - embedded alongside the Director, AI Enablement, and deployed into non-GTM, non-Engineering business teams to prototype, build, and ship AI-powered workflow solutions that make a measurable difference in how work gets done. This is not a research role or a strategy role. You will spend your time building: prompt architectures, automation flows, lightweight agents, API integrations, and demos that help a business team see - concretely - what AI can do for them. You will move across functions, which means you need to understand how businesses actually operate. The ideal background is someone who started in a business-facing role - finance, operations, marketing, customer success, HR - and developed serious hands-on AI and automation skills on top of that foundation. You will work closely with the Director, AI Enablement, who owns the program management and delivery layer. Your job is to make their scoped solutions real - fast, iteratively, and with enough rigor that what you build can go to production. What You Will Do Build and Ship AI Workflow Solutions Take scoped use cases from the Director, AI Enablement and build working solutions: prompt layers, automation flows, lightweight agents, RAG implementations, and API integrations that connect AI tools to the systems business teams already use Build working prototypes quickly - the goal is to show a team what is possible in days, not weeks, then refine based on what actually lands Translate a documented workflow assessment into a technical design, select the right tools for the job, and own the build through to a deployable solution Maintain solution documentation that is clear enough for handoff, iteration, and audit - not just for engineers, but for the business owner who will live with it Embed in Business Teams Spend time inside the functions you are building for - Finance, HR, Legal, Marketing Ops, Customer Success, and others - understanding how the work actually flows before you redesign it Run working sessions with team members to map current-state workflows, surface friction points, and identify where AI creates real leverage versus where it creates noise Build credibility with non-technical stakeholders by showing them working solutions, not decks - and by being honest about what will and will not work Support user acceptance testing and early adoption, troubleshooting issues close to launch and iterating based on real usage Support the AI Program Office Build demos and proof-of-concepts that help the Director, AI Enablement make the case for a use case - or disqualify it early before resources are committed Contribute to vendor and tool evaluations with a builder's perspective: not just whether a tool claims to do something, but whether it actually works in the context of a specific workflow Feed learnings from the build process back into the program - what worked, what did not, what should be standardized across functions Work on tactical quick wins and longer-horizon strategic builds at the same time, switching contexts across active use cases as priorities shift What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days) You have completed at least one workflow assessment alongside the Director and produced a working prototype from it At least one solution you built is in active use by a business team, with a named owner and feedback loop in place You have worked inside at least two different business functions and understand their core workflows well enough to identify the next use case without being told The Director, AI Enablement trusts you to own the build layer independently - scoping conversations happen together, execution happens with you driving The Right Fit 2-4 years of experience that includes meaningful time working inside a business-facing function - operations, finance, marketing, customer success, HR, or similar - not just in Engineering or IT Hands-on experience building with AI tools: prompt engineering, automation platforms (Make, Zapier, n8n, or equivalent), API integrations, and at least working familiarity with RAG architectures and agent frameworks Proven ability to take a messy real-world process, understand it from the inside, and build something that makes it faster or better - About Us Monks is a digital-first marketing and advertising services company connecting the dots across content, data & digital media and technology services. Inspired by the connectivity and flexibility of technology APIs, Monks’ single-P&L model offers brands seamless access to a nearly 6,000-strong team of digital talent organized across 57 talent hubs in 33 countries. With us, you'll find a diverse group of colleagues with different backgrounds and perspectives. We believe everyone has something of value to offer, and that sustaining a truly diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace begins with fostering an environment where people can be themselves, authentically, every day. We want to build something with the potential to change the heart of our industry, and we’d love to include your unique perspective. About The Role The Semi Senior Data Engineer will help design, build, and evolve scalable data solutions for digital marketing and advertising use cases. Working closely with our Analytics and Solutions Engineering teams, you will be responsible for end-to-end data engineering activities—from data discovery and ingestion to transformation, orchestration, and deployment—supporting reporting, measurement, and analytics use cases. This role is centered on developing robust data pipelines and analytics-ready data models across multiple platforms (DSPs, ad servers, and third-party sources). You will also contribute to client project phases, including requirements clarification, task planning and estimation, and solution recommendations. In addition, the role involves ensuring data quality, reconciliation across heterogeneous datasets, and supporting measurement workflows such as cross-platform metric allocation and incrementality/attribution reporting. Tools We are looking for someone experienced with (or familiar with) the following tools and technologies: Strong programming skills in SQL, Python, or other programming languages Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases Cloud platforms such as Databricks, AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform Strong knowledge of cloud infrastructure, e.g. on GCP: BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Cloud Run Jobs, Cloud Monitoring, Dataflow, BigQuery Data Transfer Service, Storage Transfer Service Data modeling and transformation tools, such as dbt (including for BigQuery) Terraform (infrastructure as code) GitHub and GitHub Actions (CI/CD processes) Looker and LookML is a plus JavaScript knowledge is a plus Knowledge of media reporting UIs / APIs (e.g., DV360, SA360, Meta) is a plus What we’re looking for A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in informative engineering, computer science, applied mathematics, engineering, or a related quantitative field—or equivalent work experience. 2-3 years of experience with any combination of analytics, marketing analytics, and analytical techniques for marketing, customer, and business applications. Hands-on experience with SQL and Python, along with experience using cloud products. Hands-on experience developing data pipelines using common ETL/ELT tools and building data architecture patterns. Familiarity with Agile methodologies and applying DataOps practices to build and deliver pipelines reliably. Experience working with media/advertising data is a plus Demonstrated ability to operate effectively independently and within a team Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain dbt models that integrate marketing and advertising data across DSPs, ad servers, and third-party platforms—reconciling differences in granularity (e.g., placement-level vs. creative-level metrics) and resolving join-key quality issues. Develop and maintain business logic for cross-platform metric allocation (e.g., distributing spend and impressions across creatives) to support monthly reporting and incrementality/attribution use cases. Build and maintain ingestion pipelines from diverse external sources, including cloud-to-cloud transfers (e.g., AWS S3 → GCS), Azure/SFTP drops, and vendor APIs, ensuring deduplication and data quality. Own and evolve GCP cloud infrastructure using Terraform, following established modular patterns and naming conventions; partner with platform teams on environment and deployment standards. Lead the migration of legacy ingestion patterns (e.g., BigQuery Data Transfers) to scalable, maintainable solutions built on Dataflow and Cloud Run. Configure and maintain observability and alerting across the stack (e.g., dbt source freshness, Cloud Run job failures, BigQuery Data Transfer issues) using Cloud Monitoring, deployed via Terraform. Manage the release lifecycle across QA, STG, and PROD environments, including branching strategy, scheduled releases, and automated release-note generation via GitHub Actions. Produce and maintain high-quality technical documentation, runbooks, and design artifacts; review and curate client-facing release communications.
