descripcion: Eaton’s IS VEH VGNA division is currently seeking a Senior Manufacturing Engineer. This position will be located at our Kings Mountain, NC facility. Relocation benefits will be provided within the United States only. The Senior Manufacturing Engineer will design, implement, improve, and maintain the processes in area of responsibility, related to gear and shaft manufacturing required for OEM and aftermarket customers in alignment to Department Goals around Safety, Quality, Delivery, Inventory and Productivity. This includes research and development of new technologies and techniques, coordinating new product launches and automated manufacturing cells. The expected annual salary range for this role is $86000 - $126000 a year. Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations. Eaton announced, on June 11, 2026, the intent to combine its Mobility Group (including both the Vehicle and eMobility segments) with a new company. We expect to complete this process by the end of the first half of 2027. The compensation and benefits that will initially be offered for this position are based on Eaton's plans, programs and practices. If you are offered and accept this position and are actively employed by the Mobility Group when the transaction closes, the new company will provide further details to employees concerning compensation and benefits at that time. What You’ll Do Monitor, improve and maintain processes in area of responsibility for transmission components in the Kings Mountain facility through: Development of safe work methods and processes. Development of processes in area of responsibility that result in a high level of quality. Updating work instructions, posted references, process alerts, PFMEA, process flows, control plans, standard work, & related documents. Improving the reliability and capability of equipment. Evaluating related processes for efficiency, waste reduction, and work balancing (Lean tools: A3, Kaizen). Becoming a Lean Tool expert in A3, VSM and Set Up Reduction. Implementation Of Change Through Evaluation of change notifications and a quick understanding of the impact to processes. Project management of cross functional teams such as safety, controls, maintenance, material delivery and operators for process changes and necessary training. Evaluate, improve and update PFMEAs per APQP guidelines, Work Instructions and Job Safety Analysis. Developing and testing improved fail-safe strategies through part design, 3D printing and testing. Responding to corrective actions to help drive continuous improvement. Active member of a cross functional Flow Line team to meet departmental goals and objectives. Participate in capital planning, investigate equipment alternatives, prepare appropriation justifications, implement equipment, and evaluate results. Assist in the implementation and deployment of actions to ensure compliance with all safety regulations as they apply to areas of responsibility. Participate in meeting plant Environment, Health, and Safety objectives Maintain a constant search for identifiable and measurable cost reductions through scrap analysis and technology applications. Work with operations, engineering technicians and maintenance technicians on day-to-day production issues. Create and revise Process Drawings, Process Sheets, and routings both in Oracle and Matrix. Qualifications Required (Basic) Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering from an accredited institution. Minimum of three (3) years experience in a manufacturing environment. Eaton will not consider applicants for employment immigration sponsorship or support for this position. This means that Eaton will not support any "CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT plans, F-1 to H-1B, H-1B cap registration, O-1, E-3, TN status, I-485 job portability, etc. Preferred Qualifications Gear manufacturing experience. Experience with Industry 4.0 tools (e.g. Automation / Additive Manufacturing / SPC / Real-time production monitoring). Experience with statistical methods used to analyze process variations. Design experience in ProEngineer or related CAD systems. 3D printing experience. Experience with PLC related logic and robotics (fanuc) troubleshooting and recovery. Skills Capability to conduct time studies and implement solutions for bottleneck improvements and line balancing. Knowledge of environmental laws and O.S.H.A. rules and regulation. Lean Manufacturing knowledge. Project Management knowledge. Working knowledge and experience manufacturing, specifically, knowledge and operation of CNC machining, Lean tools, assembly, blue print reading, measurement systems, and working within a structured team environment. Knowledge of the financial side of the business, specifically, departmental budgets, capital planning, profit plan, and production measurement systems. Ability to adjust priorities to meet continuously changing schedules. Ability to flex to off-shift coverage when required. Coordination of projects involving many groups such as engineering, production, quality, tool design, EHS. Good working relationships with peers, supervisors, operators, and managers must be maintained in order to be effective. Assure that the efficiency of the plant and quality of the parts stay high through employee involvement. Ability to work with minimal supervision. All positions may require participation in video and in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws. We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for all job applicants and employees. Employment decisions are based upon job-related reasons regardless of an applicant's race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, marital status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by law. Eaton believes in second chance employment. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction history will be considered regardless of their arrest or conviction history, consistent with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act and other local laws. You do not need to disclose your conviction history or participate in a background check until a conditional job offer is made to you. After making a conditional offer and running a background check, if Eaton is concerned about conviction that is directly related to the job, you will be given the chance to explain the circumstances surrounding the conviction, provide mitigating evidence, or challenge the accuracy of the background report. To request a disability-related reasonable accommodation to assist you in your job search, application, or interview process, please call us at 1-800-836-6345 to discuss your specific need. Only accommodation requests will be accepted by this phone number. We know that good benefit programs are important to employees and their families. Eaton provides various Health and Welfare benefits as well as Retirement benefits, and several programs that provide for paid and unpaid time away from work. descripcion: Overview Connecting clients to markets – and talent to opportunity. With 5,400+ employees and over 80,000 institutional, commercial, and payments clients, we operate from more than 80 offices spread across six continents. As a Fortune 100, Nasdaq-listed provider, we connect clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world-class products and services to all types of investors. Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, StoneX Group is made up of four business segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth. Business Segment Overview Corporate: Engage in a deep variety of business-critical activities that keep our company running efficiently. From strategic marketing and financial management to human resources and operational oversight, you’ll have the opportunity to optimize processes and implement game-changing policies. Position Purpose: The Director, Financial Planning & Analysis will serve as the lead finance business partner for the Institutional Fixed Income, Prime Services, Clearing and Equities businesses. This role is responsible for delivering strategic financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, business performance management and executive decision support across multiple institutional business lines. The successful candidate will work closely with senior business leaders, Corporate Development, Regulatory Reporting, Treasury, Accounting and Executive Management to drive profitable growth, enhance business performance, support regulatory requirements and provide actionable financial insights. The role requires a strong understanding of capital markets, institutional brokerage, securities financing and financial services operations. Responsibilities Primary duties will include: Business Partnership & Strategic Support Act as the primary FP&A partner for the Institutional Fixed Income, Prime Services and Equities businesses. Build trusted relationships with senior business leaders and provide financial guidance to support strategic decision-making. Evaluate business performance drivers, market opportunities, pricing initiatives and growth strategies. Support strategic projects, new business initiatives, product launches and investment decisions through financial modelling and analysis. Deliver actionable recommendations to improve profitability, operating leverage and return on capital. Planning, Forecasting & Budgeting Lead annual budget, rolling forecast and long-range planning processes for assigned businesses. Develop detailed revenue, expense, headcount and capital forecasts. Partner with business leaders to identify risks and opportunities affecting financial performance. Drive accountability for financial commitments and forecast accuracy. Develop scenario analyses and stress-testing models to support decision-making. Monthly & Quarterly Business Performance Reviews Lead the preparation and presentation of monthly and quarterly business performance reviews. Develop executive-level reporting packages that clearly communicate financial results, KPIs, operational metrics and business trends. Perform detailed variance analysis against budget, forecast, prior year and strategic targets. Identify key business drivers and provide insightful commentary for executive management. Support Board, Executive Committee and senior leadership reporting requirements. Regulatory Reporting & Filings Support Partner with Regulatory Reporting, Finance, Compliance and Legal teams to support regulatory filing requirements. Provide financial analysis and supporting schedules for regulatory submissions. Assist with capital, liquidity and profitability reporting requirements impacting institutional businesses. Ensure consistency between management reporting and regulatory reporting frameworks. Support responses to regulatory inquiries and audits as required. Corporate Development Support Work closely with the Corporate Development team on acquisitions, divestitures, strategic investments and partnership opportunities. Support financial due diligence activities and business case development. Develop valuation, synergy, accretion/dilution and return analyses. Assist in post-acquisition integration tracking and performance measurement. Provide financial modelling and strategic analysis for corporate development initiatives. Financial Analysis & Reporting Develop and maintain performance dashboards, management reports and KPI scorecards. Analyze revenue trends, client activity, balances, financing spreads, execution volumes and operating expenses. Drive continuous improvement of reporting processes and analytical capabilities. Leverage financial systems and business intelligence tools to improve reporting efficiency and insight generation. Leadership & Team Development Lead, mentor and develop FP&A professionals. Promote a high-performance, collaborative culture focused on accountability and continuous improvement. Implement best practices in financial planning, forecasting and business analysis. Serve as a key leader within the broader Finance organization Qualifications Qualifications To land this role you need: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related discipline. 10+ years of progressive FP&A, finance or business analysis experience. 5+ years in leadership or people management roles. Experience supporting capital markets, brokerage, institutional trading, securities financing, prime brokerage, fixed income or equities businesses. Advanced financial modelling, forecasting and analytical skills. Strong executive communication and presentation capabilities. Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive business decisions. Advanced proficiency with Excel, Power BI and enterprise planning systems. What makes you stand out: MBA, CPA, CFA or equivalent professional qualification. Experience within a publicly traded or highly regulated financial services environment. M&A, corporate development or transaction advisory experience. Experience with Oracle EPM, Hyperion or similar planning platforms. Key Competencies Strategic thinking and commercial acumen. Executive presence and stakeholder influence. Financial modelling, valuation and performance management. Deep understanding of capital markets and institutional financial services. Regulatory awareness and strong control orientation. Change leadership, team development and continuous improvement. Data analytics, dashboarding and financial storytelling. Success Measures Forecast accuracy and planning effectiveness. Quality and timeliness of monthly and quarterly business performance reviews. Business partner satisfaction and influence on decision-making. Insight generation that improves profitability and resource allocation. Successful support of regulatory and external reporting requirements. Effective support of corporate development transactions and strategic initiatives. Development and retention of high-performing FP&A talent. Hiring Salary Range $180,000 - $200,000. Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills and abilities of the applicant, internal equity and alignment with market data.) descripcion: Description AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, procurement, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure — we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain, and we're looking for talented people who want to help. You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, procurement managers, supply chain specialists, security experts, and operations managers. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers — all within an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) works to deliver scalable solutions to source, build, and maintain our socially responsible data center supply chains. We are a team of highly motivated, engaged, and responsive professionals who enable the core sustainable infrastructure of AWS — powering thousands of businesses across more than 190 countries. The Data Center Sourcing & Procurement (DCSP) team is seeking a results-oriented, data-driven Supply Chain Manager to own sourcing and supply management for critical Long Lead Equipment (LLE) supporting AWS Data Center build projects across the Americas region. As a member of the DCSP Team, you will manage the end-to-end supply chain for high-complexity, long-lead electrical distribution systems—including Structural, Mechanical, and Electrical Long Lead Equipment. Your primary responsibility is to maintain unconstrained supply at AMER scale, ensuring these critical equipment categories are available to support AWS Data Center construction schedules. Technical understanding of the Electrical Equipment category and ability to analyze drawings and specifications is preferred. Key job responsibilities A Successful Candidate Will Demonstrate Supply Chain Strategy & Execution Develop and execute the global supply chain strategy for long lead equipment, delivering high-quality equipment solutions on time and at optimal costs Manage end-to-end supply chain operations including supplier on-time delivery, capacity planning, logistics, inventory management, and lead time optimization Align demand signals with supplier capacity to maintain unconstrained supply at AMER scale Supplier Management & Performance Build and maintain strategic supplier relationships for assigned categories Manage supplier performance and allocate equipment to demands based on priority Proactively identify and mitigate supply chain risks to ensure uninterrupted delivery of critical electrical systems Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner with Design Engineering, Planning & Delivery, DCSP teams, and Delivery Management to support electrical infrastructure product roadmap development Collaborate with engineering, product managers, quality, and demand planning teams on procurement decisions Influence supplier and technology selection to provide maximum benefit to AWS Continuous Improvement & Innovation Drive standardization initiatives across programs to reduce complexity and improve supply chain efficiency Identify and implement innovative supply chain technologies and best practices to enhance flexibility and resilience Monitor industry trends and emerging technologies in electrical distribution to maintain competitive advantage Analytics & Decision Support Develop predictive analytics models for demand forecasting and capacity planning Create analytical reports that deliver actionable insights to business partners and stakeholders Support data-driven decision making for electrical equipment procurement Be a subject matter expert for the customers, technologies, and markets in which you engage. Based in Mount Juliet,TN this role ensures efficient material flow, robust supply planning, and strong team performance to meet customer demand, cost, and service objectives. descripcion: Job Title: Mgr - Budget Planning and Analysis Status: Exempt Reports to: VP - Controller Department: Accounting Job Code: 12073 Pay Range: $135,000.00 - $150,000.00 Annually Who We Are Golden 1 Credit Union is among the top credit unions in the country. As a member-owned, not-for-profit cooperative, Golden 1 is guided by the credit union philosophy of “people helping people.” We are committed to empowering our members and uplifting our communities as we create a more equitable and financially inclusive California. We welcome all who embrace our Core Values. Who You Are You are a strategic finance leader who translates complex financial data into clear, actionable insights for executive decision-making. You are a highly analytical and forward-thinking professional with strong expertise in budgeting, forecasting, and performance management within a financial institution environment. You thrive in a collaborative environment, lead with accountability, and drive continuous improvement in processes, systems, and reporting to enhance organizational effectiveness, transparency, and scalability. What You'll Do Manage, lead, and develop Golden 1’s annual budget, multi-year Financial Plan, and periodic forecasts. Oversee all enterprise financial planning activities, partnering with executive leadership to align financial strategies with organizational priorities, strategic initiatives, human capital management, and strategic goal achievement. Design and develop financial planning and analysis models at both the departmental and enterprise level, incorporating key drivers such as loans, deposits, interest rates, economic conditions, and other internal and external factors, enabling scenario analysis and strategic decision support. Lead and coordinate the enterprise-wide financial planning and budget development process, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities and delivering comprehensive executive reporting packages, KPI dashboards, and financial presentations that support organizational decision-making. Design and deliver monthly financial reporting packages that provide clear, forward-looking insights into financial performance, operational efficiency, and key business drivers, supporting executive-level evaluation and action. Apply advanced technical accounting knowledge to ensure financial plans, forecasts, and analyses are aligned with GAAP and regulatory requirements, translating accounting impacts into accurate, forward-looking financial projections and strategic insights. Analyze financial information including income, expenses, loans, deposits, and balance sheet trends to ensure alignment with financial plans and forecasts. Identify, investigate, and communicate key variances and underlying drivers, providing actionable recommendations to optimize performance. Evaluate financial and operational trends across the organization to optimize resource allocation, improve cost discipline, and enhance overall financial performance. Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to executive leadership and business units, leading financial discussions, influencing decision-making, and ensuring alignment of financial outcomes with enterprise strategy. Collaborate with Corporate Strategy and the Enterprise Project Management Office (EPMO) to ensure the Financial Plan reflects enterprise initiatives, strategic priorities, and execution timelines. In coordination with the VP – Controller, support and oversee Allowance for Credit Losses (ACL) analysis and reporting, incorporating credit risk insights into financial planning, forecasting, and performance analysis. Evaluate peer credit union performance and industry benchmarks to provide context for financial results and support strategic decision-making. Drive continuous improvement and transformation of financial planning, forecasting, and reporting processes to enhance accuracy, speed, transparency, and organizational value. Lead the administration and enhancement of budgeting and financial planning systems, identifying and implementing process and technology improvements to support scalable, data-driven decision-making. Establish and implement enterprise-wide financial planning policies, procedures, and reporting frameworks that promote consistency, transparency, and accountability. Maintain a comprehensive understanding of accounting, financial, regulatory, and economic conditions, incorporating these insights into financial planning, forecasting, and performance management. Ensure adherence to applicable regulatory requirements, internal controls, and risk management practices, integrating these considerations into financial planning processes. Lead, develop, and mentor the Budget Planning & Analysis team, establishing performance expectations, driving accountability, and supporting professional development to build a high-performing team. Foster a positive, collaborative, and results-driven work environment by promoting skill development, coaching for improvement and growth, and supporting a culture aligned with Golden 1’s mission, vision, and core values. Participate in enterprise initiatives, providing financial leadership and analytical support to cross-functional efforts. Exhibit flexibility and leadership to take on new responsibilities and assignments as identified by the VP – Controller and assist with various ad hoc analyses and projects. Perform other duties as assigned. Technical excellence: You write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code. Caring deeply about system quality, performance, and scalability. Strategic thinking: You see beyond the task, understanding how architectural decisions impact scalability, costs, and long-term flexibility. What Sets You Up for Success: 5+ years of PHP web application software engineering experience. 2+ years of experience working with MySQL or PostgreSQL. Experience with modern infrastructure tooling (e.g. DataDog, GitHub Actions, Kubernetes, Docker, AWS, Terraform, ArgoCD). Dedication towards observability by leveraging metrics, experiments, and prototypes to ensure decisions are data-driven. Strong knowledge and a passion for software engineering best practices, design patterns, and automated testing. Bonus Skills to Stand Out (Optional): Solid understanding of secure software engineering with experience in regulated environments; familiarity with PCI-DSS, similar compliance frameworks preferred. Experience in engineering software for large-scale solutions, utilizing modern tooling to get you there, and Experience with large-scale Domain Driven Design Experience in the Payments domain and/or travel industry experience. Software Engineer, AI Developer Productivity (MTS) Buenos Aires | Hybrid Job Description The AI Solutions team in Technology & Product builds internal products and platforms that help Salesforce engineers adopt AI-assisted development safely, effectively, and measurably. Our work spans developer experiences, AI usage and outcome intelligence, governance, telemetry, and integrations with coding tools and engineering systems. As a Member of Technical Staff, you will build and operate full-stack product and platform capabilities across desktop applications, backend services, data pipelines, dashboards, and developer-facing integrations. Working with experienced engineers and product partners, you will turn product needs into reliable software, own well-defined areas end to end, and help thousands of Salesforce engineers get more value from AI every day. Build backend APIs, data models, ingestion flows, dashboards, and user experiences that connect AI tool usage to outcomes engineers and leaders can act on. Contribute to technical designs and turn product requirements into clear, incremental implementation plans with support from senior engineers when needed. Own features and services in production by improving observability, reliability, performance, security, and supportability as part of the software development lifecycle. Build and ship high-quality, production-grade software using modern engineering practices, with AI as a core part of your development workflow to deliver secure, optimized, and maintainable code. Build AI-enabled and agentic workflows that fit naturally into how developers work, with appropriate evaluation, safeguards, and human oversight. Contribute to shared system context - designs, constraints, standards, and operational knowledge - that helps both people and AI agents work accurately and reliably. Review human- and AI-generated code for correctness, quality, security, and performance; participate actively in design and code reviews; and share what you learn with the team. Strong programming fundamentals and proficiency in at least one modern language, with the ability to work across frontend, backend, APIs, data stores, and service boundaries. Experience delivering well-defined features through design, implementation, testing, rollout, and production ownership. A practical understanding of data structures, API design, automated testing, source control, CI/CD, and secure software development practices. Ability to debug technical issues, use logs and metrics to understand system behavior, and make thoughtful tradeoffs with guidance when appropriate. Clear communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to ask good questions, give and receive feedback, and work effectively with engineers and product partners. A demonstrated AI-first approach to engineering - using tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, or Cursor to move faster while validating outputs and maintaining quality. The ability to write precise, structured prompts and contribute the context, examples, and constraints that make AI-assisted development reliable and production-ready. Familiarity with React, TypeScript, Go, service APIs, event pipelines, analytics systems, or cloud- and Kubernetes-based services. Experience building self-service experiences, dashboards, plugin systems, command-line tools, or reusable integration patterns for engineering teams. Hands-on experience with LLM applications, agentic workflows, prompt evaluation, or safety and quality controls for AI-enabled features. descripcion: Who We Are Johns Manville is a leading manufacturer and marketer of premium-quality insulation and commercial roofing, along with glass fibers and nonwovens for commercial, industrial and residential applications. Our products are used in a wide variety of industries including building products, aerospace, automotive and transportation, filtration, commercial interiors, waterproofing and wind energy. A proud member of the Berkshire Hathaway family of companies, we serve customers in more than 80 countries around the globe. We are committed to delivering positive and powerful experiences, because we are successful only when our employees and customers thrive. We are passionate, we care about people, we perform at a superior level, and we protect others and our environments. Pay Range $94,100.00-$129,400.00 Annual This is the base salary pay range that an applicant can expect to make upon hire. Pay within this range will vary based upon relevant experience, skills, and education among other factors. In addition, this position is eligible for an incentive bonus. The purpose of the Process Engineer's role will be to provide technical leadership to operate a major asset (typical annual revenue of $50MM to $200MM) at target regarding output, usage of material and energy by meeting the product specifications. To achieve that goal, the Process Engineer II needs to establish a process of data collection, auditing and preventive maintenance which allows the identification of deviations quickly and suggests the implementation of corrective measures. Lean, RCCA analysis, 5 time Why and the JM Solve-It method or Keppner / Tregoe, a 6 Sigma approach should be applied where needed. Furthermore, the Process Engineer II will be responsible for addressing improvements in process efficiency, product quality, and the cost of poor quality for the process, leading process optimization. Together with the electrical engineers, process control architecture will be developed and tuned. In collaboration with the specialists at JMTC, process modeling systems get developed and implemented to further optimize the efficiency of the operations. Based on performance analysis, raw material specifications will be reviewed on a regular frequency and potentially adjusted to drive the expected performance improvement. Your Day To Day Perform continuous analysis identifying areas for improvement and corrective actions. Develop standard control processes and standard operating procedures. Support the Operations and Maintenance Department efforts to trouble shoot and solve problems. Have a work until the problem is solved attitude. Utilize blueprints, electrical diagrams, equipment manuals, and engineering drawings to assist in the design, optimization, and troubleshooting of industrial systems. Responsible for monitoring product quality, investigations of quality problems and customer complaints, direction of SPC and design experiments. Execute standard control processes and standard operating procedures. Develops and provides training documents. Aids the Production Department and Maintenance personnel by personal consultations, formal training, and monitoring the execution of policies and checklists. Understands and helps implement the Edison Site Environmental Policy and Objectives Collaborates with cross-functional teams to support operations, requiring professional flexibility to address urgent manufacturing challenges. May be required to perform other related duties as assigned What You Bring To The Team Bachelor's degree in engineering, science or relevant technical field with a minimum of 3 years of experience in industrial continuous process manufacturing either as a process or design engineer and 2 years troubleshooting on manufacturing processes Proven track record of identifying and implementing process improvements Demonstrated problem solving skills including complex data analysis Successful history of innovation and adaptability Solid project management skills Demonstrated ability to effectively manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks Proven results orientation including the ability to lead key projects to successful completion Experience with DOE for process improvement Solid interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills Ability to work independently and in a team environment Ability to set and communicate expectations to team members Demonstrated collaboration skills including the ability to interact with a broad range of employees Proven ability to make timely decisions Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook Strong leadership skills Proven analytical and quality improvement ability Ability to interface at all levels of the organization, both internally and externally Supervises/Leads individuals or a project team to achieve milestones and objectives by setting priorities and providing direction. Work environment is typical of a manufacturing facility: May be exposed to environmental conditions of cold, heat, high noise levels, moving mechanical parts, heights, dust/mist/gas/fumes, extensive walking or climbing, etc. #P #D Please Keep in Mind If you do not meet 100% of these requirements, we at JM still want to hear from you. descripcion: Overview SP+, a Metropolis company, is an artificial intelligence company for the real world. We use computer vision to enable checkout-free parking experiences. Responsibilities Manages operations, employee relations and customer service to ensure the successful day-to-day operations of airport parking facilities. Directs, manages, and coordinates the activities of staff and contract personnel to ensure proper facility operation. Prepares annual expense operating budget and ensures that the facility is operating within budget perimeters and takes appropriate remedial action on negative variance. Reviews and approves bi-monthly expense reimbursement report. Ensures that proper parking, security, cash control and customer service procedures are being followed by all employees. Evaluates staff performance, serves disciplinary notices and handles first-step grievances. Acts as primary contact between the union(s) that represents the various classifications of employees (if applicable to airport operation). Inspects grounds, facilities and equipment to ensure safe and proper working conditions and to determine necessity of repairs or maintenance. Initiates corrective actions as needed. Serves as the primary liaison between the Airport and on-site management and the local operation and Corporate offices in Chicago and Nashville. Leads weekly phone calls/meetings with client to report on finances, operations and on-going projects/strategies. Coordinates and manages routine maintenance projects as well as special projects related to facility improvements. Supervises the work of sub-contractors to ensure that work is done properly and per the contract. Coordinates facility openings/closings and determines staffing requirements to accommodate work being done while ensuring desired service levels. Interacts with customers as needed to answer questions, investigate complaints/violations and resolve problems. Monitor office audits of daily cashier reports to ensure that proper sales totals are reported and recorded on time and to maintain security vigilance over possible employee theft and/or inefficiencies. Monitor and review all damage claims in order to assign responsibility for damages. Recommend and implement plans or programs to improve safety of operations to prevent the occurrence or reoccurrence of similar claims. The aforementioned are the essential functions of this job. Employees occupying this position may be required to perform other duties. The above responsibilities are subject to possible modification. descripcion: This position has a Hybrid schedule, remote access will be activated after successfully completing 90 days in the role onsite. Position Summary The position of VP Finance is established to manage all aspects, duties and responsibilities of the management financial analysis functions and maintain quality service standards set by the organization. This includes the effective management of the following areas: Leadership, coaching and development of Financial Analysis Team Annual Budget and Financial Forecasting Financial Analysis Audit and Exam Support Current Expected Credit Loss (CECL) Financial Database Management Organizational and Product Profitability Analysis Special Projects Minimum Qualifications (Education, Experience, Skills) BS Degree with emphasis in Finance, Accounting or Economics. CFA, CPA or MBA is a plus. 10 years of experience in financial management/accounting and demonstrated track record of success in all areas of responsibility. Advanced level spreadsheet, database, word processing and presentation software skills required. Effective interpersonal skills. Strong knowledge of financial products and services, general ledger usage, and database management are required. Demonstrated success in planning, organizing, leading and oversight of people and activities. Professional and effective interaction, verbal and written communication skills. Organization skills sufficient to successfully manage multiple projects, establish priorities and meet deadlines. Track record of applying critical thinking and emotional intelligence skills in a wide variety of situations. Key Relationships Work closely with Senior Management Team and other departments on a continual basis, gain a solid understanding of their business models and practices, and possess an ability to provide financial analysis and recommendations to the team as requested and on a proactive basis. Essential Duties And Responsibilities Management and Leadership: Responsible for the planning, direction and development of all staff members. Responsible for the employment, coaching, training, motivation, evaluation and discipline of all staff members. Provide managerial oversight of the activities for areas of responsibility, including assigned staff and functional deliverables of the team. Demonstrate leadership in words and actions on a daily basis; act as role model for success and engagement. Create a positive work environment conducive to trust and transparency. Responsible for the performance management of staff, to include daily feedback, coaching and mentoring; administration of appraisals that are timely and meaningful. Identify and address deficiencies constructively. Continually support, encourage and motivate team members toward ongoing growth and development. Consult with Human Resources (HR) on issues outside of the normal scope of performance or behavior. Report all issues of safety or legal consequence immediately and surface undesirable patterns as they are discovered. Partner with HR on all employment decisions, and refer requests for changes in terms or scheduling to the HR department. Monitor approved schedules, review and approve timesheets of staff, and ensure all expenses are reported as per company policy. Schedule and provide staff the opportunity for meal and rest breaks, while ensuring operational coverage is maintained. Annual Budget And Financial Forecasting Lead, develop and administer all aspects of the preparation of the annual budgeting process. Provide financial support, analysis, and counsel to departments throughout the budget cycle. Work closely with key management team members to prepare and develop financial forecast and risk analyses as needed for the senior management. Prepare and develop appropriate input methods and materials that will allow the accurate collection, consolidation and maintenance of budget data. This includes input for all balance sheet and income statement items. Develop and maintain timely integration between the budget consolidation and ALM related models. Work closely with the CFO and SVP Finance to assimilate and develop economic and industry information for integration into the budgeting/forecasting process. Prepare appropriate senior management and Board of Directors review materials for the annual budget. Financial Analysis Perform financial modeling, forecasting, and reporting of pertinent and relevant financial analyses projects that will enhance the senior management team’s understanding of financial performance. Oversee the development and preparation of all ALCO and Pricing Committee materials. Analyze the profitability of selected products and organizational units, as well as major credit union capital expenditures. Establish policies for these analyses processes. Analyze and communicate all credit union peer group related data and information. Audit Support Act as key liaison for annual financial statement audit, NCUA exam, internal audits, and model validations In collaboration with the CFO and SVP Finance, work directly with auditors, as needed, to address inquiries in a timely manner Current Expected Credit Loss (CECL) Manage the CECL model, including calculation, review, and analysis of monthly results Prepare monthly CECL Committee meeting materials, including calculation results, Key Performance Indicator (KPI) reporting, and ongoing model enhancements Process “what-if” scenarios in CECL software to demonstrate to management alternative outcomes with differing assumptions Financial Database Management Design and develop financial reports utilizing the organization’s SQL databases to provide timely Key Performance Indicators (KPI) to management. Maintain the integrity and accuracy of all financial data used for management reporting, financial analysis, budgeting, ALM simulation and cost accounting. Organizational And Product Profitability Analysis Responsible for the development, maintenance and administration of organizational and product profitability for the credit union. Ensure the control and integrity of the profitability models Develop product profitability policies in conjunction with senior management and other pertinent staff members. Provide key insights to other departments regarding product profitability and work closely with them to develop and recommend optimal solutions. Special Projects Working closely with other key team members, actively lead and/or participate in numerous project teams. Other Duties & Responsibilities Perform other duties as assigned. Physical Demands and Work Environment The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit and use hands to finger, handle, or fell objects, tools or controls. The employee frequently is required to talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand; walk, reach with hands and arms; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. Monday-Friday: 8:00am-5:00pm Saturday-Sunday: OFF Full time - 40 hours/week Show more Show less

descripcion: If you’re looking for a special place to build or grow your career, you’ve found it. Whether you’re an experienced professional, a recent college graduate or somewhere in between, IDEX is a place where you can apply your existing skills and learn new ones in an environment where you can make an impact. With interesting opportunities in engineering, marketing, sales, supply chain, operations, HR, finance, and more across more than 40 diverse businesses (https://www.idexcorp.com/our-businesses/business-segments/) around the globe, chances are, we have something special for you. Who is GAST Manufacturing? As a business unit of IDEX Corporation, GAST Manufacturing has a long history of being the leader in design and manufacturing of quality air-moving products. We specialize in offering cost effective solutions for a wide variety of industries including industrial manufacturing, healthcare, and environmental cleanup applications. We are looking to add more talent to our team. SCOPE OF ROLE The Continuous Improvement (CI) Manufacturing Engineer will proactively identify opportunities to eliminate waste, reduce variation, and improve productivity in manufacturing, while facilitating kaizen events with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration of CI principles into product and process design. This position is ideal for a hands-on problem solver who thrives in fast-paced environments and is passionate about building sustainable systems that support innovation and growth. Additionally, this role is responsible for leading the introduction of new products into manufacturing, ensuring seamless integration from design to production. This role bridges engineering, operations, and quality to deliver products that meet performance, cost, and schedule targets. Essential Duties Continuous Improvement: Lead and facilitate Kaizen events, problem solving, and other lean activities to drive measurable improvements. Develop and implement standard work, visual management systems, and 5S programs. Identify and implement improvements for new product lines to enhance quality, cost, and delivery through 3P Kaizen methodology. Project Management Lead cross-functional teams through the NPD (New Product Development) process from design validation to product launch. Manufacturing Readiness Develop and validate manufacturing processes, packaging and labeling, testing, work instructions, standard work and tooling for new products. Design For Manufacturability (DFM) Collaborate with design engineering to ensure products are optimized for efficient assembly and quality. Process Validation Conduct PFMEA, capability studies, and pilot builds to ensure robust production processes. Training & Documentation Support training of production staff and ensure documentation is complete and standardized. Metrics & Reporting Track NPI KPIs such as first-pass yield, ramp-up time, and launch readiness. Subject Matter Expert (SME) and trainer of CI tools (Mixed Model Lean, Six Sigma, SIOP, Sourcing, GDP, and KPIs). Works to grow revenue & profit by delivering strong operational performance (SQDC). Lead efforts to identify opportunities for automation and implementing automation projects Utilize 80/20 methods, Lean Manufacturing, & Six Sigma tools drive focus on critical items that will yield the highest impact to the organization. Establish CI Roadmap that deploys actions to achieve strategic goals. Drives consistency and effective adoption of CI deployment in all areas. Implement problem solving principles to identify root cause and corrective actions Will help develop and maintain operational excellence and Quality KPI’s and countermeasures Hands on participant of the Continuous Improvement/Kaizen processes by leading Rapid Improvement Events (RIE’s). Support Goal Deployment Action Plans and improvement targets for the enterprise. Drive sustainable and consistent quality processes throughout Gast/JUN-AIR with sound root cause analysis and countermeasures. Build trust and credibility by leading by example. Create regular communications with the value stream and vertical businesses (clear direction, regular updates on events/decisions, and accountability for achieving & sustaining RIE results). Measures of Performance Sustainable performance improvements in Safety, Quality, OTD, Lead-time reduction, Inventory Turns, and PBIT Timely and successful completion of various business transformation projects Significant improvement in First pass yield, warranty claims, and customer quality complaints Identification and implementation of transformational manufacturing processes (automation implementation, Poke-Yoke processes, material movement technology) Education And Experience Requirements Or Equivalencies Bachelor's degree in manufacturing, business, engineering discipline, or technical degree. 5+ years of production experience preferred. Strong continuous improvement background with knowledge of 5S, Kaizen, Lean and Value Experience in identification of large cost centers and systematically driving improvement to obtain organizational goals for a product manufacturing facility Value Stream Mapping Background with selection and implementation of automated equipment Hands on responsibility for manufacturing product quality Advanced understanding of ISO and Quality Management Systems History of results-based approach to developing and implementation of productivity funnel through the utilization of Kaizen Advanced knowledge of CI tools (Mixed Model Lean, Six Sigma, SIOP, Sourcing, GDP, and KPIs) KEY COMPETENCIES Drive for results / high sense of urgency Solid problem-solving methodology and demonstrated skill Integrity and trust Interpersonal savvy Strong leadership and influential skills Strong communication/presentation skills Strong data analyzation skills and strategy development Mentoring, development, and accountability GAST Manufacturing, a Unit of IDEX Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to workforce diversity. descripcion: Why You Belong Here At Victoria’s Secret & Co, you’ll join a world-leading specialty retail brand recognized globally for innovation and excellence in lingerie and fashion. You’ll work alongside industry leaders to set the standard for what a retail brand can achieve, placing customers at the center of everything we do to create products and experiences that bring them joy. We believe everyone deserves a place where they truly belong. We celebrate individuality and know that your passion, experience, and unique perspective strengthen our team and business. Here, you’ll be empowered to perform, grow, and engage through unmatched opportunities to develop your skills, gain real-world experience, and learn from the best in the business. Description Your Impact : As the Director, Logistics Planning – Planning & Coordination , you will lead a team of 13 planning professionals responsible for end-to-end inventory flow planning, coordination, and optimization across all Victoria’s Secret sales channels, including Retail, Digital, International, and Marketplaces. You will ensure optimal inventory positioning, flow efficiency, and capacity alignment to support business demand, improve speed to market, and maximize product availability. In this role, you will serve as a critical connector across Supply Chain, partnering closely with Distribution Centers, Transportation, SCP&A (Intelligence & Applications), Merchandise Planning & Allocation, Store Operations, Finance, Data Science, and 3PL providers to deliver integrated, data-driven logistics plans. You will drive capacity readiness, inventory optimization, and peak-planning strategies while leading cross-functional initiatives to enhance operational effectiveness. Through strategic leadership, continuous improvement, and data-driven decision making, you will translate business needs into executable logistics strategies that improve network performance and support enterprise growth Your Experience Progressive leadership experience in Supply Chain Planning, Inventory Planning, Logistics Planning or Distribution, with accountability for end-to-end inventory flow, service performance, and execution across omnichannel distribution networks. Demonstrated success building, leading, and developing high-performing planning organizations, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and data-driven decision-making. Extensive experience leading integrated supply chain planning functions, including demand forecasting, supply planning, inventory management, capacity planning, and demand fulfillment. Proven ownership of Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) and Sales & Operations Execution (S&OE) processes within retail or consumer products, aligning commercial strategies, financial plans, inventory investments, and operational capabilities. Strong expertise in developing risk mitigation strategies to effectively manage demand variability, capacity constraints, and peak-volume periods. Deep understanding of retail distribution center operations supporting both store replenishment, digital fulfillment, and wholesale fulfillment including inbound operations, receiving, put-away, order management, wave planning, carton pick/pack, and shipping. Expertise in inventory and capacity management across complex multi-node distribution and fulfillment networks to maximize product availability while minimizing cost and working capital. Advanced knowledge of supply chain planning and execution technologies, including SAP HANA, Blue Yonder (JDA), Manhattan Distributed Order Management (DOM), and related forecasting, analytics, and warehouse management platforms. Proven ability to influence and collaborate across Distribution, Transportation, Merchandise Planning & Allocation, Store Operations, Finance, Technology, Analytics, Data Science, and external logistics partners to deliver integrated business solutions and enterprise objectives. Experience developing, monitoring, and improving key supply chain performance metrics, leveraging advanced analytics and actionable insights to drive service improvements, inventory productivity, and operational efficiency. Exceptional analytical, strategic thinking, communication, and executive stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate business objectives into scalable supply chain strategies and deliver results in a fast-paced, highly complex retail environment. Experience managing through periods of rapid growth, organizational change, peak-season demand, and network expansion while maintaining service, inventory, and financial performance objectives. descripcion: Postúlate en Kit Empleo: kitempleo.com.ar/empleo/vlohn Software Engineer – Go/Golang Backend | Cybersecurity Platform Position Type: Full-Time, Remote Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours About the Role At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Software Engineer specializing in backend development to help build and scale the infrastructure powering a modern cybersecurity platform. This is not a basic CRUD development role . You’ll work on technically challenging systems involving: - Go/Golang backend services - High-volume security data processing - Distributed and event-driven systems - 100+ third-party integrations - Scalable APIs and data pipelines - Cloud infrastructure - Multi-tenant data architecture If you enjoy solving complex backend, infrastructure, and integration problems at scale, this role offers strong technical ownership and impact. What You’ll Own Backend Engineering – Go & APIs - Build and maintain backend services primarily using Go (Golang) . - Design scalable REST APIs and internal microservices. - Implement authentication, rate limiting, retry mechanisms, fault tolerance, and robust error handling. - Write maintainable, production-ready code designed for reliability and scale. - Diagnose performance bottlenecks and improve backend efficiency. Enterprise Integrations - Build and maintain integrations across 100+ enterprise systems . - Work extensively with REST APIs, OAuth, webhooks, and external services. - Design integrations that remain reliable as data volume and customer usage scale. - Troubleshoot integration failures and improve resilience. - Implement monitoring and observability around integration health. Event-Driven Systems & Data Pipelines - Design event-driven architectures for processing security data. - Build pipelines for data ingestion, transformation, and enrichment. - Work with asynchronous processing, messaging systems, and distributed workflows. - Ensure high-volume data can be processed reliably and efficiently. PostgreSQL & Data Architecture - Design scalable data models for multi-tenant applications. - Work extensively with PostgreSQL . - Design schemas and optimize complex queries. - Improve indexing and database performance. - Support both operational and analytics-oriented data requirements. - Maintain data integrity as the platform scales. Cloud Infrastructure & Observability - Deploy and operate services across cloud environments, with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) preferred. - Work with scalable compute, managed storage, and messaging infrastructure. - Implement monitoring, logging, and observability. - Diagnose production issues and improve system reliability. - Contribute to infrastructure and platform scalability initiatives. Architecture & Platform Development - Collaborate with Product, Security, and Engineering teams. - Participate in architecture decisions and technical design reviews. - Identify opportunities to improve platform reliability, scalability, and maintainability. - Contribute to AI-powered security workflows and automation initiatives. Required Experience & Skills - Strong professional backend software engineering experience. - Proficiency in Go/Golang , or strong experience with Python, Java, or Type Script with willingness to transition to Go. - Experience building production APIs and distributed backend systems. - Strong relational database experience, ideally PostgreSQL . - Experience with at least one major cloud platform: - GCP - AWS - Azure - Hands-on understanding of: - REST APIs - Webhooks - Authentication systems - Asynchronous processing - Database design and optimization - Strong debugging and problem-solving abilities. - Ability to independently own technical problems through resolution. - Strong written and verbal communication skills. Nice to Have Experience with any of the following is highly valuable: - OAuth - Event-driven architectures - Message queues and asynchronous systems - Distributed systems - High-volume data pipelines - Multi-tenant SaaS architecture - Cybersecurity platforms - SIEM systems - Identity and access management - Endpoint security platforms - Startup or high-growth engineering environments - AI/LLM-powered applications and workflows Core Technology Stack Backend: Go / Golang Database: PostgreSQL APIs: REST, OAuth, Webhooks Cloud: GCP preferred; AWS/Azure relevant Architecture: Microservices, distributed systems, event-driven processing Infrastructure: Messaging systems, monitoring, logging, observability What Makes You a Strong Fit You’re likely to succeed if you: - Prefer backend and systems engineering over frontend/UI development. - Have built production systems designed for scale. - Understand that integrations need to handle failures, retries, rate limits, and changing external APIs. - Care about clean architecture and long-term maintainability. - Think deeply about reliability, performance, and observability. - Can troubleshoot complex production issues systematically. - Take ownership without requiring constant direction. - Enjoy fast-moving, engineering-heavy environments. What a Typical Day Looks Like You may spend your day: - Building and shipping backend services in Go. - Designing an integration with an external enterprise platform. - Debugging a production integration or data-processing issue. - Optimizing PostgreSQL queries and indexes. - Improving API reliability and performance. - Building or refining event-driven data pipelines. - Reviewing architecture decisions with other engineers. - Improving monitoring and observability. - Supporting AI-powered security and automation workflows. In short: you’ll build the scalable backend infrastructure, integrations, and data systems that power a modern cybersecurity platform. We are connected through our shared values - dedicated, innovative, friendly, partners, and do the right thing. descripcion: Job Description Oracle is seeking a Principal-level Supply/Demand Planner to drive end-to-end planning for assigned products, partnering with Sourcing, Demand Management, Finance, and suppliers to build resilient supply plans, optimize inventory strategies, and quickly resolve supply-demand imbalances that impact revenue, customer delivery, and margin. This is a highly visible role for a self-directed planner who can operate independently, lead cross-functional execution, and communicate forward-looking supply capability to senior leadership in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment. Responsibilities What You’ll Do Develop and own supply plans in partnership with Sourcing Management, Demand Management, and suppliers to meet customer and business commitments. Create inventory strategies (targets, buffers, risk mitigation approaches) that balance service levels, cost, and working capital. Identify and resolve supply-demand gaps (shortages/excess) and lead cross-functional teams to drive corrective actions that protect revenue and margin. Assess forward-looking revenue capability and supply risk, providing clear insights and scenarios to senior leadership for decision-making. Coordinate supply allocations when required, partnering with internal teams and suppliers to optimize outcomes and ensure fair, transparent execution. Present business results and recommendations to stakeholders across Supply Chain, Finance, and business units—translating complex analysis into actionable plans. Improve planning processes and systems by contributing to the design, development, and evaluation of new tools, metrics, and operating rhythms. Mentor and guide junior planners, providing direction, specialist knowledge, and training; support senior planners and management on ad-hoc initiatives. Build strong stakeholder relationships across Oracle lines of business and external suppliers, influencing without authority to drive alignment and results. Expert-level Excel skills (advanced modeling, pivots, forecasting/scenario analysis). Commodity planning experience Memory storage Electronics commodity planning experience Must be able to align across PMs and supply types to align and ensure our contract manufacturers are getting the right signal at the right time. descripcion: JourneyTeam's Data & AI practice is growing, and we're looking for a hungry, humble, and smart Business Intelligence Developer to join our world-class team. This is a great opportunity for someone with a strong BI foundation who is ready to take the next step—not entry level, but also not so senior that they're done growing. In this role, you'll build modern Microsoft analytics solutions with Power BI and Microsoft Fabric, work directly with clients, and continue developing into a well-rounded consultant. If you're passionate about turning data into insight and want to be part of a collaborative, values-driven team, we'd love to hear from you. About JourneyTeam At JourneyTeam, people are at the center of everything we do. Our purpose as a company is to help others effectively use technology to create a positive, lasting impact on the world. With 30 years of technology experience, we are 100% focused on delivering Microsoft business applications and technologies that empower organizations to reach new heights of business success. We deeply understand the transformative value of Microsoft solutions and are dedicated to helping our customers unlock their full potential. Our experienced team specializes in driving success across Dynamics 365, Microsoft 365, AI and Copilot, Azure, and modern data solutions—all leveraging Microsoft's comprehensive security platform. What Truly Sets Us Apart Is How We Show Up Every Day—for Our Customers And For Each Other. We Believe That Great Outcomes Come From Great People Who Are Aligned In How They Work, Collaborate, And Take Ownership. We Succeed By Consistently Demonstrating Our Core Values A Caring Mindset Exceptional Performance Being OneTeam Making & Keeping Commitments Taking Ownership Effective Communication A Growth Mindset The Opportunity Our BI Developers turn data platforms into decisions. Working alongside our data engineers and architects, you will design and build the semantic models, reports, and dashboards our clients rely on every day. Critical aspects of this role include discovering business requirements, translating them into intuitive analytics experiences, and delivering polished, performant Power BI solutions on Microsoft Fabric. Senior-level candidates will also lead the analytics workstream on client engagements and mentor other developers. Key Responsibilities Design, build, and deploy Power BI reports, dashboards, and apps that tell a clear story and drive business decisions. Develop robust semantic models—including Direct Lake models on Microsoft Fabric—with well-structured DAX measures, calculation groups, and row-level security. Work directly with clients to gather reporting requirements, define KPIs, and translate business questions into effective analytics solutions. Shape and transform data using Power Query (M), SQL, and Fabric tools, partnering with data engineers on lakehouse and warehouse-side modeling. Apply data visualization and UX best practices to create intuitive, accessible, and performant report experiences. Leverage AI-assisted analytics—including Copilot for Power BI and natural language Q&A—to help clients get more value from their data. Optimize model and report performance (DAX tuning, aggregations, incremental refresh, capacity considerations). Manage workspace governance, deployment pipelines, report security and distribution mechanisms, and content lifecycle across development, test, and production environments. Participate in client meetings, design sessions, and demos to support solution delivery. At the Senior level, use consulting expertise to guide customers, align solutions to business goals, and drive project outcomes that create lasting customer value. Contribute to internal standards, templates, reusable assets, and documentation. Stay current with Microsoft's evolving Fabric and Power BI platform and bring forward ideas for continuous improvement. Qualifications 2-5+ years of hands-on Business Intelligence development experience, preferably within the Microsoft ecosystem. (2-3 years aligns to the BI Developer level; 5+ years with demonstrated client and technical leadership aligns to the Senior level.) Strong alignment with the JourneyTeam values described above, with a demonstrated ability to bring humility, drive, collaboration, and sound judgment into client work and team interactions. Expert-level Power BI skills: report and dashboard development, semantic modeling, DAX, and Power Query (M). Experience with Microsoft Fabric, including Direct Lake semantic models, OneLake, and lakehouse/warehouse sources. Strong SQL skills and a solid understanding of dimensional modeling (e.g., star schemas) and how model design impacts report performance. Familiarity with AI-assisted analytics capabilities such as Copilot for Power BI. Understanding of Power BI governance: workspaces, deployment pipelines, row-level security, and sharing/distribution strategies. Strong data storytelling and visualization skills, with attention to usability and design. Ability to work independently on assigned tasks and contribute to client-facing projects with support from senior team members; Senior candidates should demonstrate the ability to lead the analytics workstream and mentor others. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a collaborative mindset. Certification Requirements Applicants for this role must have the following certifications or a plan to attain them quickly after employment: Certification: PL-300 Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst Associate Certification: DP-600 Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate Preferred Skills (not Required) Experience with external tools such as Tabular Editor, DAX Studio, and ALM Toolkit. Experience with paginated reports and/or Power BI Embedded scenarios. Hands-on experience with other Fabric workloads (Data Factory, notebooks, warehouses) or Azure data services (Synapse, Databricks, Azure SQL Database). Experience with Microsoft Purview or other data governance and cataloging tools. Experience with project delivery methodologies (Agile/Scrum, Kanban, Waterfall, hybrid). Knowledge of change management practices to support data and AI adoption. Experience with Dynamics 365 (Project Service Automation or Project Operations). Experience with Azure DevOps. Compensation The base salary range for this role is $80,000 – $120,000 + performance-based bonus program. Eligibility and payout are tied to individual contributions, team performance, and company success. This is the established pay range for the Mid-level BI Developer role at JourneyTeam on the Data & AI Solutions Practice. Where you fall within this range—and the level at which you are hired—will depend on your experience, technical skillset, and demonstrated consulting ability. Benefits JourneyTeam offers a wide range of excellent benefits, including comprehensive healthcare and dental coverage, as well as a 401(k) with an approximate 4% employer match—with immediate vesting. We offer flexible time off and provide paid maternity and paternity leave. Additional perks include a monthly phone stipend (or the option to join our corporate phone plan) and a monthly gym membership reimbursement of up to $200. descripcion: There’s a Place for You at Viking Electric. A career at Viking Electric is more than a job. You’re investing in a brighter, more sustainable future together and joining a team that makes a real difference for our customers. Viking Electric https://www.vikingelectric.com/about offers electrical products and services to contractors. If it helps bring electricity to an office, home, factory or other building – you can find it here. We operate throughout the Midwest and are part of the Sonepar group, the world’s #1 electrical distributor with over 45,000 associates around the globe. Being “Powered by Difference” means we respect and value diverse perspectives. At Viking Electric, we offer a supportive culture and great benefits, and as part of the larger Sonepar group, we can offer exciting opportunities to grow your career. Vice President of Supply Chain Location: Minneapolis, Minnesota or any Viking Electric Geography Job type: Full time Schedule: 8am-5pm, Monday-Friday Salary: $200,000 - $275,000 Compensation for this position includes annual salary, 50% short-term incentive bonus, and full benefits package offerings. The exact amount of base salary may vary based on experience and skills brought to the role as well as the geographic location of the role. What You’ll Do As Vice President of Supply Chain, you’ll provide strategic vision and leadership for Viking Electric’s supply chain strategy, including purchasing, category management, supplier relations, inventory, and pricing. You’ll optimize supplier partnerships, product portfolio performance, inventory investment, and pricing effectiveness to drive profitable growth, competitive advantage, and a market-leading customer experience. You will… Define and execute strategies for inventory investment, procurement, replenishment, and inventory productivity. Partner with Operations and Sales leadership to optimize inventory deployment across the network. Improve forecasting, demand planning, and sales and inventory operations planning (SIOP), supported by key performance indicators for inventory health, service levels, and working capital. Direct enterprise purchasing and supplier relationship strategies while strengthening growth with strategic vendors. Negotiate strategic supplier agreements that improve service levels, product availability, and profitability, and establish supplier performance measures and accountability processes. Develop and oversee enterprise pricing strategies, governance, analytics, and margin optimization efforts that balance growth, profitability, and market competitiveness. Partner with Sales leadership to align pricing practices with customer segmentation and growth strategies. Lead Category Management in developing assortment, supplier, product, and category strategies that maximize sales growth, profitability, and market share. Analyze market trends, customer demand, supplier capabilities, and competitive dynamics to optimize category performance and align category strategies with business objectives. Build and develop a high-performing supply chain organization by setting clear expectations, strengthening accountability, coaching future leaders, and fostering continuous improvement, collaboration, and innovation. Serve as an active member of the Viking Electric Leadership Team and contribute to enterprise strategy, annual business planning, and organizational transformation. Maintain customer connectivity and market intelligence, collaborate with Sonepar Supply Chain leadership, and champion change that improves business performance and associate engagement. Requirements What You Bring At least 10 years of management experience. Experience leading organizational transformation and applying change management practices. Demonstrated experience driving and implementing process improvements. Experience defining and executing strategy at the executive level. Strong analytical, organizational, strategic, change management, and problem-solving skills. Ability to lead people, develop teams, and drive results through others. Strong relationship-building and communication skills, sound judgment, integrity, and a commitment to performance and results. Ability to adapt to new situations, people, cultures, and technology; appropriately challenge the status quo; and apply new learning to business priorities. High emotional intelligence, including self-awareness, self-regulation, empathy, motivation, and interpersonal skills. Bachelor’s degree in business, supply chain management, or a related field. Preferred Qualifications Management experience in logistics, operations, or supply chain. Experience working in distribution. Additional Requirements Ability to travel to Viking Electric, customer, and vendor locations. Willingness to occasionally work evenings and weekends and additional hours as needed to meet deadlines. What We Offer You We offer great family-friendly benefits to full-time associates: Healthcare plans Dental & vision Paid time off Paid parental leave 401(k) retirement savings with company match Professional and personal development programs Tuition Reimbursement Opportunity to become a shareholder Employer-paid short- and long-term disability Employer-paid life insurance for spouse and dependents Robust wellness program Gym reimbursement Employee Assistance Program (EAP) We’re proud to be a military-friendly company, and our many employee resource groups (ERGs) help you make connections and feel supported. Learn More About Us Get to know us on YouTube, LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram and learn how we’re “Powering Progress for Future Generations.” Check out the Viking Electric company page on LinkedIn and follow us for updates. Check out our YouTube Careers Playlist to see Viking Electric associates in action. Learn more at https://www.vikingelectric.com/about.
