descripcion: About Us At Félix , we're building the financial ecosystem for Latin immigrants in the U.S., starting with a revolution in remittances. Our core product is an AI-powered chatbot built on WhatsApp, allowing our users to send money home as easily as sending a text message. We leverage cutting-edge technology like AI, blockchain, and stablecoins to make cross-border payments faster, more affordable, and more accessible than ever before. We are a hyper-growth Series B company, backed by over $100 million in funding from top-tier global investors, including QED, Castle Island, Switch Ventures, HTwenty, Monashees, and General Catalyst Customer Value Fund. This isn't just about the numbers; it's a testament to the trust our investors have in our vision and our team. Additionally, Félix was selected as an “Endeavour Entrepreneur” and was a recipient of the CrossTech Fintech Startups Award. We are a group of extremely talented and dedicated high-performers, united by our shared obsession with a single goal: empowering our customers. We are all owners of Félix, driven by a bias for action and a true experimentation spirit to get shit done with urgency and focus. Joining Félix means you will be part of a team building a legacy, a company that will outlive us all. This is a rare opportunity to apply your skills to a deeply meaningful mission—serving a community that has been underserved for too long. We are a team that is fiercely loyal to each other, where radical transparency and constructive feedback are how we grow and push for excellence. We are bold, we care less about what others are doing, and more about creating sustainable value and a product that truly makes our users' lives better. We are building the future, today. About the role As a Lead Data Scientist for our Fraud team, you will be on the front lines of protecting our company and our customers. You will leverage your expertise in machine learning, statistics, and data analysis to design, build, and deploy sophisticated models that detect and prevent fraudulent activity in real-time. This is a high-impact role where you will see your work directly translate into protecting millions of dollars and ensuring a trustworthy platform for our users. Responsibilities Technical Leadership & Strategy: Define the long-term machine learning strategy for the fraud team, establish technical best practices, and mentor junior data scientists. End-to-End Model Development: Own the entire lifecycle of fraud detection models, from data exploration and feature engineering to model training, validation, deployment, and monitoring. Credit & Lending Fraud Mitigation: Design and develop models specifically targeted at lending fraud typologies, including synthetic identity fraud, first-party loan default fraud, and application fraud. Advanced Analysis: Conduct deep-dive investigations into emerging fraud patterns and user behavior, using clustering, outlier detection, network analysis, and other unsupervised techniques to uncover hidden risks and organized fraud rings. Experimentation: Design and execute A/B tests to measure the impact of new models, rules, and strategies on both fraud detection rates and user experience. Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Risk, and Operations teams to translate business needs into data science solutions, seamlessly integrate ML scores with rule engines, and communicate complex results to non-technical audiences. Productionalize Models: Deploy, monitor, and maintain machine learning models in a cloud environment, ensuring high availability and performance. Reporting & Visualization: Build and maintain dashboards using tools like Tableau or Looker to track key performance indicators (KPIs) like fraud loss rates, false positive rates, and model performance. Requirements Must-Haves: Experience: 5+ years of experience in a hands-on data science role, building and deploying machine learning models. Leadership: Proven experience leading complex data science projects from inception to production, including setting technical direction and guiding peers. Python: Expert-level Python for data analysis and modeling (pandas, scikit-learn, etc.). SQL: Advanced SQL skills for complex data extraction and manipulation. Machine Learning Modeling: Deep experience with tree-based ML models (XGBoost, CatBoost, LightGBM) and statistical models (Logistic Regression, Lasso/Ridge). Model Explainability & Ethics: Deep understanding of model explainability frameworks (SHAP, LIME) and algorithmic fairness to ensure models comply with credit lending regulations. Sampling Techniques: Strong understanding of sampling techniques for handling highly imbalanced datasets. Unsupervised Learning: Practical experience with clustering and outlier detection techniques (e.g., K-Means, K Nearest Neighbors, Isolation Forest). Model Lifecycle & Cloud: Proven experience with the full modeling lifecycle, including model deployment, monitoring, and maintenance on a cloud platform like GCP, AWS, or Azure. Analytical Rigor: A solid foundation in statistics and experience designing and analyzing A/B tests. Communication: Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences. Advanced English level. Nice to have Domain Experience: Direct experience in a FinTech, payments, or risk/fraud-focused role, particularly with exposure to credit or consumer lending. Alternative & Bureau Data: Experience working with traditional credit bureau data (Experian, Equifax, TransUnion) and alternative credit/identity data sources. Graph ML: Experience with Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) or graph analytics tools (e.g., Neo4j, NetworkX) to map complex fraud networks. Regulatory Familiarity: Familiarity with consumer lending regulations (e.g., FCRA, ECOA) and their impact on machine learning model development. MLOps: Hands-on MLOps experience (e.g., CI/CD for models, versioning, automated retraining). GCP / Vertex AI: Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), especially Vertex AI. These are the applicable requisites, although equivalent competencies in any of the above will also be considered. descripcion: Tasks Inside the Role The Vendor Scheduler is accountable for ensuring the on-time delivery of purchased components required to support production and distribution operations. This role manages supplier schedules through EDI and manual scheduling processes, balances material availability with inventory targets, and helps minimize premium freight. The position supports the Consolidation Center, parts distribution, and internal Machining departments while using data and analysis to identify supply risks, resolve delivery issues, and improve supply chain performance. Posting Information We provide a scheduled posting end date to assist our candidates with their application planning. While this date reflects our latest plans, it is subject to change, and postings may be extended or removed earlier than expected. We Take Care of Our Team Position offers a starting salary range of $65,000.00 - $83,000.00 USD Pay Offered Dependent On Knowledge, Skills, And experience Benefits include annual bonus program; 401k company contribution with company match up to 6% as well as non-elective company contribution of 3 - 7% depending on age; starting at 4 weeks paid vacation; 13+ calendar holidays; 8 weeks paid parental leave; employee assistance program; comprehensive healthcare plans and wellness programs; onsite fitness (at some locations); tuition assistance and volunteer paid time off; short-term and long-term disability plans. What You Drive At DTNA Manage supplier schedules and ensure purchased components are available in the required quantities and at the required time to support operational demand. Analyze and adjust ERP parameters to meet production needs based on fluctuating customer demand, lead time and other factors. Execute and maintain EDI and manual scheduling processes, verifying that schedule requirements are accurate, timely, and clearly communicated. Monitor supplier delivery performance and material availability; identify shortages, late deliveries, and other risks that could affect operations. Coordinate material flow in support of the Consolidation Center, parts distribution, and internal Machining departments. Manage domestic/international supply base for relevant aggregates Balance component availability with inventory-value objectives and premium-freight targets, escalating risks and trade-offs as appropriate. Control on hand inventory for multiple assembly plants in US and Mexico Assemble and analyze supply chain data to evaluate performance, identify trends, determine root causes, and recommend corrective actions. Develop and implement practical short-term containment actions and longer-term solutions within defined policies, procedures, and business requirements. Collaborate with suppliers and internal stakeholders to resolve delivery issues, communicate priorities, and maintain alignment on recovery actions. Maintain clear documentation of supply issues, decisions, recovery plans, and follow-up actions to support execution and accountability. Analyze material flow processes seeking opportunities for improvement based on lean/six sigma concepts Support continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to strengthen scheduling, inventory, delivery, and issue-resolution processes. Knowledge You Should Bring Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Logistics, Business, or a related field and 0-2 years of relevant experience, is required. Working knowledge of supply chain planning, material scheduling, inventory management, and supplier delivery concepts. Ability to use analytical and quantitative methods to interpret data, assess performance, and support sound decisions. Strong problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify root causes and develop effective short-term and long-term actions. Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across suppliers and internal teams. Ability to prioritize multiple requirements, exercise judgment within established procedures, and respond effectively to changing conditions. An attached resume is required. Exceptional Candidates Might Have One to two years of relevant experience in supply chain planning, material scheduling, logistics, procurement, manufacturing, or a related environment. Experience supporting supplier performance, component availability, production operations, or distribution activities. Experience working with EDI-enabled and manual scheduling processes. Where We Work This position is open to applicants who can work in (or relocate to) the following location(s)- Detroit, MI US. Relocation assistance is not available for this position. Schedule Type Hybrid (4 days per week in-office / 1 day remote). This schedule builds our #OneTeamBestTeam culture, provides an unparalleled customer experience, and creates innovative solutions through in-person collaboration. The Data Scientist will help develop and maintain our data infrastructure and visualization layers for digital marketing use cases, working closely with our Analytics, Data Science, and Solutions Engineering teams. This role bridges the gap between raw data and decision-ready insights, building robust pipelines and interactive dashboards to measure media performance. The candidate can expect to participate in all technical phases of data engineering and client projects, including data discovery, pipeline construction, warehouse modeling, and reporting. It is also expected that they will participate in project planning, task estimation, and making data-driven recommendations for clients. Responsibilities Backend & Data Infrastructure Build and maintain scheduled ingestion pipelines pulling spend, impression, and conversion data from media platform APIs (Google Ads, YouTube, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn) and first-party sources into BigQuery. Design and own the BigQuery warehouse layer (schema, partitioning and clustering, incremental models) so modeling and measurement datasets are reproducible and query-efficient. Develop transformation logic that cleans, normalizes, and joins cross-platform data into modeling-ready tables for Meridian (MMM) and geo/matched-market test designs. Implement data quality and validation (schema validation, freshness checks, anomaly detection) with alerting so failures and drift are caught before they reach downstream analysis. Stand up and maintain Data Manager API and GA4-to-BigQuery integrations to strengthen the first-party signal feeding the measurement stack. Manage the supporting GCP infrastructure (scheduling, service accounts, access controls, cost monitoring) and document lineage and runbooks so the work transfers cleanly off a single owner. Frontend, Data Delivery & Visualization Build and maintain reporting dashboards (Looker Studio, Looker, GA4 Omni Insights) that surface media performance, measurement results, and test readouts for client and internal audiences. Develop the serving and visualization layer that turns MMM, incrementality, and geo-test outputs into decision-ready views. Implement parameterized, self-serve filtering (campaign, platform, DMA, date range) so stakeholders pull what they need without ad hoc requests. Own serving-layer performance and definitional consistency so dashboards refresh on cadence and reconcile to the warehouse as the single source of truth. Client & Cross-functional Collaboration Nurture client understanding of the importance of building & testing data-driven strategies. Utilize data visualization techniques to explain data models and pipelines to clients and internal teams. Act as a consultative resource to help clients understand and integrate their internal data sources and testing processes. descripcion: About Us At Félix, we are building the indispensable financial companion for Latinos in the US. We combine an AI-powered, conversational-first interface with real-time financial infrastructure to make cross-border money movement as easy as sending a text. Starting with fast, affordable remittances powered by AI and crypto rails, we are expanding into credit, savings, and wallet services to support the complete immigrant financial journey. Our ambition is to deliver a white-glove financial experience with the simplicity of a conversation to a community the traditional financial system has historically overlooked. We are a hyper-growth Series C company, backed by over $300 million in funding from top-tier global investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, QED, Castle Island, Switch Ventures, HTwenty, Monashees, General Catalyst Customer Value Fund. This isn't just about the numbers; it's a testament to the trust our investors have in our vision and our team. Additionally, Félix was selected as an “Endeavour Entrepreneur” and was a recipient of the CrossTech Fintech Startups Award. Joining Félix means you will be part of a team building a legacy, a company that will outlive us all. This is a rare opportunity to apply your skills to a deeply meaningful mission—serving a community that has been underserved for too long because we are obsessed with our customers . We get things done with urgency and focus , driven by extreme ownership over our impact. We collaborate without ego , fostering radical transparency and fierce loyalty so we can grow together. Because we aim for insanely great rather than just good enough, we stay insatiably curious —always experimenting, building the future today, and delivering a product that truly makes our users' lives better. About The Role We are transitioning our core operational capabilities from third-party low-code solutions to a robust, highly scalable, in-house ecosystem. As part of the CX Platform team, you will own the construction of the operational modules that power our daily business, building features end-to-end from the React UI down to the Node.js services that aggregate and protect our data. You will own the modules, screens, and APIs that the CX team relies on every day, designing, building, and shipping them end-to-end. Your work has a direct, measurable impact: every feature you ship reduces handling times, removes friction, and gives our operators superpowers. If you love taking features from idea to production without artificial silos between frontend and backend, and you get satisfaction from shipping tools that real humans rely on to do real work, this is your place. Technology Stack: We care more about strong engineering fundamentals than expertise in any specific tool. If your foundations are solid, picking up adjacent technologies should be second nature. That said, here is the stack you will be working with day to day: Front-end: Advanced React, TypeScript, Component-Driven UI, Modular CSS Architectures. Back-end: Node.js + TypeScript, REST API design, secure aggregation layers, Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) patterns. Data Layer: Relational data modeling (PostgreSQL or similar), schema design, query optimization, transactional integrity. Security & Access: RBAC, secure handling of sensitive data, strict environment isolation. Tooling & Delivery: Modern build tools and bundlers, Git workflows, CI/CD pipelines. Responsibilities End-to-End Feature Ownership: Build complete operational modules, from the React UI down to the Node.js services and data models that power them. You own the feature, not just a layer of it. Module Development: Design and ship the modules that live on top of our CX platform: high-density data views, complex operational workflows, and internal tools that drastically reduce cognitive load for our operators. Secure Integration Layer: Implement intermediary layers (BFFs, aggregators) that consume internal microservices and external providers, standardize payloads, and enforce strict authorization rules before data reaches the client. Operational Efficiency: Collaborate shoulder-to-shoulder with core business stakeholders to deeply understand their daily workflows, then translate that understanding into technical solutions that materially reduce handling times. Engineering Craft: Champion clean patterns, pragmatic design, and a high quality bar across the modules you ship. Mentor peers and elevate the broader engineering culture. Requirements 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Fluent or advanced English. Advanced React & UI Engineering: Deep understanding of React and solid foundations in web standards (HTML/DOM, CSS, HTTP). TypeScript proficiency is expected. Solid Node.js / Backend Skills: Proven ability to design and build well-structured REST APIs in Node.js. Strong grasp of API design, service boundaries, error handling, and clean backend patterns. Data Modeling: Comfortable designing relational schemas, writing performant queries, and reasoning about transactional integrity. Security & Authorization: Hands-on experience implementing authentication and authorization flows, especially Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) over sensitive data. Aggregation / BFF Patterns: Ability to design backend-for-frontend or aggregation layers that consume multiple microservices and expose a clean, secure surface to the client. Problem Solving: Excellent problem-solving skills with a balance of creative UI implementation and strict engineering rigor on the backend. Nice to have (highly desirable): Technical Leadership: Track record of mentoring engineers, raising the bar in code reviews, and influencing architectural decisions beyond your immediate scope. Internal Tools / Enterprise Ops: Experience building internal tools, CRM systems, or high-density data applications focused on operational efficiency and scale. Regulated Environments: Background in highly regulated sectors (Fintech, Healthcare) dealing with strict role-based access control (RBAC) and data isolation. descripcion: Summary The Plant Controller is the finance and FP&A leader for the facility and a core member of the plant leadership team, owning both the controllership function (P&L integrity, internal controls, GAAP compliance) and the strategic FP&A function (profitability analysis, forecasting, budgeting, and capital investment analysis) for the plant. This is a highly visible role that regularly presents financial results, forecasts, and business recommendations to senior corporate leadership (Directors, VPs, CFO, CEO), and is expected to act as a business partner first and a controller second, using sound financial judgment to influence plant and corporate decisions. This is a driver's seat role: the Plant Controller is expected to take ownership of outcomes, not simply report on them, and to help raise the performance bar for the entire plant finance team. Key Responsibilities Controllership Own the accuracy and integrity of the plant's monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and operational reporting Oversee month-end and year-end close processes, ensuring accuracy and compliance with US GAAP Own the design, implementation, and monitoring of internal controls Own cost allocation methodology, including standard labor and overhead rates by work center/department Own resolution of standard cost variances, including purchase price variance (PPV), material usage, and labor/overhead absorption variances; drive root cause analysis and corrective action to closure, partnering with the Costing function and plant operations as needed, and escalating systemic costing issues to the Director of Costing and Director of Finance Analyze inventory valuation and metrics, including period-to-period fluctuations Serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external audit requests Mentor and guide Associate Plant Controllers; this is a leading-without-authority relationship (Associate Plant Controllers currently report to the Director of Finance, not the Plant Controller) and a deliberate development opportunity for the Plant Controller to build influence and coaching skills ahead of larger management scope FP&A and Business Partnering Serve as the FP&A lead for the plant, partnering directly with the Plant Director and plant leadership team Lead the annual budget/AOP process and periodic reforecasts for the facility Own profitability analysis by product line and/or customer, and use it to drive plant strategy Lead capital project and investment analysis, including ROI and payback calculations, for plant leadership decision-making Present financial results, forecasts, and strategic recommendations to plant leadership and senior corporate leadership Proactively lead cost reduction and margin improvement initiatives, both inter-departmentally and cross-functionally, to drive low-cost producer status Serves as the lead analyst partner to the Costing team for the plant: proactively surfacing costing opportunities, risks, and variance root causes, and driving them into Costing's review and standard-setting process; Costing owns execution and the standard, the Plant Controller owns the analysis and the push Lead plant continuous improvement events and business transformation activities Lead special projects and system implementations (e.g., Oracle EBS) on behalf of the plant Key Skills And Competencies Ability to work independently across the full scope of plant finance, exercising sound judgment on when to escalate to the Director of Finance or plant leadership Strong knowledge of US GAAP and internal control principles; working familiarity with IFRS concepts a plus given Crenlo's OEM customer relationships Demonstrated business partnering skills; able to translate financial data into clear, actionable recommendations for non-finance leaders Self-starter who proactively identifies issues and opportunities rather than waiting for direction; acts as a driver of outcomes, not a passenger along for the process Constructively challenges assumptions and the status quo at the plant; comfortable respectfully pushing back on plans or numbers that don't hold up Acts as a business partner first and a controller second, without compromising financial integrity or controls Strong data mining, analysis, and financial modeling capabilities Excellent verbal, written, and executive presentation skills Proficient with Microsoft 365 (Excel, PowerPoint, Word); experience with Oracle EBS or a comparable ERP strongly preferred Contributes to raising the performance bar for the broader plant finance team, not just individual results; supports a team-first culture where the team's collective strength matters as much as any one person's output Experience mentoring and developing accounting/finance staff; comfortable guiding and coaching an Associate Plant Controller toward advancement without formal supervisory authority over that role Demonstrated ability to influence senior leadership decisions using financial data and analysis PERFORMANCE MEASURES Success in this role is measured primarily by the plant's performance against budgeted/forecasted KPIs, including: EBITDA attainment against AOP/forecast Manufacturing efficiency and productivity metrics Cost reduction and margin improvement initiatives delivered Standard cost variance resolution, including PPV and material/labor/overhead variances, closed to root cause within expected timelines Inventory accuracy and working capital metrics Forecast/budget accuracy and timeliness of reporting Effectiveness of internal controls Education And Experience Requirements Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related discipline 8+ years of progressive experience in finance/accounting, with demonstrated supervisory experience CPA or CMA not required, but preferred / a strong plus Broad cost accounting experience in a manufacturing environment, or a lean/continuous improvement methodology and culture, strongly preferred Demonstrated FP&A leadership experience: budgeting, forecasting, and capital investment analysis Demonstrated experience presenting to and influencing senior leadership Experience with an ERP system (Oracle EBS preferred), business intelligence/reporting tools, and financial planning software Experience with internal controls and audit support preferred Working Conditions / Other Work Hours/Status: Full-time, exempt Travel Requirements: Occasional travel between Crenlo facilities and corporate office; travel to attend leadership or customer meetings as needed Environment: Combination of plant floor and office environment; may involve exposure to a manufacturing floor with associated noise, dust, and equipment Physical Requirements: Sitting/standing, free to move around plant floor and office Sustained visual concentration on financial data, reports, and monitors Maintains up-to-date knowledge of GAAP, financial reporting standards, and manufacturing finance best practices Show more Show less

descripcion: BUILD SOMETHING BIGGER THAN YOURSELF The Walt Disney Company, together with its subsidiaries and affiliates, is a leading diversified international family entertainment and media enterprise with the following business segments: Disney Entertainment, ESPN, Disney Parks, and Experiences and Products. The Walt Disney Company, together with its subsidiaries and affiliates, is a leading diversified international family entertainment and media enterprise with the following business segments: Disney Entertainment, ESPN, Disney Parks, and Experiences and Products. From humble beginnings as a cartoon studio in the 1920s to its preeminent name in the entertainment industry today, Disney proudly continues its legacy of creating world-class stories and experiences for every member of the family. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally. The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world. Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here: Building the future of Disney’s media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. Reach, Scale & Impact: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems. Content Platforms & Operations is responsible for the development and ongoing advancement of the technical and operational functions driving the worldwide distribution and monetization of Disney’s linear networks and theatrical content. This includes Disney’s media supply chain and storage, network and theatrical distribution operations, media localization, network transmission and origination, and more. The global team also plays a critical role as the primary collaboration point for Product & Technology with Disney’s EMEA, APAC, and LATAM regional business teams. How will you contribute to our magical experience? We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Java Software Engineer to join our Content Platform Engineering team, focusing on building and enhancing platform capabilities with a strong emphasis on computer vision and machine learning (ML ) workflows. Our team develops and manages a diverse suite of products and services that power Disney’s media supply chain, enabling content delivery for iconic brands like Disney+, ESPN+, Hulu, ABC, Marvel, and Star Wars. In this role, you will design and implement scalable systems, data pipelines, and platform services that deliver automated inspection, validation, and enrichment of media assets. You will be responsible for building end-to-end media inspection pipelines that leverage computer vision to streamline content analysis and inspection. Leveraging modern software engineering practices and cloud infrastructure, you will build robust, extensible platforms that enable intelligent content operations at scale. Collaborate with Cross-Functional Teams: Work closely with platform engineers, product teams, and data scientists to ensure technical solutions effectively support business goals and content strategies. Production Support: Monitor and optimize production systems, ensuring platform stability, performance, and uptime. Mentorship: Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers, fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous learning. What we need from you to be part of this story: 4+ years of software engineering experience, with significant expertise in Java. Advanced English level. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Strong hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, microservices, and scalable backend systems. Experience designing and developing REST and/or GraphQL APIs. Experience building cloud-native applications on AWS. Solid understanding of CI/CD, testing strategies, and software engineering best practices. Experience with distributed systems and event-driven architectures (Kafka, SNS, SQS). Strong problem-solving skills, ownership mindset, and ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams. Experience with Python, media technology, computer vision, or machine learning is a plus. descripcion: Inside the Role The Vendor Scheduler is accountable for ensuring the on-time delivery of purchased components required to support production and distribution operations. This role manages supplier schedules through EDI and manual scheduling processes, balances material availability with inventory targets, and helps minimize premium freight. The position supports the Consolidation Center, parts distribution, and internal Machining departments while using data and analysis to identify supply risks, resolve delivery issues, and improve supply chain performance. Posting Information We provide a scheduled posting end date to assist our candidates with their application planning. While this date reflects our latest plans, it is subject to change, and postings may be extended or removed earlier than expected. We Take Care of Our Team Position offers a starting salary range of $65,000.00 - $83,000.00 USD Pay Offered Dependent On Knowledge, Skills, And experience Benefits include annual bonus program; 401k company contribution with company match up to 6% as well as non-elective company contribution of 3 - 7% depending on age; starting at 4 weeks paid vacation; 13+ calendar holidays; 8 weeks paid parental leave; employee assistance program; comprehensive healthcare plans and wellness programs; onsite fitness (at some locations); tuition assistance and volunteer paid time off; short-term and long-term disability plans. What You Drive At DTNA Manage supplier schedules and ensure purchased components are available in the required quantities and at the required time to support operational demand. Analyze and adjust ERP parameters to meet production needs based on fluctuating customer demand, lead time and other factors. Execute and maintain EDI and manual scheduling processes, verifying that schedule requirements are accurate, timely, and clearly communicated. Monitor supplier delivery performance and material availability; identify shortages, late deliveries, and other risks that could affect operations. Coordinate material flow in support of the Consolidation Center, parts distribution, and internal Machining departments. Manage domestic/international supply base for relevant aggregates Balance component availability with inventory-value objectives and premium-freight targets, escalating risks and trade-offs as appropriate. Control on hand inventory for multiple assembly plants in US and Mexico Assemble and analyze supply chain data to evaluate performance, identify trends, determine root causes, and recommend corrective actions. Develop and implement practical short-term containment actions and longer-term solutions within defined policies, procedures, and business requirements. Collaborate with suppliers and internal stakeholders to resolve delivery issues, communicate priorities, and maintain alignment on recovery actions. Maintain clear documentation of supply issues, decisions, recovery plans, and follow-up actions to support execution and accountability. Analyze material flow processes seeking opportunities for improvement based on lean/six sigma concepts Support continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to strengthen scheduling, inventory, delivery, and issue-resolution processes. Knowledge You Should Bring Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Logistics, Business, or a related field and 0-2 years of relevant experience, is required. Working knowledge of supply chain planning, material scheduling, inventory management, and supplier delivery concepts. Ability to use analytical and quantitative methods to interpret data, assess performance, and support sound decisions. Strong problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify root causes and develop effective short-term and long-term actions. Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across suppliers and internal teams. Ability to prioritize multiple requirements, exercise judgment within established procedures, and respond effectively to changing conditions. An attached resume is required. Exceptional Candidates Might Have One to two years of relevant experience in supply chain planning, material scheduling, logistics, procurement, manufacturing, or a related environment. Experience supporting supplier performance, component availability, production operations, or distribution activities. Experience working with EDI-enabled and manual scheduling processes. Where We Work This position is open to applicants who can work in (or relocate to) the following location(s)- Detroit, MI US. Relocation assistance is not available for this position. Schedule Type: Hybrid (4 days per week in-office / 1 day remote). This schedule builds our #OneTeamBestTeam culture, provides an unparalleled customer experience, and creates innovative solutions through in-person collaboration. This pivotal role steps beyond transactional routines to directly design, control, and advance the unified buying and planning architecture. Balancing high-impact operational visibility with system modernization, the Advisor evaluates business dynamics at their fundamental root cause, utilizing advanced SAP workflows to optimize long-term material assets and tier-to-tier supplier ecosystems. Core Allocation of Time & Responsibilities 65% Core Operations & Root Cause Analysis 35% Strategic Initiatives & SAP Projects Long-Term Supplier Communications SAP Process Improvement Projects Develop medium- to long-range collaborative material and capacity forecasts. Build and embed enterprise Sales, Inventory, and Operations Planning (SIOP) workflows. Partner with Commodity Management to align localized purchasing with global corporate contracts. Formulate multi-layered risk mitigation plans to secure supply network continuity. SAP & Process Improvement Projects Act as the key pipeline interface between Supply Chain Planning and the IT department for system enhancements. Develop, map, and document refined technical workflows between functional groups. Eradicate manual processing steps to unlock systemic SAP usage adoption, automation, and scale. Perform methodical data root cause analysis to resolve operational bottlenecks Detailed Description Planning Metrics & Analytics: Establish, evaluate, and monitor critical planning data thresholds including Purchase Requisition (PR) Accuracy Rates, First-Time Match Rates, and Requisition Cancellation Rates to ensure exceptional upstream data hygiene. Supplier Performance Management: Identify and manage supplier compliance criteria according to contracted splits and lead-time performance criteria. Collaborate directly with supplier operations teams to sustainably compress lead times and eliminate system costs. SAP Master Data Architecture: Audit and maintain core SAP planning parameters systematically, taking ownership of Vendor Lead Times, Purchasing Info Records (PIR), and Celestica Supplier Portal (CSC). Multi-Tier Visibility: Ensure strategic capacity alignment and transparent forecast communications with Tier 2 and Tier 3 suppliers. Meticulously track variations in baseline forecast data and update data matrices to safeguard lines against shortages. Engineering Change Integration: Partner with local site engineering and operations teams to develop and track cut-over parameters to new part revisions, actively minimizing obsolete and excess inventory exposure. Production Readiness Validation: Validate Clear-to-Build (CTB) data accuracy, identifying repeating material gating items and formulating permanent structural resolutions. Executive Performance Reviews: Conduct formal bi-annual business reviews with critical strategic suppliers utilizing balanced performance scorecards to optimize logistics, financials, and efficiency metrics. Knowledge/Skills/Competencies Domain Expertise: Broad knowledge of advanced electronic manufacturing environments, electronics components, operational materials, and build flows. Strategic Agility: Fast learner possessing sharp knowledge of global supply chain models, including macro-level corporate strategies and fulfillment objectives. SAP and Rapid Response Expertise: Strong knowledge of IT concepts, complex systems infrastructure, and advanced SAP planning modules, configurations, and MRP techniques. Professional Capabilities: Excellent analytical capabilities, professional negotiation acumen, and structured problem resolution skills. Leadership & Communication: Strong communication, presentation, interpersonal, and leadership skills; ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing, with a wide variety of internal partners and external vendors. Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data. descripcion: About Misfits Market Misfits Market is a mission-driven, high-growth startup dedicated to reducing food waste and making shopping for sustainable, high-quality groceries easier and more affordable. We deliver organic produce, high-quality meats and seafood, plant-based proteins, dairy, bakery, wine, and other grocery items to nearly every zip code in 48 states at up to 30 percent off traditional grocery store prices. In 2022, Misfits Market acquired sustainable e-grocer Imperfect Foods and now leverages its in-house transportation network to deliver directly to consumers with one of the most carbon-efficient grocery delivery models on the market. By tackling inefficiencies in the food system, our passionate and motivated team of problem solvers helps save an average of 500,000 pounds of food per week from waste or lesser outcomes, with an all-time savings of 190+ million pounds of food. As Misfits we support our customers and mission by embracing our core values of Prioritizing our Customers Doing more with less Thinking Differently Respecting one another Moving deliberately and quickly Taking initiative and delivering About Role The Continuous Improvement Engineer is responsible for driving projects from beginning stages to completion while having a significant impact on business needs. As a CI Engineer, you will be responsible for process improvement initiatives around the business operations in logistics and distribution while maintaining high levels of quality, safety, employee morale, cost, and production at the forefront. You will work closely with the field operations teams to implement solutions, coach, and train the operations leadership team and associates. The CI Engineer will be the data resource of the team and will ensures data driven decisions are made. As we launch new markets and experiment operationally, the CI Engineer ensures we continue to delight our customers and improve our unit economics by collecting, documenting, and instilling best practices across the company. This role will be focused on supporting the Operations team, serving as one of the key team members to launch, improve, and sustain our operational systems. You will be responsible for process design, project management, implementation, and data analysis to sustain your processes. Additionally, this role will play an integral role in aiding in the expansion of our 3PL business vertical, allowing us to be a fulfillment partner to outside companies who look to leverage our operational and reporting capabilities to improve their supply chain operations and customer service. You will be responsible for helping build business processes to allow for future expansion of this critical business venture for the company. Responsibilities Work with cross-functional teams to support the launch of new projects and initiatives across the country, with a specific focus on our West Coast fulfillment operations. Maintain a thorough understanding of our Production and Delivery Operations. Responsible for supporting the team that manages the start-up, validation, and sustainment of our existing and incoming software and systems. Recommend processes, procedures, and modifications to improve production efficiencies, manufacturing techniques and production yields for existing products. Determine appropriate skills necessary for equipment/process operability and establishing training requirements. Develop and coaches current CI Engineers, developing a deep bench of lean-focused teammates. Analyze data, use of basic statistical tools, and use value stream mapping to gain a deeper understanding of processes and identify strategic improvement opportunities. Employ a working knowledge of standard-work to ensure every work activity is properly defined, displayed (point-of-use) and accurately followed by every person to enable safety adherence, consistent quality and productivity being achieved. Use basic Lean Principles to develop process improvement initiatives. Manage a portfolio of lean projects directed at reducing waste and improving quality to provide greater valve; implements such tools as: 5S, KPI, SMED, VSM, and Kaizen. Implement such tools as: SPC, Process Capability, Pareto analysis, Fishbone, SMED. Create documentation for training materials such as checklists, standard work, and standard operating procedures. Communicate plans and other agreements to stakeholders for alignment while listening to feedback and making modifications if appropriate. Be a “leader of change”. Practice “Servant Leadership”. This person must be comfortable working with all levels within the organization. They must be able to question the status quo and be a strong communicator. Strong analytical, planning, organizational, and time management skills. Must maintain satisfactory attendance, to include timeliness and onsite presence at our Fulfillment Centers. Skills & Qualifications Five-to-seven years of hands-on experience in a manufacturing, warehouse and/or delivery operations environment. Bachelor’s degree in industrial engineering, manufacturing engineering, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, project management or equivalent experience. Working knowledge of lean manufacturing principles and practices. Minimum of a Yellow Belt Lean Six Sigma Certification is preferred, and capable of providing examples of the use of Lean tools. Ability to collaborate and work cross-functionally with a variety of teams including Operations, HR, Supply, Innovation, Customer Care, and Marketing. Ability to work both independently and collaboratively, with little supervision and able to work in a changing environment with changing priorities. Demonstrated experience recognizing and identifying root causes for subtle differences in processes and data sets. Ability to Coach and to practice a very strong and disciplined Lean daily management approach at the point of value adding to enable a continual focus on process improvement to eliminate waste. This includes maintaining visual controls that track only the critical metrics, which tell you whether you are eliminating waste from your value-adding activities. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. A self-starter attitude and an ability to attack problems with minimal direction. Strong Experience using Google Suite and Microsoft Office applications, and project management software such as Jira and Confluence. Skilled in the use of MS Excel, MS Word, MS PowerPoint at an Intermediate level. Skilled in learning new concepts quickly. Details Of Position & Benefits Salary range: $85,000 - $90,000 Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance 401(k) Annual Misfits grocery box credit of $1200 paid in weekly installments Life insurance Paid vacation time Paid holidays Paid sick days Commuter benefits Please see here for Misfits Market's Job Applicant Privacy Notice. descripcion: At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One. Job Description The Financial Analyst will support financial planning and analysis activities across the FICC businesses, with primary responsibility for expense forecasting, headcount management, variance analysis, and management reporting. This individual will partner closely with business leaders and centralized finance teams to deliver accurate forecasts, insightful analysis, and executive-ready reporting. The ideal candidate is highly analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities and frequent ad hoc requests. Key Responsibilities Financial Planning & Forecasting Lead monthly expense forecasting and annual planning processes across multiple FICC business lines. Develop and maintain forecasts for compensation, non-compensation expenses, allocations, and headcount. Partner with business managers and finance leaders to identify forecast risks and opportunities. Support budget development and resource allocation initiatives. Financial Analysis Perform monthly variance analysis against forecast, budget, and prior year results. Analyze expense, headcount, and allocation drivers and communicate key trends to stakeholders. Monitor organizational changes and maintain accurate staffing and expense assumptions. Assist in evaluating business initiatives, investments, and organizational changes. Management Reporting Prepare consolidated FICC financial reporting packages for senior management. Develop executive-ready presentations highlighting key business trends, financial performance, and emerging risks. Support recurring monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting requirements. Coordinate reporting deliverables across various FICC businesses to ensure consistency and accuracy. Strategic & Ad Hoc Analysis Respond to ad hoc requests from business leaders and finance executives. Assist with special projects involving financial performance, expense management, organizational planning, and business strategy. Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes, enhance data quality, and increase efficiency through automation and standardization. Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree, or equivalent work experience Typically five or more years of related experience Preferred Skills/Experience Experience in Financial Planning & Analysis, Corporate Finance, Banking Finance, or related analytical roles. Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and analytical skills. Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills. Ability to synthesize complex data into concise, actionable insights. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Experience supporting capital markets, corporate banking, investment banking, trading, or treasury-related businesses. Familiarity with expense forecasting, workforce planning, and management reporting. Experience working with financial reporting systems such as Essbase, Hyperion, Power BI, Tableau, or similar reporting tools. Experience preparing materials for executive and senior leadership audiences. The role offers a hybrid/flexible schedule, which means there's an in-office expectation of 3 or more days per week and the flexibility to work outside the office location for the other days. descripcion: At AlixPartners, we solve the most complex and critical challenges by moving quickly from analysis to action when it really matters; creating value that has a lasting impact on companies, their people, and the communities they serve. By understanding, respecting, and honoring the needs of our employees, clients, and communities, AlixPartners actively promotes an inclusive environment. We strongly believe in the value that diversity brings to our experiences and are committed to the perpetual enhancements of initiatives, policies, and practices. We hold ourselves accountable by providing the space for authenticity, growth, and equity for everyone. AlixPartners has embraced a hybrid work model to provide flexibility and support our employees’ work-life integration. Our hybrid model combines a mix of in-person (at client site or AlixPartners office) and remote working. Travel is part of this position, but the frequency may vary based on client, team, and individual circumstances. What You’ll Do Are you passionate about a future that exceeds your expectations? Here, at AlixPartners your passion becomes your career. We work in smaller and more senior teams that bring deep industry and functional knowledge to our clients. You will sit shoulder-to-shoulder with owners, boards, and CEOs to address the issues that sit at the top of their agendas - and often become front-page news. If you join our practice, you will work with financially secure, under-performing and distressed companies across a variety of urgent, high impact situations. Our elite professionals are recognized experts in their respective fields, bringing to bear their skills and experience to craft measurable, improved outcomes for our clients. In this role, you will have the chance to create ETL workflows, scripts, statistical models, and visualizations while taking responsibility for the design, build, test, execution, and support of the data migration, cleansing, wrangling, etc. The ideal candidate will have a detailed understanding of the underlying data and data structures of multiple systems to allow in depth analysis of existing and potential data insights. We are open to hire different seniority levels, apply to learn more! Within Our Teams, You Could Be Doing Data Modeling Selecting features, building and optimizing classifiers using machine learning techniques Execute machine learning projects using state-of-the-art methods Extending company’s data with third party sources of information when needed Creating automated anomaly detection systems and constant tracking of its performance Data Manipulation Collect data from a wide variety of corporate databases, including various SQL databases -Microsoft, Redshift, Teradata, Oracle, Netezza, etc.-, Access, Excel, plain or formatted text files, OLAP cubes –Microsoft, Oracle-, and no-SQL databases. Parse data out of poorly structured XML and invalid HTML documents Use regular expressions to extract information from un-structured text documents Deal with missing data through multiple-imputation or the use of advanced models Implement automated data ingestion and transformation processes. Data Organization Build effective, reliable, and robust ETL processes that govern the data ingestion flow. Design database models, consistent table structures, and advanced dimensional schemas that carry out data quality and consistency standards. Apply modeling approaches, business intelligence patterns, and data management techniques. Data Analysis Review and analyze legacy code/scripts to understand data processing logic and business rules. Apply statistical learning toolsets to build predictive models that enrich, expand, and allow a deeper understanding of data analyses and solutions. Data Visualization Use interactive data visualization tools, such as Tableau and Power BI to present results in a compelling manner. Tell a convincing story to C-level executives using visual charts and dashboards Present complicated technical findings to a non-technical audience. Business insight Collaborate with clients and stakeholders, building relationships, influencing, and providing advice to key decision-makers. Prepare client-ready documents and compelling presentation materials. What You’ll Need Bachelor’s degree with concentration in Computer Science, Engineering or another quantitative field Data-oriented personality More than 1 year of related experience. Knowledge of any of the following languages: Python, JavaScript, C#, or similar Familiarity with at least one ETL tool (such as Alteryx, KNIME, SSIS, Pentaho, or DataStage). Comfort with big data architectures, both on cloud platforms like AWS/Azure/others and on-premise. SQL skills, such as CTEs and windows functions, to work with extensive amounts of data at various aggregation levels. Ability to apply statistical learning languages to build predictive models that enrich, expand, and allow deeper understanding of data analyses and solutions. Distributed systems knowledge, specially of HDFS and the Hadoop ecosystem. Strong verbal and written communication skills (in English). Proficiency in other languages is a plus. Ability to synthesize the requests received from team members at client sites. Capability to be a creative, innovative problem solver —but using simple ideas Motivated to discover and learn new analytical techniques and software tools to improve the quality of our work Authorized to work in applicable country and travel freely internationally without restrictions or visa sponsorship Desire to actively engage in geographically dispersed teams. Ability and willingness to work long hours and travel if necessary, to meet client demands Ability to work full time in an office and remote environment; physically able to sit/stand at a computer and work in front of a computer screen for significant portions of the workday. This description is not designed to encompass a comprehensive listing of required activities, duties or responsibilities. descripcion: Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together. The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services. The Data Science and Insights team seeks to leverage our massive data sets into actionable insights that deliver business value. As truth seekers and truth tellers, we relay what the data says without bias, even when inconvenient or difficult. We aim to improve decision-making quality and speed across the organization to enable a deeper understanding of our customers and products. We focus on efficient and effective analytic execution, positioning ourselves as the go-to experts with deep knowledge and expertise, constantly striving for better, faster insights from data. We’re looking for a Sr. Data Scientist to join Snap Inc. What you’ll do: Apply your expertise in quantitative analysis, data mining, and statistical modeling to deliver impactful, objective, and actionable data insights that enable informed business and product decisions Drive informed and timely decision-making that improves and optimizes the way our products are created, executed, and adopted' Collaborate with product managers, engineers, product marketers, and designers Think creatively, proactively, and futuristically to identify and size up new opportunities within Snap's long term roadmap for data-scientific contributions Conduct machine learning or statistical analyses, and build pragmatic, scalable, and statistically rigorous solutions to deliver actionable insights, accurate predictions, and effective optimizations Communicate best practices in quantitative analysis and develop cross-functional partnerships Utilize AI tools to more efficiently develop scalable data solutions, while maintaining rigorous standards for accuracy and statistical integrity. Knowledge, Skills and Abilities: Expertise using data modeling skills to identify key product trends and new product opportunities Ability to design implement, and track core metrics to analyze the performance of our products Ability to create visuals, dashboards, and reports to effectively communicate your insights Experience collaborating with engineers, product managers, and other cross-functional teams Ability to initiate and drive projects to completion with minimal guidance An understanding of Snapchat with great product sense and product understanding Ability to communicate complex quantitative analysis in a clear, precise, and actionable manner Adaptability in learning and applying evolving AI systems and tools to remain at the forefront of data-driven decision-making, insights generation, and industry best practices Minimum Qualifications: Bachelor's Degree in a relevant technical field such as statistics, mathematics, economics, computer science, engineering or related field or equivalent years of practical work experience 5+ years of post-Bachelor’s quantitative analysis and data science experience ; or a Master’s degree in a technical field + 4+ years of post-grad quantitative analysis and data science experience; or a PhD in a related technical field + 1+ years of post-grad quantitative analysis and data science experience Preferred Qualifications: 5+ years of experience using SQL or similar big data querying languages 5+ years of experience with programming language, such as Python or R 5+ years of experience with applied statistical techniques, such as inferential methods, causal methods, A/B testing, or statistical modeling techniques Advanced degree in applied mathematics, statistics, actuarial science, economics or related field Experience in a product-focused role at a social media, online advertising, digital media and/or mobile technology company Experience using machine learning and statistical analysis for building data-driven product solutions or performing methodological research. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please don’t be shy and provide us some information. To reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4+ days per week. At Snap, we believe that having a team of diverse backgrounds and voices working together will enable us to create innovative products that improve the way people live and communicate. EOE, including disability/vets. descripcion: General Summary Sony Pictures Entertainment is seeking a hands-on, technically strong AI Automation & Innovation Analyst to join the LATAM Data Analytics & Business Insights team, based in Bogota, Colombia or Buenos Aires, Argentina. Reporting into the Head of Data Analytics, this role will work closely with Analytics and Data Science team members and collaborate with stakeholders across all business lines to identify, design, build, and operationalize applied AI, automation, and data-driven solutions that improve efficiency, innovation, and decision-making. The role requires a practical full-stack profile capable of translating business needs into working prototypes, internal tools, dashboards, automations, and AI-enabled workflows. The analyst will connect front-end interfaces, backend logic, APIs, workflow automation, and AWS-based data warehouse assets to deliver functional end-to-end solutions. This position will work directly with the company’s data ecosystem, including hands-on querying, data preparation, integration, and application development using trusted AWS-based data assets. The analyst will also coordinate with Sony Cloud Operations, DevOps, Information Security, and technology governance teams to support deployment readiness, infrastructure alignment, access controls, documentation, security reviews, and compliance with internal technology standards. The ideal candidate combines strong technical execution, business curiosity, agility, and a practical innovation mindset. This is an individual contributor role. Responsibilities AI-Enabled Automation & Efficiency Develop and implement automation solutions that streamline repetitive, manual, or time-consuming business processes. Build AI-enabled workflows using Python, APIs, workflow automation tools, approved generative AI capabilities, and cloud-based data assets to improve productivity, speed, consistency, and decision-making. Full-Stack Solution Development Design and build end-to-end solutions, including data ingestion, backend logic, APIs, user interfaces, dashboards, lightweight web applications, internal tools, and deployment-ready prototypes. AWS Data Warehouse & Data Integration Work hands-on with the company’s AWS-based data warehouse to query, transform, integrate, and prepare data for AI, automation, and business-facing solutions. Develop reusable SQL queries, data extracts, backend logic, and data workflows that connect internal data sources with applications, dashboards, automations, and AI tools. Analytics & Data Science Collaboration Partner with Analytics and Data Science teams to understand analytical assets, predictive models, business logic, reporting products, and strategic priorities. Support the integration of analytics and model outputs into tools, workflows, dashboards, and AI-enabled solutions. Cloud, DevOps & Information Security Coordination Coordinate with Sony Cloud Operations, DevOps, Information Security, and technology governance teams to support the approval, deployment, and operationalization of AI and automation solutions. Prepare technical documentation, solution diagrams, access requirements, data flow descriptions, and deployment information for internal reviews. Applied AI Innovation Identify and apply practical AI techniques to solve concrete business problems, with emphasis on usability, speed, and measurable business value. Experiment with emerging AI capabilities, including generative AI, natural language interfaces, document intelligence, semantic search, summarization, classification, recommendation support, and AI-assisted content workflows. Stay connected with external vendors, technology partners, startups, and innovation ecosystems to bring relevant AI, automation, and emerging technology advancements into Sony, helping identify opportunities for pilots, proof-of-concepts, and scalable business applications. Agile Delivery & Documentation Develop quick prototypes, pilots, and modular solutions that can be tested, refined, approved, and scaled. Document solutions, workflows, assumptions, dependencies, technical requirements, and governance considerations to support adoption, maintenance, and scalability. Qualifications Education & Languages Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Statistics, Business Analytics, or a related quantitative or technical field. Fluent Spanish and English required; Portuguese is a plus. Experience 2 to 4 years of professional experience in full-stack development, analytics engineering, data automation, AI solution development, data engineering, business intelligence engineering, or related technical roles. Full-Stack Development Experience building practical end-to-end solutions involving user interfaces, backend logic, databases, APIs, workflow orchestration, and deployment-ready prototypes. The role does not require enterprise software engineering ownership but does require the ability to build functional, reliable tools that business users can test and adopt. Experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, Flask, FastAPI, Streamlit, Dash, or similar frameworks is a strong plus. Applied AI & Automation Working knowledge of generative AI tools, large language models, prompt engineering, document automation, semantic search, embeddings, vector search, RAG architectures, chatbot development, or AI-assisted workflow design. APIs, Pipelines & Integrations Experience with APIs, data pipelines, data integration, system connectivity, workflow automation, data quality checks, and scalable analytical workflows. Familiarity with Airflow, AWS Step Functions, Prefect, Dagster, or similar orchestration tools is a plus. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Strong documentation skills, with a keen eye for detail and organization. descripcion: Job Summary The Director of Supply Chain plays a critical role in leading the strategic direction and building consistent tools and processes for the supply chain function. This strategic leadership position requires a seasoned professional with extensive experience in the S&OP process, demand forecasting, procurement excellence, inventory optimization, and transformational systems initiatives. This leader ensures cross-functional alignment between commercial, operations, and finance teams to enable efficient supply chain planning and execution. The role also includes building high-performing teams, developing robust systems and tools, and instilling a culture of continuous improvement and accountability. Responsibilities Supply Chain Strategy & S&OP: Develop and implement comprehensive supply chain strategies for procurement, inventory management, warehousing, transportation, and logistics. Establish KPIs and dashboards to track performance and identify areas for improvement. Lead the monthly S&OP process to ensure alignment between demand, supply, inventory, and financial goals. Facilitate integrated planning across sales, operations, finance, and supply teams to optimize service levels (OTIF) and working capital. Forecasting & Demand Planning Collaborate with commercial, operations, and finance teams to develop accurate, data-driven demand forecasts and sales projections. Utilize forecasting tools and data analytics to optimize inventory levels, minimize stockouts, meet customer demand, and improve free cash flow. Utilize statistical models, historical data, and market intelligence to improve forecast accuracy and responsiveness. Procurement Manage procurement of metal and other direct materials. Collaborate with global metal procurement teams to optimize the procurement process. Establish and maintain strategic partnerships with key suppliers and vendors. Gain visibility into supplies and inventory to ensure efficient operations. Inventory Optimization: Develop and implement inventory management strategies to optimize inventory levels while balancing service levels, carrying costs, and cash flow, and mitigating stockouts. Implement inventory planning techniques such as safety stock, reorder points, and replenishment strategies. Implement inventory visibility tools and strategies to reduce obsolescence and working capital. Logistics And Distribution Support transportation, warehousing, and distribution operations to ensure timely and cost-effective product delivery to customers. Risk Management Identify supply chain risks and develop mitigation strategies to minimize disruptions. Proactively manage risks related to supplier relationships, geopolitical factors, natural disasters, and other external threats. System Transformation And Tools Evaluate, implement, and leverage technology solutions such as planning and supply chain management software, ERP systems, and data analytics tools to enhance supply chain visibility, agility, and efficiency. Champion digital tools, dashboards, and analytics that support data-driven decision-making. Data Analysis And Insights Utilize analytical tools and techniques to extract actionable insights from data, driving continuous improvement in forecasting accuracy, demand planning, inventory management, and resource allocation. Build scenario modeling and risk assessments to identify potential issues and develop mitigation strategies. Leverage AI technologies where applicable to enhance predictive analytics capabilities. Organizational Development & Continuous Improvement Build and develop a high-performing supply chain team with clear roles, responsibilities, and career paths. Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and results orientation. Drive a culture of continuous improvement within the supply chain function, proactively identifying opportunities to optimize processes, enhance capabilities, and drive operational excellence. Stay abreast of industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies related to supply chain and AI. Participate in or lead global supply chain improvement projects Qualifications 8+ years of progressive experience in supply chain management or a related field, with at least five years in leadership. Experience in a manufacturing environment preferred. Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Supply Chain Management, Operations Research, or related field. Master's degree preferred. Proven track record of successfully leading and managing a team to achieve supply chain objectives. Proactive, results-oriented, and self-motivated. Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills. Ability to lead and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights and strategies. Proficiency in supply chain management software and tools. Strong understanding of AI technologies and their applications in supply chain planning (e.g., demand forecasting, machine learning, predictive analytics, optimization algorithms, etc.). Certification in supply chain management (e.g., APICS, CSCP) is a plus. descripcion: At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. This role is at Spirit AeroSystems, Inc. a wholly owned subsidiary of The Boeing Company, supporting Spirit’s Commercial Business Units (“Spirit Commercial”). Spirit Commercial designs and builds commercial aerostructures, including for Boeing Commercial Airplanes, one of Boeing’s three business units and the premier manufacturer of commercial jetliners for decades. Spirit Commercial’s core products include fuselages, pylons, nacelles and wing components, with a focus on innovative composite and aluminum manufacturing solutions. About the Team: The Purchasing Team is responsible for procuring metallic and non-metallic parts that support Boeing’s manufacturing operations. The team manages supplier contracts and agreements with global suppliers and supports key stages of the purchased component lifecycle, including requirements identification, sourcing, order placement, and receipt/delivery. Procurement Agents work closely with internal teams and suppliers to help ensure materials are available to support production needs. Location: Wichita, Kansas (Onsite) This position may be filled at Procurement Levels 2, 3, or 4 level based on the selected candidate's qualifications, experience, and demonstrated capabilities. Level 2: 2+ years of related procurement, supply chain, sourcing, purchasing, or manufacturing experience. Level 3: 5+ years of related professional experience with increased responsibility in sourcing, supplier management, negotiations, and supply chain execution. Level 4: 9+ years of related professional experience with advanced expertise in procurement strategy, supplier relationship management, contract negotiations, and cross-functional leadership. Position Responsibilities: Manage supplier relationships to ensure quality materials and services are delivered on time and support production requirements. Lead sourcing activities including RFQs, supplier evaluations, negotiations, contract awards, and ongoing supplier management. Serve as an authorized representative of the company for procurement transactions, contracts, and purchase orders. Monitor inventory levels, supplier performance, and material demand to support supply chain continuity. Partner with internal stakeholders and suppliers to identify opportunities for improved efficiency, cost savings, and risk mitigation. Analyze supply chain data and planning requirements to optimize material availability and support business objectives. Collaborate across Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, and other functional teams to drive operational success. Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience): 2+ years of procurement, supply chain, sourcing, purchasing, or related experience, preferably within aerospace, manufacturing, or raw materials environments. Strong communication and relationship-building skills with the ability to work effectively across all levels of an organization. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, programs, parts, and supplier-related activities in a fast-paced environment. Strong analytical and data-driven mindset with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and support business decisions. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including filters, pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, and data analysis. Experience working with ERP/MRP systems, preferably SAP, and managing large datasets. Experience influencing stakeholders and driving positive business outcomes through collaboration and problem-solving. Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience): Level 3: 5+ years of related work experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience Level 4: 9+ years of related work experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience. Experience supporting manufacturing, aerospace, or raw materials procurement operations. Project management experience, including managing cross-functional initiatives and supplier-driven projects. Experience with process improvement, cost reduction, or supply chain optimization initiatives. Knowledge of manufacturing materials, production planning, and supply chain best practices.
