descripcion: Join the Clean Energy Revolution Become a Supply Chain Inventory Management Senior Specialist at Southern California Edison (SCE) and build a better tomorrow. In this job, you’ll execute and maintain the operational duties within the supply chain. You will primarily operate in the company’s system(s) of record, possessing advanced in-depth knowledge of SAP/EWM, Ariba, SharePoint, Samsara, Web EOC, Microsoft Excel, etc. The Senior Specialist supports the overseeing of Vendor/inventory performance, identifying risk to the supply chain, maintaining accurate supply forecast. The Senior Specialist will also support program components that affect warehouse performance, business processes, and metrics to maximize value from Supply Chain managed inventory. Possesses strong analytical skills, customer service, and understands the end-to-end Supply Chain process including Inventory Management, Warehousing and Transportation. In addition, has knowledge of warehouse KPI’s, knowledge of supply chain site capacity, planning, and multi-level MRP/ERP logic. As a Supply Chain Inventory Management Senior Specialist , your work will help power our planet, reduce carbon emissions and create cleaner air for everyone. Are you ready to take on the challenge to help us build the future? Responsibilities Monitors and reports on supply chain project requirements, including material supply, transportation, and discrepancies, and field laydown yards, to support operational performance and decision-making. Collaborates with key supply chain and procurement stakeholders to support material planning and prioritization activities, working closely with teams to source and expedite critical materials. Maintains data integrity and reporting for key metrics (e.g., materials movement and handling time/efficiency, loss reporting, stock levels, and safety incident performance) to track operational performance and evaluate potential risks. Conducts root cause analysis of performance issues and proposes initiatives to optimize operational activities, driving continuous improvement and cost savings. Provides strategic recommendations and reports to management throughout the supply chain and procurement teams to support informed decision-making and align with organizational goals. Leverages expertise in data and cost analysis to monitor and track the performance of operations, identify trends, opportunities, and risks, and develop actionable insights to drive operational excellence. Works directly with various suppliers at tactical levels to maintain effective supplier relationships, fostering open communication, collaboration, and mutual success. Identifies and implements supplier performance goals related leveraging data-driven insights to drive improvements. A material job duty of all positions within the Company is ensuring the protection of all its physical, financial and cybersecurity assets, and properly accessing and managing private customer data, proprietary information, confidential medical records, and other types of highly sensitive information and data with the highest standards of conduct and integrity. Minimum Qualifications Five or more years of experience in supply chain sourcing, supplier relationship management, and process optimization. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Production & Inventory Control, Business, or a related field. Five or more years of experience in supply chain, inventory management, or a related analytical role. Experience managing inventory performance, including forecasting, demand variability analysis, and identification of supply chain risks. Demonstrated experience developing and recommending inventory stocking strategies (e.g., safety stock, min/max levels, service levels). Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (e.g., formulas, pivot tables, lookups) to develop data-driven analyses, reporting, and presentations. Experience working with SAP, EWM, or similar ERP systems to manage inventory, materials, and supply chain transactions. Experience managing and maintaining MRP (Material Requirements Planning) parameters, including safety stock, reorder points, lot sizing, and lead times. Demonstrated experience analyzing demand signals and operational requirements to optimize MRP settings and ensure material availability. Experience partnering with cross-functional teams (e.g., field operations, planning, procurement) to translate business needs into system configurations and process improvements. Experience in utility, manufacturing, or similarly complex supply chain environments. Demonstrated experience mining, consolidating, and analyzing data from multiple sources to support decision-making. Experience managing multiple assignments and priorities in a fast-paced environment, with strong organizational and problem-solving skills. Demonstrated experience working on cross-functional projects and applying structured problem-solving or project management methodologies. Additional Information This position’s work mode is on-site. The employee will report to an SCE facility or in the field location. Further details of this work mode will be discussed at the interview stage. The work mode can be changed based on business needs. As a Senior Data Scientist within Star Ratings Analytics (UHC Medicare & Retirement), you will help maintain and reimagine the foundational metrics and analytics behind the Key Measures Model (KMM) and related products. This includes making them more actionable, transparent, accurate, and flexible, while incorporating new methodologies, partnerships, and technologies. descripcion: Job Description We are building a portfolio of agentic operations — production-grade AI agents that plan, act, and continuously improve the everyday experiences of our employees. The mission is to eliminate friction from the moments that matter employees spend more time on work that matters and less time on tickets, forms, and queues. As Senior Lead Software Engineer, AI Engineering, you will be a hands-on senior individual contributor on this team, reporting to the Executive Director who owns the agentic platform and flagship agents. You will be the technical anchor of one or more agent squads: designing the agent, writing the code, running the evaluation harness, integrating with enterprise tools (ServiceNow, Databricks, identity, endpoint), and taking the pager when it ships. You will pair with engineers, review PRs, drive design docs, mentor the squad, and be personally accountable for the correctness, safety, cost, and business impact of the agents you build. Job Responsibilities Design and build agents Own the end-to-end design of production agents: planner, tools, memory, retrieval (RAG / GraphRAG), guardrails, human-in-the-loop, evaluators. Implement using the team's Model Context Protocol (MCP) stack — write MCP servers/clients, define tool schemas, negotiate capabilities, and integrate securely with enterprise systems. Choose the right orchestration pattern (single-agent, planner-executor, supervisor-worker, debate/critique) for each use case; reject unnecessary complexity. Evaluation, safety, and quality Build and maintain the evaluation harness for your agents: gold sets, offline benchmarks, LLM-as-judge with human calibration, online A/B, regression gates in CI/CD. Instrument every agent with business KPIs (deflection rate, time-to-resolve, CSAT, cost per interaction) and quality KPIs (task success, groundedness, refusal correctness, safety incidents). Partner with cyber, privacy, and model risk to make guardrails concrete: PII handling, prompt-injection & jailbreak defense, tool-use hygiene, secret handling, prompt/model version pinning. Production reliability (SRE for agents) Own SLOs and error budgets for your agents; write runbooks; take part in the on-call rotation. Build canaries, circuit breakers, deterministic replay, and rollback paths for prompts, models, and tools. Diagnose and fix production issues end-to-end — from token spend anomalies to tool call failures to hallucination regressions. Platform contribution Contribute to the shared agentic platform (orchestration, model gateway, vector/knowledge stores, telemetry, eval harness) — not just consume it. Push improvements upstream so other squads benefit. Write design docs, patterns, and internal blog posts. Represent the team in architecture reviews. Technical leadership without being a manager Set the technical bar in your squad through code reviews, pairing, and design reviews. Mentor mid-level and junior engineers; grow the next generation of AI engineers. Interview candidates and help sustain a strong hiring bar. Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills 8+ years of software engineering experience, with 2+ years shipping production LLM- or agent-based systems to real users (not just prototypes or notebooks). Deep hands-on expertise in Python (primary) and comfort with at least one other modern language (TypeScript / Java / Go). Practical, current experience with the agentic stack: LLM orchestration (e.g. LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, custom), tool/function calling, RAG, evaluation harnesses, guardrails, prompt & model versioning, model gateways. Hands-on with Model Context Protocol (MCP) architectures — designing servers/clients, tool schemas, capability negotiation, and secure enterprise deployment patterns. Track record of building and running production-grade backend / distributed systems (APIs, queues, workers, observability, on-call). Strong grounding in data platforms (Databricks / Snowflake / lakehouse patterns) and modern MLOps/LLMOps (CI/CD, feature/prompt/model registry, telemetry). Practical experience with responsible AI, security, and controls for enterprise deployments: PII handling, red-teaming, prompt-injection defense, secret & tool-use hygiene. Clear technical communication: you can write a crisp design doc, review a PR with substance, and explain a trade-off to a non-technical stakeholder. Bachelor's in Computer Science or related discipline, or equivalent industry experience. Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills Experience building employee-facing / workforce productivity products at scale (IT service desk, HR tech, knowledge management, workplace assistants). Experience integrating with ServiceNow, identity providers, endpoint management, and enterprise search. Experience with multi-agent patterns (planner-executor, supervisor-worker, debate/critique) and long-horizon workflows. Contributions to open source (especially in the MCP / agent / eval ecosystem), published research, patents, or public talks in AI / agents / SRE. Prior experience in a highly regulated environment (financial services, healthcare, public sector) with model risk management (SR 11-7 or equivalent). Master's or PhD in a quantitative discipline. descripcion: The Operations Manager will oversee the daily operations of our San Antonio HVAC service, maintenance, and installation departments. This role is responsible for improving operational efficiency, supporting department leaders, driving revenue and profitability, maintaining customer satisfaction, and ensuring technicians and office staff have the tools and leadership needed to succeed. The Operations Manager will work closely with the Senior Operations Leader and leadership team to manage workflow, staffing, scheduling, technician performance, customer experience, and overall departmental execution across residential and commercial HVAC operations. Essential Duties and Responsibilities The essential functions include, but are not limited to, the following: Operational Leadership Oversee daily operations of the HVAC service, maintenance, install teams and support the dispatch department. Ensure efficient scheduling and workflow management to maximize technician productivity. Monitor labor utilization, job profitability, callbacks, and operational KPIs. Develop and improve operational processes, procedures, and department standards. Assist with staffing plans, workload balancing, and seasonal operational strategies. Support after-hours and on-call operations when necessary. Financial & Performance Oversight Monitor department revenue, gross profit, labor percentages, and efficiency metrics. Help establish and maintain pricing standards and operational budgets. Review job costing, overtime usage, warranty expenses, and inventory controls. Identify opportunities to improve profitability and reduce operational waste. Assist leadership with forecasting and growth planning. Customer Experience Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction and service quality. Assist with resolving escalated customer concerns professionally and promptly. Support company initiatives related to online reputation, reviews, and customer retention. Ensure teams maintain company standards for communication, appearance, and workmanship. Systems & Technology Utilize ServiceTitan and other operational software to manage reporting, scheduling, and performance tracking. Monitor dashboards and KPIs including: average ticket, revenue per technician, callback percentage, maintenance conversion rates, install close rates, membership growth, and labor efficiency. Assist with implementation and optimization of operational technology and processes. Supervisor Responsibilities of this Role Oversees field and office personnel across the service, maintenance, install, and dispatch departments. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with organization policies and applicable laws. Directly responsible for the teams in the respective area. Responsibilities include hiring, onboarding, training, and technician development; planning, assigning, and directing work; conducting performance reviews and accountability meetings; rewarding and disciplining employees; setting expectations/goals and employee development; addressing complaints and resolving problems. Fosters a positive team culture focused on professionalism, accountability, and growth. Works with department managers to improve communication and teamwork. Provides ongoing coaching and leadership to help field and office personnel succeed. Success Factors and Performance Indicators The Operations Manager's success will be measured by many factors pertaining to the job, including, but not limited to: Operational Leadership: Ability to drive efficiency and results across multiple departments. Financial Acumen: Understanding of job costing, profitability, and budget management. Team Development: Ability to coach, train, and hold staff accountable. Process Improvement: Champion the belief and adherence to procedures and processes. Problem Solving: Analysis and resolution at both strategic and tactical levels. Commitment to Company Values. They will have responsibility for hitting the following KPIs set by the General Manager Revenue per Technician Callback Percentage Labor Efficiency Average Ticket Maintenance Conversion Rate Install Close Rate Membership Growth Job Profitability / Gross Margin Minimum Qualifications High School Diploma/GED required; Bachelor's degree in Business, Construction Management, or related field preferred Minimum of 7 years of experience in HVAC or field-service operations, including supervisory or management experience Strong understanding of P&L management, job costing, and operational KPIs Proficiency with ServiceTitan or similar field-service management software Current HVAC Technician and EPA licenses Excellent leadership, coaching, and team-building skills Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret operational data Ability to communicate clearly and effectively with technicians, office staff, and leadership Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment Physical Demands and Work Environment Physical Demands: Primarily an office- and field-based role; ability to travel to job sites, branches, and customer locations as needed Ability to sit or stand for extended periods while working at a computer or in meetings Occasional lifting of up to 25 pounds Ability to work more than 40 hours per work week, including some evenings and weekends, as needed May occasionally be exposed to job site conditions when visiting technicians in the field Working Environment: Work is primarily performed in an office setting, with regular visits to job sites, warehouses, and customer locations. Employees may occasionally be exposed to noise, dust, and varying weather conditions while visiting field locations. Note This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee(s) incumbent in this position. Employees will be required to follow any other job-related instructions and to perform any other job-related duties requested by any person authorized to give instructions or assignments. All duties and responsibilities are essential functions and requirements and are subject to possible modification to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities. To perform this job successfully, the incumbents will possess the skills, aptitudes, and abilities to perform each duty proficiently. Some requirements may exclude individuals who pose a direct threat or significant risk to the health or safety of themselves or others. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Job Description We are looking for a highly experienced Senior Software Developer with deep expertise in Python and a strong background in both computer networking, DevOps, and message brokers. This role is for a hands-on engineer who can bridge the gap between software development, network engineering, and operational excellence. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying mission- critical applications that are not only secure and reliable but also scalable and easily maintainable in production. Your Mission Build & Scale: Design and develop scalable backend services and microservices for cloud and IoT-scale systems on a Cloud Platform. APIs & Event-Driven Systems: Build REST/gRPC APIs and pub/sub architectures using message brokers such as MQTT, Kafka, RabbitMQ, and Pub/Sub. IoT & Messaging: Enable secure device-to-cloud and service-to-service communication using MQTT, IoT concepts, and event-driven patterns. Automate & Deploy: Build and operate automated CI/CD pipelines and cloud-native deployments using Docker and Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE). Network & Debug: Apply deep knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, and Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) networking; troubleshoot complex issues using tools like Wireshark. Data & Security: Design efficient SQL/NoSQL data models and implement security best practices using IAM, Cloud KMS, and Secret Manager. Collaborate & Lead: Partner with network and security teams, mentor engineers, conduct code reviews, and uphold engineering best practices. Qualifications Proven Expertise: 5+ years of software development experience with a strong focus on modern backend development languages (e.g., Python, Go, Java, C++, or Node.js) and enterprise frameworks. Event-Driven Systems: Hands-on experience designing and operating event-driven architectures using message brokers and pub/sub systems (MQTT required; Kafka, RabbitMQ, or Google Pub/Sub a plus). GCP & Cloud Networking: Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or other major cloud providers (AWS/Azure), including core services like VPCs, subnets, Cloud Load Balancing, and Cloud Firewalls. DevOps Mindset: Strong hands-on experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions. Containerization: Proficiency with Docker and Kubernetes (GKE preferred), including deployment, scaling, and configuration management. Data Driven: Experience with both SQL and NoSQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or GCP Cloud SQL/Datastore), with an understanding of performance and reliability trade-offs. API Alchemist: Solid background in API design (REST/gRPC) and integrating distributed systems using synchronous and asynchronous patterns. Problem Solver: Exceptional debugging skills across application, messaging, network, and infrastructure layers. Leadership & Communication: Excellent communication skills with demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring, and code review experience. Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience preferred. Bonus Points Previous experience building and managing high-scale distributed systems. Experience building IoT platforms or large-scale device telemetry and command/control systems. Hands-on experience with GCP-native services such as Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, GKE, IAM, Cloud Monitoring/Logging. Experience with network automation tools such as Ansible, Netmiko, or Nornir. Knowledge of edge computing, SDN, or distributed messaging at scale. Experience with observability and monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch). Prior experience building and operating high-scale, distributed, event-driven systems. descripcion: Hey there! We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment. Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment. Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences. Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right? To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment! Ready to be part of the experience? Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission. About The Role What are we looking for: We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer (PHP) who loves solving complex problems, designing resilient systems, and building reliable services that handle real traffic at scale. If you thrive in distributed environments, care deeply about code quality, and enjoy working with event-driven architectures, you’ll feel right at home at Fever. You will work on the backend systems that power large-scale experiences, payments, reconciliation processes and high-traffic flows used by millions of users worldwide 🌍. What would you do at Fever? On your first month in Fever: Get fully onboarded into Fever’s engineering culture, our architecture, and our technical stack (PHP 8, microservices, Docker, AWS, CI/CD). Work closely with your team in plannings, groomings and retrospectives. Make your first contributions to production systems with several PRs merged. Understand and interact with core services: authentication, payments, reconciliation, operational tools. Attend one of Fever’s experiences like Candlelight ✨. After 3 months in Fever: Design and implement backend solutions end-to-end: from architecture to production-ready code. Develop and maintain high-performance PHP services and APIs following OpenAPI/Swagger contracts. Contribute to cross-team projects, architecture discussions and internal engineering initiatives. Own monitoring, performance, reliability and observability of the modules you work on (logs, metrics, tracing). Collaborate with infra, product, frontend and backend teams in a highly dynamic environment. On your 6th month in Fever: Own and evolve critical parts of Fever’s distributed system architecture. Lead the design and implementation of a new microservice from scratch to production. Drive improvements in scalability, resiliency, performance and code quality. Mentor teammates through code reviews, technical design sessions and pair programming. Join team buildings and engineering-wide activities. About You Your responsibilities: Design, build and maintain backend APIs and services for critical business domains (payments, reconciliation, fiscal automation, logistics). Work on high-concurrency systems focusing on stability, resiliency, and traceability. Integrate external services with complex and mission-critical logic. Participate actively in architectural decisions to ensure scalability and maintainability. Implement and improve CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and deployment workflows. Use Docker for local and production environments, and AWS services (SQS, Lambdas, CloudWatch, SNS, S3…) for distributed infrastructure. Promote engineering excellence through clean code, testing and continuous improvement. Collaborate in an agile, cross-functional squad with backend, infra, QA and product. Must have skills: Robust experience building backend systems, especially using PHP 8+. Solid experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs at scale. Deep understanding of MySQL and PostgreSQL. Strong knowledge of microservices, distributed systems, concurrency and event-driven architectures. Experience with Docker, CI/CD pipelines and delivering software from dev to production. Good technical judgment: you know when to iterate fast and when to reinforce stability. Experience with testing and code quality tools (PHPUnit, PHPStan, SonarCloud). Excellent command of Git and collaborative development. Professional proficiency in English. It would be a plus if you have experience in: Experience with AWS infrastructure (SQS, Lambdas, CloudWatch, ECS/EKS). Experience with Redis, caching strategies and message queues like Kafka or RabbitMQ. Familiarity with frameworks such as Symfony, Laravel or Slim. Observability tools (Datadog or similar). Experience handling services with 1,000+ requests/second. Background integrating critical external APIs (payments, financial systems). Experience working in agile, cross-functional international teams. Curiosity, creativity and a proactive mindset. Benefits & Perks Full-time employment (“Relación de dependencia”). Competitive compensation. OSDE 410. English lessons. WelHub Membership. 40% discount on all Fever experiences. Remote-friendly work from anywhere in Argentina. Responsibility and impact from day one. A fast-growing global environment with international teammates. Team buildings and internal events. About The Process Fever aims to provide a fast and transparent experience to our candidates: Talent Interview (1h) – Intro to Fever, culture and your background. Technical Assignment (3 days) – Your opportunity to showcase your skills. Team Interview (2h) – Review of the technical challenge and deeper discussions. Engineering Manager Interview (1h) – Final deep dive into technical decision-making and role expectations. Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you! descripcion: Postúlate en Kit Empleo: kitempleo.com.ar/empleo/vwtl3 JOB DESCRIPTION Push the limits of what's possible with us as an experienced member of our Software Engineering team. As an Experienced Software Engineer at JPMorgan Chase within the Global Technology team, you serve as member of an agile team to design and deliver trusted market-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. Depending on the team that you join, you could be developing mobile features that give our customers and clients more control over how they bank with us, strategizing on how big data can make our trading systems quicker, creating the next innovation in payments for merchants, or supporting the integration of our private and public cloud platforms. Job Responsibilities - Participates in, design and develop scalable and resilient systems using Java or Python to contribute to continual, iterative improvements for product teams - Executes software solutions, design, development, and technical troubleshooting - Creates secure and high-quality production code and maintains algorithms that run synchronously with appropriate systems - Produces or contributes to architecture and design artifacts for applications while ensuring design constraints are met by software code development - Gathers, analyzes, synthesizes, and develops visualizations and reporting from large, diverse data sets in service of continuous improvement of software applications and systems - Identifies hidden problems and patterns in data and uses these insights to drive improvements to coding hygiene and system architecture - Contributes to software engineering communities of practice and events that explore new and emerging technologies - Adds to team culture of diversity, equity, inclusion, and respect Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills - Hands-on practical experience in system design, application development, testing and operational stability - Proficient in coding in one or more languages, such as, Java, Java Script, React.js, Spring and Spring Boot - Experience in developing, debugging, and maintaining code in a large corporate environment with one or more modern programming languages and database querying languages - Overall knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle - Understanding of agile methodologies such as CI/CD, Application Resiliency, and Security - Knowledge of software applications and technical processes within a technical discipline (e.g., cloud, artificial intelligence, machine learning, mobile, etc.) Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills - Familiarity with modern front-end technologies - Exposure to cloud technologies Your Role Level JPMorgan Chase is looking to hire Software Engineers at Software Engineer II and Software Engineer III levels. A determination will be made on placement for successful candidates based on the results of a skills-based assessment which applicants will be asked to complete during the hiring process, as well as, the candidate interview. The assessment will evaluate ability to perform basic coding and systems design responsibilities. For the Software Engineer II level, the role requires the ability to understand advance features of a coding language, design a viable system, and solve functional problems through basic language applications. For the Software Engineer III level, the role requires a higher level of proficiency and the ability to function independently, including the ability to use and explain advance features of a coding language, design systems across technologies and platforms, solve functional and non-functional problems through an application of language best practices, as well as, the ability to assess issues broadly, identify alternative or innovative solutions, collaborate effectively, and provide guidance to others. We provide a competitive compensation package that recognizes your experience, credentials, and education alongside a robust benefits program to meet your needs. Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets. Who We Are Since 1954, Cupertino Electric, Inc. (CEI) has been powered by people who’ve built a reputation for delivering high-profile, complex projects. Real, tangible things that alter the landscape and improve lives. And we've done it with integrity for more than 70 years. We’re problem solvers and innovation seekers. We’re team players and safety fanatics. And we're proud to be part of Quanta Services (PWR:NYSE), North America's largest employer of skilled craft labor. Because what we do is important, but how we do it is everything. THE PURCHASING TEAM Cupertino Electric’s Purchasing Team manages all equipment and materials purchases for both job sites and corporate expenditures. This includes vetting vendors and establishing and maintaining relationships with new and loyal suppliers. About The Role We are seeking a highly experienced Sr Purchasing Agent. This person will handle the entire procurement cycle of materials, rentals, consumables, and sub-contracts. This includes sourcing, planning, purchasing, delivering, and returning materials for project needs. As part of the purchasing team, the person will research, examine, and evaluate supply sources and material acquisitions per government FAR & DOD regulations. The person will work closely with core Project teams to manage high visibility and high-value programs. They will apply purchasing skills to ensure timely and efficient execution of Cupertino's projects. Process requisitions and issuing purchase orders in a timely manner. Develop and manage internal customers’ relationships. Negotiate pricing with suppliers for assigned purchases. Establish positive relationship with suppliers. Maintain a Purchasing Status Report. Follow established procedures and processes to manage job assignments. Partner with Project Engineers, General supervisors, and Superintendents. Develop a list of tools, consumables, and supplies needed to construct the job. Be an effective member of project team to influence purchasing selections. Provide weekly status reports/updates to management. Identify and drive cost reduction opportunities. About You You possess technical competency in construction equipment and have a good understanding of the dynamics of the industry. You bring a wide range of skills including excellent project management, facilitation, and communication skills. You have experience exercising good business judgment and are confident in tapping into your analytical thinking skills. Technical proficiency in construction equipment preferred. Autonomous, exceptional communication and organizational skills. Intermediate MS Word & Excel Flexibility with changing priorities and multi-tasking. Knows industry dynamics. Chief critical ability and business judgment. Exceptional facilitation, teamwork, project management skills. Reactive and highly motivated, energetic and results oriented. Proven written and verbal communication skills. What You Will Gain You will gain exposure to all the moving parts of Cupertino Electric’s procurement process. In this role, you will be in an environment that allows you to develop strategies and skills to excel in negotiation, communication, and complex problem-solving. As a valued and essential partner to many of our teams, you will develop cross-functional relationships across the organization. Minimum Qualifications Any combination of education and experience that, in the sole judgment and discretion of Company, would likely provide the required knowledge, skills and abilities as well as possession of any required licenses or certifications may qualify. Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent industry experience preferred. Licensure/Certifications: CPSM Desired Experience: Five (5) to Ten (10) years of increasing procurement experience related to purchasing electrical material. Must have working knowledge and proven experience directly related to FAR acquisition policies and procedures. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. This position is not eligible for sponsorship. PLEASE NOTE: CEI will never ask for any money or financial information from applicants during the hiring process. As a Quality Professional for Latin America, you will serve as the regional focal point for Quality and EHS activities within the Transformer Order Execution organization. You will work closely with Project Managers, EHS specialists, factories, suppliers, and other stakeholders to support the implementation and follow-up of EQS requirements across active projects in the region. Your responsibilities will include non-conformity management, facilitation of root cause analyses, follow‑up of corrective actions, sharing lessons learned, monitoring customer satisfaction indicators, and acting as a key link between projects and the regional organization. This is a hands‑on position that combines operational execution within one of the LATAM subregions, regional coordination, and reporting responsibilities. Beyond consolidating information, you will drive action follow‑up, support continuous improvement initiatives, and provide visibility of EQS performance within the Executive Unit. Working closely with the Quality team, you will help ensure consistent processes, reliable reporting, effective governance, and continuous improvement across the region. The role is focused on coordination, follow‑up, monitoring, and reporting of regional EHS requirements and actions. How You’ll Make An Impact - Act as the regional focal point for Quality activities across LATAM, serving as a liaison between projects, management, and the different functions involved to ensure consistent management practices across the region. - Execute and support daily Quality activities, including follow‑up of Non‑Conformities (NC/NCC), corrective actions, root cause analyses, lessons learned, performance reporting, and the facilitation of problem‑solving activities. - Coordinate and consolidate regional Quality indicators, customer satisfaction metrics (NPS), action plans, and lessons learned, ensuring data accuracy, visibility, timely reporting, and escalation of overdue actions when required. - Support management through trend analysis, risk identification, and recommendations that drive continuous improvement, process enhancement, and operational excellence initiatives. - Support the planning and execution of internal audits based on the Integrated Management System, reporting findings to ensure compliance. - Consolidate and monitor regional EHS indicators, requirements, and action plans, coordinating project teams, EHS specialists, and external service providers to ensure appropriate follow‑up, visibility of EHS performance, and escalation of relevant risks across LATAM. titulo: Last Mile Supply Chain Manager, Last Mile Demand Forecasting
descripcion: Description Join Amazon Logistics as a Supply Chain Manager and help plan the capacity that keeps millions of packages moving to customers across North America. You'll take demand forecasts and turn them into capacity plans that make sure we have the right resources in the right places at the right time. In this role, you'll work with planning teams across Retail to solve real supply chain challenges. Your forecasts and capacity adjustments will directly impact our ability to deliver on our customer promise. You'll own demand forecasting for a rapidly growing logistics network, working across multiple teams to optimize how our network performs. Using advanced forecasting tools and systems, you'll make data-driven decisions at scale and shape the future of last-mile delivery through smart planning and continuous improvement. The impact you'll make is significant. You'll turn demand signals into capacity plans that balance efficiency with customer experience, mitigate capacity constraints before they impact delivery performance, and partner with technical teams to improve forecasting accuracy and planning systems. Your work will influence decisions that affect Amazon's logistics operations across North America. If you're passionate about supply chain optimization, thrive in fast-paced environments, and want to see the direct impact of your work on millions of customers, this is your opportunity to make a difference at scale. Key job responsibilities You'll develop and maintain accurate demand forecasts for your assigned region by analyzing historical data, market trends, and business inputs from cross-functional partners. You'll translate these forecasts into detailed capacity plans that ensure our delivery network has the right resources to meet customer demand while optimizing efficiency. You'll collaborate closely with retail planning teams and technology teams to gather inputs, validate assumptions, and align on capacity requirements. This includes regularly reviewing forecast accuracy, identifying gaps between planned and actual performance, and making real-time adjustments when business conditions change. A critical part of your role involves monitoring system configurations and making necessary adjustments to ensure forecasts flow correctly through planning systems. You'll troubleshoot discrepancies, resolve data quality issues, and partner with technical teams to improve forecasting tools and processes. You'll communicate forecast insights and capacity recommendations to leadership through regular business reviews, explaining variances and providing data-driven recommendations for network optimization. Throughout all of this, you'll drive continuous improvement in how we forecast demand and plan capacity across the logistics network. A day in the life Your week centers on publishing a 13-week demand plan that keeps Amazon's last-mile delivery network running. You start by analyzing demand signals, interrogating trends, and evaluating forecast accuracy using ML forecasting models. Mid-week, you collaborate with technology and data science teams to enhance forecasting models and align field partners on plan changes. As publication approaches, you finalize your forecast, communicate risks to leadership, and coordinate high-volume event planning. When curveballs hit—demand spikes, system issues—you diagnose root causes with data and drive solutions fast. Your expertise in data analysis and forecasting science plays a vital role in delivering for customers every day. About The Team You'll join a diverse team of problem solvers who thrive on collaboration and collective success. Our mission is to deliver accurate capacity plans that keep millions of packages moving to customers across North America. You'll work closely with teammates and cross-functional partners in retail planning, technology, and field operations to solve real-time capacity constraints and optimize network performance. While we tackle challenges together, this role requires intrinsic motivation to drive results and own your outcomes. We value self-starters who bring initiative while collaborating effectively with others. If you're motivated to make an impact in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment where individual ownership drives collective results, you'll fit right in. descripcion: At Network Solutions, we’ve been trusted for decades to help people get online and stay ahead. We’ve been here since the beginning of the internet, and we’re still building for what comes next. As the original digital identity authority, we help secure domain names, protect brands, and safeguard the infrastructure businesses rely on. We empower our customers to own and manage the assets that define them online, while delivering enterprise-grade security to protect against virtual threats. Our team leverages modern, AI-accelerated tools to streamline how businesses manage their digital presence, making the most of our decades of experience. The Network Solutions team is here to help online businesses protect what’s theirs and build for tomorrow. That’s why millions trust us to protect their domains, brands, and websites every day. Senior Applied AI Engineer The impact you’ll make We are looking for a hands on Senior Applied AI Engineer who combines strong software engineering with practical AI problem solving. You will build production AI experiences across Network Solutions, including conversational agents, business and website creation, knowledge and FAQ agents, content experiences, domain discovery, and intelligent automation. You will take ambiguous customer and product problems, evaluate different approaches, and independently turn the strongest solution into reliable, secure, observable, and cost efficient production systems. This is an applied engineering role focused on shipping real AI products. What you’ll do Translate loosely defined product problems into practical AI solutions, choosing between LLMs, RAG, tool calling, agents, deterministic workflows, or traditional software. Design and build production AI services using Python, FastAPI, asynchronous workers, PostgreSQL, Redis, queues, model APIs, and external tools. Build reliable tool calling agents and multi step workflows that interact with internal APIs, MCP tools, business systems, and knowledge sources. Design event driven systems using RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus, or equivalent platforms, including retries, dead letter handling, idempotency, back pressure, and failure recovery. Build and improve RAG systems covering ingestion, chunking, embeddings, hybrid retrieval, reranking, metadata filtering, context construction, and citations. Experiment with models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, and open weight ecosystems, selecting the right model for quality, latency, reliability, and cost. Create AI evaluation pipelines using curated datasets, regression tests, retrieval metrics, LLM as judge techniques, groundedness checks, and tool execution evaluation. Diagnose hallucinations, retrieval failures, incorrect tool usage, agent loops, latency issues, provider failures, and unexpected inference costs. Operate as an AI powered engineer using Cursor, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or equivalent coding agents to accelerate design, implementation, testing, debugging, and refactoring. What we’re looking for 5 or more years of professional software engineering experience building production backend, distributed, or cloud based systems. Hands on experience building Applied AI, LLM, RAG, NLP, or agent based applications, with meaningful production exposure. Advanced Python skills including FastAPI, asynchronous programming, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy or SQLModel, and production API development. Strong backend and distributed systems fundamentals including REST APIs, concurrency, background processing, caching, reliability, and production debugging. Production experience with RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus, or equivalent queue and messaging architectures. Hands on experience integrating LLM APIs and building structured output, function calling, tool calling, or agent execution workflows. Experience building at least one RAG or knowledge grounded system with measurable quality and latency outcomes. Strong PostgreSQL and data modeling skills, with experience using Redis, pgvector, vector databases, or hybrid search technologies. Demonstrated use of AI coding agents such as Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or equivalent tools as a core part of daily software engineering. Applied AI engineering knowledge You should be comfortable going beyond a working demo and understand how modern AI systems behave, fail, and scale in production. Strong understanding of prompting, structured outputs, tool schemas, context management, model routing, retries, fallbacks, rate limits, and streaming responses. Ability to design experiments and evaluations that compare approaches using measurable outcomes rather than subjective testing alone. Understanding of retrieval quality, grounding, hallucination mitigation, prompt injection risks, tool authorization, and practical agent guardrails. Experience with Docker, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, distributed tracing, OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, or similar tooling. How you’ll work You will often start with an ambiguous customer or product goal rather than a detailed implementation plan. You should be able to independently break the problem down, validate assumptions, choose an approach, and drive the solution through production. Turn product goals into testable technical hypotheses and rapidly prototype alternatives when needed. Choose the simplest architecture that solves the problem well rather than using an agent or LLM by default. Define quality, latency, reliability, safety, and cost targets and measure production performance against them. Own implementation across APIs, workflows, data, queues, model integration, evaluations, observability, and production support. Use AI coding agents aggressively to increase engineering velocity while preserving architecture quality, testing discipline, security, and maintainability. What will make you stand out Experience with Semantic Kernel, Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph, PydanticAI, or equivalent agent frameworks. Experience building or consuming Model Context Protocol tools and servers, or working with model gateways such as LiteLLM. Experience with Azure AI Search, pgvector, Chroma, Kubernetes, Azure, OCI, or similar production AI platform technologies. Experience building high scale customer facing AI products, open weight model inference, AI safety controls, or automated agent evaluation systems. Strong problem solving, excellent engineering judgment, and the ability to independently move from ambiguity to a production quality solution are the foundation for this role. #NetworkSolutions Show more Show less

As a Quality Professional for Latin America, you will serve as the regional focal point for Quality and EHS activities within the Transformer Order Execution organization. You will work closely with Project Managers, EHS specialists, factories, suppliers, and other stakeholders to support the implementation and follow-up of EQS requirements across active projects in the region. Your responsibilities will include non-conformity management, facilitation of root cause analyses, follow‑up of corrective actions, sharing lessons learned, monitoring customer satisfaction indicators, and acting as a key link between projects and the regional organization. This is a hands‑on position that combines operational execution within one of the LATAM subregions, regional coordination, and reporting responsibilities. Beyond consolidating information, you will drive action follow‑up, support continuous improvement initiatives, and provide visibility of EQS performance within the Executive Unit. Working closely with the Quality team, you will help ensure consistent processes, reliable reporting, effective governance, and continuous improvement across the region. You will support management through performance reporting, trend analysis, and Management Reviews to provide visibility into regional project performance. The role is focused on coordination, follow‑up, monitoring, and reporting of regional EHS requirements and actions. How You’ll Make An Impact - Act as the regional focal point for Quality activities across LATAM, serving as a liaison between projects, management, and the different functions involved to ensure consistent management practices across the region. - Execute and support daily Quality activities, including follow‑up of Non‑Conformities (NC/NCC), corrective actions, root cause analyses, lessons learned, performance reporting, and the facilitation of problem‑solving activities. - Coordinate and consolidate regional Quality indicators, customer satisfaction metrics (NPS), action plans, and lessons learned, ensuring data accuracy, visibility, timely reporting, and escalation of overdue actions when required. - Support management through trend analysis, risk identification, and recommendations that drive continuous improvement, process enhancement, and operational excellence initiatives. - Support the planning and execution of internal audits based on the Integrated Management System, reporting findings to ensure compliance. - Consolidate and monitor regional EHS indicators, requirements, and action plans, coordinating project teams, EHS specialists, and external service providers to ensure appropriate follow‑up, visibility of EHS performance, and escalation of relevant risks across LATAM. What You Bring - Bachelor’s degree in engineering; Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Quality Management, or a related field. - Minimum 5 years of experience in Quality Management, Continuous Improvement, Operational Excellence, Project Quality, EHS Coordination, or similar roles. - Experience in non‑conformity management, root cause analysis, corrective action programs, and continuous improvement initiatives. - Knowledge of Integrated Management Systems based on ISO 9001 standards. ISO 9001 Internal Auditor Certification. - Knowledge of ISO 1401 and ISO 4501 is considered an advantage. Additional certifications such as Lean, Six Sigma Green Belt, Process Mapping, Kaizen, or other continuous improvement methodologies are highly valued. - Advanced English proficiency. Strong analytical, communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills. You will contribute by providing visibility, coordination, and support for EQS activities across the region. descripcion: We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 5+ years of software engineering experience to join our U.S. client. In this role, you will own end-to-end feature delivery across the full stack — front-end, back-end, data, and integrations — while leveraging modern development tools, including AI-assisted development, to build and ship production-quality software efficiently. Our client is building an AI-powered platform that transforms how wholesale distributors operate by embedding intelligent automation into the core workflows that drive product distribution. Serving a multi-trillion-dollar industry, the platform unifies customer relationship management, product information, eCommerce, and order and quote management into a single AI-driven ecosystem. By streamlining complex processes and reducing manual data entry, it enables sales teams to focus on delivering exceptional customer experiences and growing strategic relationships. This is a generalist full stack role — engineers are not siloed into front-end or back-end. You will work closely with PMs, designers, and other engineers to scope, build, and deploy features that distributors feel directly. You will periodically work with customers to support onboarding, troubleshoot integrations, and help them get the most out of the platform. On this job you'll be leveraging agentic AI development tools as a first-class collaborator. You should be ready to guide agents, structuring context, validating output and making judgement calls AI cannot. Responsibilities: Own end-to-end delivery of features — from refining tickets to deployment, monitoring, and iteration Build and maintain production-quality applications fully leveraging AI to build Python, Typescript, and Vue.js components Move fluidly across the stack, which is TypeScript /Vue.js on the front-end, Python on the back-end, SQL and data modeling, infra touch points. You don't need expertise in these languages as AI will do the heavy lifting, but you will pick up whatever the work needs. Operate AI coding agents (Claude Code and similar) at a high level: scope work, structure context, run multiple agents in parallel where it makes sense, and ship reviewed, production-quality output Collaborate in a squad model with PMs, designers, and engineers; participate in 2-week sprints, standups, refinements, retrospectives, and code reviews Design schemas, queries, and APIs that hold up at scale — performance, reliability, and correctness are on you, not on the agent Debug and troubleshoot production issues across different application layers Contribute to engineering practices, better patterns, better tooling, and effective ways to incorporate AI into the development process Work with customers directly a few times a year — distributors operate in warehouses and on sales floors, and the best product decisions come from understanding their environment firsthand Required Experience: Excellent English communication skills 5+ years of professional software engineering experience with real, demonstrable full stack delivery — production systems, real users, and meaningful ownership. Resume-level hands-on experience, not LLM -generated portfolios. Strong fundamentals. You understand what the code is doing and why. You can read a stack trace, reason through a query plan, debug a race condition, and tell when an agent is wrong. We are explicitly not hiring "vibe coders" who depend on AI to compensate for missing fundamentals — AI amplifies seniority, it doesn't replace it. Daily, hands-on use of agentic dev tools. Claude Code, Cursor agent mode, Codex, or equivalent — used to ship real features, not just autocomplete. You can talk concretely about how you structure prompts, manage context, parallelize agents, and verify their output. AI-curious mindset with an interest in using agentic AI tools to improve software development. Experience with AI-assisted development tools is valued, but you do not need to be an AI expert Generalist mindset with the ability to work across different areas of the technology stack rather than being limited to a single area of ownership Strong understanding of databases, APIs, system design, and application architecture Startup mindset: pragmatic, fast, biased to ship, and comfortable working through ambiguity Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions to PMs, designers, engineers, and customers Strong ownership and judgment: ability to take features from idea to production and determine what to build, what to simplify, and when a technical solution needs improvement Proven experience delivering software in a dynamic startup or fast-paced engineering environment Collaborative approach, can-do attitude, and strong problem-solving skills Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent Desired Experience: University degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience Experience building integrations with distribution ERPs or similar systems — ingesting orders, products, customers, and pricing and reconciling messy real-world data Experience working in customer-facing or implementation environments Experience building or integrating with AI-powered or agentic products Familiarity with concepts such as AI agents, MCP, tool use, evaluations, prompt engineering, or context engineering, Harnessing and Orchestration Experience using AI coding agents or AI-assisted development tools in a professional software engineering environment Prior experience at an early-stage SaaS startup Additional Information: Your ideas are heard and your contributions matter — think big! Own your work and be recognized for your contributions Work with smart and creative people Making mistakes is human. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoys taking on challenging work, wants to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excels in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team! Show more Show less

descripcion: ABOUT VICTORY LIVE Victory Live is a private equity backed technology company aimed at maximizing distribution and yield for live event ticket inventory. We provide an end-to-end software platform for the live ticketing industry, managing thousands of sports, theater, and live music event tickets on behalf of artists, promoters, teams, venues, and professional resellers. Victory Live’s comprehensive offerings include an established B2B marketplace, along with both a full-service and an automated SaaS platform to handle all elements of the ticket sales lifecycle, from ingestion to sales fulfillment. THE POSITION The Sr. Software Engineer on our Python and FastAPI services is the engine room of our engineering org. You will lead projects from planning through execution, write the code on the hardest pieces, and raise the bar for the engineers around you. You'll also be a force multiplier for AI-assisted development on your team, modeling how to use Claude, Copilot, and agentic workflows to ship faster without compromising quality. RESPONSIBILITIES Lead delivery of more in-depth initiatives from planning through launch in partnership with product and technical leadership, where you own the technical execution Take on the hard parts. When a FastAPI service needs a rewrite or a hard data migration, you're the one writing it Shape architecture. Participate actively in design discussions on our Python services, write design docs, and weigh tradeoffs out loud so the team can learn from your reasoning Mentor mid-level and junior engineers. Pair, code-review thoughtfully, and help teammates level up their skills, including their AI tooling fluency Drive process improvements. Spot recurring pain in the team's workflow and propose changes, not just complaints Push the AI-native bar. Build internal tooling, prompt patterns, and agentic workflows that make the whole team faster, not just yourself Be a reliable code reviewer on PRs across the team, including outside your immediate project area Operate cleanly on-call. Know your services in production; lead incident response when needed and write the postmortem REQUIREMENTS 5+ years building production software, with strong depth in Python and FastAPI (or a comparable async web framework) Demonstrated ability to make sound architectural decisions in a Python service and explain tradeoffs clearly in writing Strong technical depth in backend systems, API design, or distributed services built in Python Mentorship experience and a track record of helping teammates grow Fluent, deliberate use of AI tooling across the full engineering lifecycle (design, code, test, debug, review, docs) PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience with Celery, SQLAlchemy at scale, and Kafka-backed event pipelines Experience leading projects in marketplace, ticketing, e-commerce, or two-sided platform environments Comfort with Datadog, Grafana, Kibana, Airbrake, Sentry, OpsGenie, or comparable production tooling WHY VICTORY LIVE You'll build the infrastructure live events run on; millions of tickets, hundreds of venues, many of the largest teams and events in the world A lean team where decisions move fast and your code reaches real fans, often the same week Every release has stakes. Every improvement is felt High expectations, low tolerance for politics, and a culture built on writing well and shipping with care OUR VALUES We build the systems that power live event ticketing, and we hold a high bar for how we do it. Four principles run through everything: Quality of life. Sustainable processes over heroics. Nobody should be a single point of failure, and nobody should be afraid to take a vacation Quality of code. Clarity over cleverness. If a teammate needs a long explanation to follow your code, it needs simplifying. Tests prove your work; they aren't optional Protection of production. Every change is reviewed, tested, and observable. We build with monitoring in mind from day one so we find problems before our users do Shared knowledge. We work across time zones, so we communicate in the open. Questions go in channels, not DMs, and one answer becomes shared knowledge ENGINEERING PRINCIPLES We are an AI-native engineering team. Here is what that looks like in practice: AI-assisted engineering. Every engineer uses Claude, Claude Code, Copilot, and agentic tooling as a routine part of their workflow Async-first. Most decisions happen in writing through Jira, Confluence, PR descriptions, design docs. We over-communicate on changes and under-communicate on noise Ownership mindset. Engineers are responsible for what they write and no code reaches production without review. Reviewers are co-owners Observability is part of "done." If the on-call engineer can't understand a system without reading source, more logging, metrics, and dashboards are needed Preservation of quality of code and life. We write code that is clean, tested, and maintainable so it serves us well over time, and we build sustainable processes so no one burns out or becomes a single point of failure Shared knowledge and continued education. We grow as a team by learning from each other through reviews, documentation, and collaboration OUR STACK & WAYS OF WORKING Python and FastAPI power our B2B marketplace, distribution integrations, and partner-facing APIs Web & mobile clients, REST APIs, microservices Frameworks and tools: FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy, Alembic, Celery, pytest, Uvicorn Data: Postgres, Redis, Kafka Cloud & infra: AWS (RDS, ElastiCache, CloudSearch, EKS, MSK), Kubernetes, Terraform, Docker AI tooling: Anthropic / Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, in-house agentic workflows Observability: Datadog, Grafana, Elastic/Kibana, OpsGenie Collaboration: Jira, Confluence, GitHub, Slack, Miro Async-first, agile cadences, distributed onshore + offshore teams BENEFITS & PERKS Comprehensive medical coverage 100% employer-paid dental, vision, life, and disability insurance 401(k) with company match Paid parental leave Paid time off and company holidays Employee wellness and professional development opportunities Victory Live is an equal opportunity employer. descripcion: Who We Are At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. The Role Are you passionate about solving complex problems? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment? Then there’s a good chance you will love being a part of our Software Engineering – Development team at Kyndryl, where you will be able to see the immediate value of your work. As a Software Engineering - Developer at Kyndryl, you will be at the forefront of designing, developing, and implementing cutting-edge software solutions. Your work will play a critical role in our business offering, your code will deliver value to our customers faster than ever before, and your attention to detail and commitment to quality will be critical in ensuring the success of our products. Using design documentation and functional programming specifications, you will be responsible for implementing identified components. You will ensure that implemented components are appropriately documented, unit-tested, and ready for integration into the final product. You will have the opportunity to architect the solution, test the code, and deploy and build a CI/CD pipeline for it. As a valued member of our team, you will provide work estimates for assigned development work, and guide features, functional objectives, or technologies being built for interested parties. Your contributions will have a significant impact on our products' success, and you will be part of a team that is passionate about innovation, creativity, and excellence. Above all else, you will have the freedom to drive innovation and take ownership of your work while honing your problem-solving, collaboration, and automation skills. Together, we can make a difference in the world of cloud-based managed services. With dedication and hard work, you can climb the ladder to higher bands, achieving coveted positions such as Principal Engineer or Vice President of Software. These roles not only offer the chance to inspire and innovate, but also bring with them a sense of pride and accomplishment for having reached the pinnacle of your career in the software industry. Required Technical And Professional Experience 2–3 years of experience working as a Software Engineer on development projects. descripcion: Position: Indirect Purchasing Manager At Nexteer, our strength lies in the diversity of our team—each member contributing unique backgrounds, experiences, and aspirations. We believe this diversity fuels our innovation, broadens our perspectives, and propels our collective growth. For over a century, we’ve been innovators in the automotive industry. Our vision is clear - we are a global leading motion control technology company accelerating mobility to be safe, green and exciting. Our unwavering commitment to Quality, Collaboration, Integrity, and Accountability guides us as we solve motion control challenges for our global customers. If you’re ready to join a dynamic team that drives change and makes a difference, Nexteer welcomes you! About the Role: The Indirect Purchasing Manager is responsible for developing and executing sourcing strategies for all non‑production (indirect) goods and services. This role leads category management, drives cost optimization initiatives, manages supplier relationships, ensures compliance with corporate policies, and partners cross‑functionally to deliver measurable value, mitigate risk, and support business objectives. This role will report directly to the US Executive Director of Purchasing and have a dotted line reporting structure to Nexteer’s Global Indirect Commodity Purchasing Director. Key Responsibilities As an Indirect Purchasing Manager , you will be responsible to: Strategic Sourcing & Category Management Develop and implement sourcing strategies across assigned indirect commodities (e.g., IT, Facilities, Machinery & Equipment, Logistics, Outside Services, MRO, Engineering and Corporate Expenditures). Oversee and conduct market research, benchmark pricing, and evaluate emerging trends to inform category strategies. Build multi‑year category roadmaps that align with organizational goals and operational needs. Spend Analysis & Cost Optimization Analyze spend data to identify consolidation opportunities, inefficiencies, and cost‑saving initiatives. Use analytics tools to track spend patterns, supplier performance, and compliance. Develop cost models, total cost of ownership (TCO) analyses, and savings forecasts. Supplier Relationship Management Source, evaluate, and select suppliers based on quality, cost, capability, and risk profile. Lead supplier business reviews, performance scorecards, and continuous improvement initiatives. Build strategic partnerships that enhance service levels, innovation, and long‑term value. Cost Savings & Value Delivery Lead negotiations to secure competitive pricing, favorable terms, and measurable cost reductions. descripcion: At Nox Group, we are dedicated to humanizing construction as one of the fastest-growing industrial enterprises in the US. Nox Group owns and operates Corbins, RMCI, Nox Innovations, and Construction Labels, and our teams set the standard as industry leaders. As we continue to expand our reach nationwide, we seek people who are passionate about personal growth and eager to make a positive impact throughout the industries and communities we serve. We prioritize our people, our partners, and our relationships. Start your journey today and join our skilled team. Are you a data-driven professional with a passion for turning complex information into clear, actionable insights? If so, we want to meet you! Nox Group of Companies seeks an exceptional Business Intelligence Analyst to join our software team and help power smarter decisions across the enterprise. Because we thrive on innovation and excellence, we are looking for a skilled BI professional who can bring technical expertise, analytical rigor, and a collaborative spirit to our dynamic environment. If you’re ready to make a meaningful impact on the construction industry through data, we want to hear from you. Responsibilities Data Warehouse & Pipeline Coordination Collaborate with the Business Intelligence Manager to understand project priorities, data requirements, and delivery expectations, ensuring all work aligns with the broader BI strategy. Perform data warehouse development tasks as directed, including building and modifying tables, views, and transformation logic to support reporting and analytics needs. Coordinate with the Business Intelligence Manager before implementing data changes to ensure schema updates, new data sources, and structural modifications are reviewed and incorporated appropriately. Partner with Software Developers and Business Analysts to understand upstream data sources and ensure reliable, accurate data flows into the warehouse. Document data models, transformation logic, and warehouse structures to support maintainability and knowledge sharing across the team. PowerBI Development Design, develop, and publish PowerBI dashboards and reports that translate business data into clear, actionable visualizations for stakeholders across the enterprise. Collaborate with the Business Intelligence Manager and business stakeholders to gather reporting requirements and translate them into well-structured, effective dashboards. Create and maintain data models within PowerBI, including DAX measures, calculated columns, and relationships optimized for performance and accuracy. Maintain and update existing PowerBI dashboards to reflect evolving business needs, adding new features and enhancements as directed. Perform PowerBI QAQC to validate data accuracy and visual integrity before publishing reports to end users. Documentation & Support Create and maintain public-facing documentation for PowerBI dashboards and reports, including data definitions, refresh schedules, and usage guidance to support self-service adoption. Provide ongoing support to end users for dashboards and reports within your area of ownership, serving as a resource for questions and troubleshooting. Maintain and update Excel refreshable reports connected to live business data sources as needed. Perform ad-hoc SQL reporting to support business analysis and stakeholder requests. Collaboration & Project Execution Operate within an Agile/sprint-based workflow, participating in sprint planning and delivering BI work in alignment with team priorities set by the Business Intelligence Manager. Coordinate with Business Analysts on PowerBI initiatives, ensuring reporting and analytics requests are clearly defined and handed off with sufficient context for development. Communicate proactively with the Business Intelligence Manager on project status, blockers, and upcoming deliverables. Communicate with various stakeholders across the business including executives/C-Suite members. Qualifications Education Minimum of a high school degree. A bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related field is preferred. Industry-recognized certifications in business intelligence, data analytics, or related disciplines are a plus. Experience 3-5 years of experience developing and publishing PowerBI dashboards and reports in a production environment. 3-5 years of experience with SQL Server querying and data warehouse concepts Experience within a company of similar size and complexity to Nox Group of Companies (preferred) Experience in the construction or industrial sectors is a plus. Technical Skills: Must be proficient with the following technologies and disciplines Microsoft PowerBI — dashboard development, data modeling (DAX), report design, and publishing Microsoft SQL Server — ad-hoc querying, data validation, and basic warehouse development Data warehouse concepts — table design, views, stored procedures, transformation logic, and data pipeline awareness Excel — refreshable report design and maintenance connected to live data sources Agile/sprint-based project management methodologies Microsoft Office (Word, Excel) Mental Requires strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to interpret complex data sets and translate them into clear, meaningful visuals for both technical and non-technical audiences.
