descripcion: About Us At SYNC, we transform the way businesses and professionals work with our custom-tailored remote personnel solutions. Together, we help businesses build and automate workflows, implement and manage technology systems, and execute an endless list of administrative and sophisticated marketing-related tasks. Our hands-on approach allows us to streamline operations, strengthen client relationships, elevate brands, and solve the challenges that prevent companies from achieving greater success. Our success is powered by a highly skilled remote workforce sourced from around the globe. We provide a structured onboarding program and equip our team with the tools, resources, and support they need to thrive in today's technology-driven world. We are also much more than task managers. We work closely with our clients to build customized partnerships that benefit everyone involved. Job Detail As our AI Specialist, you will serve as the internal subject matter expert for all artificial intelligence and machine learning initiatives. Reporting directly to the Technology Team Leader, you will actively audit company operations, pinpoint high-impact AI use cases, and lead the implementation of intelligent tools and workflows that drive efficiency, enhance service delivery, and support our rapid scaling efforts. Responsibilities Strategic Identification & Scoping Analyze existing internal workflows, department functions, and client service delivery processes to identify high-value AI opportunities. Evaluate and recommend third-party AI tools, platforms, LLMs, and custom automation frameworks that align with business goals. Execution & Implementation Design, build, and deploy new and optimize existing AI-driven solutions, automations, and integrations. Standardize AI usage guidelines, prompt engineering practices, and related data security protocols across the company. Measure and report on the ROI and performance metrics of implemented AI initiatives. Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner closely with leadership team members to translate business challenges into actionable AI technical solutions. Educate and train internal team members on adopting new AI tools to ensure seamless organizational onboarding. Requirements Deep experience integrating modern AI technologies (Large Language Models, API integrations, predictive analytics, workflow automations) Experience with our existing tech stack is a plus (Go High Level, Google Workspace, ASANA, Zapier, Jotforms, WordPress and Elementor) Remote Competency: Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage project pipelines, and communicate effectively across a fully remote business structure. Problem-Solving Mindset: A pragmatic approach to AI—focusing on practical ROI and measurable business impact over hype. Fluent in English, read, write, and speak at C1 level or higher, with excellent communication skills Minimum of 3 years of hands-on, professional experience in AI-focused roles (e.g., AI Specialist, Machine Learning Engineer, AI Solutions Architect) Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, or a related technical field (equivalent relevant technological experience of at least 5 years will be considered in lieu of degree) Advanced Technical Proficiency. Connecting disparate systems, automating complex workflows, and building custom internal/external AI tools requires mastery across several tool categories: 1. Enterprise LLM & Model APIs Key Tools: OpenAI API, Anthropic (Claude) API Why it matters: You will need to programmatically build custom tools, internal assistants, and automated response systems tailored to our business data. Mastery here means understanding model selection (cost vs. speed vs. capability), system instructions, and API optimization. 2. Advanced Workflow & AI Orchestration Platforms Key Tools: n8n or Make Why it matters: To scale operations quickly without building every backend system from scratch, you must connect AI models to our CRM (Go High Level, Odoo), project management software (ASANA), and communication tools (Google Workspace). These platforms allow rapid deployment of complex, multi-step AI automations. 3. Data Orchestration & GTM Automation Key Tools: Clay Why it matters: Clay is the gold standard for B2B companies looking to scale operations, lead generation, and client enrichment. An AI Specialist proficient in Clay can use AI to automate complex research, lead scoring, and automated client onboarding pipelines. 4. AI Agent Frameworks Key Tools: LangChain / LangGraph or CrewAI Why it matters: Basic automations follow strict "if-this-then-that" rules, but next-generation operational efficiency uses autonomous AI agents that can make decisions, execute tasks across multiple systems, and handle non-linear workflows. 5. Vector Databases & RAG Platforms Key Tools: Pinecone, Qdrant, or Supabase (pgvector) Why it matters: To make AI useful for your specific business, it needs access to your proprietary company knowledge (standard operating procedures, past client deliverables, pitch decks, contract templates). Mastery of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) using vector databases ensures AI outputs are accurate, contextual, and grounded in our company's data. Schedule This position is FULL TIME, and candidates are expected to work exclusively for SYNC (moonlighting and side projects during regular business hours are prohibited). Workdays are Monday through Friday, from 9:00 am to 6:00 pm Show more Show less

You'll ship features into a live PHP monolith that runs a performance advertising business, and you'll help design the services they break out of it. The work starts in the monolith, because that's where the business runs today — and the decisions you make there are what the next architecture gets built on. Basic Qualifications: 7+ years building and operating production web applications Deep PHP experience in a long-lived, server-rendered application you were responsible for You've shipped and operated an integration against a major ad platform's API — Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, or Google/YouTube. We mean the real thing: rate limits and backoff, token rotation, async report jobs, version deprecations, backfilling after an outage You can talk credibly about normalizing data across more than one ad platform — where the object models refuse to line up, why the same campaign reports different numbers in two places, and how you decide which one billing gets to believe Strong vanilla JavaScript, and comfort in a modern component framework — you'll be introducing one, not inheriting one You've owned a system where a bad change costs real money, and you can talk about blast radius, rollback, and how you verify a data change before you run it Self-directed across time zones, and clear in writing What makes you stand out: Production Go Background job and queue systems — retries, idempotency, work that survives a reboot An understanding of how commercial media-buying automation platforms are built. You don't need to have built one. We want someone who can reason about how those systems work and what's worth building versus buying Dense operational UI — data grids, bulk actions, review queues, spreadsheet export. This is what our ad ops team stares at all day Docker and twelve-factor instincts Shipping AI-backed features, not just using AI to write code — evaluating model output, precision versus recall, and what a false positive costs when a human is downstream Key Responsibilities: Ad Platform Integration: This is the heart of the role. They are deep in the Meta Marketing API — campaign and creative objects, insights and spend, audience exclusions, duplicate-ad detection, and the policy surfaces that tell them when an ad is in trouble — and they are bringing TikTok, Snapchat, and YouTube online now. Four platforms means four object models, four sets of rate limits, four ideas of what a conversion window is, and one internal model that has to make sense of all of them. Designing that abstraction well is the highest-leverage thing anyone there can do this year. Compliance and Creative Review: The products their ad ops team runs on: AI-assisted creative checking, rescanning live ads for compliance drift, flagging unsubstantiated claims and unlicensed likeness or music, and the human review queues wrapped around all of it. Revenue Systems: Billing rules, referral commission logic based on advertiser spend, and reconciling what the platforms report against what they recorded. Spend numbers move after the fact. If you already know why that matters for billing, we should talk. Making Shipping Safe: Meet their new deployment pipeline halfway from the application side: a migration system so no schema change reaches production by hand, tests where a bug costs them money, and making the app stateless so they can eventually run more than one of it. Their DevOps engineer owns the infrastructure. You own whether the code is safe to ship through it. About RYZ Labs: RYZ Labs is a startup studio built in 2021 by two lifelong entrepreneurs. The founders of RYZ have worked at some of the world's largest tech companies and some of the most iconic consumer brands. They have lived and worked in Argentina for many years and have decades of experience in Latam. What brought them together is the passion for the early phases of company creation and the idea of attracting the brightest talents in order to build industry-defining companies in a post-pandemic world. Our teams are remote and distributed throughout the US and Latam. They use the latest cutting-edge technologies in cloud computing to create applications that are scalable and resilient. We aim to provide diverse product solutions for different industries, planning to build a large number of startups in the upcoming years. At RYZ, you will find yourself working with autonomy and efficiency, owning every step of your development. We provide an environment of opportunities, learning, growth, expansion and challenging projects. You will deepen your experience while sharing and learning from a team of great professionals and specialists. Our values and what to expect: Customer First Mentality - every decision we make should be made through the lens of the customer Bias for Action - urgency is critical, expect that the timeline to get something done is accelerated Ownership - step up if you see an opportunity to help, even if not your core responsibility Humility and Respect - be willing to learn, be vulnerable, and treat everyone that interacts with RYZ with respect Frugality - being frugal and cost-conscious helps us do more with less Deliver Impact - get things done in the most efficient way Raise our Standards - always be looking to improve our processes, our team, our expectations. Status quo is not good enough and never should be Show more Show less

descripcion: Build the Future with AspenView Technology Partners At AspenView, we are passionate about transforming the way organizations approach technology. We specialize in creating high-performing, nearshore IT teams to help North American clients innovate faster and more efficiently. As we continue to grow, we’re looking for exceptional people to join our team and help drive impactful change across industries. Why Join AspenView? At AspenView, we’re more than a nearshore IT partner—we’re a people-first, purpose-driven company that believes great culture drives great outcomes. We’re passionate about connecting talent and technology to deliver measurable value for clients—and meaningful career paths for our people. Here’s what you can expect: Competitive base Comprehensive benefits and wellness support Flexible work model: hybrid, remote, or in-office Real growth opportunities and leadership visibility Inclusive, respectful culture that blends U.S. innovation with Colombian heart A company that listens, invests in you, and celebrates wins together About The Role In this role, you will lead the architecture and implementation of multi-step agentic workflows capable of reasoning, tool execution, and synthesizing complex clinical and operational data. You will engineer sophisticated RAG pipelines that bridge unstructured medical knowledge with enterprise EHR systems, establishing strict safety guardrails, hallucination controls, and HIPAA-compliant AI pipelines. What You Will Do Agentic System Engineering: Architect and deploy autonomous agentic AI workflows and multi-agent systems (using frameworks like LangGraph, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, or CrewAI) capable of multi-step reasoning, dynamic tool usage, and clinical task execution. Advanced RAG Architecture: Design, optimize, and scale production RAG pipelines utilizing hybrid search (dense + sparse retrieval), re-ranking, query transformation, context compression, and semantic routing over multi-modal clinical and research datasets. LLM Fine-Tuning & Evaluation: Evaluate, fine-tune, and benchmark foundational models (e.g., Llama 3, Claude, GPT-4, Med-PaLM) for specialized healthcare tasks, establishing rigorous evaluation frameworks (e.g., Ragas, TruLens) for accuracy, groundness, and latency. Vector Database Infrastructure: Manage and optimize vector stores (Pinecone, Qdrant, Milvus, Weaviate, or pgvector) for high-concurrency, low-latency similarity searches and knowledge retrieval. Guardrails & HIPAA Compliance: Implement enterprise safety controls, input/output sanitization, and hallucination guardrails (e.g., NeMo Guardrails, Llama Guard) to ensure 100% HIPAA compliance and zero unauthorized PHI leakage. Cross-Functional Innovation: Collaborate closely with US-based clinical researchers, cloud architects, and product leads to translate complex healthcare needs into autonomous AI capabilities. Experience What You Bring 4+ years in software production engineering, with at least 2+ years dedicated to building LLM applications, agentic workflows, and RAG architectures in production. Technical Expertise Agentic Frameworks & Orchestration: Strong mastery of modern AI orchestration ecosystems (LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, or CrewAI). Search & Retrieval Infrastructure: Deep knowledge of Vector Databases (Pinecone, Qdrant, Milvus, pgvector), embedding models, semantic chunking strategies, and re-ranking models (e.g., Cohere Rerank, BGE). Programming & Cloud AI Stack: Advanced proficiency in Python, with hands-on deployment experience on cloud platforms (AWS Bedrock / SageMaker or Azure OpenAI / Vertex AI). Model Evaluation & Guardrails: Experience implementing LLM observability, evaluation metrics (faithfulness, answer relevance), and safety frameworks. Healthcare Interoperability (Preferred): Familiarity with medical ontologies (SNOMED, LOINC, ICD-10) and healthcare data interfaces (FHIR APIs, HL7) is a strong plus. Language Proficiency Advanced/Fluent English (C1/C2) for daily technical collaboration with Boston-based technology and research leadership. Soft Skills & Competencies Systems Thinking for Non-Deterministic AI: Exceptional ability to debug, evaluate, and stabilize non-deterministic model outputs for mission-critical healthcare applications. Clinical & User Empathy: Deep commitment to designing transparent, explainable, and safe AI systems that empower clinicians rather than replace them. Proactive Nearshore Ownership: Self-starter capable of driving end-to-end AI features autonomously in a remote-first, agile nearshore setting. Clear Technical Storytelling: Ability to communicate complex AI concepts, architectural trade-offs, and evaluation metrics clearly to non-technical stakeholders. Visa Sponsorship AspenView does not sponsor employment visas for this role. Applicants must be permanently authorized to work in their country of residence and must not require visa sponsorship now or in the future. Equal Opportunity Employer AspenView is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe in creating an environment where all employees feel welcome, valued, and empowered to succeed. We celebrate diversity and strive to build a culture of inclusion where all individuals, regardless of their race, color, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, age, or any other characteristic, can thrive. We encourage applicants from all walks of life to join our team and make a lasting impact. Show more Show less

descripcion: Estamos revolucionando las finanzas en América Latina 🚀 Fundada en 2017, Ualá nació con la misión de llevar los servicios financieros en América Latina al Siglo XXI. Hoy, ya somos el neobanco de más de 11 millones de usuarios y seguimos creciendo para transformar la industria en la región con soluciones fáciles y accesibles. Con presencia en Argentina, México y Colombia, seguimos expandiendo nuestro ecosistema con productos innovadores en Medios de Pago, Crédito, Inversiones y soluciones para comercios con Ualá Bis. Además, logramos la ronda de inversión más grande de la región en los últimos años y seguimos sumando talento para hacer realidad nuestra visión. Si querés ser parte de un equipo de +1100 personas que desafía lo establecido, trabaja con la mejor tecnología y siempre pone a las personas en el centro, ¡sumate a Ualá! #LoMejorEstáPorVenir En esta oportunidad, estamos en búsqueda de un Strategy Collections Specialist para sumarse al equipo de cobranzas con el objetivo de diseñar, optimizar y articular la estrategia de cobranza regional end-to-end (Argentina y México) basada en datos, maximizando el recupero neto, la eficiencia de provisiones y el ROI . Tendrás El Desafío De Definir e iterar las estrategias de cobranza segmentadas por clusters de riesgo y etapas de mora. Diseñar estrategias de tratamiento omnicanal (Timing, Canales automáticos como Bots, WhatsApp, SMS e intensidad de contactabilidad) mitigando la fricción y potenciando el Cure Rate. Monitorear y evaluar de manera sistemática los modelos estadísticos y scores de collections en producción, corriendo experimentos recurrentes (A/B Testing) para optimizar su efectividad. Servir de nexo estratégico con el equipo de Collections Ops, asegurando que los grandes macroprocesos e implementaciones en el CRM/Emerix se traduzcan en campañas eficientes . Detectar e impulsar oportunidades de automatización de procesos operativos internos y reportes complejos, erradicando la carga manual y reduciendo el riesgo de errores en la operación regional. Liderar la estrategia de tratamiento y pricing dinámico de refinanciaciones, quitas y planes de pago personalizados para maximizar el valor de recupero. Coordinar y supervisar funcionalmente las tareas de un analista a cargo, actuando como mentor técnico (coaching de queries, diseño metodológico de hipótesis y armado de tableros) garantizando el backup cruzado dentro del equipo. Asegurar el correcto volcado y explotación de datos en BigQuery / SQL, colaborando con Data Science para robustecer los dashboards y alertas de performance del área . Elaborar presentaciones ejecutivas e insights de valor para los Comités de Crédito y Riesgos, articulando el lenguaje técnico con las variables financieras del negocio. Universitario completo o en curso en carreras afines a Finanzas, Economía, Administración, Ingeniería o Sistemas. Manejo de herramientas de visualización como Tableau o Looker (excluyente). descripcion: We are a fast-growing U.S.-based B2B technology company building the infrastructure layer for modern social, video, search, and commerce experiences in sports betting, casino, and adjacent entertainment markets. Our platform helps partners embed personalized short-form video feeds, creator- and user-generated content, search and discovery, content-driven journeys, and social engagement layers. Under the hood, the platform depends on high-throughput data pipelines, event-driven workflows, ranking systems, partner integrations, and scalable backend services. We are expanding the engineering team and looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who can own meaningful backend systems end-to-end, ship production code quickly, and help us scale the platform with strong technical judgment. We love builders! People that love to tinker, love to build things! Overall Purpose of the Role As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will be a hands-on owner of backend services that power ingestion, ranking, feeds, search, real-time events, creator tooling, and partner-facing APIs. This is not a management role and is not a purely architecture role. We are looking for a strong senior individual contributor who can turn ambiguous product and technical problems into reliable, scalable production systems. You will work closely with the founders, product, design, and other engineers to build systems that support fast product iteration while maintaining reliability, observability, and clean engineering practices. Own backend features end-to-end: technical design, API design, data modeling, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and iteration after launch. Build and improve event-driven data flows, queues, workers, APIs, and data pipelines that support real-time product experiences. Improve performance, reliability, observability, and cost efficiency across critical backend systems. Work with SQL, NoSQL/key-value stores, caches, cloud storage, message queues, and analytics/event systems to support scalable product features. Integrate with partner APIs and internal systems across sports betting, casino, media, and commerce workflows. Participate in code reviews, technical planning, incident response, and architectural discussions. Collaborate effectively in an async-first remote environment with clear written communication and strong U.S. time-zone overlap. Mentor junior or mid-level engineers when needed, while remaining primarily focused on hands-on execution. Must-Have Skills / Qualifications 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 3+ years building production backend systems. Strong production experience in Go or Python, with willingness to work in both languages. Strong Go experience is a major plus. Experience designing, building, and operating APIs, backend services, workers, and data pipelines in production environments. Strong understanding of distributed systems fundamentals, reliability trade-offs, performance optimization, and production debugging. Experience with cloud infrastructure such as GCP, AWS, or Azure, including containerized services and modern deployment workflows. Practical experience with SQL databases, NoSQL/key-value stores, queues/streaming systems, caches, and API design patterns such as REST or gRPC. Ability to work independently in a fast-moving startup environment without heavy day-to-day supervision. Strong English communication skills, especially written communication for technical decisions, async updates, and code reviews. Comfortable working with ambiguity and translating product requirements into pragmatic technical plans. Advantageous / Nice-to-Have Experience Experience with both Go and Python in production. Experience with GCP services such as Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, BigQuery, or similar services on AWS/Azure. Experience with search, ranking, personalization, recommendation systems, analytics infrastructure, or ML-adjacent data systems. Experience with Typesense, Meilisearch, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, or similar search infrastructure. Experience with video/media pipelines, ffmpeg, short-form video products, creator platforms, social feeds, or live/interactive media. Experience in B2B SaaS, gaming, sports betting, casino, commerce, fintech, or other regulated/partner-integrated environments. Experience with infrastructure-as-code, Kubernetes, Terraform, observability tooling, or incident management. Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. This Role Is Ideal For Someone Who We love builders! People that love to tinker, love to build things! Enjoys owning backend systems from idea to production and continuing to improve them after launch. Wants to work on high-volume systems involving feeds, search, events, media, personalization, and partner integrations. Show more Show less

descripcion: Postúlate en Kit Empleo: kitempleo.com.ar/empleo/vo81r Who is UJV? Planning and managing a 5-star vacation from scratch requires expertise, cleverness, and a genuine passion for detail. That's what UJV is all about. UJV is a service-driven team of experts that work behind the scenes, engineering luxury travel experiences for advisors globally, so they can grow their business and fully satisfy their exclusive clients. We are the luxury travel advisor’s right hand. How? - UJV is a team of travel experts that advises and supports luxury travel advisors worldwide. - We work behind the scenes as allies of top luxury travel advisors, to offer a 5 Star experience for their clients. - We offer travel advisors the knowledge and tools needed to grow their business and better serve their exclusive clients. - We offer an experience-centered service based on passion, expertise, integrity - and attention to detail. - We are willing to do the hard work in order to see our clients shine. Role Mission At Ultimate Jet Vacations, we don't believe data should sit inside dashboards waiting to be discovered. We're looking for a Business Intelligence Analyst who can transform complex commercial data into clear, actionable insights that help our leaders make faster and smarter decisions. This isn't a report-building role. It's a strategic business partner role. You'll work closely with our Head of Commercial Strategy and department leaders across Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Operations to uncover trends, identify opportunities, challenge assumptions, and proactively bring insights to the table before anyone asks for them. If you're naturally curious, enjoy solving business problems with data, and love telling the story behind the numbers, we'd love to meet you. Responsibilities - Own and continuously improve our core Tableau dashboards across Sales, Gross Profit, Agent Performance, Regional Performance, Marketing, and Luxury Travel. - Partner with department leaders to review performance, identify trends, uncover opportunities, and translate data into meaningful business conversations. - Proactively identify GP leakage, negative-margin bookings, underperforming agents, operational inefficiencies, and emerging commercial trends, providing recommendations for improvement. - Prepare and maintain the weekly Commercial Reporting package, ensuring leadership has accurate and actionable metrics for strategic meetings. - Maintain the integrity of our commercial data model, Tableau environment, and data dictionary while collaborating closely with the Technology team. - Design thoughtful ad hoc analyses that help answer strategic business questions—not simply produce reports. - Improve data accessibility by empowering department leaders to confidently self-serve key dashboards and metrics. - Research, design, and implement AI-powered analytical solutions using Large Language Models (Claude preferred) to automate repetitive reporting and accelerate decision-making. - Continuously look for opportunities to improve reporting processes, dashboard usability, and overall data quality across the organization. Qualifications - 2-4 years of experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, Commercial Analytics, or a similar analytical role. - Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related field. - Advanced experience with Tableau. - Strong SQL skills. - Excellent Excel and/or Google Sheets proficiency. - Experience designing dashboards focused on business decision-making rather than simply displaying metrics. - Strong understanding of data modeling and data visualization best practices. - Experience working with AI tools or Large Language Models (Claude preferred). - Ability to communicate complex analytical findings in a clear, simple, and business-friendly way. - Full professional proficiency in English, both written and verbal. Bonus Points - Experience with Python for data analysis or automation. - Experience with HubSpot reporting. - Experience within the travel, hospitality, or luxury industries. - Experience building AI automations or analytical workflows. Who You Are - You don't wait for someone to ask for a report; you already noticed the trend. - You're naturally curious and love digging beneath the surface to understand why something is happening. - You enjoy partnering with business leaders, asking thoughtful questions, and helping them make better decisions through data. - You see dashboards as conversation starters, not finished products. - You're constantly looking for ways to improve processes, automate repetitive work, and make data easier for everyone to understand. - Most importantly, you care about business outcomes just as much as the numbers behind them. Why You'll Love This Role - You'll work directly with company leadership and have a real impact on commercial strategy. - Instead of spending your days building endless reports, you'll influence decisions across multiple departments, improve how the business uses data, and help shape the future of analytics and AI at Ultimate Jet Vacations. - If you enjoy turning data into action, challenging assumptions, and building solutions that make everyone's job easier, this role is for you. descripcion: GBS Chevron Global Business Services (GBS), located in Buenos Aires (Puerto Madero), Argentina, is accepting applications for the position of Sr. Data Analyst. Successful candidates will join the center, which is part of a multifunction service and technical center with a workforce of more than 1800 employees that deliver business services and solutions to the corporation across the globe. Overview The Trading Insights Data Analyst partners with business stakeholders, traders, Product Owners, Data Engineers, and Data Scientists to deliver data-driven solutions that support decision-making across Chevron's global Supply & Trading organization. The role combines business analysis, data analysis, reporting, testing, and data product enablement to translate business needs into actionable insights and scalable analytics solutions. Serving as a key liaison between business and technical teams, the Data Analyst develops expertise in trading processes and market fundamentals, leads requirements gathering and stakeholder workshops, validates solution designs through report and dashboard mock-ups, supports self-service analytics, identifies data quality gaps, and ensures delivered solutions meet business needs through solution validation, user acceptance testing (UAT), and business sign-off. Responsibilities for this position may include but are not limited to: Develop business acumen across Crude, Refined Products, NGLs, Natural Gas, LNG, and related trading domains. Lead business-facing requirements gathering sessions, workshops, and stakeholder engagement activities. Elicit, document, and manage business, functional, reporting, and data requirements. Create and validate report, dashboard, and data model mock-ups to confirm business requirements and solution approaches. Guide business users and Citizen Developers in discovering, understanding, joining, and utilizing enterprise data products while promoting self-service analytics best practices. Identify, document, and coordinate resolution of data quality issues across data sources, datasets, and reporting solutions. Perform data validation and functional testing of reports, dashboards, analytics solutions, and data products. Coordinate UAT activities, including test planning, execution, defect management, and stakeholder sign-off. Validate delivered applications, analytics, reports, and dashboards against business requirements and acceptance criteria. Partner with Technical Leads, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, Product Owners, and business stakeholders to deliver solutions that create measurable business value. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, Finance, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Data Analyst, Business Intelligence Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role supporting data, analytics, reporting, or business intelligence solutions. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business needs into actionable requirements and data-driven solutions. Experience leading business-facing requirements gathering sessions, stakeholder interviews, workshops, and documentation of business and functional requirements. Proficiency in data analysis and reporting tools such as Power BI, Excel, SQL, or similar business intelligence platforms. Proficiency in SQL for data exploration, analysis, validation, and troubleshooting, including experience working with relational databases and complex datasets to support reporting, business analysis, and data quality investigations. Ability to develop and validate report, dashboard, and data model mock-ups to facilitate solution design and stakeholder alignment. Experience coordinating and supporting User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including test planning, test case development, execution, defect management, and stakeholder sign-off. Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively with business stakeholders, Product Owners, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and delivery teams. Ability to coordinate work across global business and delivery teams spanning multiple regions and time zones. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting analytics, reporting, data, or AI solutions within the Oil & Gas, Energy, Commodities, or Supply & Trading domain. Knowledge of trading businesses and market fundamentals related to Crude, Refined Products, Natural Gas, NGLs, LNG, or other commodity markets. Experience enabling self-service analytics and supporting business users or Citizen Developers in discovering and utilizing enterprise data products. Familiarity with data governance, data quality management, metadata, and enterprise data cataloging concepts. Experience working in Agile and/or SAFe delivery environments. Experience with Azure DevOps (ADO) for backlog management, requirements tracking, testing, and work management. Exposure to Data Science, Machine Learning, Generative AI, or Agentic AI use cases and business applications. Relocation Options: Relocation will not be considered. International Considerations Expatriate assignments will not be considered. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by bringing together data, science, technology and human ingenuity to deliver better outcomes for all. ZSers drive impact by bringing a client-first mentality to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS. Insights & Analytics ZS's Insights & Analytics group partners with clients to design and deliver solutions to help them tackle a broad range of business challenges. Our teams work on multiple projects simultaneously, leveraging advanced data analytics and problem-solving techniques. Our recommendations and solutions are based on rigorous research and analysis underpinned by deep expertise and thought leadership. Leverage analytic techniques to use data to guide client and ZS team decision-making. Design custom analyses in R, Tableau, SAS, Visual Basic, Power BI, SQL and Excel to investigate and inform client needs. Synthesize and communicate results to clients and ZS teams through oral and written presentations. Develop client relationships and serve as key point of contact on aspects of projects. Provide client and ZS teams project status updates. Create project deliverables and implement solutions. Advance problem-solving skills and improve ZS’s capabilities; Guide and mentor Associates on teams. Empathy, adaptability and emotional intelligence. Close attention to detail, with a quality-focused mindset. Self-discipline for planning and organizing tasks. Aptitude for, and enjoyment of, working in teams. descripcion: Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together. The Financial Consultant Capital Finance is a trusted financial advisor and strategic partner supporting Optum Rx. This role plays a critical part in the planning, governance, and execution of the capital portfolio, representing approximately $425M in annual capital spend. In this role, you will provide financial and operational oversight across capital planning, business case development, forecasting, variance analysis, and performance reporting. You will serve as a key liaison between business leadership, Finance, and enterprise capital governance teams, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards and driving disciplined capital execution. Primary Responsibilities Capital Planning & Governance Support the development, prioritization, and execution of the capital plan Ensure alignment with enterprise capital governance standards, processes, and controls Deliver visibility into capital investments, benefits realization, and overall financial outcomes Financial Analysis & Decision Support Develop financial models and analyses to support business cases and investment decisions Evaluate capital initiatives and deliver data-driven recommendations to leadership Identify risks and opportunities in capital performance and recommend actionable solutions Forecasting & Performance Management Manage capital forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis processes Deliver accurate and timely reporting to support business decision-making and accountability Drive improvements in forecast accuracy and overall capital efficiency Cross-Functional Partnership Collaborate across functions to align on capital priorities and performance expectations Influence decisions through strong financial insight, communication, and business acumen Process & Reporting Optimization Enhance capital reporting frameworks to improve transparency and insights Identify opportunities to streamline processes, tools, and operational efficiency Support continuous improvement of capital planning and tracking capabilities You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field 3+ years of experience in financial planning & analysis, accounting, or related finance roles Solid understanding of accounting principles and financial systems Proven analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills Demonstrated ability to manage complex financial processes and deliver actionable insights Demonstrated solid communication skills with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting capital planning, governance, or investment portfolios Experience working in a matrixed or large enterprise environment Advanced financial modeling and forecasting skills Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The salary for this role will range from $72,800 to $130,000 annually based on full-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable. Our global consulting firm combines creativity and innovative technology to deliver industry-leading digital solutions. Over the last 20+ years, our company has been honored with multiple employer awards, recognizing our commitment to our talented teams. Our challenge We are seeking a skilled Python Developer with strong programming expertise and experience in developing scalable, high-performance applications. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with Python frameworks, REST APIs, databases, cloud platforms, and modern software development practices. The candidate should be able to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and contribute throughout the software development lifecycle. Build scalable RESTful APIs and microservices using Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django. Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code following best practices. Integrate applications with databases, third-party services, and cloud platforms. Collaborate with product owners, business analysts, architects, and development teams to understand requirements. Perform code reviews and ensure adherence to coding standards. Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize application performance. Develop automated unit and integration tests. Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, and technical discussions. Create and maintain technical documentation. Requirements: Strong experience with Python programming . Hands-on experience with Django, Flask, or FastAPI . Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts. Experience developing REST APIs and Microservices . Knowledge of relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQL Server . Experience with Git and version control systems. Familiarity with Docker and containerization. Understanding of software design patterns and development best practices. Strong debugging and problem-solving skills. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Preferred, but not required: Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP . Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps. Experience with message queues such as Kafka or RabbitMQ . Familiarity with Kubernetes and container orchestration. Exposure to AI/ML frameworks and Python libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, or Scikit-learn. Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments. Cutting edge projects at the world’s leading tier-one banks, financial institutions and insurance firms. A truly diverse, fun-loving and global work culture. descripcion: Building the Future of Open Finance Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work. The team Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. We are currently seeking an experienced Software Engineer to join our growing Consumer team. The Consumer team at Kraken focuses on building applications that expose Kraken’s product offering to the mass market. Trying to onboard the next 100 million people to the benefits of crypto. This role primarily involves developing features and maintaining our “Consumer” applications, which consists of a suite of applications aimed at offering the simplest way for our customers to interact with Kraken. We expect anyone applying for this role to have an extreme eye for detail, a passion for building genuinely world class user experiences, a “ship fast but don’t ship shit” attitude and be highly self driven. The opportunity Design and implement customer-facing Rust backend services powering trading, payments, and crypto experiences Own features end-to-end rather than stopping at the API/backend boundary, understanding customer experience, frontend impact, and the product problem behind what you're building. Collaborate with product teams to understand customer requirements and integrate with Kraken's trading infrastructure while maintaining a product-led engineering focus Propose improvements and drive solutions autonomously. You're not simply implementing specifications, but translating evolving product requirements into resilient solutions that ship valuable experiences. Use AI extensively to amplify scope and speed, moving from manually writing code toward orchestrating AI and validating implementation, increasingly focused on problem definition, architecture, and product validation. What You Bring Rust/backend engineer with proficiency in network services, asynchronous code, and distributed systems design (RPC protocols, Kafka, event-driven architectures) Product engineering mindset. You personally drive features end-to-end, work across backend/frontend boundaries and operate outside technical silos Security-first approach to system design with ability to autonomously debug across the stack (OS, network, application) Openness to how the engineering profession is evolving because of AI, prioritizing shipping valuable products over manual code writing Nice to haves Full-stack experience including React/TypeScript or other frontend frameworks - valuable for demonstrating cross-boundary collaboration mindset Cryptocurrency or blockchain domain knowledge Experience building products at consumer-focused technology companies Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. descripcion: Kamatics is seeking a Data Analyst who is responsible for business intelligence reporting, dashboard development, data migration, and reporting system implementation. This role partners closely with cross-functional teams to gather business requirements, analyze existing reports and data sources, and develop interactive dashboards and reporting solutions using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Crystal Reports, and Opcenter Intelligence . A key focus of this position is supporting the migration of existing reports to a new reporting environment while ensuring data accuracy, integrity, and consistency. The ideal candidate has strong SQL and business intelligence experience, excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, and the ability to translate complex data and business requirements into effective reporting solutions. This is a full-time, on-site position based in Bloomfield, CT. Responsibilities Analyze and document existing Crystal Reports , including data sources, business logic, calculations, and visualizations. Partner with business stakeholders to gather, document, and translate reporting requirements into effective dashboards and reporting solutions. Design and develop reports and interactive dashboards using Power BI, Tableau, Crystal Reports, Opcenter Intelligence, and other business intelligence tools . Support the migration of existing reports and data to a new reporting environment, accurately translating existing logic and data structures. Perform data extraction, transformation, loading, and validation activities as part of reporting and system migration initiatives. Validate and test migrated reports to ensure data accuracy, integrity, and alignment with business requirements . Identify, investigate, and resolve data discrepancies, reporting issues, and migration-related challenges. Create and maintain documentation for reports, dashboards, data sources, business logic, and reporting processes. Partner with IT and cross-functional teams to integrate reporting solutions with existing systems and data infrastructure. Provide training and ongoing support to end users on reporting tools, dashboards, and system capabilities. Continuously evaluate reporting processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy, and usability. Perform other duties as assigned. Qualifications Education & Experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field . 3+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Business Intelligence Analyst, Reporting Analyst, or similar role. Technical Skills Demonstrated experience developing and analyzing reports using Crystal Reports . Strong SQL skills for data extraction, manipulation, querying, and analysis. Experience with data migration and ETL processes , including data extraction, transformation, loading, and validation. Experience with database technologies such as Oracle, SQL Server, or MySQL . Proficiency with business intelligence and reporting tools such as: Power BI Tableau Crystal Reports Opcenter Intelligence Ability to analyze complex datasets and translate business requirements into clear, accurate, and effective reporting solutions. Experience validating data and troubleshooting reporting or data discrepancies. Familiarity with project management methodologies is a plus. Core Competencies Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders . Strong organization and documentation skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities and work collaboratively across teams. Adaptable and comfortable learning new technologies, systems, and reporting tools. Continuous improvement mindset with a focus on reporting efficiency and effectiveness. Physical Requirements Frequent sitting and computer workstation use. Frequent use of a keyboard and mouse. Occasional bending and twisting. Benefits: At Kamatics, we recognize how important your career and benefits are to you and your family. We offer a full suite of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, short and long-term disability coverage, accident insurance, critical illness insurance, basic and supplemental life insurance, employee assistance plan, retirement savings and matching, and other developmental opportunities. We are committed to supporting the way you live and work. Kamatics is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status. Applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to complete the application process may contact Human Resources. This position requires access to information subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Employment is contingent upon the applicant being a “U.S. person” as defined by ITAR (22 CFR §120.15), which includes U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, refugees, or asylees, as required by U.S. export control laws. It is built by those who take pioneering, creative approaches and implement them with quality and excellence. We are Worldwide Clinical Trials, and we are a global team of over 3,500+ experts, bright thinkers, dreamers and doers and, together, we are changing the way the world experiences CROs – in the best possible way. Our mission is to work with passion and purpose every day to improve lives and we are looking for others who value this same pursuit. Why Worldwide We believe everyone plays an important role in making a world of difference for patients and their caregivers. From our hands-on, accessible leaders, to our cohesive and supportive teams, we are committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed. We prioritize cultivating a diverse and inclusive environment that continues to promote collaboration and creativity. We are proud to be a workplace where people thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day. Join us! What the Grants Payments Data Analyst Does at Worldwide The role of the Grants Payments Data Analyst is to assist in building a forecast model for needed forecasting outside of Medidata Payments, and to own that model and future updates and improvements. The role will also be involved in developing the forecasting process outside of Medidata Payments and how that links with forecasts from Medidata Payments. They will work closely with the Revenue Recognition, Clinical Payments, Investigator Grants Payments, and Project Analyst teams, along with other departments that contribute data to the forecasting and payment of sites, to assist in developing the end-to-end forecasting process of Clinical Site Payments. The Analyst will also be involved in developing a client-ready forecast format for the Project Analyst to incorporate into their Financial Client Deliverables. What you will do - Work with the Central Planning and Clinical Operations teams to gather current site enrollment and patient enrollment data (actuals and forecast) - Assist in creating a model for forecasting needed outside of Medidata Payments and own the model and subsequent updates and improvements - Assist in linking the forecast model with Medidata Payments forecasts - Work with the Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A;) Revenue Recognition team to confirm adherence to requirements for financial audits - Create client-ready forecast deliverables as specified per sponsor contracts - Perform forecast analysis: plan vs. actuals; total budget needs with sponsor - Notify Project Analysts and Global Project Leads of issues in over-forecast and under-forecast variances - Ensure compliance with audit requirements and support the year-end and interim audit processes - Support the Clinical Operations (CO) process - Stay up to date with local and global revenue regulations - Ensure accurate reporting to clients in a timely manner in line with client requirements - Complete final reconciliation on study closeout and provide the Project Analyst with final client-ready reports for review - Perform other duties as assigned. The duties and responsibilities listed above are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and are not necessarily all-inclusive. What you bring to the role - Ability to influence and challenge as required - Understanding of the process of paying sites - Understanding of accounting and revenue recognition standards Your experience - Strong analytical skills - Proficient in Excel, databases, and accounting systems - Degree educated with at least 2 to 5 years of finance experience Promotion to the next level is not automatic based on years of experience. Personnel are evaluated on proven competency, level of responsibility, and ability to work independently. We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do. To view our other roles, check out our careers page at Discover a world of difference at Worldwide! For more information on Worldwide, visit www.Worldwide.com or connect with us on LinkedIn. We know that when our employees feel appreciated and included, they can be more creative, innovative, and successful. Different worlds, same standard: we ship tangible outcomes into production, fast. Then we work alongside customers to maintain and optimise them long term, upskilling their teams along the way. Role Overview We are seeking a Backend Engineer with strong expertise in Python, Google Cloud Platform and AI solutions to join our Americas team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining the backend systems that power AI-driven applications for our enterprise clients in North America. Based in Argentina, you will be a key contributor to the regional engineering team, translating client requirements into high-quality technical deliverables. You will focus on building generative AI features and cloud-native services while collaborating with our global engineering teams in Europe. As a Backend Engineer at Beyond, you'll: Develop Core Logic: Write clean, maintainable, and highly efficient code in Python to support high-scale content platforms and data-intensive applications. Implement AI Features: Assist in building and deploying AI features, such as RAG pipelines and LLM integrations using Vertex AI, following established architectural patterns. Engineer Cloud Infrastructure: Design and configure scalable backend architectures on GCP, utilizing Cloud Run, GKE, and Cloud Functions with a focus on performance and observability. Contribute to Technical Design: Participate in the creation of Technical Design Documents (TDDs) and help translate business requirements into functional backend components. Deploy & Automate: Manage the full lifecycle of your code, from local development to production, leveraging Terraform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and robust CI/CD pipelines. Collaborate Globally: Work closely with US-based product owners and European delivery teams, requiring a proactive communication style and flexibility for early-morning syncs. Ensure Quality: Champion best practices in API design, security, and automated testing to ensure the reliability of enterprise-level deployments. Things that will make you stand out: Engineering Experience: 3-5 years of professional experience in backend development, with a focus on web services and API design. Python Expertise: Mastery of the Python ecosystem (FastAPI, Flask, or Django) and experience with asynchronous programming. GCP Proficiency: Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform services, specifically App Engine, Cloud Run, Vertex AI, BigQuery, and Cloud SQL. AI/ML Integration: Proven experience integrating LLMs into applications and an understanding of vector databases (e.g., Vertex Vector Search, Pinecone). DevOps Skills: Proficiency with Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform. Communication: Fluent English skills with the ability to discuss technical trade-offs clearly with both peers and stakeholders. Nice to Have AI Frameworks: Experience with LangChain or LlamaIndex. Data Engineering: Understanding of data pipelines and ETL processes to support AI model training and retrieval. CMS Familiarity: Experience working with headless CMS architectures or Digital Experience Platforms (DXP). Certifications: GCP Professional Cloud Architect or Professional Data Engineer. We believe the best work happens when we collaborate in person. Your energy and presence will be vital in making our studio a hub of creativity and innovation. Benefits We believe in supporting our team members both professionally and personally. descripcion: We are pleased to announce a wonderful opportunity for an Operations Manager . What will you be doing most days? Coach and support hotel team to effectively manage wages and controllable expenses. Strives to maintain profit margins without compromising guest or team member satisfaction Manage costs within the hotel, including supplies, utilities, food and beverage and labor expenses to within budgeted parameters, combining with sales/revenue acumen to deliver an efficient and profitable operation Ensure service, technical skills and other training occurs throughout the property to support successful daily operations Ensure the cleanliness and functionality of of the rooms and entire building of the hotel. Effectively run and oversee the housekeeping department ensuring that it is run and operating effectively on a daily basis Review financial reports and statements to understand property’s performance versus budget and expenses. Works to determine areas of concern and develops strategies to improve performance Establish and maintains open, collaborative relationships with direct reports and entire team. Ensures direct reports do the same for their team Establish a presence with team members on property and actively solicits team member feedback. Utilizes an “open door” policy and reviews team member engagement results to identify and address team member problems or concerns. Ensures team members are treated fairly and equitably Hire team members who demonstrate strong functional expertise, creativity and leadership to meet the business needs of the operation Foster team member commitment to providing exceptional service, participates in daily stand-up meetings and models desired service behaviors in all interactions with guests and team members Demonstrate and communicates drivers of guest satisfaction; ensures core elements of service strategy are in place to produce the desired results Serve as a guest advocate for the property. Pulls together resources to resolve guest and operational issues and impact results Is highly visible and interfaces with customers on a regular basis to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels, and overall satisfaction Observe service behaviors of team members and provides feedback to individuals and/or supervisors Review comment cards, guest survey results and other data to identify areas of improvement Analyze service issues and identifies trends. Facilitates the development of creative solutions to overcome obstacles and ensures implementation to continually improve guest satisfaction results Ensure that building is well maintained and that operational areas have an atmosphere that meets or exceeds guest expectations Make decisions and oversee team performance, removes obstacles to success and ensures adequate resources are available to achieve business results Inspire and motivate teams to achieve operational excellence Ensure policies are administered fairly and consistently and that team member performance is evaluated and recognized where appropriate Ensure property meets franchise standards Ensure property is a safe and secure facility for guests and team members Communicate and ensure execution of hotel emergency procedures What are the requirements for this position? You have 3+ years of previous hotel management experience preferred Food and Beverage experience preferred You have previous hotel leadership experience with proven success in leading teams You have the ability to coach, train, praise, and discipline employees effectively and consistently You have at least a high school diploma, with a college degree preferred You have extensive financial knowledge and strong business acumen You have a valid driver’s license from the appropriate state You have a drive for results demonstrated through successful performance in prior leadership positions You have an action orientation to work efficiently and effectively toward operational objectives You have strong time management skills to meet commitments across multiple departments and roles You have a customer focus to consistently deliver optimal employee and customer satisfaction for the hotel Physical Requirements For This Position You must be able to walk and stand for extended periods of time as the job dictates. Somos la suite de soluciones 100% Cloud más completa para la integración y gestión punta a punta de toda la operación COMEX🚀 En SIDOM buscamos construir un mundo en el que los negocios fluyan sin obstáculos, donde las transacciones sean seguras, rápidas y eficientes; simplificando el comercio internacional con innovación y talento. En esta oportunidad nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un SR Fullstack Engineer para diseñar, construir y asegurar la calidad técnica de la solución de punta a punta, con el peso del rol en el lado servidor: APIs, lógica de negocio, integraciones y capa de datos. La distribución del rol es aproximadamente 70% backend / 30% frontend. En este último implementa y mantiene interfaces en React sobre definiciones de producto y diseño ya existentes; no es responsable del diseño visual ni de la definición de la experiencia de usuario. Responsabilidades Diseña las APIs, la lógica de negocio del lado servidor y el modelo de datos, y toma las decisiones técnicas de fondo: contratos de API, estructura de la base de datos, patrones de diseño. Diseña e implementa las integraciones con sistemas y servicios externos: autenticación, webhooks y procesos asincrónicos. Traduce las historias de usuario y criterios de aceptación del Product Analyst en tareas técnicas concretas y acotadas. Implementa vistas y componentes en React + TypeScript que consumen las APIs que diseña, cerrando la funcionalidad de punta a punta. Resuelve manejo de estado, validaciones de formularios, estados de carga y error del lado cliente. Trabaja sobre el sistema de diseño y las definiciones de UX/UI vigentes Revisa el código antes de aprobarlo (backend y frontend): corrección funcional, seguridad, legibilidad y deuda técnica. Es responsable final de todo lo que se mergea a la rama principal, sin importar cómo se haya generado el código. Implementa personalmente la lógica de negocio central y las integraciones críticas. Incorpora herramientas de IA a su flujo de trabajo donde aportan valor. Ejecuta o supervisa de forma directa los deploys a producción, cambios de seguridad o permisos, migraciones de base de datos, y cualquier cosa que toque datos de clientes, según el marco de trabajo vigente del equipo. Resuelve bugs e incidentes de producción cuando la causa raíz no es evidente o el impacto es crítico. Escribe y mantiene tests automatizados (unitarios y de integración) sobre el código backend que desarrolla. Cubre con tests los componentes de frontend con lógica relevante (no se espera cobertura visual ni de interacción exhaustiva). Aplica buenas prácticas de seguridad en ambas capas: validación de inputs, manejo de credenciales y tokens, control de accesos. Participa de la planificación y estimación de historias junto al PA y el Developer Manager. Trabaja con el PA para asegurar que cada historia tenga el detalle necesario —incluida la definición de interfaz— antes de empezar a implementarla. Requisitos Estudiante avanzado/a o graduado/a de Ingeniería en Sistemas/Informática, Licenciatura en Ciencias de la Computación o afines. 5 años o más de experiencia como desarrollador/a fullstack, con foco en backend JavaScript/TypeScript (Node.js). Frontend-React con TypeScript: componentes funcionales, hooks, manejo de estado, consumo de APIs, formularios y validaciones. Experiencia diseñando y construyendo APIs consumidas por otros equipos o sistemas Experiencia integrando sistemas propios con APIs o servicios de terceros (ideal si incluye organismos, plataformas de comercio exterior/aduanas o proveedores logísticos). Modelado y consulta de datos en bases relacionales (PostgreSQL/MySQL) y, valorable, no relacionales (MongoDB o similar). Muy deseable: Experiencia real en la utilización de herramientas de IA generativa para desarrollo (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code o similares). descripcion: Who We Are SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are. This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically-acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day. SiriusXM Media is the gateway for marketers to the largest digital audio advertising ecosystem in North America. As the combined advertising revenue organization of Sirius XM Holdings Inc., SiriusXM Media spans across leading owned and operated audio platforms Pandora and SiriusXM; innovative ad tech solutions powered by AdsWizz; sonic creative consultancy Studio Resonate; and an extended content network featuring exclusive monetization agreements with Audiochuck, NBCUniversal, SoundCloud, and many more. Reaching more than 150 million listeners each month, SiriusXM Media delivers audiences the tailored brand experiences they crave while putting creators first, making it easy for every marketer to produce, plan, buy and measure across its entire audio universe. How You’ll Make An Impact As a Staff Software Engineer on the Planning team within SiriusXM’s Ad Sales Product Engineering organization, you’ll define and drive the technical direction of our ad buying systems. You’ll architect resilient, cloud-native backend services that power large-scale ad delivery and campaign planning tools across the SiriusXM and Pandora ecosystem. Beyond building systems, you’ll shape engineering practices — leading modernization, scalability, and reliability initiatives that move our ad tech platforms forward. What You’ll Do Lead the design and development of scalable, maintainable services that power ad buying and the complicated parts to it. Architect and evolve the Slingshot platform toward modern and cloud-native paradigms. Drive end-to-end execution — from design and implementation to deployment, monitoring, and performance optimization. Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Data Engineering, DevOps, and SRE to deliver high-impact, integrated ad buying capabilities. Partner with data, UI, billing, and ad trafficking teams to optimize end-to-end ad buying workflows through intelligent automation. Champion observability, reliability, and operational excellence using Datadog, Grafana, and modern CI/CD practices. Mentor engineers across teams, fostering a culture of technical rigor, inclusion, and continuous improvement. Influence long-term architecture and technology strategy, aligning with SiriusXM’s broader ad tech roadmap. What You’ll Need 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2+ years in a Staff or equivalent senior technical leadership role. Expertise in Python (Django, FastAPI, or similar frameworks) and backend architecture (e.g. microservices). Strong foundation in distributed systems and data pipelines, with hands-on experience in Kafka, Celery, or Airflow. Experience with ad serving or delivery platforms (e.g., Google Ad Manager, AdsWizz, Triton). Deep familiarity with AWS, Kubernetes, and infrastructure automation. Proficiency with observability tools (Datadog, Sentry, Grafana) and CI/CD workflows. Demonstrated success leading cross-team technical initiatives, mentoring engineers, and influencing large-scale architecture. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience. Must have legal right to work in the U.S. At SiriusXM, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your background and experience. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We expect the base salary for this position to be in the range of $106,600 to $200,000 and will depend on your skills, qualifications, and experience. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary short-term and long-term incentives. We encourage all interested candidates to apply. Our goal at SiriusXM is to provide and maintain a work environment that fosters mutual respect, professionalism and cooperation. SiriusXM is an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate on the basis of actual or perceived race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, alienage or citizenship status, age, disability or handicap, sex, gender identity, marital status, familial status, veteran status, sexual orientation or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. descripcion: Postúlate en Kit Empleo: kitempleo.com.ar/empleo/vlsap Azumo is currently looking for a highly motivated Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer to develop and enhance our data and analytics infrastructure. The position is FULLY REMOTE , based in Latin America. Professional English proficiency (B2/C1) This position will provide you with the opportunity to collaborate with a dynamic team and talented data scientists in the field of big data analytics and applied AI - If you have a passion for designing and implementing advanced machine learning and deep learning models, particularly in the Generative AI space, this role is perfect for you. We are seeking a skilled professional with expertise in Python for production-level projects, proficiency in machine learning and deep learning techniques such as CNNs and Transformers , and hands-on experience working with PyTorch We're looking for a versatile Machine Learning Engineer / Data Scientist to join our big-data analytics team. In this hybrid role you'll not only design and prototype novel ML/DL models , but also productionize them end-to-end, integrating your solutions into our data pipelines and services. You'll work closely with data engineers, software developers and product owners to ensure high-quality, scalable, maintainable systems. Key Responsibilities Model Development & Productionization Design, train, and validate supervised and unsupervised models (e.g., anomaly detection, classification, forecasting). Architect and implement deep learning solutions (CNNs, Transformers) with PyTorch Develop and fine-tune Large Language Models (LLMs) and build LLM-driven applications. Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and integrate with vector databases. Build robust pipelines to deploy models at scale ( Docker , Kubernetes , CI/CD ). Data Engineering & MLOps Ingest, clean and transform large datasets using libraries like pandas , NumPy , and Spark Automate training and serving workflows with Airflow or similar orchestration tools. Monitor model performance in production; iterate on drift detection and retraining strategies. Implement LLMOps practices for automated testing, evaluation, and monitoring of LLMs. Software Development Best Practices Write production-grade Python code following SOLID principles, unit tests and code reviews. Collaborate in Agile (Scrum) ceremonies; track work in JIRA Document architecture and workflows using PlantUML or comparable tools. Cross-Functional Collaboration Communicate analysis, design and results clearly in English. Partner with DevOps, data engineering and product teams to align on requirements and SLAs. About Azumo Based in San Francisco, California, Azumo is an innovative software development firm specializing in AI software development services - We help companies of all sizes build intelligent applications by combining expertise in data, cloud, and AI - Our talented AI developers are trusted to deliver Top AI Development services in Generative AI , intelligent automation, and custom machine learning solutions. Our culture emphasizes collaboration, continuous learning, and solving complex problems with modern AI solutions. We believe in giving back to our community and will volunteer our time to philanthropy, open-source initiatives and sharing our knowledge. Solid background in machine learning & deep learning ( CNNs , Transformers , LLMs ). Hands-on experience with PyTorch or similar frameworks (training, custom modules, optimization). Proven track record deploying ML solutions Expert in pandas , NumPy and scikit-learn Familiarity with Agile/Scrum practices and tooling ( JIRA , Confluence ). Strong foundation in statistics and experimental design. Excellent written and spoken English. Preferred Qualifications Experience with cloud platforms ( AWS , GCP , or Azure ) and their AI-specific services like Amazon SageMaker , Google Vertex AI , or Azure Machine Learning Familiarity with big-data ecosystems ( Spark , Hadoop ). Practice in CI/CD & container orchestration ( Jenkins/GitLab CI , Docker , Kubernetes ). Exposure to MLOps/LLMOps tools ( MLflow , Kubeflow , TFX ). Experience with Large Language Models , Generative AI , prompt engineering , and RAG pipelines Hands-on experience with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone , FAISS ). Experience building AI Agents and using frameworks like Hugging Face Transformers , LangChain or LangGraph Documentation skills using PlantUML or similar.
