descripcion: Job Description Ingram Content Group (ICG) is hiring an Industrial Engineer to contribute to our Engineering team in La Vergne, TN . The Industrial Engineer will provide Industrial Engineering services and partner with distribution and manufacturing operations, logistics, and IT to ensure continuous process improvements related to safety, quality, productivity, and manufacturing costs. They will support plant operations through the design, development, testing, and evaluation of basic integrated systems for managing product distribution systems & print-on-demand processes including productivity measurement, human work factors, inventory control, logistics, material flow, cost analysis, and production coordination. Want to join a key team that helps the world read? At Ingram, the Engineering team serves a key role within the organization. We ensure that our distribution centers and warehouse facilities function at maximum efficiency. Safety is a core value in our operations environment. We emphasize this through training, education and accident prevention programs. Process Improvement is another core value, and through innovations such as voice and Radio Frequency (RF) technologies, as well as feedback from our associates, we work toward constant improvement. The world is reading, and it is our goal to connect as many people to the content they want in the simplest ways. If you want to be part of a customer-centric team that strives for excellence, collaboration, innovation, we can’t wait to meet you! Required Qualifications: Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or a related technical degree. 2 years in a manufacturing or distribution environment. 2 years experience with new layouts, material handling, PLCs or process improvements. 2 years experience in AutoCAD computer software. 1 year experience in SolidWorks or other 3D computer software Preferred Skills: 2-5 yrs experience in an engineering role in a manufacturing or distribution environment Holds strong communication skills and the ability to build cross-departmental partnerships Key Responsibilities: Participates in cross-functional teams to deliver and coordinate multiple projects including basic feasibility studies, multi-option production expansion analysis, capital project justifications and other analyses. Participates in the design efforts for new and revised products, processes, systems, and technologies that drive efficiencies and cost savings. Executes new programs/projects that enhance performance or increases capabilities for the business. Contributes to the planning and development of engineering strategy and provides technical advice. Executes lean project initiatives including defining scope, design criteria, budgets, resource needs, and establishing and managing the project schedule. Travels to various sites to lead the installation of new systems. Travels to various vendors as needed to evaluate new applications of technology. Communicates study results and makes recommendations to management. Hiring Salary Range: $84,895k - $107,643k. This range represents the anticipated low and high end of the salary for this position. It will be determined by factors including but not limited to: the applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, geographic location, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. Additional Information Perks/Benefits: A highly competitive compensation package with generous benefits beginning first day of employment for Medical/Prescription Drug plans, HSA, Vision, Dental and Health Care FSA. 15 vacation days & 12 sick days accrued annually and 3 personal days 401K match, Life and AD&D, Employee Assistant programs, Group Legal, & more Wellness program with access to onsite gym and basketball court for associates Encouraged continued education with our tuition reimbursement program Financial and in-kind opportunities to engage with non-profits in your community Company match program for United Way donations Volunteer opportunities and in-kind drives for non-profits throughout the year Take breaks or brainstorm in our game room with ping pong & foosball Casual Dress Code The world is reading, and Ingram Content Group (“Ingram”) connects people with content in all forms. descripcion: About Parexel Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere. We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose -- moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart(R). About The Role We are seeking a Scientist, Precision Medicine / Bioinformatics (Quantitative Biomarker Sciences) to join our team in a remote capacity. As a Bioinformatics Scientist, you will support clinical research activities that advance new treatments for patients. This position plays a key role in biomarker data analysis, pipeline automation, data quality oversight, and cross-study data integration. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams, follow industry-standard processes and regulated practices, and contribute to study operations from planning through data delivery. Responsibilities include executing well-defined analytical requests, maintaining data processing pipelines, performing quality control checks, building interactive data visualization tools, and supporting AI-assisted analysis code development. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, this role offers pathways to deepen your expertise in precision medicine, biomarker science, and bioinformatics while making a meaningful impact on clinical research outcomes. Key Responsibilities Execute data analysis and visualization tasks with minimal supervision, including figure and analysis updates, pipeline execution, data quality control, and results delivery Run and optimize automated data processing pipelines, perform routine quality control on outputs, document run parameters and versions, and generate analytical outputs Build and refresh interactive data viewers using RMarkdown, Quarto, or Shiny for single-study and cross-study data exploration; package and publish outputs in agreed team formats Support cross-study database integration activities including data collation, standardization, variable mapping, identifier harmonization, and validation Contribute to experiment preparation activities such as generating balanced sample layouts and coordinating downstream submission steps Maintain a reusable library of prompts, code snippets, and workflows for common bioinformatics tasks; establish coding standards and provide guidance on strict compliance practices Proficiency in Python and Bash scripting for data processing and automation Familiarity with AI tools and the ability to quickly learn emerging technologies Experience with proteomic data analysis Proficiency with version control tools (Git/GitHub) and experience following SOPs in regulated environments Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills Preferred Qualifications Master's degree in Bioinformatics, Computer Science, Computational Biology, or related field Experience with Olink proteomic platform or other high-dimensional biomarker technologies Knowledge of cardiovascular, metabolic, immunology, hematology, oncology, renal, neurodegenerative, or rare genetic disease research Familiarity with basic statistical modeling fundamentals (linear/logistic models, survival analysis, multiple testing correction) Experience with Claude Code and other AI-assisted development tools Benefits And Compensation We offer a comprehensive benefits package to eligible employees. descripcion: Overview This job contributes to REI’s success by supporting engineered labor standards (ELS), labor management systems, and process design and optimization across the distribution center network. This role partners closely with distribution center leadership to ensure labor standards are accurate, sustainable, and aligned with operational best practices. This role serves as a trusted thought partner to DC Operations, Production Control (PC), Continuous Improvement (CI), and cross-functional stakeholders. This role is responsible for leading the design, deployment, and governance of engineered labor standards (ELS), optimizing labor management systems (LMS), and architecting solutions that enhance productivity, reduce cost, and improve the team member experience at scale. Models and acts in accordance with REI’s guiding values and mission. Responsibilities And Qualifications Develop standard work instructions with DC Operations teams to ensure validity and team member alignment. Support the development, validation, and maintenance of engineered labor standards (ELS) using time studies, historical data, and predetermined time systems (e.g., MOST, MSD, MTM). Detect gaps between observed time and labor standards, and develops key insights to improve productivity. Serve as the technical SME for LMS integrations, performance tracking, and labor standard configurations in partnership with CI, operations, and Warehouse Management Systems IT (WMIT). Collaborate with DC Operations, LMS Analyst, and Warehouse Functional Analysts to ensure labor standards are integrated into Labor Management Systems (LMS) and used effectively for performance tracking Conduct performance audits and observations to identify deviations from standards and drive corrective action or refinement. Analyze and evaluate methods for optimal operations. Outline alternatives for processes, equipment, and system design Provide analytical decision support using core Industrial Engineering skills, mathematical tools, modeling and computational methods for system analysis, evaluation, and optimization Develop and standardize network-wide processes and best practices that improve throughput, labor efficiency, and safety while reducing operational variability. Collect data and perform complex data analysis to understand current state conditions that will be used to drive continuous improvement ideas, capacity analysis, cost/benefit analysis, and change initiatives and projects. Develops knowledge of DC best practices and engineering standards. Leverages best practices and engineering standards in the development of engineered labor standards to reduce variation in measured tasks. Utilize existing AutoCAD layouts to support XYZ data mapping for warehouse travel calculations. Performs machine speed testing that involves timing various pieces of equipment horizonal, vertical, and turning speeds. Utilizes project management methodologies to manage labor standards refreshes. Work closely with LMS Analyst to develop LM tool and reports to enable leadership to quickly and accurately track and assess performance. Required Skills: 8+ years of Industrial Engineering or Manufacturing experience 2+ years using Manhattan Associates Labor Management software or similar labor management software Bachelor’s degree in industrial engineering or Manufacturing Engineering Certification in one or more predetermined time systems, preferably MOST or MTM Experience developing and implementing engineered labor standards and LMS integrations across multi-site operations Prior experience with Distribution/Fulfillment center environment Preferred Skills: Project management certification (PMP) or equivalent job experience Lean Six Sigma certification or demonstrated application of structured problem-solving methodologies. Proficiency with AutoCAD and SQL Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Excel and statistical tools Closing At REI, we believe the outdoors is for all. We are committed to becoming a fully inclusive, anti-racist, multicultural organization. We know that there's strength in our diversity – that each employee brings unique skills, experiences, and perspectives. Every day you are driving change, fostering a culture of respect, and knowing you're backed by benefits that support your whole life. To work towards this commitment and fulfill our brand promise of inspiring and enabling a life outside for everyone, we seek employees who demonstrate different ways of working, create a sense of belonging, and actively listen and learn. Pay Transparency We are committed to practices that promote pay equity and transparency. As required by applicable Pay Transparency laws, REI provides a range of compensation for roles that may be hired in locations under these requirements. Factors that may be used to determine your actual salary may include a wide array of factors, including: your specific skills and experience, geographic location or other relevant factors. REI offers all regular employees a generous employee discount, access to health benefits, a retirement savings plan and accrued time off. descripcion: Get To Know Us Mill Rock Packaging (MRP) is a growing U.S.-based packaging company and a market leader in designing, engineering, and producing high-end, sustainable, and customized graphic paperboard, folding carton, and commercial printing products. We serve customers across industries like food and beverage, technology, health and beauty, pharmaceuticals, and more. What sets us apart? Our culture is built on five core behaviors that guide everything we do: Lead with Safety – We put people first, always. Build Trust – We keep our promises and act with integrity. Innovate and Be Resilient – We embrace challenges and create solutions that raise the bar. Include and Collaborate – We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger. Raise the Bar – We strive for excellence in every detail. If you’re looking for a place where these values aren’t just words but actions, you’ll feel right at home here. Curious? Learn more at http://www.millrockpackaging.com! How You'll Make An Impact As a Material Planner , you’ll be based in-person and help ensure our plants have the right materials available at the right time to support production, service, and customer commitments. In this role, you’ll partner closely with Procurement, Operations, Production Planning, Customer Service, and site teams to monitor material needs, support inventory planning, resolve supply issues, and help strengthen the flow of materials across the business. What You’ll Do Plan, coordinate, and monitor material availability to support plant production schedules and customer needs. Partner with Procurement, Production Planning, Operations, Customer Service, and site leaders to understand material requirements, priorities, and potential constraints. Review demand, inventory levels, supplier lead times, and production needs to identify potential shortages, overages, or timing concerns. Support purchase planning and follow-up activities to help ensure materials are ordered, delivered, and available when needed. Communicate proactively with internal stakeholders regarding material status, risks, changes, and issue resolution. Maintain accurate planning, inventory, and material-related information in company systems. Help identify process improvements that strengthen material flow, reduce disruptions, and improve service to internal and external customers. Basic Qualifications What it takes to succeed: High school diploma or equivalent required; additional education or training in supply chain, business, operations, logistics, or a related field preferred. Experience in material planning, procurement, buying, inventory management, production planning, customer service planning, or a related manufacturing support role. Strong understanding of manufacturing, plant operations, production flow, or internal business processes. Ability to analyze information, manage priorities, follow up on details, and solve problems in a fast-paced environment. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across functions and locations. Proficiency with Microsoft Office and the ability to learn and use planning, purchasing, inventory, or ERP systems. Preferred Requirements We value diverse experiences and perspectives—they help us innovate every day. While these qualifications are preferred, they’re not required: Prior experience as a Material Planner, Buyer, Buyer/Planner, Procurement Specialist, Production Planner, or similar supply chain role. Experience working in a manufacturing environment, ideally within packaging, paperboard, folding carton, printing, or a related industry. Familiarity with supplier lead times, inventory planning, material requirements planning, and production scheduling concepts. Internal knowledge of Mill Rock Packaging plants, processes, products, customers, or systems. Interest in growing into a broader supply chain, procurement, or planning career path. Why You’ll Love Working Here Our Culture: We’re stronger together. Safety comes first, and we believe our people, customers, and investors are the foundation of our success. Collaboration and respect drive everything we do. Competitive Compensation: Your base pay will reflect factors like market location, experience, and skills. Many roles also include performance bonuses as part of the total compensation package. Benefits That Matter: We offer a full range of benefits designed to support you and your family, including: Medical, dental, and vision insurance Paid Time Off (PTO) and company holidays 401(k) with employer match Short-term and long-term disability insurance Life insurance …and more! descripcion: Postúlate en Kit Empleo: kitempleo.com.ar/empleo/vn3g6 Manager, Clinical Data Scientist, Clinical Data Sciences We’re in relentless pursuit of breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. We innovate every day to make the world a healthier place. To fully realize Pfizer’s purpose – Breakthroughs that change patients’ lives – we have established a clear set of expectations regarding “what” we need to achieve for patients and “how” we will go about achieving those goals. Pfizer Research & Development serves as the beating heart of Pfizer's trailblazing product pipeline, the essence of our mission to bring life‑changing medicines to the world. Pfizer offers competitive compensation and benefits programs designed to meet the diverse needs of our colleagues. Application Instructions: Please submit your resume in English when applying. Work Location Assignment: Buenos Aires, Argentina (Complejo LUMINA – Office Park). This role follows a hybrid model. Colleagues are expected to work from the assigned Pfizer office 2–3 days per week, or as required by business needs. What You Will Achieve In this role, you will: - Serve as Clinical Data Scientist and Trial Lead for one or more clinical trials, assuming responsibility for all CDS activities including selection and application of data acquisition standards, Data Management Plan, selection of quality risk indicators, and third‑party study data due diligence. - Serve as a technical resource to the study teams for DM and RBM standards, tools, data provisioning, and reporting. - Partner with Research/Business Units, external DM service providers and internal CDS staff to deliver high‑quality data management for all studies as assigned. - Proactively drive quality and efficiency to meet timeline and milestones for data management, ensuring scientific and operational excellence in support of strategic imperatives and in collaboration with the cross‑functional study team(s). - Ensure work carried out by or on behalf of CDS is in accordance with applicable SOPs and working practices. - Participate in and ensure quality database design including documentation, testing and implementation of clinical data collection tools, both CRF and non‑CRF, using an electronic data capture (EDC) system and/or other data collection systems. - Ensure the required study‑specific CDS documents in the Trial Master File (TMF) are of high quality and are filed contemporaneously. - Ensure operational excellence in collaboration with partners for application of standards, data acquisition, proactive data review and data integrity monitoring, data cleaning, e‑data processing, data access and visualization, and database release. Here Is What You Need (Minimum Requirements) - Demonstrated successful experience in all relevant clinical data management activities in a Biopharmaceutical or CRO setting. - Working knowledge of all phases of clinical trials and ability to assess and determine study requirements from protocol review. - Strong project and risk management skills; CRO and vendor oversight experience preferred. - Strong verbal and written communication skills; consistent, detail‑oriented, communicative, and dedicated to doing a job well done. - Minimum 5 years of Data Management experience. - Working knowledge of clinical research, FDA & ICH, GCP, GCDMP, and related regulatory requirements. - Proficient experience using commercial clinical data management systems and/or EDC products (Oracle RDC / Inform preferred). - Experience using relational databases (e.g., MS SQL Server, MS Access, or Oracle) and data visualization tools (e.g., Spotfire, jReview). - Familiarity with MedDRA/WHO‑Drug. - Proficiency in the use of Microsoft Office Suite of tools (Outlook, Word, Excel, etc.). - Bachelor’s degree required; degree in a scientific field preferred; Master’s degree preferred. Bonus Points If You Have (Preferred Requirements) - Master’s degree. - Contract Research Organization (CRO) and vendor oversight experience. - Proficient in using commercial clinical data management systems and/or EDC products. - Ability to adapt to changing priorities and manage multiple projects simultaneously. - Strong interpersonal skills and ability to build relationships with stakeholders. - Experience using common AI tools, including generative technologies such as ChatGPT or Microsoft Copilot, to support problem solving and enhance productivity. Demonstrated curiosity for exploring how these tools can improve outcomes and understanding of responsible AI practices, including risk management and ethical use. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, designing scalable backend systems, and taking ownership of software from initial requirements through production operations. You will help build and improve services across our platform including customer operations, billing, notifications, document management, reporting, and third-party integrations. Location & Reporting Location: Fort Lauderdale, FL Department: Software Engineering Employment Type: Full-time, on-site Reports to: Director of Software Engineering NO VISA SPONSORSHIP AVAILABLE Key Responsibilities Design, develop, test, and maintain backend services and APIs. Build scalable Python applications using Fast API or similar frameworks. Design event-driven workflows using Kafka and asynchronous processing. Develop reliable integrations with satellite providers and other external platforms. Create clear API contracts and maintain technical documentation. Strong understanding of object-oriented design and software architecture. Strong Python development experience. Experience building production APIs and backend services. Experience with asynchronous and event-driven architectures. Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL. Experience writing efficient SQL and troubleshooting data-related issues. Experience with Docker and containerized applications. Experience working with Kubernetes-based production environments. Familiarity with cloud platforms, preferably Google Cloud Platform. Strong understanding of API security, authentication, and authorization. Experience troubleshooting production systems. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical teams. descripcion: Unimacts Global is a contract manufacturer and total energy solutions provider operating across renewable energy, traditional energy, and diversified industrial markets. Our manufacturing capabilities span structural steel, tubes, piles, complex castings, forgings, and sophisticated engineered systems. With operations across the U.S., EU, and Asia, we manufacture and deliver the components that keep energy and industrial infrastructure moving at scale. Unimacts Global is a subsidiary of Zetwerk, a global manufacturing platform backed by leading institutional investors. The Continuous Improvement Engineer owns the identification, prioritization, and execution of process improvement initiatives across steel fabrication operations at the Sloan, NV facility. This role is responsible for driving measurable gains in productivity, quality, and cost across solar pile and galvanized tubing product lines using Lean, Six Sigma, and Kaizen methodologies. Success is measured by validated cost savings, OEE improvement, scrap reduction, and the sustainability of implemented changes. Business Context Unimacts Global operates high-volume steel fabrication for solar infrastructure and structural tubing markets. The Sloan facility must scale production capacity while maintaining cost discipline in preparation for enterprise growth and market expansion. This role exists to build a disciplined, data-driven continuous improvement function that turns one-time fixes into standardized, sustained operational gains. Key Operational Expectations Lead data analysis, interpretation and inference of key operational data metrics across all departments. Report plant performance daily as an executive summary Conduct root cause analysis on quality defects, downtime, and scrap using DMAIC, 5-Why, and fishbone methods Develop systems and processes to digitalize on-ground operations in terms of inventory management, engineering and maintenance management Track OEE, scrap rate, cycle time, and cost-per-unit metrics, and build the improvement pipeline from data trends Apply 5S and visual management systems on the shop floor and audit sustainment after implementation Build the business case, financial justification, and ROI tracking for improvement projects and capital requests Train and coach production supervisors and operators on Lean tools and problem-solving methods Report savings, project status, and improvement roadmap to Plant Manager and leadership on a recurring cadence Spearhead all new projects and improvements in the plant Develop a technical and financial feasibility study for NPI requests from customers Develop process automations for communication, workflow and optimize communication and information flow in the factory Propose chains of command, PFMEA and PFD for the most efficient state of operations Analyze common defects and work with Quality to ensure recurrence prevention in an engineering way Decision Authority This role owns the continuous improvement pipeline end to end, from opportunity identification through implementation and sustainment audit. The Continuous Improvement Engineer is accountable for delivering validated results, not simply recommending changes. Budget authority for equipment and capital remains with the Plant Manager, but this role drives the technical justification, savings validation, and ROI analysis. Cross-Functional Interfaces Plant Manager: Improvement priority setting, capacity planning, capital project prioritization Production Supervisors: Kaizen participation, standard work deployment, sustainment of improvement changes Quality: Joint root cause analysis on defects, process validation, inspection criteria alignment Engineering & Maintenance: Equipment reliability data, downtime root cause, preventive maintenance alignment to process capability Inventory: Work with the inventory management team and analyze root cause(s) of data discrepancy, propose and implement corrective and preventive actions Operations: Minimize/eliminate the waste in the plant to maximize streamlined process flow in the factory. Develop SOPs, WI, best practices and resource optimization. Requirements 5-7 years of continuous improvement or manufacturing engineering experience in steel fabrication, metal forming, or welding operations Demonstrated track record of leading Lean or Six Sigma projects with quantified cost, quality, or throughput results Working knowledge of fabrication equipment (CNC cutting, press brake, welding cells, galvanizing lines) Proficiency in MS Dynamics or similar ERP systems, plus statistical analysis tools (Minitab or equivalent) for data-driven decision making Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, GD&T, and weld symbols Strong facilitation and influencing skills, with experience driving change through supervisors and operators who do not report to this role Hands-on problem solver comfortable spending the majority of the workday on the production floor Six Sigma Green Belt certification required; Black Belt preferred Must be able to lift 20 pounds with one hand Must work in extreme in temperatures, cold and heat Stand 5-6 hour per day Stay on the production floor - this is not a "desk job." The Continuous Improvement Engineer partners with cross-functional teams to identify, analyze, and implement process improvements that enhance safety, quality, delivery, cost, and operational efficiency. This role applies Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement methodologies to eliminate waste, optimize processes, and drive sustainable operational excellence. By leveraging data, structured problem-solving, and collaboration, the Continuous Improvement Engineer supports strategic initiatives that improve productivity, standardize best practices, and strengthen overall business performance. What You Will Do Lead and support continuous improvement initiatives that improve safety, quality, delivery, cost, and operational performance. Analyze manufacturing processes and operational data to identify opportunities for waste reduction, productivity improvements, and process optimization. Apply Lean Manufacturing and structured problem-solving methodologies, including Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping, 5S, A3, PDCA, DMAIC, and Root Cause Analysis, to drive sustainable improvements. Manage continuous improvement projects from planning through implementation, ensuring objectives, timelines, and deliverables are achieved. Develop and maintain process documentation, standard work, visual management tools, project reports, and performance metrics to support operational excellence. Collaborate with Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Maintenance, Engineering, and Operations teams to implement process improvements, standardize best practices, and support organizational change. Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), validate improvement results, and provide recommendations for ongoing optimization. Coach and support employees in the application of Lean principles and continuous improvement methodologies to foster a culture of operational excellence. Up to 10% travel. Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, evaluate opportunities, and implement effective solutions. Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate and build relationships across all levels of the organization. Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering solutions that support both internal and external stakeholders. descripcion: Data Collection & Integrations Engineer Extract Singular is a marketing intelligence platform that unifies marketing analytics, giving marketers actionable insights from previously siloed data. By connecting marketing, attribution, and business data across platforms, Singular helps companies understand performance and make better decisions with their data. Our next generation of products goes beyond marketing measurement. Extract is Singular’s data movement platform, built to help companies reliably collect, transform, and move data between the tools and systems they use every day. Singular works with some of the world’s leading companies, including Uber, Lyft, Airbnb, LinkedIn, Rovio, and Warner Bros. Singular is backed by Norwest Venture Partners, General Catalyst, Thomvest Ventures, Method Capital, Translink Capital, DCM, and Telstra Ventures. About the Role We are looking for a strong Data Collection & Integrations Engineer to join the Extract team and help build the infrastructure and integrations that power our data platform. descripcion: Description Senior Transformation Analyst Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress. Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring together talented experts across a broad spectrum of business critical corporate functions. Every role plays an essential part in enabling our customers to achieve their goals. Our teams are agile, collaborative, and committed to delivering—for each other, for our customers, and ultimately for the people who rely on the services we support. Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know: Why Syneos Health We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program. We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life. We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress. Job Responsibilities Build and maintain dashboards and reports to track key performance indicators (KPIs) related to enterprise transformation efforts. Maintain predictive models from disparate datasets to support strategic decisions such as revenue burn analysis, employee turnover, and headcount forecasting. Support the design of executive-level reporting packs, surfacing relevant trends and data insights. Analyze workforce, cost, and operational data to uncover drivers of performance and areas of opportunity. Partner with Finance and People teams to ensure consistent use of data and alignment on core business metrics. Support business case development through financial modeling, ROI calculations, and comparative analysis of options and outcomes to inform strategic decision-making. Assist in maintaining standardized data models and definitions across multiple data sources and teams. Contribute to scenario modeling and ad-hoc analysis to inform strategic decisions. Ensure data integrity and consistency across reporting outputs. Communicate findings in a clear and compelling way, both visually and verbally. Expert utilization of Powerpoint and Excel. Comfortable presenting data outcomes and trends to executive leaders. Get to know Syneos Health Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients. No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. This position partners with cross-functional teams—including Finance, People, and Operational Excellence—to support the delivery of impactful reporting, dashboard development, and conducting analysis aligned with enterprise priorities such as cost optimization, productivity, and headcount planning. The analyst ensures that data is accurate, accessible, and actionable, serving as a foundational resource for enabling effective business insights and alignment. Show more Show less

descripcion: Introduction At IBM Software, we transform client challenges into solutions. Building the world’s leading AI-powered, cloud-native products that shape the future of business and society. Our legacy of innovation creates endless opportunities for IBMers to learn, grow, and make an impact on a global scale. Working in Software means joining a team fueled by curiosity and collaboration. You’ll work with diverse technologies, partners, and industries to design, develop, and deliver solutions that power digital transformation. With a culture that values innovation, growth, and continuous learning, IBM Software places you at the heart of IBM’s product and technology landscape. Here, you’ll have the tools and opportunities to advance your career while creating software that changes the world. Your Role And Responsibilities Confluent is pioneering a fundamentally new category of data infrastructure focused on data in motion. Have you ever found a new favorite series on Netflix, picked up groceries curbside at Walmart, or paid for something using Square? That’s the power of data in motion in action—giving organizations instant access to the massive amounts of data that is constantly flowing throughout their business. At Confluent, we’re building the foundational platform for this new paradigm of data infrastructure. Our cloud-native offering is designed to be the intelligent connective tissue enabling real-time data, from multiple sources, to constantly stream across the organization. With Confluent, organizations can create a central nervous system to innovate and win in a digital-first world. We’re looking for self-motivated team members who crave a challenge and feel energized to roll up their sleeves and help realize Confluent’s enormous potential. Chart your own path and take healthy risks as we solve big problems together. We value having diverse teams and want you to grow as we grow—whether you’re just starting out in your career or managing a large team, you’ll be amazed at the magnitude of your impact. About The Team The mission of the Data Science team at Confluent is to serve as the central nervous system of all things data for the company: we build infrastructure, metrics, insights, and models. Our team of data scientists is dedicated to designing and deploying advanced data solutions that enable organizations across the globe harness the power of real-time data. We focus on driving actionable insights and optimizing business outcomes across our customers’ data ecosystems. Our outputs enable data-driven thinking and help optimize every part of the business. There are limitless opportunities for an ambitious data scientist to make an immediate and meaningful impact within our high-growth company. About The Role As a Senior Data Scientist at Confluent, you will be a key player in helping define the product roadmap and driving revenue growth at Confluent. You will collaborate with our Product team and cross-functional partners across the organization. You will use data and analysis to identify and solve challenges, unlocking growth and adoption across our suite of products. This role requires a strong blend of technical skills, strategic thinking and leadership skills to influence strategy and investment decisions. What You Will Do Own prioritization for your domain and collaborate with product managers, engineers, marketing leads, and other stakeholders to define the data science roadmap for your product area Work across the org to define and measure success metrics for new features and initiatives Utilize data to uncover trends, identify opportunities for growth, drive strategic product decisions, and shape product roadmaps Apply technical expertise with quantitative analysis, experimentation, data mining, and the presentation of data to improve product experience Share actionable insights and recommendations with leadership at various levels, playing a pivotal role in determining Product strategy Collaborate with other data scientists across our organization to share best practices, learn new analytical techniques, and champion an organizational culture where data is central to decision making Peer review teammates’ work and provide feedback, working to upskill more junior team members Preferred Education Master's Degree Required Technical And Professional Expertise 5+ years of experience in Data Science/Analytics Strong proficiency in data manipulation with data querying languages (e.g. SQL) and scripting languages (e.g. Python) Experience with A/B testing and experiment best practices Excellent communication skills, and ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and build relationships at all levels of the organization Preferred Technical And Professional Experience Experience in SaaS/Product-led Growth companies Exceptional problem solving skills and analytical skills Proficiency in data visualization and building dashboards with tools such as Tableau Experience and knowledge of causal inference, machine learning and other advanced analytical methods Show more Show less

descripcion: Manager, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) Baltimore, MD (Hybrid) or Remote, U.S. │ Finance │ Full-Time About Zerofox ZeroFox protects what's real by removing what isn't. We steadfastly safeguard organizations from fraud, abuse, misinformation, and attack by preemptively exposing, disrupting, and eliminating external threats across the public attack surface — because when people can't tell what's real, they stop trusting everything. ZeroFox uniquely fuses Cyber Threat Intelligence, Brand and Domain Protection, Attack Surface Intelligence, Executive Protection, and Physical Security Intelligence in one platform packed with intelligence you'll actually use. Our continuous cycle — Discover, Validate, Disrupt — helps thousands of customers worldwide, including leaders in finance, media, technology, retail, healthcare, and government, reduce risk, accelerate response, and defend their world. We're growing fast, investing deeply in AI, and building a team of people who are serious about results and never take themselves too seriously. If you're ready to take the fight to the adversary, come defend your world with us. What Zerofox Will Look Like To You This role sits inside a finance function that runs on private-equity discipline — every forecast gets stress-tested, every number has to hold up under board and sponsor review. You'd be joining at a moment when SaaS metrics like ARR, NRR, and CAC aren't just tracked, they're the language leadership uses to make real decisions. The Manager, FP&A seat is where financial rigor turns into actual influence over how the business runs. THE ROLE You'll own the monthly forecast and annual budget process end-to-end — building the model, defending the variance, and turning "the numbers moved" into a clear answer for why and what happens next. You'll build and maintain the operating model, board reporting package, and PE sponsor deliverables, and you'll be the person tracking the SaaS metrics — ARR, NRR/GRR, CAC, LTV, and departmental unit economics — that tell leadership whether the business is actually working. You'll partner directly with functional leaders on department-level forecasts, hold the line on budget accountability, and support the CFO on ad hoc analysis: pricing decisions, headcount planning, deal economics, scenario modeling. You'll work closely with Accounting to keep forecast and actuals talking to each other, and you'll have real license to improve the FP&A tech stack as ZeroFox scales — less time reconciling spreadsheets, more time on analysis that changes decisions. THE REALITY YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF... You want ownership of real numbers, not a seat that just reports on them You can build a model once and defend it in front of a board or a PE sponsor without flinching You translate SaaS performance into the language a private equity sponsor expects — not just what the metrics are, but what they mean You've actually used AI tools like Claude, Copilot, or ChatGPT to speed up modeling and reporting, not just talked about wanting to You can run budgeting, forecasting, and board cycles at the same time without letting one slip THIS PROBABLY ISN'T FOR YOU IF... You need the model handed to you — this role builds it from scratch You're looking for a reporting-only seat; this role expects you to hold functional leaders accountable to their budget You want a forecast cycle that's slow and consensus-driven — this one moves fast and belongs to you You think "good enough" is fine for board reporting — sponsor-grade means every number holds up to scrutiny THE TOOLKIT You'll Need To Bring 5+ years of FP&A experience, including time at a SaaS or subscription-based company Direct experience reporting into a PE-backed or PE-owned finance organization Advanced financial modeling skills — you build models other people can actually follow and audit Fluency in SaaS metrics and the ability to explain what they mean, not just report them Would Love, But We Won't Hold It Against You Experience with FP&A and ERP tooling (NetSuite, Adaptive Insights, Anaplan, or similar) Sharp Excel/Google Sheets skills, plus comfort with SQL or BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI) Hands-on experience using AI tools (Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar) to speed up modeling, analysis, and reporting Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field; MBA, CPA, or CFA a plus The Other Stuff Compensation range: $125,000 – $145,000 base + $10,000 bonus. We innovate every day to make the world a healthier place. To fully realize Pfizer's purpose – Breakthroughs that change patients' lives – we have established a clear set of expectations regarding "what" we need to achieve for patients and "how" we will go about achieving those goals. Pfizer Research & Development serves as the beating heart of Pfizer's trailblazing product pipeline, the essence of our mission to bring life‐changing medicines to the world. Pfizer offers competitive compensation and benefits programs designed to meet the diverse needs of our colleagues. Application Instructions: Please submit your resume in English when applying. Work Location Assignment: Buenos Aires, Argentina (Complejo LUMINA – Office Park). This role follows a hybrid model. Colleagues are expected to work from the assigned Pfizer office 2–3 days per week, or as required by business needs. What You Will Achieve In this role, you will: Serve as Clinical Data Scientist and Trial Lead for one or more clinical trials, assuming responsibility for all CDS activities including selection and application of data acquisition standards, Data Management Plan, selection of quality risk indicators, and third‐party study data due diligence. Serve as a technical resource to the study teams for DM and RBM standards, tools, data provisioning, and reporting. Partner with Research/Business Units, external DM service providers and internal CDS staff to deliver high‐quality data management for all studies as assigned. Proactively drive quality and efficiency to meet timeline and milestones for data management, ensuring scientific and operational excellence in support of strategic imperatives and in collaboration with the cross‐functional study team(s). Ensure work carried out by or on behalf of CDS is in accordance with applicable SOPs and working practices. Participate in and ensure quality database design including documentation, testing and implementation of clinical data collection tools, both CRF and non‐CRF, using an electronic data capture (EDC) system and/or other data collection systems. Ensure the required study‐specific CDS documents in the Trial Master File (TMF) are of high quality and are filed contemporaneously. Ensure operational excellence in collaboration with partners for application of standards, data acquisition, proactive data review and data integrity monitoring, data cleaning, e‐data processing, data access and visualization, and database release. Here Is What You Need (Minimum Requirements) Demonstrated successful experience in all relevant clinical data management activities in a Biopharmaceutical or CRO setting. Working knowledge of all phases of clinical trials and ability to assess and determine study requirements from protocol review. Strong project and risk management skills; CRO and vendor oversight experience preferred. Strong verbal and written communication skills; consistent, detail‐oriented, communicative, and dedicated to doing a job well done. Minimum 5 years of Data Management experience. Working knowledge of clinical research, FDA & ICH, GCP, GCDMP, and related regulatory requirements. Proficient experience using commercial clinical data management systems and/or EDC products (Oracle RDC / Inform preferred). Experience using relational databases (e.g., MS SQL Server, MS Access, or Oracle) and data visualization tools (e.g., Spotfire, jReview). Familiarity with MedDRA/WHO‐Drug. Proficiency in the use of Microsoft Office Suite of tools (Outlook, Word, Excel, etc.). Bachelor's degree required; degree in a scientific field preferred; Master's degree preferred. Bonus Points If You Have (Preferred Requirements) Master's degree. Contract Research Organization (CRO) and vendor oversight experience. Proficient in using commercial clinical data management systems and/or EDC products. Ability to adapt to changing priorities and manage multiple projects simultaneously. Strong interpersonal skills and ability to build relationships with stakeholders. Experience using common AI tools, including generative technologies such as ChatGPT or Microsoft Copilot, to support problem solving and enhance productivity. Demonstrated curiosity for exploring how these tools can improve outcomes and understanding of responsible AI practices, including risk management and ethical use. EEO (Equal Employment Opportunity) & Employment Eligibility Pfizer is committed to equal opportunity in the terms and conditions of employment for all employees and job applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, or disability. Providing technology solutions and passenger transportation services for complex ground environments and projects is the company's primary focus. Role Description In the capacity of an AI Quality Engineer, you are responsible for architecting and managing the intelligent systems that uphold our platform's integrity. Moving beyond manual verification, you will engineer agentic processes and automated solutions to create, sustain, and evaluate test scenarios, while proactively identifying potential issues through production monitoring. By merging LLM capabilities with our core technology—including Python test Suites, Playwright, GitHub Actions, Jira, Sentry, and Grafana—you will develop the essential tooling that scales our quality assurance and engineering efforts. This role works closely with Backend, DevOps, development teams, and product stakeholders, leveraging existing CI/CD, cloud, API, and observability infrastructure to build and own the quality engineering automation layer throughout the software development lifecycle. Key Responsibilities Architect, implement, and maintain AI-enabled workflows and agents that automate testing, triage, and quality analysis across the software development lifecycle. Integrate LLM-based workflows with internal systems through APIs and MCP connectors, including GitHub, Jira, CI/CD pipelines, and observability platforms. Engineer AI-driven test lifecycle management systems that extract scenarios from documentation, utilize self-healing mechanisms, and optimize Playwright performance. Construct automated anomaly detection pipelines that link performance shifts and user issues across monitoring tools, delivering actionable root-cause intelligence. Develop rigorous evaluation frameworks for AI processes, auditing metrics such as precision, latency, and operational expenditure to ensure output reliability. Treat prompt design and context engineering as core technical disciplines, ensuring they are version-controlled and thoroughly validated like traditional codebase components. Modernize test data orchestration, automating the creation and masking of high-fidelity datasets for non-production environments. Drive quality intelligence reporting initiatives, replacing static documentation with interactive dashboards highlighting ROI and automation efficacy. Partner with Backend, DevOps, QA, and Product teams to identify and automate high-friction or repetitive activities across the software development lifecycle. Deploy AI capabilities while adhering to regulatory and security standards like ISO 27001, maintaining the strict confidentiality of credentials and production assets. Ensure dedicated focus on AI architecture and tooling by balancing proactive system development (80%) with targeted support for existing manual QA efforts (20%). Develop systems that effectively hand off complex anomalies to the Human QA team, ensuring AI empowers the critical peer-review lifecycle. Qualifications A minimum of three years of professional experience in software, automation, or platform engineering. Advanced proficiency in Python for architecting robust tools and services rather than basic scripting. Expertise in LLM API implementation, including advanced prompt engineering, RAG, tool calling, and agentic workflows. Deep understanding of API orchestration and designing automated systems that interact with live infrastructure. Hands-on experience managing CI/CD pipelines, specifically utilizing GitHub Actions. Command of SQL for direct data validation and database integrity checks. Familiarity with Playwright or similar E2E frameworks, with the ability to optimize suite stability. descripcion: Sumá tu energía a la compañía que contribuye al desarrollo de nuestro país. En YPF buscamos personas que quieran ser parte de un gran equipo que transforma desafíos en oportunidades y que actúa con excelencia para generar valor. Con más de cien años de historia, somos la compañía energética líder de la Argentina, impulsando el desarrollo y la innovación tecnológica del país. ¡Sumarte a YPF es unirte a un proyecto que combina experiencia, pasión y la energía necesaria para seguir construyendo nuestro futuro! ¿Qué buscamos? Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de profesionales graduados en Ingeniería Industrial, para ocupar la posición de Coordinador Datalización & IA. ¿Cuál será tu desafío? El rol tendrá como desafío definir, liderar y ejecutar la estrategia de inteligencia artificial en supply chain, impulsando el uso avanzado de analítica, machine learning e inteligencia artificial generativa para maximizar la toma de decisiones basada en datos. Coordinar y desarrollar la cartera de proyectos de incubación, asegurando la escalabilidad, y alineación de las soluciones de IA con la estrategia del negocio y Tecnología. ¿Cuáles serán sus principales tareas? Definición de la estrategia de IA: Colaborar en la definición y evolución de la estrategia de Inteligencia Artificial, alineada con la estrategia de datalización y los objetivos del negocio, identificando casos de uso de alto impacto (predictivos, prescriptivos y generativos). Gobernanza y priorización de casos de uso: Liderar el portafolio de iniciativas de IA, priorizando casos de uso según impacto en valor, madurez del dato, factibilidad técnica y riesgo, asegurando su correcta industrialización y escalado. Liderazgo técnico y desarrollo de capacidades: Coordinar portafolio (Data Scientists / IA Analysts/ IA Gen), asegurando buenas prácticas en modelado, validación, despliegue y monitoreo de modelos de Machine Learning e IA Generativa (LLMs, RAG, Fine-Tuning). Arquitectura y calidad de soluciones de IA: Asegurar diseños robustos, escalables y seguros de las soluciones de IA, trabajando en conjunto con equipos de Tecnología para garantizar la calidad, trazabilidad y mantenibilidad de los modelos. Relación con Stakeholders y traducción negocio–IA: Actuar como referente de IA frente a áreas de negocio, traduciendo problemáticas estratégicas en soluciones basadas en IA y comunicando resultados, alcances y limitaciones de los modelos de forma clara y accionable. Innovación y evolución tecnológica: Identificar nuevas tecnologías y tendencias, promoviendo su adopción responsable y fomentando la innovación continua en el uso de Inteligencia Artificial. ¿Qué valoramos? Formación académica: Graduado/a en Ingeniería Industrial, con especialización en Ciencia de datos y/o Machine learning. Experiencia profesional: se valorará el conocimiento y la implementación de inteligencia artificial en los procesos del negocio, para su optimización y eficiencia. Experiencia técnica: comprensión de modelos de IA, Machine Learning e IA Generativa. Conocimiento de casos de uso de IA en distintas áreas de negocio. Capacidad para evaluar soluciones, proveedores y tecnologías emergentes. Entendimiento de conceptos como entrenamiento, inferencia, precisión, sesgos y rendimiento de modelos. Asimismo, deberá tener conocimiento de bases de datos, modelos de datos, interpretación de indicadores, elaboración de reportes y detección de tendencias, capacidad para definir controles, identificar errores, duplicados e inconsistencias y asegurar la integridad de la información Competencias claves para el rol: capacidad de análisis y planificación, orientación a resultados, proactividad, capacidad para influir y movilizar cambios, trabajo colaborativo, adaptabilidad, autonomía y capacidad para desenvolverse en entornos dinámicos. descripcion: Brainlabs is the independent, founder-led agency building the future of media. We have over 1000 Brainlabbers based across the global, all united through the 12 principles laid out in our Culture Code. We're full-service, with people and AI agents working side by side, all aligned to one thing: maximizing our clients' revenue through a genuinely scientific approach to media. If you want to help play your part in achieving this for the world's biggest brands in an environment that will support and challenge you in equal measure, this is where you do it. What's The Role We're looking for a Data Analyst to own the flow of data between our operational systems, our data warehouse and the rest of the business. Systems like Hubspot and our People Planner, hold the client, revenue and pipeline data that Finance, Ops and Client Leadership rely on. This role keeps that data well structured, reliably synced and trustworthy as it moves into BigQuery and back out into the tools people use every day. A key part of the job is getting the right, live data presented cleanly in Notion, so client teams can actually use it to inform their day to day workflows. What You Do Build and maintain integrations that move operating system data into the data warehouse. Push data warehouse data back into operating systems to create complete workflows and data lifecycles Debug data discrepancies across source systems and downstream tools, identifying the causes and automating solutions to prevent issues moving forward. Own HubSpot (or a comparable CRM) as a system of record: properties, associations, lifecycle stages etc. and the automation that keeps them consistent, including data quality, deduplication and governance at scale. Work closely with finance, operations, and other business support teams, translating technical decisions into terms non-technical stakeholders can act on. Who You Are Deep experience managing data structure (objects, properties, associations, lifecycle stages, automation), not just using it as an end user, with strong data quality and governance practices (deduplication, enrichment, validation, access controls, auditability). Able to turn a non-technical brief into a full plan and build it, and explain technical solutions to non-technical stakeholders without jargon. Comfortable in fast-moving rollouts, balancing speed with long-term architecture as requirements evolve. Experience building sync logic (canonical IDs, upserts, change detection, idempotent reruns) and ETL/ELT pipelines that survive repeated runs without duplicating or corrupting data. Experience integrating data into BigQuery, Snowflake or similar warehouses via API-based integrations, including reverse ETL back into business systems. Strong Python (or similar) and SQL for automation, data movement, transformation and validation across warehouse tables and views. Confident with REST APIs (auth, pagination, rate limits, retries, error handling) and GCP tooling (Cloud Run, Cloud Scheduler, Secret Manager, BigQuery, GitHub Actions) for building and orchestrating automated jobs. Able to debug data discrepancies across source systems and downstream tools, with good version control hygiene (GitHub or similar). How You Succeed Data moves between systems reliably and accurately at scale Systems stay clean at scale, with properties and associations that hold up as volume grows. Data discrepancies get caught and fixed at the source Finance, operations and other business teams trust the numbers New integrations and automations are shipped with documentation and clear guidance You balance shipping quickly against building for the long term, and can explain that trade-off to a non-technical stakeholder in plain terms. descripcion: When you join the Fountain team, you become part of the leading enterprise solution for frontline workforce management. Fountain’s automated, customizable platform provides a seamless applicant experience for workers, while ensuring organizations can scale and manage their frontline talent. We’ve helped hundreds of companies like UPS, CLEAR, Stitch Fix, GoPuff, Fetch, and sweetgreen to hire, onboard, and manage over 14 million workers in more than 75 countries. In 2022, we closed $185M in our Series C, led by SoftBank and B Capital. Join our growing team of highly collaborative, ambitious, and forward-thinking Fountaineers as we empower our hundreds of customers and millions of frontline workers around the world. Let’s elevate frontline work together. Fountain builds workforce management software for the world's largest hourly employers. We are an agent-first engineering organization where coding and review agents are integrated into our daily workflow. Our platform team builds the critical systems that enable engineers and agents to ship dependable products at scale. What You’ll be Doing: As a member of our compact platform squad (currently four engineers), you will develop the foundational systems that power the entire Fountain ecosystem. Your responsibilities will typically involve: Ship platform capabilities across all customer and internal products Own performance, security, and stability for high-traffic production systems Enhance agentic systems, including coding agents and observability tools Lead architectural decisions for human and agentic interfaces Design reliable code, APIs, and contracts for humans and agents Collaborate with product and engineering teams to deliver customer impact Work autonomously with product managers and designers Identify problems, ship fixes, and own outcomes like an early-stage product team What you bring A minimum of five years in a professional engineering role, primarily focused on backend development, with a proven history of launching production-ready systems. Expert-level systems design. You have a keen eye for the architectural foundations beneath every feature and aren't afraid to express your technical perspective. You possess a track record of identifying and re-engineering misaligned systems. Exceptional discernment for technical trade-offs, UX, APIs, and code. You possess a clear vision of excellence across various domains and consistently elevate the standards of your colleagues. Demonstrated experience with agentic or LLM-based systems beyond consumer use. You've shipped something where an LLM was in the critical path, built tooling that agents consume, or designed evals that catch regressions. Bonus if you can describe the failure modes you've seen and what you did about them. Initiative. Our strongest signal: you ship things nobody asked you to ship, and they turn out to matter. Thrives in autonomous and ambiguous environments, operating effectively without the need for a structured ticket queue. Excellent written communication. You'll work across time zones (EU, US, South Africa, India) and async clarity is the highest-leverage skill in this kind of org. Nice to have Designed APIs or tools meant to be consumed by agents: structured outputs, deterministic surfaces, good observability. Experience within early-stage product teams or startup environments. Proficiency with event-driven architectures, monorepos, and/or observability at the platform level. Even if you do not meet all the requirements above, we still encourage you to apply for this position. While we try to be thorough with our prerequisites, not everything about you as a candidate can be condensed into a list of bullet points. What do you have to lose? Fountain offers an incredibly unique work environment. We employ a diverse team all over the world. Each Fountaineer is given the freedom to do their best work from wherever they choose. We also understand the importance of in-person connections and hold in-person meetings with your team and meet annually as an organization to build our relationships and focus on the future of moving Fountain Forward. The benefits we offer in the United States include competitive health plans and a retirement plan. Some Fountain-wide perks offered to all employees across the globe include a flexible vacation policy, paid holidays, monthly lunch stipends, annual allowances for ongoing education related to your profession and career advancement, along with home office, cell phone, and wellness reimbursements. Fountain is a global employer, so some benefit offerings will vary from country to country. Fountain is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We welcome applicants of any educational background, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, socioeconomic status, disability, and veteran status. By submitting an application, you confirm that you have read our Privacy Policy and agree that we may process and retain your personal data for the purpose of recruitment in accordance with applicable data protection laws. descripcion: 🎯 Misión del Puesto Nos encontramos en busqueda de un Analista de Datos y BI que su mision sera transformar datos provenientes de las distintas áreas y sistemas de Reino Homecenter en información confiable, clara y accionable para la toma de decisiones. Desarrollar, automatizar y mantener reportes, tableros e indicadores de gestión, garantizando la calidad, consistencia y trazabilidad de la información y acompañando al Jefe de Control de Gestión y a las distintas áreas del negocio en el análisis de resultados, detección de desvíos y oportunidades de mejora. 🚀 Principales Responsabilidades Business Intelligence y Reporting Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener dashboards e informes de gestión. Construir visualizaciones para el seguimiento de KPIs comerciales, operativos, logísticos y financieros. Automatizar reportes manuales y estandarizar criterios, definiciones y fuentes de información. Asegurar que los tableros sean claros, simples y orientados a la toma de decisiones. Mantener actualizados los reportes y controlar su correcto funcionamiento. Análisis de Datos Analizar grandes volúmenes de información provenientes de distintas fuentes. Detectar tendencias, desvíos, inconsistencias y oportunidades de mejora. Realizar análisis por tienda, región, categoría, producto, canal y período. Profundizar en las causas de los principales desvíos detectados. Elaborar análisis ad hoc para Control de Gestión, Gerencias y Dirección. Traducir información técnica en conclusiones comprensibles y accionables para el negocio. Calidad y Gobierno de la Información Validar la integridad y consistencia de los datos antes de su publicación. Realizar controles cruzados entre fuentes y sistemas. Identificar diferencias y trabajar sobre su causa raíz junto con las áreas responsables. Documentar fuentes, criterios de cálculo y definiciones de indicadores. Contribuir al desarrollo de una única fuente confiable de información para la compañía. Automatización y Mejora Continua Detectar procesos de reporting susceptibles de automatización. Desarrollar soluciones que reduzcan tareas manuales y tiempos de elaboración. Participar en proyectos de integración de nuevas fuentes de datos. Proponer mejoras en la disponibilidad, trazabilidad y visualización de la información. Soporte a Control de Gestión y al Negocio Acompañar al Jefe de Control de Gestión en la preparación de información para Gerencia y Dirección. Brindar soporte analítico para reuniones de seguimiento de resultados. Comprender necesidades de usuarios internos y transformarlas en soluciones de BI. Capacitar y acompañar a los usuarios en la correcta utilización e interpretación de dashboards. Requisitos 🧠 ¿Qué perfil buscamos? Estudiante avanzado o graduados de Sistemas, Ingeniería Industrial, Administración, Economía, Ciencia de Datos, Estadística o carreras afines. 3 a 5 años de experiencia en Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Control de Gestión, Reporting o posiciones similares. Experiencia desarrollando dashboards e indicadores para usuarios de negocio. Experiencia trabajando con grandes volúmenes de información y múltiples fuentes. Se valorará experiencia en Retail, consumo masivo, logística o compañías multisitio. Power BI avanzado. Excel / Google Sheets avanzado. SQL intermedio/avanzado. Power Query y modelado/transformación de datos. Desarrollo y seguimiento de KPIs. Manejo de bases de datos y diferentes fuentes de información. SAP Business One, deseable. Python para análisis y automatización, deseable. Conocimientos de procesos ETL y Data Warehouse, deseable. ✨ Valoramos Alta capacidad analítica y pensamiento crítico. Orientación a resultados y visión de negocio. Atención al detalle y rigurosidad con la información. Capacidad para detectar inconsistencias y analizar causa raíz. Capacidad para transformar datos complejos en información simple y accionable. Autonomía, organización y proactividad. Curiosidad y mentalidad de mejora continua. Comunicación efectiva y capacidad de trabajo transversal. Orientación al cliente interno. Beneficios 🎁 Beneficios Crecimiento Reales posibilidades de desarrollo profesional en una estructura dinámica y en constante expansión. Salud Medicina prepaga de primer nivel para vos Equipamiento Computadora portátil corporativa provista por la empresa para tus tareas diarias. Comodidad Estacionamiento propio libre y gratuito en nuestras oficinas de Nordelta. Propósito Sumarte y ser protagonista de un proyecto tecnológico y de logística en pleno proceso de transformación digital. 📢En Reino Homecenter creemos que el crecimiento se construye con personas apasionadas, comprometidas y con ganas de ir siempre por más. Hoy nos encontramos en una etapa de expansión y transformación, consolidando un proyecto que comenzó hace 11 años y que ya cuenta con 23 sucursales en GBA y CABA. Queremos seguir profesionalizando nuestras áreas, fortaleciendo nuestros equipos y desarrollando nuevas capacidades para afrontar los desafíos que vienen. Por eso buscamos personas que quieran crecer junto a nosotros, aportar valor y ser protagonistas de esta historia. 🚀 Show more Show less

descripcion: We’re looking for people who put their innovation to work to advance our success – and their own. Join an organization that ensures a more secure world through connecting and protecting our customers with inventive electrical solutions. What You Will Experience In This Role Act as a project leader for assigned manufacturing projects, including developing project plans, coordinating resources, supervising costs and schedules, presenting project status, and ensuring project objectives are achieved. Facilitate process improvements using Lean manufacturing tools (e.g., Kaizen, 5S) to optimize layouts, improve material flow, and reduce waste. Work with operators, supervisors, and value stream planners to assist manufacturing operations through layout improvements, line balancing, troubleshooting, and ongoing improvement activities. Support the development of business unit improvement plans using value stream maps, metric deployment, and management system assessments. Lead and support capital expenditure (CAPEX) projects, including equipment justification, implementation, and startup activities. Review, update, and create work instructions, process documentation, and routing information to support manufacturing operations. Compose and implement basic fixtures, tooling, and process improvements to improve safety, quality, and efficiency. You Have Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Industrial Technology, or a related technical discipline required. 2+ years of manufacturing engineering experience preferred. Experience with Lean manufacturing principles and continuous improvement tools. Proficiency with CAD software (SolidWorks or AutoCAD preferred) and Microsoft Office applications. Experience with ERP systems (JD Edwards preferred) and PLM systems (Enovia preferred). Experience working with automation equipment preferred. Strong problem-solving, communication, and project management skills. We Have A dynamic global reach with diverse operations around the world that will stretch your abilities, provide plentiful career opportunities, and allow you to make an impact every day nVent is a leading global provider of electrical connection and protection solutions. We believe our inventive electrical solutions enable safer systems and ensure a more secure world. We design, manufacture, market, install and service high performance products and solutions that connect and protect some of the world's most sensitive equipment, buildings and critical processes. We offer a comprehensive range of systems protection and electrical connections solutions across industry-leading brands that are recognized globally for quality, reliability and innovation. Our principal office is in London and our management office in the United States is in Minneapolis. Our robust portfolio of leading electrical product brands dates back more than 100 years and includes nVent CADDY, ERICO, HOFFMAN, ILSCO, SCHROFF and TRACHTE. Learn more at www.nvent.com. Commitment to strengthen communities where our employees live and work We encourage and support the philanthropic activities of our employees worldwide Through our nVent in Action matching program, we provide funds to nonprofit and educational organizations where our employees volunteer or donate money Core values that shape our culture and drive us to deliver the best for our employees and our customers. We’re known for being: Innovative & adaptable Dedicated to absolute integrity Focused on the customer first Respectful and team oriented Optimistic and energizing Accountable for performance Benefits to support the lives of our employees Pay Transparency nVent’s pay scale is based on the expected range of base pay for this job and the employee’s work location. Employee pay within this range will be based on a combination of factors including knowledge, skills, abilities, experience, education, and performance. Where federal, state, or local minimum wage requirements exist, employee pay will comply. Compensation Range $62,900.00 - $116,900.00 Depending on the position offered, employee may be eligible for other forms of compensation, such as annual incentives. Benefit Overview At nVent, we value our people and their health and well-being. We provide a broad benefits package with meaningful programs for eligible full-time employees that includes: Medical, dental, and vision plans along with flexible spending accounts, short-term and long-term disability benefits, critical illness, accident insurance and life insurance. A 401(k) retirement plan and an employee stock purchase plan — both include a company match. Other supplemental benefits may include tuition reimbursement, caregiver, personal and parental leave, back-up care services, paid time off including volunteer time, a well-being program, and/or legal & identity theft protection. At nVent, we connect and protect our customers with inventive electrical solutions. People are our most valuable asset. Inclusion and diversity means that we celebrate and encourage each other’s authenticity because we understand that uniqueness sparks growth. Show more Show less
