descripcion: ¿Qué hace la compañía?Reconocida software factory de Venezuela que se destaca en el desarrollo de software para el sector retail. Su equipo crea soluciones innovadoras y en la nube que optimizan procesos comerciales y operativos para negocios de diferentes tamaños en toda Latinoamérica.¿Qué necesitás para ser parte del equipo?A nivel personal: Capacidad de pensar como investigador (curiosidad, hipótesis, experimentos) pero ejecutar como ingeniero de producto (plazos, impacto, trade-offs). Comunicación clara: capaz de explicar decisiones técnicas a founders, negocio y equipo no técnico. Alto nivel de autonomía y responsabilidad.A nivel Técnico: Contar con + de 4 años de experiencia sólida en C# / .NET (8 o 9) con servicios en capas y APIs REST en producción. Angular moderno con componentes standalone y manejo de estado (NgRx o equivalente). MongoDB: modelado, índices, agregaciones y paginación server-side. Mensajería asíncrona (MassTransit, RabbitMQ, SQS) y eventos como contrato entre servicios. Python (Flask / FastAPI) y Airflow. AWS (Cognito, SQS, EKS), Docker y Kubernetes. Criterio sobre aislamiento de datos en sistemas multi-cliente. Uso cotidiano de asistentes de IA y capacidad de auditar lo que producen. Haber construido herramientas que analizan código (Roslyn, ts-morph, tree-sitter) o capas de contexto para agentes (AGENTS.md , reglas, MCP). Dominio funcional de ERP, POS, inventario o fiscalidad | Es un plus! Git y PRs acotados como forma de trabajo, no como imposición.¿Qué vas a hacer? Diseñar y desarrollar servicios y APIs REST en .NET/C#, dentro de una arquitectura de microservicios. Diseñar y mantener modelos, índices, agregaciones y mecanismos de paginación en MongoDB, contemplando escenarios de alta demanda. Implementar procesamiento asíncrono y comunicación basada en eventos entre servicios mediante tecnologías como RabbitMQ, MassTransit o AWS SQS. Desarrollar servicios y procesos de procesamiento de datos e IA en Python, utilizando frameworks como Flask/FastAPI y Airflow. Trabajar sobre la capa de contexto e indexación del código, desarrollando herramientas que permitan extraer, estructurar y mantener información del código fuente de forma automatizada. Construir y mantener índices y funciones para el procesamiento de datos provenientes de la red neuronal, facilitando la integración y comunicación entre los distintos servicios. Desarrollar mecanismos para que los agentes de IA puedan interpretar y consultar el código y su contexto, utilizando documentación estructurada, reglas, MCP u otras estrategias similares. Integrar y mantener servicios sobre AWS, trabajando con componentes como EKS, SQS y Cognito. Participar en la construcción y evolución de ambientes Docker/Kubernetes y pipelines de CI/CD. Diseñar soluciones considerando el aislamiento y procesamiento seguro de datos en una arquitectura SaaS multitenant. Trabajar con Redis y mecanismos de procesamiento asíncrono para optimizar el rendimiento y la comunicación entre componentes. Integrar servicios con plataformas de pagos y otras soluciones fintech. Utilizar asistentes de IA como parte del desarrollo cotidiano, validando, auditando y comprendiendo el código generado antes de incorporarlo a la solución. Participar en el diseño y desarrollo de soluciones vinculadas al procesamiento de datos vectorizados en el edge y su integración con los servicios de la plataforma.¿Cuándo y dónde trabajarás?Trabajarás bajo relación contractor en un esquema híbrido, con dos días de home office y tres de presencialidad en oficinas del coworking La Maquinita, en Palermo Soho, CABA. Durante los dos primeros meses de onboarding el esquema será presencial para que puedas integrarte de forma óptima al negocio. El horario es de lunes a viernes de 9:00 a 18:00hs. Se respetarán los feriados de Argentina.¿Qué ofrecen? Modalidad contractor con pago de salario 100% en USD. Tres semanas de vacaciones. Feriados nacionales. Oportunidad real de crecer hacia posiciones Lead a medida que el equipo se expande.¿De qué fases consta el proceso de selección?Tendrás una primera instancia con nuestra recruiter, Carla Carrizo, para conocer tu recorrido laboral e intereses. Luego, tendrás por delante una instancia presencial con el Tech Lead del equipo en donde se realizará un challenge técnico presencial:- un ejercicio corto de documentación e indexación con defensa en vivo- un desafío de código end-to-end- una charla de fit Podés usar IA en los ejercicios declarándolo: después la empresa va a solicitar que expliques y modifiques tu propio trabajo en vivo, porque eso es exactamente lo que hace el rol.

Ability to communicate in English fluently to collaborate with other teams. Experience in data analytics, data visualization techniques, and core Data Science methodologies. Knowledge of data warehousing (ETL/ELT), technical architectures, and big data environments (e.g., Hadoop, Spark). Knowledge of cloud computing, including virtualization, multi-tenant infrastructures, and storage systems. We help customers transform and evolve their business through the use of Google’s global network, web-scale data centers, and software infrastructure. Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. descripcion: Job Description When you join Honeywell Aerospace, you become a member of our global team of thinkers, innovators, dreamers, and doers who make the things that make the future. That means changing the way we fly, fueling jets in an eco-friendly way, keeping buildings safe and even making it possible to breathe on Mars. Working at Honeywell Aerospace isn’t just about developing cool things. That’s why all our employees enjoy access to dynamic career opportunities across different fields. Join a team of finance professionals to support the Honeywell Aerospace business, providing critical financial analysis and strategic insights to drive business performance and achieve organizational goals.. You will play a part in supporting the Aerospace Strategic Plan, Annual Operating Plan and Rolling Forecast. You will create and analyze monthly, quarterly, and annual reports to ensure financial information has been recorded accurately and advise leadership of any issues through variance analysis. You will also play important part to identify trends and developments in competitive environments and present findings to senior management. Responsibilities The Finance Manager position supports the Aerospace Cost Management Function within the Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) team and will report to the Cost CFO, Sr. Finance Director. The role is responsible for providing financial support including month end close responsibilities, financial forecasting, strategic analysis and reporting key Aerospace functions. The role will work closely with Aero finance and business partners to develop strong financial plans and provide meaningful contributions to the business. Honeywell Aerospace Finance Team is seeking a Finance Manager for our Phoenix, AZ location. Are you ready to help us make the future? Key Responsibilities Provide analysis / insights necessary to deliver, and improve monthly and quarterly forecasts Communicate financial results and metrics on a timely basis Financial projections for short range outlook and quarterly financial forecast cycles Annual Operating Plan, month-end close, actuals reporting and variance analyses Drive continuous improvement within the Aero Cost Management processes to enable more efficient and robust financial support Complete ad hoc tactical and strategic financial analysis Interact and collaborate with finance and business partners to identify opportunities and risks Maintain process documentation Work independently Provide managerial support for US & India based analysts Train new team members Qualifications YOU MUST HAVE Minimum 5 years of accounting/financial analysis experience WE VALUE Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business Administration Advanced degree and/or CPA/CMA is desirable Excellent analytical ability, financial knowledge and business acumen that enable understanding and evaluation of business transactions Good oral and written communication skills, including ability to present complex analysis with clarity. The ability to quickly identify subtle patterns within financial data sets & identify issues Strong personal computer skills and knowledge of financial reporting tools (SAP, Essbase, Hyperion Financial Planning, Tableau). Intellectual curiosity, self-motivated, desire to go above and beyond, and respectful of others Ability to consistently deliver on time and with highest levels of quality Experience developing forecasts and operating plans Due to compliance with U.S. export control laws and regulations, candidate must be a U.S. Person, which is defined as, a U.S. citizen, a U.S. permanent resident, or have protected status in the U.S. under asylum or refugee status or have the ability to obtain an export authorization. Benefits Beyond a performance-driven salary, you'll work alongside dedicated experts on technology that's advancing aviation. descripcion: BOORTMALT is a global malting company with a 3 million tonnes production capacity. The group is present on 5 continents with 27 malting plants. Boortmalt's expertise is widely acknowledged by brewers, distillers, and food industries, who rely on the supply of top-quality barley malts. The Boortmalt Group is a fully owned subsidiary of the agricultural and agribusiness cooperative Axereal. Our relationship with Axereal, Europe's largest grain cooperative, ensures us access to high-quality barley year-round. Buscamos un/a Data Analyst para incorporarse a nuestro equipo en Punta Alvear. La posición tendrá un rol clave como puente entre los datos, los modelos analíticos y de inteligencia artificial, y la operación industrial, transformando información de procesos, calidad y producción en insights confiables y recomendaciones concretas para el negocio. Principales responsabilidades: Analizar datos históricos y en tiempo real para identificar variables críticas de proceso, tendencias de desempeño y relaciones entre inputs y outputs. Validar y desafiar los resultados generados por modelos de optimización, inteligencia artificial y modelos híbridos utilizando datos reales de producción y análisis estadístico. Aplicar técnicas estadísticas avanzadas, incluyendo regresión, correlación, análisis de componentes principales (PCA), pruebas de hipótesis y Diseño de Experimentos (DoE). Estructurar, depurar, armonizar y estandarizar datos provenientes de diferentes procesos y sitios productivos. Desarrollar y mantener modelos analíticos, dashboards y herramientas de reporting que faciliten la toma de decisiones operativas. Traducir análisis complejos en recomendaciones prácticas para los equipos de Operaciones, Ingeniería, Calidad, Energía, Sustentabilidad y Plant Management. Participar en la calibración, validación e implementación industrial de modelos físicos, estadísticos e híbridos. Monitorear el desempeño de los modelos y proponer mejoras a partir del feedback operativo y los resultados de producción. Brindar soporte analítico a iniciativas de optimización de procesos, eficiencia energética, mejora de calidad y mejora continua. Estudiante avanzado/a o graduado/a de Ingeniería Química, Ingeniería Industrial, Ingeniería de Procesos, Analítica de Datos, Estadística, Matemática Aplicada o carreras afines. Experiencia analizando datos operativos o de procesos y aplicando métodos estadísticos para resolver problemas reales del negocio. Experiencia participando en iniciativas de optimización de procesos, mejora continua o eficiencia operativa. Conocimientos avanzados de Python, especialmente Pandas, SciPy, Statsmodels y Matplotlib. Manejo avanzado de Power BI y/o Microsoft Fabric. Sólidos conocimientos de análisis de regresión, correlación, PCA, pruebas de hipótesis y Diseño de Experimentos (DoE). Capacidad para interpretar información técnica y transformarla en conclusiones y recomendaciones claras para diferentes stakeholders. Habilidad para trabajar de manera colaborativa con equipos multidisciplinarios. Inglés intermedio/avanzado, tanto oral como escrito. Interés por la inteligencia artificial, las nuevas tecnologías y su aplicación en entornos industriales. Será valorado: Experiencia en ambientes industriales o de manufactura. Conocimiento de bases de datos industriales y datos de sensores. Conocimientos básicos de SQL. Conocimientos de R. Ofrecemos un atractivo paquete de compensación y beneficios y, como parte de una organización global, brindamos oportunidades de desarrollo profesional a nivel internacional. Como Maestros de la Malta, queremos ser un excelente lugar para trabajar, poniendo el foco en la flexibilidad, la inclusión, la colaboración, la salud y el bienestar. Vivimos nuestros valores y ponemos a las personas en el centro de todo lo que hacemos. " Strive " - Nuestra ambición es ser los mejores productores de malta. Por eso, cada día nos comprometemos a desafiarnos para alcanzar el más alto nivel. " Care " - Nuestra fortaleza se potencia cuando cuidamos nuestro planeta, a nuestros colegas y a nuestros socios comerciales. Promovemos la confianza y el respeto, y creemos que la diversidad nos hace más fuertes. " Inspire " - Adoptamos una mirada de largo plazo, alcanzando un desempeño sostenible a través de la innovación y la digitalización, para ser reconocidos como verdaderos Maestros de la Malta. " Explore " - Pensamos de manera innovadora y adoptamos ideas pioneras para convertirnos en una fuente de inspiración. Nos gusta desafiar el statu quo para desarrollar todo nuestro potencial. descripcion: Summary JOB DESCRIPTION A Manufacturing Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and improving manufacturing processes to ensure safe, efficient, and cost-effective production. This role works closely with production, quality, maintenance, and leadership teams to optimize operations and support business objectives. Responsibilities Manufacturing Engineer Essential Duties and Responsibilities Design, develop, implement, and validate manufacturing processes, methods, tooling, equipment, and controls to support the production of products and components. Analyze and plan labor utilization, equipment requirements, workflow, manufacturing space, and layout to maximize efficiency and productivity. Support all phases of prototype development, builds, and production launches Actively apply new manufacturing technologies and evaluate opportunities that contribute to plant objectives, cost reduction, quality improvement, and operational efficiency. Participate in product design reviews to ensure manufacturability, optimal productivity, and cost effectiveness; recommend alternative designs, materials, or processes as needed. Prepare and evaluate manufacturing studies related to cost, quality, inventory levels, feasibility, and process capability for new and existing products. Recommend and implement improvements to manufacturing processes involving materials, labor, tooling, equipment, layouts, and ancillary systems. Select, approve, and develop tooling and equipment to meet manufacturing requirements and product design intent. Coordinate implementation of new processes and provide training to ensure readiness and timing objectives are met. Establish and verify poka-yoke (error-proofing) systems. Serve as a technical resource for process changes, problem-solving teams, and continuous improvement initiatives, ensuring product design intent is maintained. Actively pursue quality improvements across manufacturing processes. Support new program launches as part of the SDT or Pre-Launch Team, as assigned. Research and implement state-of-the-art manufacturing technologies to ensure products are manufactured in the most capable and cost-effective manner. Work closely with production teams to ensure key performance measures are met and lines are properly balanced. Maintain effective communication with all stakeholders and provide periodic status updates. Act as a customer liaison for product design and engineering-related matters. Complete all required training as mandated by the company and customers. Perform other duties and special projects as assigned. Quality, Safety & Compliance Responsibilities Ensure compliance with ISO and IATF 16949 standards. Develop and maintain PFMEAs, Process Flow Diagrams, Control Plans, and Operator Instruction Sheets. Collaborate closely with Ergonomics and Health & Safety teams to ensure safe and efficient workstation and line design. Adhere to all Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) standards. Report occupational injuries, illnesses, accidents, and unsafe conditions promptly. Support continuous improvement in safety, ergonomics, and environmental performance. Manufacturing Engineer Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience 3+ years of experience in Manufacturing Engineering or a related manufacturing role (automotive experience and background strongly preferred). Proficiency in 2D and 3D CAD modeling software, with the ability to create detailed drawings, assemblies, and production-ready designs. Experience with MODAPTS (Modular Arrangement of Predetermined Time Standards) for work measurement, labor analysis, and process improvement Strong working knowledge of product design and assembly processes using PFMEA principles. Hands-on experience implementing manufacturing processes, methods, tooling, equipment, and controls. Practical knowledge of PFMEA, Control Plans, Process Flows, and Operator Instruction Sheets. Experience creating processes and procedures to meet budgetary goals and performance metrics Proficiency with Windows operating systems and Microsoft Office applications. Strong organizational, analytical, communication, and time-management skills. Beyond is a technology consultancy helping organizations thrive in a rapidly changing world. In this role, you will be responsible for building and scaling the backend systems that power complex, AI-driven applications for our enterprise clients in North America. Based in Argentina, you will act as a core technical pillar for the region, bridging the gap between client requirements and high-performance delivery. You will focus on engineering excellence, specifically in the realms of generative AI and cloud-native architecture, while collaborating with our global engineering teams in Europe. Implement AI Solutions: Build and deploy production-grade AI features, including RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines, LLM orchestrations, and Agentic workflows using Vertex AI. Engineer Cloud Infrastructure: Design and configure scalable backend architectures on GCP, utilizing Cloud Run, GKE, and Cloud Functions with a focus on performance and observability. Own Technical Design: Author Technical Design Documents (TDDs) that translate business needs into executable backend blueprints using modern cloud-native patterns. Deploy & Automate: Manage the full lifecycle of your code, from local development to production, leveraging Terraform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and robust CI/CD pipelines. Collaborate Globally: Work closely with US-based product owners and European delivery teams, requiring a proactive communication style and flexibility for early-morning syncs. Ensure Quality: Champion best practices in API design, security, and automated testing to ensure the reliability of enterprise-level deployments. Things that will make you stand out: Engineering Experience: 6+ years of professional experience in backend development, with a strong focus on building distributed systems. Python Expertise: Mastery of the Python ecosystem (FastAPI, Flask, or Django) and experience with asynchronous programming. GCP Proficiency: Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform services, specifically App Engine, Cloud Run, Vertex AI, BigQuery, and Cloud SQL. AI/ML Integration: Proven experience integrating LLMs into applications and an understanding of vector databases (e.g., Vertex Vector Search, Pinecone). DevOps Skills: Proficiency with Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform. Communication: Fluent English skills with the ability to discuss technical trade-offs clearly with both peers and stakeholders. Nice to Have AI Frameworks: Experience with LangChain or LlamaIndex. Data Engineering: Understanding of data pipelines and ETL processes to support AI model training and retrieval. CMS Familiarity: Experience working with headless CMS architectures or Digital Experience Platforms (DXP). Certifications: GCP Professional Cloud Architect or Professional Data Engineer. What we want from you: We are building a world-class delivery centre in Buenos Aires and want the best engineering talent in the region. We believe the best work happens when we collaborate in person. Your energy and presence will be vital in making our studio a hub of creativity and innovation. Benefits We believe in supporting our team members both professionally and personally. descripcion: WHO WE ARE Jampp is a programmatic advertising platform used by ambitious companies to accelerate the growth of their mobile businesses. Founded in 2013, Jampp combines machine learning, creative optimization, and proprietary advertising technology to drive incremental growth for leading mobile advertisers such as Uber, Just Eat Takeaway.com, FREENOW, Rappi, and BIGO Live. Today, Jampp operates across more than 10 countries with a team of over 100 mobile experts and is part of the Affle Group, a fast-growing AdTech company that owns several industry-leading platforms. Jampp is consistently recognized as a leading mobile performance partner by the industry’s main Mobile Measurement Partners. THE GROWTH TEAM We are looking for a technically driven and highly analytical Senior Growth Analyst to join our Growth team. The Growth team combines data analysis, experimentation, business understanding, and deep product knowledge to drive advertiser performance. This is not only a campaign management role: you will own performance strategies, understand how Jampp’s technology and optimization models work, investigate complex challenges, and turn data into measurable improvements. You will work closely with Customer Success, Product, Data Science, Supply, and other technical teams to improve advertiser results, our product, and the way we work. WHAT YOU’LL DO Own the strategy, setup, execution, and optimization of performance campaigns, with a strong focus on CPA, ROAS, sustainable growth, and advertiser outcomes. Work with Customer Success to translate advertiser goals into strategies and identify opportunities to retain and grow accounts. Develop a deep understanding of Jampp’s products and ML-driven optimization models, including audiences, supply, attribution, creatives, measurement, and campaign configurations. Independently investigate performance issues across model behavior, supply, attribution, tracking, data, and campaign configurations. Design, execute, and own structured experiments, defining hypotheses and success metrics and driving measurable advertiser performance improvements. Use SQL, BI platforms, and AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT to independently analyze data, identify opportunities, investigate performance issues, and provide actionable recommendations. Partner with Product and Data Science on product and model experimentation, providing evidence-based feedback and translating validated learnings into scalable best practices. Identify repetitive or manual tasks that can be automated to improve the team’s efficiency. 🤚 This is not an exhaustive list. At Jampp, we value autonomy and ownership, so we look for people who can identify opportunities and proactively turn ideas into action. WHAT WE LOOK FOR Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Economics, Business, Data Analytics, or another relevant quantitative field. 5+ years of experience in performance advertising, AdTech, growth, data analytics, or a related industry. 3+ years of hands-on experience managing and optimizing performance campaigns, including CPA or ROAS optimization, attribution, and experimentation. Mobile, programmatic, or DSP experience is strongly preferred. Strong understanding of performance measurement, attribution, optimization models, and data-driven decision-making. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently investigate complex performance issues and communicate clear recommendations. Demonstrated experience designing and owning experiments that delivered measurable performance improvements. SQL proficiency, with the ability to independently query, combine, and analyze data to investigate complex business and performance questions. Experience using BI and data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, or similar platforms. Hands-on experience using AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT for analysis, SQL, problem-solving, and workflow automation, with the ability to validate their outputs. Experience partnering with Customer Success teams to translate advertiser goals into performance strategies and recommendations. Experience collaborating with Product, Data Science, or other technical teams. Advanced English and strong written and verbal communication skills. A proactive, hands-on, and collaborative working style with strong attention to detail and organization. NICE TO HAVE Experience with Python or another scripting language for data analysis and automation. Experience connecting to and working with APIs to extract data or automate processes. descripcion: About Promtior Promtior is at the forefront of the Agentic AI revolution, delivering cutting-edge solutions that transform businesses across industries — bridging technology and people to turn AI into a real competitive advantage. Since 2023, we've helped organizations boost operational efficiency through tailored Agentic AI solutions, from discovery and development to full implementation, across three core lines: AI Product Delivery (predictive analytics, intelligent automation, AI-driven chatbots, image processing), AI Department as a Service (LATAM-based teams that integrate directly with our clients' teams), and AI Adoption Consulting (helping companies find and act on AI opportunities across their business). We're a team held together by genuine relationships, constant exchange, and shared learning. We believe innovation happens when people feel included and collaborate with purpose, and we aim for professional growth to go hand in hand with personal well-being. About the Role We're looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our Engineering team as a technical reference in ML. This is a senior, client-facing position: you will own the technical direction of the machine learning systems that power our agentic AI solutions, make and defend modeling and architecture decisions in front of clients, and raise the technical level of the engineers around you as we scale our global operation. Key Responsibilities You will own the design, development, and deployment of machine learning models in production environments, taking responsibility for the full model lifecycle: data processing and feature engineering, training and evaluation, serving, monitoring, and retraining. You will define the architecture of scalable data and ML systems, and set the standards the team works to — evaluation criteria, validation strategies, testing, versioning, and production monitoring. You will make and justify the core technical trade-offs, including which problems call for classical ML and which are better solved with generative or agentic approaches, balancing accuracy, cost, and latency. You will act as the technical counterpart for clients, translating business problems into ML solutions, running technical discovery, and defending the approach in front of technical stakeholders. You will mentor and unblock other engineers, review their work, and drive the adoption of MLOps best practices and new AI technologies across teams. Required Experience Advanced or completed studies in Systems Engineering, Data Science, AI, or related fields. 5+ years of professional software or data engineering experience. 3+ years of hands-on experience developing and productionizing machine learning models (not experimental or notebook-only work). Strong, production-level command of Python and ML libraries (scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or others). Proven experience owning the full model lifecycle in production, including monitoring, performance degradation, and retraining strategies. Strong experience working with data (ETL, analysis, feature engineering) and building data and ML pipelines. Experience deploying and serving models in cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure). Solid architecture and integration skills across APIs, backend, and services. Demonstrated experience acting as a technical reference: mentoring engineers, reviewing code, and owning technical decisions. Experience working directly with clients or technical stakeholders as the technical counterpart. Good command of Git and collaborative work in technical teams. Advanced English Level. descripcion: Our Mission and Opportunity Early education is one of the most important determinants of childhood outcomes, a critical support for working families, and a $175B market that remains underserved by modern technology. Brightwheel is the largest, fastest growing, and most loved platform in early ed, trusted by millions of educators and families every day. We are a three-time Cloud 100 company, backed by top investors including Addition, Bessemer, Emerson Collective, Lowercase Capital, Notable Capital, and Mark Cuban. Our Team Our team is passionate, talented, and customer-focused. We embody our Leadership Principles in our work and culture. We are a distributed team with remote employees across every US time zone, as well as select offices in the US and internationally. Who You Are You are a highly analytical and technically proficient Senior Data Analyst with a proven track record of using data to improve customer success and drive revenue expansion, informing decision-making in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. As a natural problem-solver, you excel at translating complex data into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You've played a key role supporting a Post-Sales or Ecommerce analytics function at a prior company — ideally with subscription, ecommerce, product, or retention data — with a proven ability to translate data into actionable insights and leverage AI to drive business outcomes. What You’ll Do You are primarily responsible for Education (Experience Curriculum) analytics — driving GTM insights, retention, and financial analysis for our curriculum subscription/ecommerce business — while helping optimize the broader customer journey across Post-Sales. Meet regularly with Education stakeholders to deeply understand their data needs and translate metrics and analyses into actionable recommendations that drive business impact. Develop and maintain core Education and Post-Sales data models and pipelines using SQL and dbt — including subscription/ecommerce data — to ensure data accuracy and reliability for all reports. Build, automate, and maintain dashboards and reports in our BI tools (Sigma + Tableau) to track key Education retention, GTM insights, and customer-health KPIs for the Education and leadership teams. Own and maintain weekly business review (WBR) source files and underlying pipelines, ensuring business leaders receive validated, goal-aligned reports. What You’ve Done 2–4 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a relevant technical role — preferably with subscription, ecommerce, or other Post-Sales domain experience. Advanced proficiency in core technical analytics, including SQL (writing complex queries and manipulating data), Data Transformation (maintaining data models with tools like dbt), and Business Intelligence/Visualization with tools like Sigma or Tableau. Demonstrated experience in creating and maintaining data models and pipelines that served as the single source of truth for Post-Sales reporting. A history of building and owning a suite of dashboards and reports in a BI tool, consistently delivering valuable insights to business stakeholders. Excellent communication skills for stakeholder management, including acting as a trusted consultant and effectively translating technical information for all levels of an organization. Demonstrated fluency using AI to fundamentally change how you work — not just to speed up tasks, but to automate routine workflows, accelerate analyses, and build reusable tools and data infrastructure. Bonus: Experience with Salesforce. This role must be available for work during standard US working hours (any 8-hour shift from 9am EST - 8pm EST). descripcion: Summary Of Position The Operations Manager has primary responsibility for providing oversight, coordination, supervision, planning, administration, training and logistical support to one or more facilities. Work effort weighs heavily on the safe and successful collection, transportation and disposal of residential/commercial solid waste and recyclables. This role requires superior organizational skills that help in driving continuous improvement surrounding operations, clients, and employees. This manager will build rapport with both internal/external clients and strive to maintain business commitments that allow fulfillment of defined service level agreements. The operations leader will build a high performance team by exercising superior judgment and the proper balance of command and control. Determining appropriate staffing levels required to meet seasonal demands, monitoring metrics, and measuring team performance to exceed production and performance targets are key.Overall and in partnership with the Division/District Manager(s) the operations leader will meet defined objectives, provide timely reporting, training, coaching and discipline. Issues/concerns as needed are escalated to the leadership team. Essential Job Functions Oversees day-to-day operations of the transportation, hauling and support operations, ensuring superior customer service and hauling of refuse without contamination of air, land or water. Formulates, manages and monitors operating metrics while diagnosing and improving processes, procedures, operational and customer service performance. Participates in the development of Divisional/District Operational budgets and follows best practices in measuring and monitoring. Ensures thorough root cause investigations for all incidents/injuries and follows up with needed training, discipline, retraining, reporting. Participates regularly in review of Operations department, including assisting with selection, coaching, employee discipline, performance evaluation and training. Provides input into termination, compensation, bonus eligibility and promotion decisions.\ Formulates both short-term and long-term goals and action plans in conjunction the Division/District Manager(s), Facility Manager and RVP. Participates in regular P&L reviews to ensure that budgets are met; programs are developed and in place for appropriate resource allocation, equipment utilization, equipment maintenance, and controlled use of labor and material costs. Interacts with local city, municipal, and county agencies to enhance business relationships, promotes community involvement and ensures customer satisfaction. Works with functional groups to resolve employee relations issues, build rapport and champion team spirit. Assists with development, implementation, and coordination of safety programs for the Division/District, and monitors work processes, procedures and expenses required to drive team performance, achievement goals while proactively working to reduce risk. Conducts monthly or bi-monthly route observations to confirm compliance with high standards of customer satisfaction and in compliance with Fed, State and Local Regulations/contracts. Monitors routing information required to maintain most efficient use of vehicles equipment and personnel. Closes daily routes Consults with municipal officials and community groups to foster key client relationships and business partnerships Monitors DOT, OSHA and ensures regulatory compliance. Serves as a liaison with the HR and Safety Departments to develop and implement technical and non-technical training. Provides oversight for all operational safety related training and mentors field operational supervisors in safety processes. Respond to critical incidents at any time of day or night. Analyzes work and seasonal demand on a daily basis to determine appropriate staffing levels and task execution. Maintains an overall positive attitude toward leaders, colleagues, direct reports and customers Other Job Responsibilities Employees in this job classification must attend and participate in corporation sponsored training courses as assigned. Employees in this job classification are responsible for keeping up to date on current technology, as job appropriate, being used by Waste Pro USA. Any additional job duties that may be assigned by the Supervisor. WORK ENVIRONMENT: Normal setting for this job is carried out in office, field and maintenance facilities. Show more Show less

descripcion: Required Experience 3–5 years of experience in software engineering or data engineering, with extensive hands-on use of AI tools and LLM-based development over the past year (professional projects, internal initiatives, or substantial personal builds). Professional English proficiency (C1/C2 minimum) — mandatory. You will work daily with international clients and colleagues. Strong hands-on experience with the Google AI stack: Gemini models, Vertex AI, and ideally Gemini Enterprise or ADK — ideally with experience taking at least one solution to production on GCP. Strong programming skills in Python and TypeScript/JavaScript, and experience building and consuming APIs. Experience with front-end development (React or similar) and at least one backend framework. Hands-on experience with RAG, embeddings, and vector search, and with at least one agentic framework (Google ADK, LangGraph/LangChain). Strong working experience with GCP; Azure or AWS is a plus. Fluency with agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, or Cursor. Experience building and maintaining data pipelines. Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Certifications A Google Cloud certification is a strong differentiator at application. If you do not hold one yet, obtaining it within your first 2 months in the role is a requirement — Artefact sponsors the exam and gives you time to prepare. Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer (preferred), covering Vertex AI, generative AI, and production ML. Google Cloud Generative AI Leader is valued as a foundation, complemented by hands-on Vertex AI / Gemini Enterprise delivery experience. Preferred Experience Experience with MCP servers, multi-agent patterns, or LLM evaluation tooling (LangSmith, Langfuse, promptfoo). Experience with Terraform or CI/CD pipelines. Experience with GCP, BigQuery, or Google Workspace integrations alongside Gemini Enterprise. Key Capabilities A strong candidate will bring: Deep expertise in Gemini Enterprise and the Google AI stack, combined with breadth across the full stack Owns features end to end, from interface to infrastructure Cares about evaluation and reliability, not just the happy path Communicates clearly with clients in demos, documents, and code review Client-facing mindset: understands client needs and translates business requirements into technical solutions Learns new tools and models fast, and shares what works A Senior Deployed AI Engineer specialized in Gemini Enterprise and the Google AI stack: an engineer who works embedded with our clients and takes AI products from idea to production. You'll design and build the interfaces, services, and agentic systems at the heart of our client work: conversational apps over enterprise data, agents automating workflows, and the pipelines supporting them. You own components end to end: front end, service, data, deployment, and evals. Build Full-Stack AI Applications, End to End Develop interfaces in TypeScript/React and backend services/APIs in Python or Node. Implement agentic behavior: orchestration, tool/function calling, memory, guardrails. Build RAG pipelines: ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector/hybrid search. Connect AI systems to enterprise data via APIs, semantic layers, and MCP. Go Deep on Gemini Enterprise and the Google AI Stack Build agents with Gemini models, Vertex AI, ADK, and Agent Engine. Configure Gemini Enterprise: Agent Designer, the Inbox, and agent sandboxes. Connect Gemini Enterprise to client systems via connectors, with proper permissions. Build grounded apps with Vertex AI Search, RAG Engine, Search grounding, and BigQuery. Implement interoperability via A2A and MCP. Track Google's releases and translate new capabilities into client value. Make AI Systems Production-Grade Write evals and regression tests; monitor cost, latency, and quality. Apply solid practice: version control, review, testing, CI/CD, observability. Deploy on GCP/Azure/AWS using containers, serverless, and infra-as-code. Build and maintain data pipelines feeding AI systems. Work AI-Natively and Client-Facing Use agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, Cursor) daily, with good judgment. Communicate progress, trade-offs, and blockers to clients and leads. Support pre-sales: scope solutions, build demos, estimate effort with partners. Mentor engineers; contribute to accelerators and engineering standards.

descripcion: What is IP Corporation? IP Corporation is a privately held, family-owned chemical manufacturing organization with more than 70 years of stability, innovation, and growth. Headquartered in Minnesota, IP Corporation supports a portfolio of operating companies that manufacture and distribute resins, gel coats, composite materials, and specialty polymer solutions used across a wide range of industrial applications. Our operating companies, Interplastic Corporation, North American Composites, HK Research, and Molding Products, work together to deliver technical expertise, high-quality products, and long-term partnerships to customers around the world. We are known for our customer-first mindset, strong technical capabilities, and collaborative culture built on trust and continuous improvement. What is a Plant Process Engineer? The Plant Process Engineer is responsible for optimizing manufacturing processes to improve efficiency, quality, and safety within plant operations. This role works closely with Operations, Quality, and Engineering teams to analyze performance, troubleshoot process issues, and implement improvements. The position plays a key role in driving continuous improvement, ensuring process consistency, and supporting reliable and cost-effective production. What You Can Expect to Do as a Plant Process Engineer: Analyze and optimize manufacturing processes to improve efficiency, throughput, and product quality. Troubleshoot process-related issues and support root cause analysis and corrective actions. Partner with Operations and Quality teams to ensure process consistency and performance. Identify and implement process improvements to reduce waste, variability, and cost. Support scale-up, process changes, and new product introductions within the plant. Develop and maintain process documentation, including SOPs and work instructions. Monitor process data and performance metrics to identify trends and opportunities. Support compliance with safety, environmental, and regulatory requirements. Collaborate with engineering teams on equipment and process design improvements. Participate in continuous improvement initiatives such as Lean or Six Sigma projects. What We Are Looking For in a Plant Process Engineer: Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering or a related field required. 2-5 years of experience in process engineering within a manufacturing environment. Strong understanding of chemical or industrial manufacturing processes. Experience with process optimization, troubleshooting, and data analysis. Knowledge of safety, environmental, and regulatory standards. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to work cross-functionally in a team-oriented environment. Strong communication and organizational skills. Preferred Qualifications Familiarity with continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean or Six Sigma preferred. Why Join IP Corporation? Be part of a stable, privately held organization with more than 70 years of success and industry leadership. Competitive benefits including medical, dental, vision, generous PTO, and a 401(k) with company match. Opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a collaborative, values-driven organization where your contributions matter. Work alongside experienced professionals in an environment that encourages continuous learning, development, and career growth. Join a culture built on teamwork, integrity, innovation, and long-term customer partnerships. Contribute to products and solutions that support a wide range of industries across North America and beyond. Enjoy the benefits of a company that combines the stability of an established organization with the agility and entrepreneurial spirit to drive innovation and continuous improvement. Physical Requirements and Work Environment Ability to work in an office and/or manufacturing environment. Ability to sit, stand, walk, and use computer equipment for extended periods. Ability to occasionally lift office or manufacturing-related materials as needed. Ability to work safely in plant or production areas when required. IP Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. El rol de FP&A Data Analyst será responsable de construir la pata técnica del equipo de FP&A modelos de forecast, automatización de procesos manuales y conectividad con el datalake regional (BigQuery). Reportando al FP&A Lead, esta persona será la primera contratación dedicada a Data & Capabilities dentro del equipo, en un momento en que FP&A está avanzando hacia una operación más predictiva y automatizada. Trabajará en un entorno dinámico, regional y de alto crecimiento, en estrecha colaboración con los Business Partners de los 4 países (AR, CL, CO, MX) y con los equipos de BI y S&OP. Su trabajo va a tocar todas las dimensiones del proceso financiero cierres, forecast, reporting, soporte comercial y planning anual. Buscamos a alguien con mentalidad de builder, que odie el trabajo manual repetitivo y automatice por instinto. Una persona que pueda traducir una pregunta vaga de negocio en una estructura analítica concreta, con paciencia para construir cosas que tarden semanas en dar fruto y curiosidad para entender qué hay detrás de cada número. Responsabilidades Construir y mantener modelos de GMV, margen y opex por país y BU. Apoyar la construcción del budget anual y los rolling forecasts. Modelar business cases para nuevos lanzamientos, canales y decisiones de pricing junto con los BPs. Automatizar procesos manuales recurrentes del ciclo de cierre y planning. Desarrollar pipelines y queries sobre BigQuery para alimentar reportes y dashboards. Construir herramientas de análisis escalables que puedan usar los BPs sin asistencia técnica permanente. Diseñar y mantener dashboards de seguimiento de KPIs financieros y operativos. Crear vistas analíticas a medida para necesidades específicas del Lead, los BPs y otros stakeholders. Validar la consistencia de la data entre fuentes (BigQuery, Odoo, archivos operativos) y proponer correcciones a la metodología de cálculo. Mantener la documentación técnica de los modelos y procesos del equipo. Identificar oportunidades de mejora analítica y proponer soluciones basadas en datos para preguntas abiertas del negocio. Requisitos Formación Lic. en Economía, Actuario, Ingeniería Industrial, Ciencia de Datos o carreras afines. Experiencia 2-3 años en roles de FP&A, BI, analytics financiero o consultoría con foco analítico. SQL avanzado (excluyente) Idealmente con experiencia en BigQuery o equivalente. Python para análisis y automatización (excluyente). Manejo avanzado de Excel/Google Sheets y modelado financiero. Deseable experiencia con herramientas de visualización (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, React), noción de pipelines de datos y uso de AI. Fluidez financiera comprensión sólida de P&L, márgenes, forecast y working capital (no requiere ser contador). Curiosidad para entender el negocio detrás de los números y traducir preguntas abiertas en análisis estructurados. Inglés intermedio funcional. Mentalidad builder gusto por automatizar, construir tools reutilizables y resolver problemas con criterio antes que escalarlos. Capacidad de trabajar de forma autónoma, gestionar prioridades y comunicarse bien con stakeholders no técnicos. Buscamos ser los mejores Elevamos el estándar constantemente. Decidimos con datos (y criterio) Usamos información para tomar decisiones inteligentes. Ganamos en equipo Construimos juntos, sin silos. Damos el máximo por impacto real Nos enfocamos en resultados, no en excusas. Nuestro modelo combina creatividad, tecnología de punta y un enfoque basado en datos para adquirir y desarrollar marcas que lideren el mercado. Innovamos, perseguimos la excelencia y marcamos tendencia en el mercado. ¿Qué nos hace diferentes? Nos mueve el desafío de construir algo extraordinario. Experiencia en la escritura de pruebas unitarias, de integración y automatizadas, orientadas a garantizar estabilidad y confiabilidad. Familiaridad con metodologías ágiles. descripcion: Sobre el proyecto: Estamos construyendo un plataforma corporativa unificada basada en Salesforce y un conjunto de aplicaciones relacionadas para la digitalización de ventas y procesos internos. El trabajo se divide en dos áreas principales: Procesamiento de datos: el sistema recopila listas de precios de proveedores (Excel, PDF, sitios web) de diversas fuentes, las procesa y las carga en el CRM. La arquitectura y el núcleo de este pipeline son gestionados por el equipo de backend. Tu tarea será mantenerlo y desarrollarlo, además de supervisar la calidad de los datos en cada etapa. Por ejemplo, actualmente la revisión de la "cola de revisión" en el pipeline se realiza a través de CLI; tendrás que convertirlo en un dashboard de UI intuitivo (REST API + frontend). Trabajarás con datos reales: formatos no estándar, diseños desalineados y casos extremos. Este sistema es nuevo, tiene 3 meses de historia y resuelve un problema que hasta ahora la empresa gestiona manualmente. Desarrollo de sitios web: creación de recursos web relacionados con nuestros eventos, servicios y productos. Se valora la capacidad de comprender el mercado, la necesidad del cliente y cómo nuestras soluciones resuelven estos problemas con el objetivo de mantener un set de sitios web con una arquitectura visual y editorial unificada y eficaz. Responsabilidades Desarrollo Web y Backend: Participar en el desarrollo y mantenimiento de la REST API (FastAPI) y el frontend (React/Vue) para el dashboard de UI de la "cola de revisión", en sustitución del actual CLI. Mantener actualizados los sitios web relacionados con nuestros eventos, servicios y productos. Mantener y desarrollar el pipeline en Python: ORM SQLAlchemy, migraciones con Alembic, adaptación de la lógica para nuevos formatos de datos. Garantizar un intercambio de datos correcto e ininterrumpido con Salesforce a través de REST API. Adicional: Control de calidad de datos: Verificar exportaciones, escribir consultas SQL para comprobar la base de datos y revisar datos manualmente en la interfaz de Salesforce. Gestionar casos de prueba (test cases) para los parsers, teniendo en cuenta anomalías en los datos (estructuras anidadas, diseños desalineados). Redactar reportes de errores (bug reports). Tareas operativas: Ejecutar el pipeline (origen → PostgreSQL → Salesforce) siguiendo instrucciones predefinidas. Revisión de la cola de revisión: análisis de registros de productos con discrepancias que no fueron resueltas por el proceso automático. Preparación de entornos de prueba antes de las demostraciones. Requisitos técnicos: Stack Python: conocimientos básicos de Python, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy y Pydantic. Experiencia en el desarrollo y comprensión de los principios de diseño de aplicaciones REST API. Web/Frontend: experiencia trabajando con HTML/CSS y JavaScript. Conocimientos básicos de React o Vue para la creación y mantenimiento de interfaces y dashboards sencillos. Bases de datos: PostgreSQL. Experiencia trabajando con bases de datos, optimización de consultas y estructura de la base. Arquitectura e infraestructura: comprensión de las arquitecturas de microservicios y cliente-servidor. Calidad de datos: comprensión del ciclo de vida de los bugs y los principios del diseño de pruebas. Enfoque analítico, capacidad para escribir scripts para la verificación de datos y disposición para realizar revisiones minuciosas. Soft skills: enfoque sistémico, disciplina y atención al detalle. Nuestros procesos son muy sensibles a las discrepancias. Para asegurarnos de tu atención al detalle, comienza tu carta de motivación con una consulta SQL válida que devuelva la palabra 'Akribis'. Esperamos la máxima atención a los detalles. Se valorará positivamente: Experiencia en el parsing de archivos complejos en PDF/Excel y comprensión de procesos ETL. Familiaridad con el ecosistema de Salesforce. Qué ofrecemos Rol con impacto real: vas a influir directamente en cómo opera el negocio. Cercanía con decisión y velocidad de implementación (sin burocracia). Espacio para proponer estándares, ordenar procesos y profesionalizar el ecosistema digital. Aprendizaje acelerado y posibilidad de crecimiento a medida que escala la transformación. descripcion: We're hiring a full-stack engineer to own and advance our BI integrations and semantic model converters. This includes the Excel plugin, the Google Sheets add-on, and the Looker integration. You'll work at the seam between third-party BI ecosystems and the core query engine: translating query semantics across protocols (MDX, DAX, SQL), managing authentication and token flows, keeping result sets correct across tools with very different data models, and driving down the friction and defect rate that customers feel most directly. The role also covers semantic model interoperability: building converters that translate other formats into SML, the platform's Semantic Modeling Language. It's a different shape of problem from the BI adapters, closer to mapping one semantic modelling language to another, and it's what lets a customer bring an existing model to the platform without rebuilding it. This is a high-ownership role with a tight feedback loop to real customer escalations. You'll partner closely with product, QA, and customer-facing teams, and your work will show up in support queues and renewal conversations, so correctness and reliability are the job, not a nice-to-have. What you'll do Design, build, and maintain BI tool integrations across their full lifecycle, including features, performance, and defect resolution. Build and maintain converters that translate external semantic model formats into SML. Handle the hard cross-protocol problems: query translation between MDX/DAX/SQL. Reproduce, triage, and fix customer-reported bugs against real semantic models, and turn recurring issues into durable fixes and better tests rather than one-off patches. Build and expand automated test coverage (integration and end-to-end) so adapter regressions are caught before customers see them. Track the moving targets (Microsoft Office add-in APIs, Google Workspace add-on platform, Looker/LookML changes) and adapt our integrations ahead of breaking changes. Collaborate with product and support to prioritize the friction that matters most, and communicate clearly with customers when an issue is technical and externally visible. What you bring 4+ years of professional experience with TypeScript/JavaScript in a full-stack context (React on the frontend and Node.js on the backend) Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building and shipping production software, ideally client integrations, plugins, or SDKs Expertise in unit and integration testing using Jest, alongside proven approaches for mocking requests and responses in automated test suites Working knowledge of SQL and exposure to analytical query languages and semantics (MDX, DAX) and an intuition for how the same question maps differently across tools Deep proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, and Python Comfort with authentication and session mechanics: OAuth, tokens, and the failure modes that show up when they're mishandled A debugging temperament: you can take a vague customer report and a live model and drive it to a root cause Fluency with modern AI-assisted development tools, and good judgment about where they speed you up versus where they need a human in the loop Expertise in testing methods such as unit, integration, and e2e, tools used for each (e.g. Jest), as well as approaches for mocking requests and responses for test automation Nice to have Hands-on experience with Python Experience with end-to-end (e2e) testing frameworks, particularly Playwright Experience with semantic layers, OLAP, or BI platforms (Power BI, Tableau, Cognos) and their driver/connector ecosystems Familiarity with XMLA/Tabular endpoints or similar analytical serving protocols Background supporting enterprise B2B customers where correctness and governance are non-negotiable Familiarity with containers and infrastructure related to web apps such as Docker We offer*: Flexible working format - titulo: Full Stack Engineer for VC-Backed AI Startup
descripcion: ABOUT INTRIQ Intriq turns a client's disorganised data room into deal-ready insight. We build the platform that lets accounting and audit teams process financial documents at machine speed without losing the rigour a human review demands. Every output is derived solely from the client's own data, nothing external. THE ROLE You will build the platform that does it, from the React workspace auditors touch every day, down through the async Python pipelines that read and reason over financial documents. You will work across three repositories: QNextDash (frontend), QInsights (API and pipeline backend) and QCLI (internal tooling), shipping features end to end rather than staying on one side of a spec. This is not a maintenance role. You will be one of the first engineers shaping how the async document pipeline, the API contracts and the infrastructure scale as we take on larger clients and heavier document volumes. WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO • Build across the stack. A Next.js workspace view one week, the FastAPI endpoint and Postgres schema behind it the next. • Design and harden async workflows: document ingestion, markdown conversion, LLM-based extraction and multi-step review pipelines that stay correct under concurrency and partial failure. • Own services from Terraform up. Provision the Fargate task or Lambda, wire the CI/CD pipeline, and watch it in CloudWatch once it is live. • Work directly with data. Shape Postgres schemas, write the queries behind reporting and audit trails, and keep every pipeline output traceable back to its source document. • Make architecture calls with the founding team. At this size, the person who writes the code decides how it is structured. THE STACK Frontend: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, TanStack Query, Zustand, Tailwind API and pipeline: FastAPI, Pydantic v2, asyncpg, PostgreSQL 17, AWS Lambda, Bedrock and Claude Infrastructure: AWS Fargate, AWS Lambda, Terraform, Docker, GitHub Actions, CloudWatch, Cognito WHAT WE NEED • Proven full-stack experience. Comfortable moving from a React and TypeScript interface to a Python API to the database underneath, not fluent in one layer only. • Strong TypeScript and Python, with FastAPI or a comparable async Python framework in production. • Real experience designing async workflows and APIs. You can reason about concurrency, retries and partial failure, not just the happy path. • Solid PostgreSQL. Schema design, query performance and migrations, not an ORM you have never looked past. • Working knowledge of microservices and the trade-offs of splitting against consolidating services. • Some data engineering or ML exposure. Building or consuming data pipelines, working with LLM-based extraction, or shipping features that depend on model output. • DevOps fluency. CI/CD and AWS in practice: Fargate, Lambda, Terraform. You ship your own infrastructure changes rather than handing them off. • Startup pace, said plainly: small team, direct ownership, fast iteration, decisions made by whoever is closest to the problem. You will ship in your first week and own real production surface within your first month. USEFUL, NOT ESSENTIAL • Experience in fintech, audit or accounting software, where correctness and traceability matter as much as speed. • Exposure to security and compliance for AI systems, and familiarity with compliance tooling such as Sprinto. Intriq is SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certified, and the standard shapes how we build. • Spanish and English both used day to day. Portuguese is a bonus. HOW WE WORK • Remote, based in Argentina. The team is distributed and works to US hours, so expect a US calendar and overlap with the US working day. • Small by design. A handful of engineers, no layers between you and the founders. • Secure by default. Client data stays in the client's own environment. No cross-client model training. US-hosted models only. THE PROCESS Three conversations: an intro, a live coding interview with the engineering team, and an architecture discussion with the founding team. We read every application and aim to run the process inside two weeks. If you have not heard from us within two weeks, please take it as a no. If you have shipped something you are proud of that touches this stack, put that at the top of your application rather than writing a cover letter. Show more Show less

descripcion: CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions. Every asset must match the client's actual product 1:1 - down to hardware and geometry. No artifacts, no hallucinations, no "close enough" . This is a control and reproducibility problem, not a prompting problem, and it needs an engineer. This is a greenfield build. You'll be the first engineer in this direction, working directly with the Design Director as the technical interface between creative teams and software infrastructure. What You Will Work On Architect and run our AI Media Production platform: serving ComfyUI or similar engines, GPU environments, one-click UIs for non-technical teams; Ship modular, versioned, reproducible generative pipelines, node-based and/or code-first (e.g. diffusers); Develop one-click presets and use cases for image and video generation; Train LoRAs end-to-end: from real product photography to evaluated, production-ready models; Build control-first generation into every pipeline: ControlNet, IP-Adapter, inpainting, reference conditioning; Engineer QC into the pipeline itself: automated checks against product references, before a human ever reviews; Build our creative intelligence loop: encode what makes our best-performing assets work into reusable presets and styles; Own the technical roadmap with the Design Director; qualify new models and tools; drive adoption through enablement, not mandates. Requirements: Your must haves You don't need to meet every single requirement. If you're excellent in most of these areas and can show shipped work, we'd love to hear from you. Nice to have 3D/render-hybrid workflows: Blender or CAD renders as geometric ground truth with generated environments; LLM orchestration and agentic workflows: automated prompt generation, VLM-based QC; Experience producing visuals for performance marketing. Our client does not just report on data—they build with it, driving marketing decisions for over 1,000 dealer clients across digital and direct channels. They operate on a cloud-native Databricks Lakehouse platform and foster an AI-forward culture where modern tooling accelerates analysis and deployment. The Role As a Data Scientist, you will work primarily inside Databricks building datasets, features, and machine learning models that power marketing intelligence. You will spend your time on data preparation, exploratory analysis, feature engineering, and model training/evaluation, supported by senior engineers and architects on the production side. Key Responsibilities Data & Modeling (80%) - Build and maintain data pipelines and transformations in Databricks using Python, PySpark, and SQL. - Perform exploratory data analysis to understand marketing, campaign, and customer datasets. - Engineer features, prepare training datasets, and train, evaluate, and tune machine learning models. - Support model deployment and monitoring in production alongside senior engineers. - Investigate and resolve data quality issues in source feeds and pipelines. - Leverage AI coding tools efficiently while maintaining code quality and deep understanding. Collaboration & Quality (20%) - Participate in sprint planning, standups, and retrospectives within an Agile/SCRUM framework. - Write tests, data validation checks, and participate in code reviews. - Document datasets, features, model assumptions, and results. - Present findings and recommendations to both technical and business stakeholders. Core Qualifications Required: - Experience: 1-3 years of hands-on experience in data science, machine learning, or analytics engineering (including internships, co-ops, research, or complex projects). - Education: Degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Data Science, or comparable practical experience. - Languages & Core Tooling: Solid proficiency with Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn) and SQL (joins, aggregations, window functions). - Data Science Fundamentals: Solid understanding of supervised learning, train/test splits, feature engineering, cross-validation, and evaluation metrics (ROC AUC, RMSE, precision, recall). - Statistics & Data Handling: Working knowledge of descriptive statistics, hypothesis testing, data profiling, and data cleaning. - Modern Workflow: Proficiency with Git, collaborative development, and AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude, etc.). - Communication: Strong written and spoken English skills to effectively explain complex findings to non-technical audiences. Nice to Have: - Hands-on experience with Databricks (Unity Catalog, clusters, jobs, notebooks) or PySpark. - Exposure to MLflow, Delta Lake (medallion architecture), or Azure cloud services. - Experience with time-series forecasting, uplift modeling, or audience segmentation. - Familiarity with visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, Plotly) or CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps). - Interest in Large Language Models (LLMs) and generative AI applications. Why Apply Through Latino Legends? - Modern Stack: Hands-on experience in Databricks on a modern lakehouse platform with zero legacy code clutter. - Mentorship & Career Growth: Work side-by-side with senior architects who review your code and help you transition from notebook experiments to production-level machine learning. - High Impact: Your models directly inform millions of dollars in active marketing spend. - Distributed Culture: Enjoy a collaborative, cross-border culture across the U.S. and Latin America. Planificar las necesidades de dotación de corto, mediano y largo plazo, identificando posiciones críticas, brechas de talento y capacidades requeridas. Participar en la definición de estructuras organizacionales para operaciones actuales, nuevos proyectos y escenarios de crecimiento. Liderar e impulsar procesos vinculados con Relaciones Laborales, Administración de Personal, Talento, Desempeño, Desarrollo, Compensaciones y Beneficios. Implementar y consolidar procesos y prácticas de RH consistentes y alineados con las necesidades de las distintas operaciones. Liderar y desarrollar al equipo de Recursos Humanos que brinda soporte a los proyectos, fortaleciendo su rol como socio del negocio. Generar y monitorear indicadores de gestión que permitan anticipar necesidades y sustentar la toma de decisiones. Impulsar iniciativas de mejora y transformación de RH, articulando las necesidades de la Operación con la estrategia de Recursos Humanos de la compañía. Requisitos: Requisitos Profesional con más de 8 años de experiencia integral en Recursos Humanos y experiencia liderando equipos. Experiencia previa como Gerente, Jefe/a, HRBP Senior o responsable de RH con fuerte vinculación con Operaciones. Sólida experiencia en Relaciones Laborales y Administración de Personal, complementada con experiencia en procesos de Talento, Desarrollo y gestión estratégica de RH. Experiencia concreta en contextos de planta, proyectos u operaciones. Se valorará especialmente experiencia en Ingeniería y Construcción, Minería, Oil & Gas, Energía, Industria o servicios complejos. Formación universitaria. Se valorarán especialmente carreras con fuerte base analítica y de gestión, como Ingeniería Industrial o Administración de Empresas. La formación específica no será excluyente. Perfil con visión estratégica y orientación al negocio, combinado con una modalidad de trabajo hands-on, capacidad de ejecución, método y orientación a resultados. Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, influencia, negociación y construcción de relaciones con interlocutores de diferentes niveles. Flexibilidad, capacidad de adaptación y habilidad para liderar procesos de cambio construyendo confianza dentro de la organización. Disponibilidad para viajar frecuentemente a las Operaciones.Lugar de TrabajoRosario, con posibilidad de evaluar candidatos residentes en Buenos Aires u otras localidades, siempre que cuenten con disponibilidad para viajar regularmente a Casa Central en Rosario y a los distintos proyectos y operaciones de la compañía.Modalidad de TrabajoModalidad flexible, con una dinámica que combinará presencia hibrida en Casa Central y viajes frecuentes a las Operaciones. Durante la primera etapa se requerirá una mayor presencia en Rosario, pudiendo luego adecuarse la frecuencia de acuerdo con las necesidades del rol y del negocio. Beneficios Se trata de una oportunidad profesional sumamemnte rica e interesante, de asumir un rol protagónico y de alto impacto, con la posibilidad de contribuir activamente a la evolución y profesionalización de Recursos Humanos, acompañando el crecimiento del negocio y co-construyendo un modelo de gestión cada vez más estratégico, sólido y cercano a la Operación.

If you have an entrepreneurial spirit, and a genuine passion for taking on new challenges, this role is for you. descripcion: About Promtior Promtior is at the forefront of the Agentic AI revolution, delivering cutting-edge solutions that transform businesses across industries — bridging technology and people to turn AI into a real competitive advantage. Since 2023, we've helped organizations boost operational efficiency through tailored Agentic AI solutions, from discovery and development to full implementation, across three core lines: AI Product Delivery (predictive analytics, intelligent automation, AI-driven chatbots, image processing), AI Department as a Service (LATAM-based teams that integrate directly with our clients' teams), and AI Adoption Consulting (helping companies find and act on AI opportunities across their business). We're a team held together by genuine relationships, constant exchange, and shared learning. We believe innovation happens when people feel included and collaborate with purpose, and we aim for professional growth to go hand in hand with personal well-being. About the Role We're looking for a Senior AI Engineer with deep hands-on experience building agentic AI systems to join our Engineering team as a technical reference. This is a senior, client-facing position: you will own the technical direction of our agentic solutions end to end, make and defend architecture decisions in front of clients, and raise the technical level of the engineers around you as we scale our global operation. Key Responsibilities You will lead the design and development of production-grade agentic AI systems, defining the architecture of autonomous agents, tool orchestration, and retrieval pipelines, and selecting the right models, tools, and trade-offs for each use case. You will establish evaluation and quality practices for agentic systems — evals, guardrails, observability, and cost and latency optimization — and be accountable for their reliability in production. You will act as the technical counterpart for clients, translating business problems into agentic solutions, running technical discovery, and defending the approach in front of technical stakeholders. descripcion: Why Join dLocal? dLocal is the financial infrastructure powering global commerce in the world's fastest-growing markets. The biggest companies in the world trust us to unlock growth in 60+ countries across emerging markets—moving money where others see complexity. We don't just process payments; we are architects of payment ecosystems and partners in our customers' expansion. You'll work alongside 1,300+ teammates from 40+ nationalities and tackle global challenges from day one. What’s the opportunity? As our Fraud Prevention Analyst II, you will help us shape fraud strategy across industries, balancing loss reduction with conversion and top-tier user experience. You’ll decide when to approve or reject payments, using data, experimentation, and close collaboration with Data Science to improve model features and thresholds. You’ll own KPIs for key clients and verticals, translating their needs into effective controls. A core part of your impact will be streamlining workflows and reducing manual review through smarter rules and tooling. Your work will directly lower chargebacks/claims while protecting revenue and customer trust. What will I be doing? Continuously analyze transactional data to identify emerging fraud patterns and attack vectors Design, test, and iterate rules that minimize fraud while safeguarding conversion and UX Collaborate with Data Science to enhance features, refine model rules, and set optimal scoring thresholds Evaluate and integrate new datasets to improve data quality, coverage, and signal relevance Own KPIs for key clients and industries; meet with their fraud teams to align on goals and solutions Run experiments (A/B, backtesting) to quantify rule/model impact and guide decisions Build clear monitoring (dashboards/alerts) to track performance, drift, and false positives Identify and drive automation opportunities that reduce manual reviews and errors (e.g., auto-tuning thresholds, rule deployment pipelines) Partner with Engineering/Data to implement tooling, integrations, and reporting that accelerate decisioning and incident response What skills do I need? Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Engineering, Statistics, or related field 3+ years in fraud prevention or a closely related risk domain Strong SQL and experience working with large datasets Proven experience with AI/ML in fraud or risk scoring (features, thresholds, model-informed rules) Strong analytical, presentation, and communication skills; able to translate insights into action Automation mindset: comfortable with tools and workflows; familiarity with AWS SageMaker, Athena, or QuickSight is a plus Advanced English (mandatory) What do we offer? Besides the tailored benefits we have for each country, dLocal will help you thrive and go that extra mile by offering you: Flexibility in how you work: We focus on impact and productivity over fixed hours. This means our teams have flexible schedules and, depending on your role and location, you will combine self‑managed focus time with moments of in‑person connection in our collaboration hubs Fintech industry: work in a dynamic and ever-evolving environment, with plenty to build and boost your creativity Referral bonus program: our internal talents are the best recruiters - refer someone ideal for a role and get rewarded Work From Anywhere: Team members can work while traveling for up to 3 months every year What happens after you apply?
